An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport why the Tour de France Femmes 2024 stages in the Netherlands cannot receive national subsidy, while earlier men's Grand Tour stages did, and whether the event could be added to the subsidy ladder. The minister answered that since 2021 the subsidy scheme deliberately excludes events whose ownership lies with a commercial party rather than a European or world federation, that the event therefore cannot apply, and that it will not be added to the ladder.
It is therefore not possible for the Tour de Femmes 2024 to apply for a subsidy under this subsidy scheme.
Het is dus niet mogelijk voor de Tour de Femmes 2024 om een subsidie aan te vragen middels deze subsidieregeling.

An MP asks the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about a news report on athletes losing or having to repay part of their allowance because of earnings rules, and how the rules might be improved. The minister acknowledges the regulation, says its effects vary by individual, and points to an evaluation and a new topsport strategy expected by end 2024, with no definitive proposal yet.
I look forward with interest to the scenarios for a new provision model.

MPs Heerema and Brekelmans asked the ministers about the IOC withdrawing recognition of the boxing body IBA over Russian influence, and whether the Netherlands should back World Boxing and cut ties with the IBA. The minister agreed on excluding Russian athletes, officials and trainers, supported the IOC decision, but said it is not yet clear whether World Boxing will gain Olympic recognition and only committed to keeping in contact with NOC*NSF.
It is currently not yet clear whether World Boxing already has prospects of Olympic recognition; that is a matter for the IOC.
Het is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk of World Boxing al zicht heeft op de Olympische erkenning, daar gaat het IOC over.

MPs Minhas and Heerema asked the state secretary about NS plans to cut some Intercity and Sprinter services between Alkmaar, Haarlem and Amsterdam in the 2024 timetable, the expected ridership, use of the transition compensation, and how regions and the concession will safeguard service levels. The state secretary answered that NS decides the timetable within concession rules, that about 1800 extra trains per week are added overall, that the transition plan is submitted to the ministry, and that the new concession will include tariff differentiation requirements.
It is currently not possible to make the contribution from the 2023 public transport transition compensation scheme transparent, because it depends on actual passenger numbers.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk om de bijdrage uit de regeling transitievergoeding OV (TVOV) 2023 inzichtelijk te maken omdat deze afhangen van de werkelijke reizigersaantallen.

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reports that tobacco companies are investing in medicines for smokers, the 'sjoemelsigaret' (cheat cigarettes) and whether the government will act against them. The state secretary condemned the investments, said legal limits prevent a different measurement method in national rules, and said a College van Beroep ruling is awaited, with the RIVM results to be shared with the European Commission.
As promised, in my letter of 4 July I also informed you of the outcome of external legal research into the possibility of stricter national rules or a different measurement method.
Zoals toegezegd heb ik u in mijn brief van 4 juli jl. tevens op de hoogte gesteld van de uitkomst van extern juridisch onderzoek

The minister answers that good-causes allocation is not a goal of gambling policy, cites the sport allocation figures, and says the matter will be assessed in the Koa law evaluation in 2024 and an exploration due before the 2024 budget debate.
Payment to good causes, however, is not a goal of gambling policy.

The minister acknowledged the risks, outlined about EUR 1 million of planned measures funded from the EUR 200 million Rijks-N-wegen package, noted that the bridges and roads on them are the responsibility of the province and municipality, and said MIRT funds cannot finance new investment decisions.
Implementing road safety measures on the bridges is therefore the responsibility of the municipality.
Het realiseren van verkeersveiligheidsmaatregelen op de bruggen is dan ook de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.

The minister answered that fentanyl-xylazine combinations are not known in the Netherlands, that online sale of prescription veterinary medicines to private persons is prohibited, and that NVWA, IGJ and customs supervise trade, with no need for additional measures at this time.
There is currently no reason for additional measures regarding the veterinary medicine xylazine.

MPs Heerema and Ellian asked whether people with a history of sexual intimidation or abuse should be barred from coaching children, and why sport disciplinary rulings are not factored into VOG screening after the sport register was closed. The minister acknowledged the lack of data linkage, said the Ministry of Justice considers disciplinary rulings unsuitable for VOG screening because they fall outside criminal law, and said the sport register closure is under discussion toward a future integrity centre.
The Ministry of Justice and Security, responsible for VOG screening, considers it undesirable to include disciplinary rulings in VOG screening because disciplinary law falls outside criminal law.

Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, verantwoordelijk voor de VOG screening, acht het niet wenselijk tuchtrechtelijke uitspraken te betrekken bij de VOG screening omdat het tuchtrecht buiten het strafrecht valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heerema over het Warenwetbesluit attractie- en speeltoestellen (WAS)

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether climbing and bouldering walls will be classified as play equipment under the new Warenwetbesluit attractie- en speeltoestellen, and how the sport/play distinction is drawn. The minister answered that the ministry is exploring safety requirements for climbing walls used also for recreation, that climbing walls used only for sport remain outside the decree, and that the boundary between sport and play is being clarified.
The aim of this is to increase the safety of both existing and future facilities.
Het doel hiervan is het verhogen van de veiligheid van zowel bestaande als toekomstige faciliteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heerema over het ‘Nationaal onderzoek toekomstbestendigheid sportclubs’ via de RVVB, Register voor Verenigingsbesturen

An MP asked the minister about the national study on the future resilience of sports clubs by the Register for Association Boards, covering regulatory differences, added rules and burdens, regulatory-burden testing, and local permit treatment. The minister answered that commercial and association sport differ by legal form, that a Sira study on regulatory burden will report before summer, and that local permitting is a local responsibility.
Before the summer, the State Secretary of VWS will send the report to your House.
Voor de zomer zal de Staatssecretaris van VWS het rapport naar uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Brekelmans over het bericht 'ISU brengt Nederland in verlegenheid: Overleg met Russische bondsvoorzitter tijdens WK Afstanden in Heerenveen wekt wrevel’

VVD MPs Heerema and Brekelmans asked the Foreign Minister whether it is acceptable that the Russian skating federation chairman attended an ISU meeting during the World Single Distance Championships in Heerenveen despite calls to exclude Russia and Belarus from international sport. The government replied that the ISU, not the KNSB, was responsible for the invitation, that the KNSB protested in writing, and that international sport is autonomous so it has no means to block such decisions.
The ISU was therefore responsible for the invitation, not the KNSB.
De ISU was dan ook verantwoordelijk voor het uitnodigen, niet de KNSB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'Ruimtegebrek dreigt door extra gymlessen Hardenbergse scholen: 'Vooral in Dedemsvaart''

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about shortages of gym space threatening the new two-hour weekly physical education norm, and whether all municipalities can meet it. The minister answered that municipalities and schools share responsibility, that a follow-up study by VSG is underway, and that schools are expected to meet the norm by the new school year, with the Inspectorate monitoring.
The Inspectorate of Education will also, as part of its broad supervision, monitor sufficient and good physical education.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs zal in het brede toezicht ook toezien op voldoende en goed bewegingsonderwijs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Brekelmans over de berichten ‘Nederlands standpunt Russische sporters’, ‘Aziatische sluiproute voert Russische sporters wellicht alsnog naar Olympische spelen 2024’ en ‘D

MPs Heerema and Brekelmans asked whether the Dutch government will suspend visas for Russian athletes while Russia wages war in Ukraine, and how many visas were issued. The minister answered that two short-stay visas were granted in July 2022 for sports events, that each application is assessed individually under the Schengen visa code, and that no separate visa policy for Russian athletes exists.
There is no separate visa policy for this category of applicants.
Er is geen sprake van apart visumbeleid voor deze categorie aanvragers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Brekelmans over de berichten 'Nederlands standpunt Russische sporters', 'Aziatische sluiproute voert Russische sporters wellicht alsnog naar Olympische spelen 2024', en '

Two VVD MPs asked the government what role it can play in excluding Russian sports officials and sports-governing bodies, and whether it knows the international boxing federation is dominated by Russian officials, sponsored by Gazprom and allows Russian athletes under their own flag. The minister answered that the government has spoken out with international partners, confirmed awareness of these facts, said the Dutch boxing federation will skip certain IBA events, and stated that Dutch athletes will suffer no disadvantage.
I have, together with my international colleagues, expressed myself on this in several statements to international sport.
Ik heb mij samen met mijn internationale collega’s daar in meerdere statements richting de internationale sport voor uitgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Thijs Zonneveld: "Alleen een topsporter voor de klas is niet genoeg"’

An MP asked the minister whether the 'Sporthelden op School' business case and pilot linking top athletes, sports clubs, municipalities and schools is known, and whether it can inform new pilots and the athlete stipend scheme. The minister confirms awareness, agrees that school-sport links can help vulnerable children, but defers concrete decisions on the pilots to an exploration starting in early 2023 and proposes linking the EUR 200,000 stipend amendment funds to top athletes working in schools in 2023.
I cannot yet say anything about that because we are starting the exploration of the further design of these pilots in early 2023.
Daar kan ik nog geen uitspraken over doen omdat we met de verkenning over de nadere invulling van deze pilots in het begin van 2023 starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Heerema over het bericht dat de N9 te smal, te saai en te gevaarlijk is

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about press reports calling the N9 road too narrow, dull and dangerous, and why only parts of the N9 are being made safer. The minister confirmed planned safety measures (tunnel and roundabout at Kogendijk, removal of risky bus stop and bike path), but declined to fund a physical lane separation across the whole N9 because the €200 million budget is prioritised for other road sections.
From the €200 million this cabinet has made available for road safety on national N-roads, funds are therefore being allocated to improve road safety on the N9.
Vanuit de € 200 miljoen die dit kabinet beschikbaar heeft gesteld voor verkeersveiligheid Rijks-N-wegen worden daarom middelen beschikbaar gesteld om de verkeersveiligheid op de N9 te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Bewoners Zeist boos over uitbreidingsplannen KNVB: 'Heel bos moet er voor wijken'

An MP asked the minister for Long-term Care and Sport about residents' opposition to the KNVB's plan to expand its Zeist campus onto nature land, and about the role of Staatsbosbeheer, the value of the campus and comparable facilities abroad. The minister answered that the expansion is a private KNVB initiative for the KNVB and the province of Utrecht to assess, and that Staatsbosbeheer will not sell the land until the zoning change and nature compensation are approved.
However, it is up to the KNVB itself to weigh what is precisely needed for talent development and the Netherlands' international competitive position in the football world.
Het is echter aan de KNVB zelf om een afweging te maken over wat er precies nodig is voor talentontwikkeling en de internationale concurrentiepositie van Nederland in de voetbalwereld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Nederlanders hebben minder vertrouwen in vaccinaties’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about a European survey showing lower Dutch trust in vaccines, and about vaccination rates, youth-group differences, and campaigns. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to a planned trust monitor and a RIVM pulse survey, and said it is too early to judge the effect on vaccination uptake.
I attach great importance to vaccinations and to achieving the highest possible vaccination rate.
Ik hecht zeer aan het belang van vaccinaties en het behalen van een zo hoog mogelijke vaccinatiegraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Erkens over het artikel ‘Directeur Thialf uit in brief aan Tweede Kamer ’zeer grote zorgen’ over voortbestaan’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Thialf ice rink's plans to innovate on sustainability and energy costs, and about sustainability support for sports facilities. The minister confirmed awareness, stated support for sports sustainability through the BOSA scheme and other subsidies, and committed to evaluating and continuing the BOSA scheme from 2024 and to exploring financing structures.
I informed your House about this in advance of the committee meeting on sport on 28 November.
Ik heb uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd voorafgaand aan het WGO sport van 28 november jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rudmer Heerema over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Amsterdam tussen de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) en de Koninklijke Nederlandse Lawn Tennis Bond (KNLTB)

MPs Ellian and Heerema asked the ministers about court rulings on the Dutch data protection authority (AP) and its fine on the KNLTB, including whether a European Commission letter criticising the AP's strict reading of 'legitimate interest' was withheld. The minister answered that the matter is pending before the courts and the CJEU, that the Commission letter was not shared with the cabinet and is confidential within court proceedings, and that the cabinet will not intervene in the independent AP.
Assessing which documents are necessary for resolving a dispute is for the judge, not the cabinet.
De beoordeling welke stukken voor de beslechting van een geschil noodzakelijk zijn, is aan de rechter, niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Erkens ver het artikel 'Amateurclubs rekenen op taaie winter door hoge gasprijzen: ‘Sommige leden douchen júíst hier'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the impact of high gas and energy prices on sports facilities, especially swimming pools and ice rinks, and what support is available. The minister acknowledged the strong impact, cited a Mulier Institute survey and NOC*NSF estimates (including 200 pools at risk of closure), noted a 378 million euro cost increase for 2022-2023, and pointed to sustainability support and ongoing consultations with operators and municipalities.
That is why I asked operators of sports facilities to calculate the size of the cost increase, from which the figure you cited follows.
Daarom heb ik exploitanten van sportaccommodaties gevraagd om een berekening te maken van de omvang van de lastenstijging, waaruit het door u genoemde getal volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Nispen over het artikel 'KVLO: 'Tekort sportaccommodaties brengt bewegingsonderwijs PO in gedrang''

MPs Heerema and Van Nispen asked the minister about a KVLO report warning of too few gymnasium places to deliver two hours of physical education in primary schools, and whether municipalities were using their funds properly and preparing in time. The minister answered that municipalities have no earmarked funds and that the matter is local, that an inventory was done and a communication plan will be drawn up, but gave no figures on the shortfall or on intervention.
Gymnasium capacity is a local matter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de antwoorden op Kamervragen over ondermaatse motoriek basisschoolleerlingen

An MP asked the minister to explain differences between ALO-trained and post-initial HBO-trained physical education teachers, the evidence on their effectiveness, and policy on hiring ALO teachers to address declining motor skills and teacher shortages. The minister answered that both routes give starting competence, that research shows little difference in parent and child satisfaction, that two weekly lessons alone are insufficient for children with serious motor deficits, and that schools decide on staffing while the ministry promotes specialist teachers via funding and a planned survey.
Two hours of physical education per week, however, is not sufficient to bring children with serious motor skill deficits up to a sufficient level.
Twee uur bewegingsonderwijs per week is echter niet voldoende om kinderen met ernstige achterstanden in de motorische vaardigheden op een voldoende niveau te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Het Woud gymt alleen nog buiten, óók als het regent’

An MP asked the minister about a newspaper report that a school gymnasium only offers outdoor PE, and whether schools can meet the two-hour PE requirement without adequate indoor facilities. The minister said outdoor PE is legally permitted, that 53 percent of primary schools gave less than two 45-minute PE lessons, and that a list of municipalities lacking facilities cannot be shared because the research was anonymized, though a sports-facility inventory will be shared before summer.
Sharing a list of these is not possible, because OCW did not carry out the research itself but a research agency did.
Een lijst hiervan delen is niet mogelijk, omdat OCW niet zelf het onderzoek heeft uitgevoerd, maar een onderzoeksbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Formule E-coureurs hopen op race in Eindhoven'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the prospects of a Formula E race in Eindhoven, including contact with the Formula E CEO, the government's role, and the requirements for hosting. The minister replied that the government has no direct contact with the CEO, that the ministry coordinates support across departments via a support letter, and that a concrete plan from the local organiser is still needed.
The priority now is that a concrete plan comes forward, with clarity on the timeline, sound financial justification and involvement of other parties.
Het is nu zaak dat er een concreet plan komt, met daarin duidelijkheid over de planning, een gedegen financiële onderbouwing en betrokkenheid van andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over opmerkingen van buurtsportcoach mevrouw N. Haarman tijdens het rondetafelgesprek ‘bewegingsarmoede’ op 21 februari jl.

An MP asked whether municipalities using neighbourhood sports coaches as physical education teachers, paid under the sports collective agreement rather than the education one, circumvents co-financing duties and should be banned. The minister said the arrangement is undesirable, will discuss it with the municipalities concerned and VSG, and will examine the practice in the upcoming revision of the regulation.
On substance, I find it undesirable if such a construction leads to the neighbourhood sports coach being deployed solely in education.
Inhoudelijk vind ik het onwenselijk als een dergelijke constructie leidt tot enkel de inzet van een buurtsportcoach in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'MQ Scan: 24% van basisschoolleerlingen heeft ondermaatse motoriek; Zorgwekkende piek onder negenjarigen'

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about a press report that 24% of primary pupils have below-average motor skills, and what will be done about it, including gym capacity and whether specialist PE teachers should be mandatory. The minister answered that a statutory two-hour PE requirement from 2023, subsidy schemes and a gym-capacity inventory are underway, but declined to set a threshold for mandatory specialist teachers, citing the labour market and school choice.
As soon as these are available, I will share them with your House.
Zodra deze beschikbaar zijn, zal ik dit met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Verkoopverbod of niet: jongeren kopen massaal snus'

MPs Heerema and Rajkowski asked why snus and nicotine pouches above 0.035 mg remain widely available despite the Dutch sales ban, and what the NVWA is doing about online and social media sales. The State Secretary replied that the NVWA targets importers and websites, has seized stock and pressed importers to stop sales, uses notice-and-take-down on social media, and is intensifying enforcement while awaiting the Digital Services Act.
I am in discussion with the NVWA about how enforcement can be intensified.
Ik ben met de NVWA in gesprek over hoe de handhaving geïntensiveerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rahimi over het bericht ‘Kabinet wil minder fastfoodwinkels in de stad’

MPs Heerema and Rahimi asked whether the government will restrict fast-food outlets, how this fits EU and national rules on freedom of enterprise, and what the preventive agreements and industry commitments achieve. The State Secretary answered that legal options for municipalities to shape the food environment are being explored, subject to EU Services Directive justification, and that industry product-improvement steps are underway.
I am having the options explored to give municipalities more legal tools in this area.
Ik laat de mogelijkheden verkennen om gemeenten op dit vlak daarom meer juridische handvatten te bieden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en El Yassini over de uitzonderingsregeling die de internationale voetbalfederatie FIFA heeft uitgevaardigd betreffende spelers en coaches van Oekraïense voetbalclubs middel

MPs Heerema and El Yassini asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the FIFA exemption for Ukrainian footballers and coaches and whether they need work permits to join Dutch professional clubs. The minister answered that since 1 April 2022 (retroactive to 4 March) Ukrainians under the temporary protection directive are exempt from the work permit requirement, with only an employer notification duty to UWV, and that other cases would follow normal salary and quality criteria.
From 1 April 2022, with retroactive effect from 4 March 2022, an exemption from the work permit requirement applies to refugees from Ukraine who fall under the temporary protection directive.

Per 1 april 2022, met terugwerkende kracht vanaf 4 maart 2022, geldt een vrijstelling van de tewerkstellingsvergunningsplicht voor vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne die onder de richtlijn tijdelijke bescherming vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'De Atletiekunie is succesvol, maar zit in nijpende geldnood'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about a newspaper report that the athletics federation (Atletiekunie) is successful but in financial distress, including why NOC*NSF funding has fallen despite results. The minister answered that the budget is closed and allocation is NOC*NSF's responsibility, that total support has not declined, and that sports federations are making prioritisation choices with a broader sector strategy under discussion.
The allocation of available financial resources across promising top sport programmes is the responsibility of NOC*NSF.
De verdeling van de beschikbare financiële middelen over kansrijke topsportprogramma’s is de verantwoordelijkheid van de NOC*NSF.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Rudmer Heerema over de voorkeur voor de vakleerkracht bewegingsonderwijs

MPs Van Nispen and Rudmer Heerema asked whether all physical education lessons in primary schools should be given by ALO-qualified specialist teachers, including what barriers exist and whether a law change is planned. The minister replied that the current mix of specialist and qualified group teachers should remain, that a full switch is unrealistic given teacher shortages and funding, and that no law change is warranted.
Given the current education labour market, I see no reason to change the law on this point.
Ik zie, gelet op de huidige onderwijsarbeidsmarkt, geen aanleiding om de wet op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Rudmer Heerema en Rajkowski over de verplichte MY2022 app bij de Olympische Spelen

VVD MPs asked whether data from the mandatory MY2022 Olympic app could be used for surveillance, whether it is securely transmitted and shared with third parties, whether the government will press the IOC and Chinese authorities to make it compliant or optional, and what measures the Netherlands will take. The minister answered that the risks fit a broader picture of Chinese data collection, that the app's encryption lacks authenticity checks, that data is shared with Chinese companies, that Dutch athletes are not obliged to use the app but must use the HMS function (which can be used online), that concerns were raised with the Chinese ambassador, and that briefings for NOC*NSF will be repeated.
Our concerns about this app were therefore conveyed to the Chinese ambassador in The Hague prior to the Games.
Onze zorgen over deze app zijn dan ook voorafgaand aan de Spelen overgebracht aan de Chinese ambassadeur in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Peter de Groot en Minhas over woningbouw binnen bestaand stedelijk gebied en de gevolgen voor sportvoorzieningen

MPs from the VVD asked the housing and health ministers whether housing construction in dense cities is squeezing sports facilities, and how municipalities plan space for sport. The minister answered that data on squeezed sports space is unavailable, that no standard norms exist, that he will not mandate a sports paragraph in spatial plans, and that the government will compile examples of multifunctional sports facilities.
A specific obligation regarding including a sports paragraph does not seem desirable given municipalities' own responsibility in this, and in my view is also not necessary.
Een specifieke verplichting m.b.t. het opnemen van een sportparagraaf lijkt niet wenselijk gezien de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten in deze, en is m.i. ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de toekomst van de sportsector

An MP asked the minister about the state of the sports sector's financial recovery, falling sports participation among young people, comparisons with other countries, health effects and consultation with sports bodies. The minister answered that talks with sports federations and NOC*NSF are ongoing, the damage inventory is not finished, and a long-term strategy will follow, but gave no firm dates on several points and declined to compare with other countries.
This inventory has not yet been completed.
Deze inventarisatie is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Grondpersoneel geweerd bij veiligheidsonderzoek Schiphol’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about reports that ground-handling staff were excluded from a state safety and working-conditions study at Schiphol, and about incidents, unreported occurrences and staff shortages. The minister answered that the researchers judged detailed safety-culture insight unnecessary, outlined ILT inspections and incident-reporting efforts, and noted that ILT had handled a small number of staff-shortage reports.
NLR, as lead of the research team, states that during the study it became clear that detailed insight into the degree of safety culture would not contribute to answering the research question.

Het NLR geeft hierover als trekker van het onderzoeksteam aan dat gedurende het onderzoek is gebleken dat gedetailleerd inzicht in de mate van veiligheidscultuur niet zou bijdragen aan het beantwoorden van de onderzoeksvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de beslissing in de bezwaarprocedure met betrekking tot het subsidieverzoek voor de organisatie van de World Gymnaestrada 2023

An MP asked the State Secretary to explain the rejection of the subsidy application for the World Gymnaestrada 2023, its impact, and why the positive advice of the Dutch Sports Council was not followed. The minister answered that the application failed to demonstrate subsidy need, the side events were aimed at participants rather than broader social impact, and the policy conditions were not met, while offering to think along with organisers.
Moreover, the advice of the Dutch Sports Council is not the only deciding factor in reaching a subsidy grant.
Daarnaast is niet enkel het advies van de Nederlandse Sportraad bepalend om tot een subsidieverlening te komen.

Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Van den Berg, Inge van Dijk  en Van der Laan over het volgens het kabinet benodigde onderzoek om de sportsector toe te voegen aan de groep van essentiële sectoren

MPs asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the research needed before adding the sports sector to the essential sectors (per the Van den Berg motion) is finished, and what additional research is still required given existing studies on fitness and sport participation. The minister said the government considers sport a high priority, cites its own consideration of existing studies and OMT advice, and reports that a large part of sport was allowed again from 14 January 2022.
That is why the cabinet has stated that sport is a high priority, even though it does not fall under the definition of essential retail and/or services.
Daarom heeft het kabinet uitgesproken dat sport een hoge prioriteit heeft, ook al valt het niet onder de definitie van essentiële detailhandel en/of dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Rudmer Heerema over de extra reistijd op het traject Alkmaar-Den Haag van NS

MPs Minhas and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary about longer rail travel times between Alkmaar and Den Haag under NS's 2022 timetable, and whether this conflicts with the goal of more frequent trains. The State Secretary replied that NS manages the timetable, that the net benefit for most travellers outweighs the losses for a few tens of passengers, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
I see no reason at this time to intervene as concession grantor in this process.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om als concessieverlener in dit proces te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de nasleep van de storing in het Centraal register uitsluiting kansspelen

An MP asked when the Kansspelautoriteit's evaluation of Cruks start-up problems would be ready, whether all consequences had been mapped, how pre-20 October records were corrected, and how many players were wrongly admitted. The minister replied that the evaluation results are expected by 1 April, that all Cruks records were checked and corrected by 16 November, and that 67 reported players were admitted despite registration, with broader checks of operators' records ordered.
The Kansspelautoriteit expects to have the results available by 1 April at the latest.
De Kansspelautoriteit verwacht uiterlijk 1 april de resultaten beschikbaar te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'Scheuren in wanden vuurtoren Lange Jaap. Groot gebied rondom toren afgesloten, ook de doorgaande weg.'

An MP asked the minister about cracks in the walls of the Lange Jaap lighthouse, why Rijkswaterstaat did not intervene earlier, and how to prevent similar damage elsewhere. The minister acknowledged inadequate maintenance under Rijkswaterstaat's duty of care, announced an external review, a structural-support study and a decision by end January 2022.

To my regret it must be concluded that Rijkswaterstaat did carry out regular inspections and in-depth studies and some repairs, but took no structural measures to counter or limit the degradation of the structure.

Tot mijn spijt moet worden geconcludeerd dat Rijkswaterstaat weliswaar reguliere inspecties en verdiepende onderzoeken heeft uitgevoerd en enkele herstelmaatregelen heeft gedaan, maar geen structurele maatregelen heeft getroffen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Grenzen van baggeren in Waddenzee nabij’

MPs De Vries and Heerema asked the minister about the limits of dredging in the Wadden Sea, the risk that the Natura 2000 dredging volume is exceeded around 2023, and the accessibility of Wadden islands and ports. The minister answered that the Natura 2000 plan caps dredging, monitoring anticipates possible exceedance, and alternative access solutions and a Ameland decision around 2023 are being studied, with a Boontjes evaluation pending.
It is established that the task regarding accessibility is to make mobility sustainable and to continue guaranteeing accessibility in the long term.
Vastgelegd is dat de opgave met betrekking tot bereikbaarheid is om de mobiliteit te verduurzamen en de bereikbaarheid ook op de lange termijn te blijven garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Rudmer Heerema en Peter de Groot over het artikel ‘Onderzoek: riolen en bruggen kwetsbaar voor hackers’ in het Financieel Dagblad op 14 oktober 2021

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that sewer, bridge and lock control systems are vulnerable to hackers, including a case of a good-faith hacker taking over a city sewer system and delayed patching, and what the government has done on patching, procurement, threat sharing and Algemene Rekenkamer recommendations. The minister acknowledges the vulnerabilities, reports no successful attacks or Wbni notifications at Rijkswaterstaat or ProRail in the past two years, and describes existing programmes, regulation and ongoing cooperation, while stating no specific case could be confirmed.
Inquiries show no further information is available about a case of a good-faith hacker who was able to take over the sewer system of a large municipality.
Uit navraag blijkt geen nadere informatie beschikbaar over een casus van een goedwillende hacker die het rioleringssysteem van een grote gemeente kon overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Profronde van Noord-Holland blaast alles af bij gebrek aan politiebegeleiding'

MPs Heerema and others asked whether cycling races are being cancelled for lack of police escorts and what legal rules prevent races without full police escort. The minister answered that no races were cancelled solely for lack of police motorcycle escorts, that no legal rule bars races without police escort, and that an experiment with trained civilian traffic marshals is being examined given existing legal limits.
There is no legal rule that prevents the passage of races without police escort.
Er bestaat geen wettelijke regel die de doorgang van koersen zonder politiebegeleiding verhindert.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Alarmerende verschuivingen'; Succescoach Jac Orie luidt de noodklok over fysieke ontwikkeling nieuwe generatie sporters’

An MP asked the state secretary about reported declines in youth physical development, its effects on health and elite sport, and the government's response, including physical education and monitoring of funds. The government acknowledged a downward trend in motor skills, said no studies link it to elite sport careers, and pointed to subsidies, a RIVM study on care costs, and a broad-development approach.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heerema over het bericht ‘Motoriek basisschoolkinderen verslechterd door coronalockdown’

An MP asked the minister about reports that children's motor skills worsened during the COVID lockdown, including how many schools skipped physical education, how lost PE hours are being tracked and caught up, and the future care costs. The minister answered that schools are responsible for PE and motor catch-up, that no central monitoring exists, that home activity explains most differences, and that a RIVM study on care costs is pending.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van der Woude over het boek ‘Amalia, de plicht roept’ van Peter Rehwinkel

MPs asked whether a crown heir marrying a same-sex partner would have to give up the throne, and whether that fits current norms and what it means for their children's eligibility. The government answered that a crown heir may marry a same-sex partner and need not renounce the throne, while noting the constitutional succession system sits in tension with modern family law and that the child question should be addressed in a future consent law.
The cabinet therefore does not see that a crown heir or the King would have to renounce the throne if they wished to marry a partner of the same sex.
Het kabinet ziet dus niet dat een troonopvolger of de Koning afstand zou moeten doen van de troon wanneer hij/zij zou willen trouwen met een partner van hetzelfde geslacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Aukje de Vries en Grinwis over het bericht op NOS.nl getiteld ‘Spoorbrug over Van Harinxmakanaal bij Leeuwarden nog wekenlang defect’

MPs Heerema, De Vries and Grinwis asked the minister about a defect that left the Leeuwarden railway bridge over the Van Harinxmakanaal unable to open for shipping for weeks, its causes, repair timeline, communication, inspection frequency, and whether a replacement study is needed. The minister and state secretary answered that the bridge was repaired and reopened in early October, that ProRail sees no need for early replacement or a quickscan, and that inspections and repair costs were addressed.
ProRail did its utmost to restore the functioning of the railway bridge as quickly as possible and was in constant contact with the ministry, the province and the municipality.
ProRail heeft haar uiterste best gedaan de werking van de spoorbrug zo spoedig mogelijk te herstellen en heeft daarbij voortdurend in contact gestaan met het ministerie, de provincie en de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Dijk gaat schuiven, weilanden in Reeuwijk onder water’

MPs Valstar and Rudmer Heerema asked the government about a dike subsidence in Reeuwijk that farmers attribute to American crayfish burrowing, and about control of invasive crayfish. The minister answers that the cause is not yet established and that crayfish burrowing seems unlikely to be the main cause, that a national strategy process is underway, and that recreational or volunteer fishing for crayfish is not advisable.
According to the water manager, Hoogheemraadschap van Rijnland, it is currently unclear what caused this dike subsidence.
Het is volgens de waterbeheerder, het Hoogheemraadschap van Rijnland, op dit moment niet duidelijk wat de oorzaak is van deze dijkverzakking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Winair bungelt aan randje faillissement'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Rudmer Heerema asked the ministers about the risks of a Winair bankruptcy for connectivity to Saba and Sint Eustatius, the financial exposure of the Netherlands, support requests, and the governance of the state shareholding. The minister answered that Winair is the only scheduled carrier to those islands, that the Netherlands has only a hypothecary loan secured on the hangar, that a steunverzoek is under review with the primary responsibility resting with Sint Maarten, and that the shareholding is being evaluated with a letter promised later this year.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform your House.
Zodra daarover meer bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'NS wil kaartjesloket op stations Alkmaar, Hilversum en Hoorn sluiten. De provincie Noord-Holland probeert daar een stokje voor te steken'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the government would intervene to prevent NS from closing ticket counters at Alkmaar, Hilversum and Hoorn stations, and what this means for public transport accessibility. The government answers that closures are NS's operational responsibility, that alternative services remain available, and that NS will be held to account under the concession only if accessibility or satisfaction is harmed.
The consideration regarding the ticket service counters is an operational responsibility of NS.
De afweging met betrekking tot de ticketservicebalies is een operationele verantwoordelijkheid van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘PricoH stopt met Kwadraatonderwijs. Ouders reageren verbijsterd: ‘Dit is een grote ramp’’

An MP asked the minister whether a Hoogeveen school board's plan to close its gifted-education (Kwadraat) department, leaving 17 pupils without alternatives, was correct and how thuiszitters would be prevented. The minister answered that the department will continue with a different financing arrangement paid by the regional partnership, and that the remaining questions were not currently at issue, while describing general support measures and monitoring.
The Kwadraat department will not be closed (see the answer to question 1).
De Kwadraatafdeling zal niet worden gesloten (zie beantwoording vraag 1).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'School duwt kinderen ongevraagd uit de kast'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister how he assesses reports that the Gomarus school in Gorinchem pressured LGBTI pupils to come out and detained them, and whether this conflicts with the Dutch school safety and citizenship duties. The minister called the reports unacceptable, said the Inspectorate is investigating with results expected by summer 2021, and declined to pre-empt that investigation, while noting that schools may hold a traditional marriage view provided the school culture meets the basic values.
The Inspectorate is examining the extent to which the school safeguards pupils' safety and whether legal requirements such as the citizenship duty and the Social Safety at School Act are met.
De inspectie onderzoekt in hoeverre de school de veiligheid van leerlingen waarborgt en of aan wettelijke eisen als de burgerschapsopdracht en de Wet sociale veiligheid wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat een fout in de nieuwe gokwet zorgt voor meer risico op matchfixing

An MP asked whether the Wwft reporting regime (unusual transactions go to the FIU-Nederland, not directly to sports bodies) weakens sports bodies' information position on matchfixing, and what the government will do. The minister replies that event-level signals still reach the SBIU and sports bodies, that the sport's position has not worsened, and that a 'fast lane' for FIU information sharing will be set up, but rejects amending the Wwft.
All in all, I conclude that the information position of the sport has not worsened.
Ik concludeer al met al dat de informatiepositie van de sport niet slechter is geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Tielen over een bericht op Nu.nl met de titel ‘Sportclubs lopen miljoenen euro’s mis door ‘weeffout’ in NOW regels’

MPs Heerema and Tielen asked whether the NOW 3 wage-subsidy rule, which uses June 2020 as the reference month, unfairly excludes sports clubs and seasonal employers, and whether it can be fixed as was done for NOW 1 and 2. The minister defends June as the reference month to limit abuse and operational risk, says changing it now is not feasible, notes that some sports clubs can claim through the TASO scheme instead, and does not provide the requested data on rejected applications.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Reddingsbrigade Nederland maakt zich ernstige zorgen over start zomerseizoen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Ministers of Medical Care and Infrastructure about the Reddingsbrigade's concerns over lifeguard preparation for summer and the impact of pool closures on children's swimming lessons. The Minister answered that swimming lessons for children up to 12 have resumed, that the Reddingsbrigade may now train if commissioned by safety regions, and that a meeting with the brigade has taken place.
This conversation has now taken place and the Reddingsbrigade has the opportunity to practise and provide training in the context of water safety.
Inmiddels heeft dit gesprek plaatsgevonden en heeft de Reddingsbrigade de mogelijkheid om te oefenen en opleidingen te verzorgen in het kader van de waterveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Leraar Khalid A. had meiden dansschool ‘volledig in de greep’: ‘Naar de top in ruil voor seks’'

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether a dance teacher who allegedly abused girls was able to act for so long, whether screening tools suffice to keep abusers out of sports and youth settings, and what the 15 million euro structural funding for sex-crime capacity has achieved. The government answered that it cannot comment on ongoing criminal investigations, relies on the VOG screening and the abuser register, sees no added value in a dedicated prosecutor for cross-database pattern searches, and reports about 90 new detectives phased in.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de verzamelbrief moties en toezeggingen primair en voortgezet onderwijs

An MP asked the minister about the Inspectorate's partial funding suspension of the Jewish school Cheider over social safety, sex and worldview education, and finances, and whether sanctions are meant to force rapid compliance. The minister confirmed the facts, explained that funding suspension aims to restore compliance, and said the court suspended the sanction pending objection proceedings, with the board responsible for pupil safety in the meantime.
The judge suspended the sanction decisions until six weeks after the decision(s) on objection.
De rechter heeft de sanctiebesluiten geschorst tot zes weken na de beslissing(en) op bezwaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Fors meer scholieren geschorst voor wapenbezit op school

MPs asked the ministers about the rise in school suspensions for weapon possession, the number of police reports by schools, and whether schools can check pupils and what sanctions apply. The minister confirmed the increase is worrying, cited rising suspension counts and police incident figures, said no data explain the rise, and pointed to the existing Actieplan Wapens en Jongeren for local cooperation with youth work.
Police systems cannot automatically generate how many schools have filed reports.
Antwoord 4 Uit de politiesystemen valt niet automatisch to genereren door hoeveel scholen aangifte is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ''Illegale pokeravonden in de voetbalkantine: 'Dan is dus je hele club naar de Filistijnen''

MPs Heerema and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked how the government will tackle criminal interference in amateur sports clubs and what steps it will take. The minister answers that a broad study confirmed such interference, points to existing cooperation (RIEC's, awareness campaigns, planned guidance and local sports agreements) and says criminal law is a last resort, while not answering question 8 about the committee meeting.
I therefore want to examine whether additional information campaigns could play a role here.
Ik wil dan ook bezien of extra voorlichting hier een rol kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Slob: verklaringen die homoseksuele identiteit afwijzen gaan te ver'

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether schools may be barred from issuing statements rejecting homosexuality, how this fits with his remarks in a debate, and what he will do if schools still use such statements. The minister answered that discrimination of pupils on sexual orientation is already prohibited under the Equal Treatment Act and school duty of care, that he found some old statements, that the inspectorate will act, and that no new legislation is needed.
No school in the Netherlands may condemn or reject pupils on the basis of their sexual orientation.
Geen enkele school in Nederland mag leerlingen veroordelen of afwijzen op basis van hun seksuele gerichtheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over ‘Raadsel rond nieuwbouw Avicenna College: ‘2,5 miljoen euro aan belastinggeld verdwenen’’

An MP asked the minister about the Rotterdam audit finding that the Avicenna College new building cost EUR 2.5 million less than budgeted, alleged sharing of the remainder between board and builder, inspectorate oversight, and whether board members can found a new school in The Hague. The minister said the municipality decides on conclusions from the audit, the inspectorate monitors lawful spending but not municipal housing funds, and the inspectorate will follow the school closely with a repair investigation in autumn 2021, while founding approval rests on legal conditions and new eligibility rules apply.
The research results give the inspectorate reason to critically follow developments at Avicenna College through a supervision plan, progress meetings and a repair investigation in autumn 2021.

De onderzoeksresultaten zijn voor de inspectie reden om de ontwikkelingen bij het Avicenna College kritisch te volgen door middel van een toezichtsplan, voortgangsgesprekken en een herstelonderzoek in het najaar van 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Cameraploeg PowNed belaagd door leerling Emmauscollege in Rotterdam’

MPs El Yassini and Heerema asked the Minister about reports that a PowNed camera crew was attacked by a pupil at the Emmauscollege in Rotterdam, including whether security intervened and what sanctions the school imposed. The Minister answered that a suspect was arrested, the criminal investigation is ongoing, the school provides support and sanctions for the minor, and that harassing journalists is unacceptable.
The criminal investigation is still ongoing, so I cannot yet make a statement about this case.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek loopt nog, waardoor ik over deze zaak nog geen uitspraak kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Utrecht moet vervoer naar islamitische school in Amsterdam betalen'

An MP asked the minister whether transport cost rules for pupils should exclude schools rated very weak or harmful by the inspectorate, and why the government will not tighten the 'closest accessible school' rule. The minister replied that school performance is not a condition in the law, parents choose the school, and the inspectorate and minister handle failing schools instead.
It is up to the Inspectorate of Education to determine whether a school meets the legal requirements and to issue remedial orders in case of shortcomings.
Het is aan de inspectie van het onderwijs om vast te stellen of een school aan de wettelijke eisen voldoet en bij tekortkomingen herstelopdrachten te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Docenten Emmauscollege bedreigd om spotprent na aandacht voor moord op Samuel Paty'

An MP asked the minister about threats against teachers at a Rotterdam school after a satirical cartoon was shown in class following the Samuel Paty killing. The minister condemned the threats, confirmed a police report and support from the inspectorate and a school safety foundation, and said schools and teachers will be supported but gave no new structural measures.
It is completely unacceptable that a teacher has been intimidated and threatened for wanting to convey the value of free speech to his pupils.
Het is volstrekt onacceptabel dat een leraar is geïntimideerd en bedreigd omdat hij de waarde van het vrije woord wil overbrengen op zijn leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Jonge meiden over feestjes bij hockeytrainers: ‘Megaveel drank en dan bed in lokken’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Rudmer Heerema asked about press reports of sexual misconduct by hockey coaches and what could keep such coaches out of sport, including data-sharing powers and a dedicated prosecutor. The minister answered that the government supports sports bodies' prevention efforts, screening tools such as the VOG and the disciplinary registry, and reporting campaigns, but declined to extend the football violence law or appoint a special prosecutor.
No. The Football Violence Measures Act grants powers to mayors, public prosecutors and criminal judges to prevent disturbances of public order.

Nee. De Wet Maatregelen bestrijding voetbalvandalisme en ernstige overlast kent bevoegdheden toe aan burgemeesters, officieren van justitie en strafrechters die zij kunnen inzetten ter voorkoming van verstoringen van de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Directeur Avicenna College moet terugtreden'

An MP asked the minister about press reports on governance failures and poor education quality at Avicenna College, including the director's role, the inspectorate's oversight and a new school application in The Hague. The minister replied that an external expert's recommendations are being adopted, an interim board is being appointed with a new supervisory board, the inspectorate is investigating both governance and quality, and the Hague school approval stands while SIVOR must first fix Rotterdam.
At the same time, the school has the full attention of the Inspectorate of Education.
Tegelijkertijd heeft de school de volle aandacht van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Ruim de helft van de basisschoolleerlingen heeft vanwege coronamaatregelen drie maanden geen gymles gehad’

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether schools met the two-hour weekly physical education requirement after COVID-19 closures left many pupils without gym, and what would be done about resulting motor-skill deficits and compliance after summer. The minister said the inspectorate monitors via signals and would intervene if needed, schools can use catch-up funding, and the government will stay in dialogue on post-summer continuity.

When the inspectorate, for example following signals, establishes that a school does not comply with the current legal framework, it will address the school or board and, if necessary, issue a remedial order.

Wanneer de inspectie, bijvoorbeeld naar aanleiding van signalen, vaststelt dat een school zich niet aan de huidige wettelijke kaders houdt, dan zal zij de school of het bestuur daarop aanspreken en volgt zo nodig een herstelopdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Voetbaltv daagt privacywaakhond AP voor de rechter om uitblijven besluit’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the Dutch privacy regulator AP taking VoetbalTV to court over its failure to issue a decision, and about inconsistent GDPR enforcement across EU states. The minister answered that the AP acts independently, that consistency is pursued via the EDPB, that a decision is now before the court so the AP cannot comment on its content, and that the matter will be raised with the AP after the summer recess.
Under Article 52 of the GDPR, each supervisory authority acts with complete independence in performing its tasks and exercising its powers under the regulation.

Op grond van artikel 52 van de AVG treedt elke toezichthoudende autoriteit volledig onafhankelijk op bij de uitvoering van de taken en de uitoefening van de bevoegdheden die haar overeenkomstig deze verordening zijn toegewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘schrappen eindtoets groep 8 kan ongelijkheid vergroten’

An MP asks the education minister about a CPB report warning that scrapping the basic-school final test (eindtoets) may disadvantage around 14,000 pupils, especially those from lower-income or lower-educated or migrant families, who would miss a higher school recommendation. The minister accepts the CPB conclusions, points to schools' professional judgement, the April 2020 letter urging schools to place pupils generously, and planned monitoring and a new school-advice handbook, but does not adopt mandatory rules.
For this reason I have asked primary and secondary schools to pay attention to pupils who may not enter at a level that suits their abilities in school year 2020/2021.

Om die reden heb ik bij scholen in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs aandacht gevraagd voor leerlingen die in schooljaar 2020/2021 mogelijk niet instromen op een niveau dat past bij hun capaciteiten en mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Turncoach Gerrit Beltman verbreekt stilzwijgen over zijn onmenselijke trainingsmethoden

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care (VWS) about coach Gerrit Beltman's admitted abuse of young gymnasts and the KNGU's response. The minister condemned the conduct, said VWS funds independent research, pledged support for follow-up with the CVSN, described existing VOG and registration-list screening, and noted the KNGU suspended a Team NL program with six coaches pending the investigation.
That is why the Ministry of VWS is funding independent research into the nature, scale and approach of boundary-crossing behaviour in gymnastics.
Daarom financiert het Ministerie van VWS het onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de aard, omvang en aanpak van grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de turn- en gymsport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over “bijlagen bij WOB verzoek goedkeuring SIVOR”

An MP asked the minister whether the Islamic secondary school foundation SIVOR's application was rejected because its enrolment forecast fell below the foundation norm, whether DUO's forecasting software contained errors, and whether the ministry adjusted the application in the applicant's favour. The minister confirmed the software errors were corrected and the application assessed as submitted, while explaining that DUO's control forecast can revise forecasts up or down and that application rules are applied equally.
The errors in the calculation module have been corrected, after which a correct forecast was used to assess this application.
De fouten in de rekenmodule zijn gecorrigeerd, waarna alsnog een juiste prognose is gebruikt voor de beoordeling van deze aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht over de sluiting van basisschool De Fontein te Lelystad

An MP asked the education minister about the closure of primary school De Fontein in Lelystad, including parents' ability to choose a school during COVID-19 and whether closure could be postponed one year. The minister confirmed contact with the school, said no generic exemption from the closure norm would be granted, and noted the school had decided to close and pupils were being placed elsewhere.
I see no reason for a generic exception to grant schools a one-year postponement due to the coronavirus crisis.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een generieke uitzondering om scholen een jaar uitstel te verlenen in verband met de coronacrisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over misstanden bij het Haga Lyceum

An MP asks the minister about governance failures at the Haga Lyceum, including the alleged wiretapping of the Inspectorate during its investigation, the board crisis, and whether the school should be closed. The minister answers that the inspectorate could complete its work, that the court ordered two of three board members to step down, that a special intervention (aanwijzing) is being pursued, and that closure is not the aim.
The inspectorate is currently conducting a new investigation at the Cornelius Haga Lyceum and into the board.
De inspectie voert momenteel opnieuw onderzoek uit bij het Cornelius Haga Lyceum en naar het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Macron gaat buitenlandse imams weren’

MPs Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Heerema asked the government about France's plan to restrict foreign imams, about radical religious influence in Dutch neighbourhoods, closing institutions, foreign-trained imams, an imam certification system, an imam training programme, informal education oversight and French-language rules in schools. The minister answered that the government will act against antidemocratic conduct without targeting any religion, points to a taskforce and a bill on dissolving legal persons, and promises an exploratory report on informal education before summer.
Due to signals of possible antidemocratic or intolerant elements within a number of organisations offering informal education, I have announced a broad exploration.
Vanwege signalen van mogelijke antidemocratische of onverdraagzame elementen binnen een aantal organisaties die informele scholing aanbieden, heb ik een brede verkenning aangekondigd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Vuurwapens, explosieven en cocaïne: schoolkoepels slaan alarm over criminele leerlingen' en de uitzending van Jinek van 21 februari 2020

MPs Heerema and Van Wijngaarden asked ministers about reports that school federations see rising serious incidents involving weapons and drugs, underreporting to police, and conflicting ministerial statements on filing criminal complaints. The government says there is no national incident registry, points to the Veiligheidsmonitor and existing police and municipal partnerships, stresses the importance of filing complaints for serious offences, and promises to discuss cooperation with partners and to publish the evaluation of the Wet veiligheid op school in summer 2020.
There is no national registration of the number of incidents that have occurred at schools.
Er is geen landelijke registratie van het aantal incidenten dat zich op scholen heeft voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ''Middelbare scholen: neem het maatwerkdiploma serieus''

MPs Heerema and Wiersma asked the education ministers about reports that pupils with a mixed-level (maatwerk) secondary diploma struggle to gain access to university or higher vocational study, and about related pilots and rules. The ministers answered that current routes exist for such pupils, that a broader review of mixed-level diplomas will be sent to parliament before summer, and that the experiment group and admission rules are being examined.

We are currently working on our policy response to the study on the advantages and disadvantages of diplomas with subjects at different levels in combination with access to further education, as mentioned in the coalition agreement.

Momenteel werken wij aan onze beleidsreactie op het onderzoek naar «voor- en nadelen van diploma’s met vakken op verschillende niveaus i.c.m. toegankelijkheid van het vervolgonderwijs»» uit het regeerakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het bericht ‘KNLTB in beroep tegen uitspraak AP’ en ‘Boete voor tennisbond vanwege verkoop van persoonsgegevens’

MPs Heerema and Van Gent asked the ministers about the Dutch data protection authority's fine on the KNLTB tennis federation for selling personal data and its interpretation of 'legitimate interest' under the GDPR, including whether the fine was proportionate and why no alternative intervention was used. The minister answered that the GDPR is binding EU law, that the AP acts independently and cannot be instructed, that the KNLTB's appeal is pending so details cannot be given, and that the sports sector will draft new guidelines by mid-2020.
It is for the AP to impose a proportionate sanction; it makes its own independent assessment in this.
Het is aan de AP om een proportionele sanctie op te leggen, zij maakt hierin onafhankelijk haar eigen afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Ouders klagen nu ook in Amsterdam over School voor Persoonlijk Onderwijs‘

An MP asks the Minister about parent complaints at School voor Persoonlijk Onderwijs (SvPO) branches, including the inspectorate's handling of signals, the Utrecht 'zeer zwak' rating, governance, medezeggenschap, and sanctions. The Minister answers at length, describing inspectorate reports, the legal procedures, a planned broad inspection investigation, and that sanctions will be considered after that report.
I will await the inspectorate's report and then consider whether further measures are necessary and desirable.
Ik wacht de rapportage van de inspectie af en zal dan bezien of verdere maatregelen nodig en wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Geschiedenisles over de Holocaust op een diverse school: ‘soms lastige vragen’

Two VVD MPs asked the education minister about a report that teaching the Holocaust in diverse schools is sometimes difficult, whether the mandatory Holocaust curriculum is taught everywhere, and how teachers are supported. The minister answered that schools are obliged to teach the Holocaust but decide how, that the inspectorate does not monitor every school, that teachers can use School and Veiligheid training, and that the citizenship bill does not regulate content.
It is important that every pupil learns about the atrocities that took place during the Second World War.
Het is van belang dat elke leerling leert over de verschrikkingen die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse school is 5600 euro parkeergeld kwijt per docent’

An MP asked the minister about reported parking costs for teachers in Amsterdam, whether schools compensate them, and whether cities should be allowed unorthodox measures such as free parking or a city allowance. The minister said no data exist on parking costs or compensation, noted the sums are a maximum scenario and that parking policy is a local matter, and said he would not commit to a city allowance but declined to direct municipalities.
No data are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Studies niet toegerust op hoogbegaafd talent’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that higher education is not equipped for gifted students, and whether schools may charge parents for gifted-student provision and what action is taken against them. The minister acknowledges uneven provision, points to a subsidy scheme funding 139 partnerships, says there is no overview of gifted students or of costs, and states that voluntary parental contributions are legally allowed with inspectorate oversight and sanctions.
I have no overview of the number of gifted students who do or do not receive appropriate provision.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal hoogbegaafde studenten dat wel of geen passend aanbod krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Rudmer Heerema over de nieuwe dienstregeling van de NS

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about the new NS timetable from December 2019, including shorter Alkmaar connections, intercity service during peak hours, rolling stock and overcrowding at Beverwijk. The minister answered that travel times improved, that NS sets the timetable within the concession and that it will introduce newer rolling stock in 2021, while regretting the overcrowding.
NS is responsible for drawing up the timetable on the main rail network, including weighing sprinters against intercity services or a direct connection.

NS is verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen van de dienstregeling op het hoofdrailnet, inclusief de afweging tussen het rijden van sprinters of intercity's of het rijden van een rechtstreekse verbinding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Islamitisch onderwijs groeit: aantal leerlingen in tien jaar tijd met 60 procent toegenomen’

An MP asked the minister about the reported growth of Islamic education, Cito scores of Islamic schools, underperforming schools, the use of the book 'Help ik word volwassen', and the value of diverse schools. The minister answered that religious denomination is not tracked as a growth factor, that the Inspectorate rates only two of 59 Islamic primary schools as weak or insufficient, that the schools' freedom of education is constitutionally protected, and that civic education duties apply to all schools.
It is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Bijna honderd miljoen gaat in 25 jaar naar vernieuwing Tilburgse middelbare scholen’

An MP asked the minister about reports that Tilburg secondary schools must fund a large share of building renewal, and whether municipalities use education housing funds from the municipal fund for other purposes. The minister answered that municipal funds are unearmarked and that schools may contribute to new buildings, while proposing legal clarification of responsibilities for school buildings.
The funds municipalities receive from the municipal fund are not earmarked and therefore fall under municipalities' policy and spending freedom.
De middelen die de gemeenten uit het gemeentefonds ontvangen zijn niet geoormerkt en vallen daardoor onder de beleids- en bestedingsvrijheid van gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Rudmer Heerema over de berichten ‘Neergeschoten vrouw in Alkmaar teisterde buurt al jaren: “Tweehonderd meldingen gemaakt”’ en ‘Door politie doodgeschoten vrouw (48) liep in

MPs Regterschot and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary about news reports that a 48-year-old woman with confused behaviour, shot dead by police in Alkmaar, had generated many prior reports to housing, police and mental health services, and whether earlier intervention was possible. The government answered that the figure of hundreds of reports was not recognised, that agencies acted per national guidelines, that the incident was complex and not preventable, that a stronger person-centred approach and triage are planned, and that a local rather than national approach is preferred.
It is not customary to go into detail on an individual case such as this one.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om gedetailleerd in te gaan op een individuele casus, zoals deze.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Nijkerken-de Haan en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘schorsing om herkenbare leerlingen in bescherming te nemen’ en ‘drie jongens opgepakt voor mishandeling Gorinchem’

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Education ministers why students filmed in a violent assault in Gorinchem were suspended rather than arrested, whether the schools protected perpetrators, and whether parents should lose child benefit, plus questions on youth gangs and the number of suspects. The minister answered that police arrested fourteen suspects under sixteen, all six incidents were reported, suspensions were to protect school calm, child benefit cannot be cut for under-sixteens, no national overview of youth gangs exists, and he will report on administrative approaches to street terror before the recess.
Due to the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot make further statements about this case.
In verband met het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘70 amateurvoetbalclubs zien signalen van criminaliteit op de vereniging’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that 70 amateur football clubs see signs of criminal interference, and what action is planned. The minister acknowledged the signals as worrying, announced a joint investigation with the Health and Sport Minister into criminal interference in sports clubs, and pointed to prevention measures such as governance coaching and the Code Goed Bestuur.
Together with the Minister for Medical Care and Sport, I am going to conduct research into the interference of criminals in sports associations.
Samen met de Minister van Medische Zorg en Sport ga ik onderzoek doen naar de inmenging van criminelen bij sportverenigingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Allah verafschuwt seks tussen mensen van het eigen geslacht’

MPs Wiersma and Rudmer Heerema asked the Minister about reported Islamic school teaching materials that reportedly condemn same-sex relations, questioning whether the Inspectorate of Education should have acted and whether it has sufficient expertise and powers. The Minister answers that the Inspectorate has been asked to investigate, that schools must operate within democratic rule-of-law values with sanctions possible, but largely defers judgment until the Inspectorate's report and notes the publisher will review the method with external experts.
Following the reporting, I informed your House that I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to conduct further investigation into this case.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) heb gevraagd om nader onderzoek te doen naar deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Burgemeesters op de bres voor kortebaandraverijen'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the impact of the Wet Kansspelen op afstand and the gambling tax change on short-track harness racing organisations, including possible compensation and whether the sector will survive. The government answered that the wetswijziging will likely lower payouts to the sector, that compensation talks are ongoing with implementation expected 1 January 2021, and that it could not provide a ten-year overview of race numbers.
We do not have the requested overview of developments over the past ten years.
Wij beschikken niet over het gevraagde overzicht van de ontwikkelingen in de afgelopen tien jaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over het bericht van Innovo dat iemand die eerder aan de pabo is begonnen niet voor een zijinstroomtraject in aanmerking komt

Three VVD MPs asked whether someone who started but did not finish the pabo (primary teacher training) is blocked from the zij-instroom (career-changer) teaching route, and whether the rule should be lifted. The minister answered that eligibility requires a completed higher education degree, that the person may be able to start a shortened part-time programme, and that he does not intend to change the degree requirement.
I do not intend to change the condition that a career-changer must have a higher education diploma, which appears to be the problem in this situation.
Aan de voorwaarde dat een zijinstromer een ho-diploma moet hebben, wat in deze situatie het probleem lijkt, wil ik niet tornen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Banken dreigen rekening Haga Lyceum te blokkeren’

An MP asked the education minister whether schools can receive lump-sum funding on foreign bank accounts and whether this could be banned, after reports that banks threatened to block the Haga Lyceum's account. The minister replied that all Dutch secondary schools hold Dutch accounts (except three in the Caribbean Netherlands), no urgent need for new rules exists, and schools account for spending via annual reports and audits.
At present all secondary schools in the Netherlands have a Dutch bank account and there is no acute need for new laws or regulations on this point.
Antwoord 2 Op dit moment hebben alle vo-scholen in Nederland een Nederlandse bankrekening 2 en ontbreekt een acute noodzaak tot nieuwe wet- en regelgeving op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht in het Noord-Hollands Dagblad op 9 juli 2019  ‘Vernieuwing Leeghwaterbrug opnieuw maanden vertraagd’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported months of delay in replacing the Leeghwater bridge in Alkmaar, covering the cause, safety, damages to businesses and when the bridge will be finished. The minister said the province of Noord-Holland is responsible and the municipality is permit-giver and supervisor, that a province letter will largely answer the questions, and that the ministry will be kept informed.
This bridge and the works on this bridge fall under the responsibility of the province of Noord-Holland.
Deze brug en de werkzaamheden aan deze brug vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Noord Holland.
