Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat AZ aan een ramp is ontsnapt

MPs Koerhuis and Rudmer Heerema asked the Minister of Interior about the roof collapse at the AZ stadium, including inspection of stadium roofs, expertise support for municipalities and the sequencing of the Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen. The minister answered that the cause is still unknown pending investigations, that building owners and municipalities bear inspection duties, and that pilot projects for higher consequence classes are being explored.
At this moment it is still unclear what caused the roof of the AZ stadium to collapse.
Op dit moment is nog onduidelijk wat de oorzaak is geweest van het instorten van het dak van het AZ-stadion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Kwint over het bericht ‘Sportende kinderen maken teveel herrie: sluiting sportveld dreigt na veertig jaar’

MPs Heerema and Kwint asked the minister about a Nijmegen primary school's sports field facing closure over noise complaints from neighbours, questioning the investment, the noise-based closure, and possible guidance for schools. The minister replied that the municipality is responsible for local matters, the closure procedure has been paused for joint talks, and no guidance document for schools is considered necessary.
How this is shaped within the legal framework is a local matter.
Hoe dit binnen de wettelijke kaders wordt vormgegeven is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Docent DaCapo in Sittard-Geleen weg na ongepaste mails aan leerlinge'

An MP asked the education minister about a teacher dismissed for inappropriate messages to a student who then could work elsewhere, and whether a teaching register or other measures could prevent such teachers returning to classrooms. The minister answered that screening staff is the employer's responsibility, that the register is no longer being pursued, and that teachers must maintain a safe school climate, without committing to a new barrier.
Screening and hiring staff is the responsibility of an employer.
Het screenen en aannemen van personeel is de zaak van een werkgever.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ’Lerarentekort? In Brabant zitten 300 basisschoolleraren in de WW’

MPs Heerema and Wiersma asked why hundreds of qualified primary-school teachers in Brabant are on unemployment benefits while schools face a teacher shortage, and whether UWV should be obliged to match them to vacancies. The minister acknowledges the problem, describes re-integration efforts via the Participatiefonds and regional coordinators, provides a provincial table, and says a research report will be sent before summer without committing to a UWV obligation.
I agree that employers and job seekers must be able to find each other and that the parties with a role in the education labour market must do everything to ensure this happens.

Ik ben het met u eens dat werkgevers en werkzoekenden elkaar moeten kunnen vinden en dat de partijen die een rol vervullen op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt er alles aan moeten doen om ervoor te zorgen dat dit ook gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Kan ik meer verdienen met hetzelfde werk in het PO?’

An MP asked the minister about a KVLO article on PE teachers in primary education placed through staffing agencies or sports service bureaus, which may earn less and change more often than school-employed teachers, and whether schools pay more through such arrangements. The minister answered that no general or national data are available on contract types, pay or agency profits, that the equal-pay rule for hired workers applies, and that he is consulting the PO-Raad and KVLO to raise the issue with their members.
With the information available to me, it is not possible to make general statements about the distribution of the different types of appointments schools make with their teachers.
Met de informatie die mij bekend is, is het niet mogelijk om algemene uitspraken te doen over de verdeling van de verschillende typen aanstellingen die scholen aangaan met hun leerkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat te weinig leraren getraind zijn in de aanpak van radicalisering

MPs Becker and Rudmer Heerema (VVD) asked whether the government agrees that too few teachers have been trained to recognise and address radicalisation, given few school reports and concerns from NCTV and AIVD. Minister Slob replied that about 5,000 education professionals have been trained via SSV and 2,000 via ESS, that the government will focus training on priority municipalities and promote it, but will not make teacher training mandatory.
I do not intend to oblige teachers to follow a training.
Ik ben niet voornemens docenten te verplichten een training te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat meisjes met een migratie-achtergrond al in de basisschoolleeftijd worden ontvoerd en uitgehuwelijkt

MPs Becker, Rudmer Heerema and Van Wijngaarden asked whether girls with a migration background are abducted and married off from primary school age, how many cases exist, how schools report them, and what legal and consular tools exist. The minister answered that no 2018 reports involved primary-school-age victims, gave case counts, pointed to existing reporting and court-intervention routes, and promised further steps in a June progress report.
Exact figures on the abandonment of minors abroad are currently not available, as figures on this specific subject cannot be derived from the current registration system.

Exacte cijfers over achterlating van minderjarigen in het buitenland, zijn momenteel niet beschikbaar aangezien cijfers over dit specifieke onderwerp niet te herleiden zijn uit het huidige registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Becker over het bericht ‘Islamitische Haga Lyceum van plan meer omstreden predikers uit te nodigen’

MPs Heerema and Becker asked the government about a school inviting controversial preachers, asking whether it can refuse entry, act through EU-level lists, and use the proposed changes to article 2:20 BW against such schools. The minister called the invitations undesirable, said entry bans on EU citizens are unrealistic and EU blacklists undesirable due to the ban on censorship, and said dissolution of organisations under 2:20 BW is case-dependent for the courts.
Under article 2:20 of the Civil Code, the court may, at the request of the Public Prosecution Service, declare a legal entity whose activities conflict with public order prohibited and dissolve it.
Op basis van artikel 2:20 BW kan de Rechtbank op verzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie een rechtspersoon waarvan de werkzaamheid in strijd is met de openbare orde, verboden verklaren en ontbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘slapeloze nachten voor hoogbegaafden nu het Leids initiatief voor educatie LIVE per 1 mei stopt’

An MP from the VVD asked the minister whether the Leiden LIVE initiative for gifted children, which lost municipal funding on 1 May 2019, leaves children at home without education, and what the regional special-needs partnerships, municipality and inspectorate are doing. The minister answered that alternative provision was created for the affected pupils, that the inspectorate is investigating the partnerships' lawful use of funds, and that no further consultation is needed.
The inspectorate's investigation focuses on the lawful use of funds by the partnerships involved.
Het onderzoek van de IvhO richt zich enerzijds op de rechtmatige besteding van middelen van de betrokken samenwerkingsverbanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van den Bosch over de beantwoording op vragen inzake het bericht ‘Verval in de gymzaal: kapotte trampolines en turnbruggen’

MPs Heerema and Van den Bosch asked whether municipalities are responsible for financing and maintaining gym facilities and equipment, how often schools have held them to account, whether an investigation into slow replacement of defective gym equipment is planned, and whether municipal Gemeentefonds funds should be cut for non-replacement. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for accommodation financing while school boards are responsible for safety, that objection and appeal routes exist, that no investigation is planned given horizontal supervision, and that cutting Gemeentefonds funds is undesirable and lacks a legal basis.
I have no insight into how often schools have held their municipality to account on this responsibility.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoe vaak het is voorgekomen dat scholen hun gemeente op deze verantwoordelijkheid aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Rudmer Heerema en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘ADO supporters bekladden Amsterdam’

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that ADO Den Haag supporters defaced Amsterdam monuments, including the Dokwerker, with anti-Jewish slogans, asking about arrests, club responsibility, and nationwide stadium bans. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that a complaint is under review by the Public Prosecution Service, that the KNVB and clubs can impose stadium bans as a private-law measure, and that he will discuss antisemitism in football with the KNVB.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het plaatsen van (bewerkte) foto’s en filmpjes van leerkrachten in klaslokalen op internet

Two VVD MPs asked whether pupils posting edited photos and videos of teachers online is a growing problem, whether this breaches GDPR, and what sanctions apply. The minister said schools should set their own rules on phone use, that Kennisnet and the School and Safety foundation will be supported, that lawfulness under GDPR is for the Dutch data protection authority or courts to judge, and that the government does not hold figures on sanctions imposed.
The data on the number of sanctions is not known to me.
De gegevens over het aantal sancties zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Sportclubs moeten verduurzaming aantonen’

MPs of the VVD asked the ministers about a requirement that large sports clubs report energy-saving measures by 1 July 2019, with possible fines, and whether clubs run by volunteers should be exempted to avoid higher membership fees. The minister confirmed the reporting duty and its enforcement by municipalities, pointed to support from sports federations and De Groene Club, and said municipalities decide on fines and usually give time to comply.
Sports clubs with questions about the reporting duty can turn to their own sports federation or to De Groene Club.
Sportverenigingen met vragen over de informatieplicht kunnen terecht bij de eigen sportbond of bij De Groene Club.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het nieuwsbericht ‘Leerkracht geschorst na ‘beledigen profeet’

MPs Heerema and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked why a Hoofddorp technical instructor was suspended after allegedly insulting the prophet Mohammed, whether this falls under free speech, and what sanctions could follow if complaints were false. Minister Slob answered that the suspension is a personnel matter between employer and employee, that the Inspectorate found an open school climate, and that he will not intervene in the pending appeal hearing or speculate on its outcome.
It is important that this committee can do its work undisturbed and carefully. I therefore do not wish to speculate about a possible ruling.
Het is belangrijk dat deze commissie ongestoord en zorgvuldig haar werk kan doen. Ik wil daarom niet speculeren over een mogelijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Verval in de gymzaal: kapotte trampolines en turnbruggen'

A VVD MP asked the minister about reports that many gym teachers use condemned sports equipment, and about who is responsible for safe materials and their replacement. The minister acknowledged the reports, said he has no detailed figures on affected schools, pointed to a planned study, and said responsibility lies with school boards, municipalities (under the Wpo) and exploitants.
I have no insight into how many schools exactly have to deal with materials that do not fully comply.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel scholen exact te maken hebben met materialen die niet volledig voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Politie zoekt getuigen van levensgevaarlijke rit over wielerparcours’

MPs Dijkstra and Heerema asked about police escort of cycling races, the legality of volunteer 'motards' directing traffic, and whether organisers should fund police presence. The minister answered that motards may not direct traffic while riding, that the police role is supervisory, and that the government will consult the KNWU and other parties on possible problems if police involvement is reduced.
Yes. I consider it important to get the possible problems clearly in view and to jointly explore possible solutions, including regarding the deployment of motards.
Ja. Ik vind het belangrijk om de mogelijke problemen goed in beeld te krijgen en gezamenlijk mogelijke oplossingen te verkennen, ook waar het gaat om de inzet van motards.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Bowi van #SorryJohan doet stap terug: 'Je krijgt veel stront over je heen'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about threats against the initiator of the #SorryJohan campaign and how to promote LHBT acceptance in sport and football, and asked her to work with the Justice Minister on tracing the threateners. The minister condemned all threats, pointed to the Alliantie Gelijkspelen, Sportakkoord and KNVB cooperation, and declined to comment on individual investigations.
On individual cases of threats and investigations by the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot make any statements.
Over individuele gevallen van bedreiging en onderzoeken door het Openbaar Ministerie, kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat de provincie Noord-Holland woningbouw in Alkmaar tegenhoudt

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the province of Noord-Holland is blocking housing construction in the Alkmaar region, and whether the Metropoolregio Amsterdam should be extended to include those municipalities and others such as Hoorn. The Minister answered that the national target is on track to be discussed further, that the Alkmaar region can build without joining the MRA, that she has not yet talked with the province but will do so and report by the end of Q1 2019, and that delays stem mainly from implementation capacity and the province has earmarked EUR 15 million for bottlenecks.
I have committed to your chamber to enter into talks with the province of Noord-Holland soon and to inform you of the outcomes.
Ik heb uw kamer toegezegd spoedig met de provincie Noord-Holland in gesprek te gaan en u over de uitkomsten te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht «Turkije gaat weekendscholen financieren in Nederland»

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that Turkey would finance weekend schools in the Netherlands, asking about contacts with Turkey, the number of applications, oversight, and risks to integration. The minister answered that Turkey promised transparency and shared information, about 15 subsidy applications exist, weekend schools fall outside Inspectorate supervision and no specific rules apply, and the government has no full picture but cannot ban informal education, while raising concerns with Turkey.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat de experimentele klas voor hoogbegaafde leerlingen in Leiden (LIVE) in haar voortbestaan wordt bedreigd

An MP asked the ministers about the threatened Leiden experimental class for gifted pupils (LIVE), which lost its education funding because it is not a formal school, and whether the 15 million euro coalition funding and the Thuiszitterspact apply. The minister answered that LIVE is not a recognised school, so education funding and inspectorate oversight do not apply, that municipality and regional partners are responsible, and that they are working with the region and Gedragswerk to find a suitable arrangement.
The initiative has not been designated as a school within the meaning of the Compulsory Education Act 1969. Therefore, funding from education is not permitted.
Het initiatief is niet aangemerkt als school in de zin van de Leerplichtwet 1969. Daarom is financiering vanuit onderwijs niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Syriërs sturen kinderen naar weekendscholen'

VVD MPs Becker and Rudmer Heerema asked about reports that Syrian refugees send children to weekend schools teaching their own language and culture, asking for data, content oversight, and whether such schools undermine integration and Dutch values. The government answered that it has no information on the content or numbers of these weekend schools because they are not schools under education law and fall outside Inspectorate oversight, while stating that informal education is free but should not obstruct integration or promote anti-democratic views.

At present the cabinet has no information on the nature and scope of the education at weekend schools focused on language, culture and religion, because weekend schools are not schools within the meaning of education legislation.

Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen informatie over de aard en omvang van het onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen die zich richten op taal, cultuur en religie, omdat weekendscholen geen scholen zijn in de zin van de onderwijswetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Becker over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse school ruilt Paasontbijt voor Suikerfeest’

Two VVD MPs asked the education minister about an Amsterdam primary school replacing its Easter breakfast with a Suikerfeest celebration, including whether parents and the medezeggenschapsraad were consulted and whether Dutch traditions are protected. The minister answered that schools set their own celebrations, the school's participation body had discussed broader attention to faith traditions, and the civic-education duties and a forthcoming bill clarifying the citizenship mandate were pointed to.
Primary schools themselves determine which festivals, celebrations or commemorations take place at school.
Basisscholen bepalen zelf welke feesten, vieringen of herdenkingen op school plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Koerhuis over de tekortkoming bij de aansluitingsplicht van nutsbedrijf Liander bij het nieuwbouwproject 'Oostweide' in Heiloo

MPs Rudmer Heerema and Koerhuis asked the minister about grid operator Liander's failure to connect the Oostweide new-build project in Heiloo on time, including household hardship, financial liability, compensation, and whether such cases occur elsewhere. The minister answered that financial consequences are private-law matters outside his involvement, that Liander and the builders reached constructive agreement to finish work quickly, and that he is consulting network operators and the regulator ACM on the wider problem of missed 18-week connection deadlines.
Any financial consequences result from private-law relationships between the parties, in which I am not involved.
Eventuele financiële consequenties zijn het gevolg van privaatrechtelijke verhoudingen tussen de partijen, waarbij ik niet ben betrokken.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Basisscholen missen 1300 leraren, na de zomer dreigt lesuitval’

Two VVD MPs asked about reports of 1,300 missing primary school teachers, including the extension of the chain-employment rule, use of the supplementary unemployment benefit pool, part-time and retired teachers, and vakleerkrachten for physical education. The minister answered that the chain-rule exemption for substitutes took effect in August 2018, that re-integration results were not previously tracked but monitoring starts in September, and that several proposals (such as Vervangingsfonds coverage for self-employed teachers) are being reviewed or are not the government's responsibility.
As a result, data are currently lacking to factually answer how many benefit recipients return to teaching.
Hiermee ontbreken dus momenteel gegevens om de vraag feitelijk te kunnen beantwoorden hoeveel uitkeringsgerechtigden terug keren voor de klas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Becker over het bericht 'Onvrede over moskee-schoolreis'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether schools organising class visits to mosques, possibly to salafist mosques with past hate preachers, conflict with parental rights and the civic-education duty, and whether the inspectorate should act. The minister said schools decide their own programmes within legal limits, parents can request exemption, the inspectorate sees no signals of conflict with democratic basic values, and he will clarify the civic-education duty and ask the inspectorate to reinforce oversight.
I intend to make active promotion of the basic values of our democratic constitutional state an explicit part of the civic-education duty, as part of clarifying that statutory duty.

Ik ben van plan om, als onderdeel van de verduidelijking van de wettelijke burgerschapsopdracht, actieve bevordering van de basiswaarden van onze democratische rechtsstaat daarvan expliciet onderdeel te laten zijn.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht: ‘Basisschool wil geen homorol in eindmusical vanwege geloof leerling’

MPs Heerema and Yesilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) asked whether a Hengelo primary school's ban on same-sex roles in the final musical, reportedly due to a Jehovah's Witness pupil's faith, was consistent with the attainment targets on sexual diversity. The minister answered that schools have discretion within the attainment targets, that she would not assess this individual case, and that the school is itself holding a dialogue on the issue.
It is not for me to assess the school principal's conduct in this individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om de handelwijze van de schoolleider in deze individuele casus te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Rudmer Heerema en Van Meenen over het oppotten van geld door schoolbesturen

Four MPs asked the minister whether school boards are hoarding funds, whether a liquidity upper bound of 1.5 is desirable, and related questions on reserves, the Commissie-Don benchmarks, and the inspectorate's oversight. The minister rejected an absolute upper bound, argued that average liquidity is not a causal result of lump-sum funding and that the 'oppotten' label does not fit, and said the inspectorate uses signalling values as detection tools while committing to adjust the framework.
I see no reason to take a different position.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om een ander standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Aangifte misbruik in joodse school pas na druk minister’

MPs Heerema asked why reporting alleged sexual abuse at a Jewish school took so long, what action is taken against the school board, whether the suspect still works there, and how often schools fail to report abuse. Minister Slob refused to comment on the individual case citing the confidentiality of the inspectorate's trust inspector, but ordered the inspectorate to investigate the board's handling of social safety.
Given the seriousness of the signals and the concerns about the safety and well-being of the pupils, I have asked the inspectorate to investigate social safety and the board's conduct.

Gelet op de ernst van de signalen en de zorgen die bestaan over de veiligheid en het welzijn van de leerlingen, heb ik de inspectie gevraagd onderzoek te doen naar de sociale veiligheid en het handelen van het bestuur daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Kindcentra krijgt 'extra punten' in Den Bosch’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the new admissions policy of a primary school foundation in Den Bosch, which gave extra points to children attending certain childcare centres, was acceptable and whether it creates unfair competition. The minister replied that the policy was adjusted after local debate, that schools may use priority criteria within legal limits, that complaints or court review are available, and that no further action is planned.
In the meantime I have understood that the proposed admissions policy in Den Bosch has been adjusted in response to the local debate.
Ondertussen heb ik begrepen dat het voorgestelde aanmeldbeleid in Den Bosch is aangepast als reactie op het lokale debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Volleybalbond denkt aan organisatie WK 2022’

An MP asked the minister whether the event framework's subsidy ceilings are adequate to bring a 2022 volleyball World Championship to the Netherlands and whether the framework would be revisited. The minister answered that the bid is the sports federation's initiative, that the government will explore its role within existing frameworks, and that the sports event framework is being evaluated this year with a decision expected in autumn.
I am willing to look at whether the central government, within the existing policy frameworks, can play a role in that.
Ik ben bereid om mee te kijken of de rijksoverheid, binnen de bestaande beleidskaders, daarbij een rol kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Omtzigt en Rudmer Heerema over de btw-vrijstelling voor denksporten

MPs Bruins Slot, Omtzigt and Rudmer Heerema asked about the VAT exemption for mind sports (bridge, chess, draughts) after the 2017 CJEU ruling that such activities are not 'sport'. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling removes the sports exemption, estimates about EUR 1 million extra VAT revenue, and says talks are underway on possibly listing mind sports under the cultural services exemption, with a letter to the House promised before the summer recess.
However, I aim to inform the House in more detail about this before the summer recess.
Ik streef er echter wel naar uw kamer voor het zomerreces hierover nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht 'Te veel leraren ziek, basisschool moet dicht'

Two MPs asked the minister whether the temporary-contract chain rule under the Wet werk en zekerheid is causing school closures due to teacher sickness, and what options and timelines exist for relief. The minister answered that the chain rule exemption for winter sickness substitutes applies only in January to March, that schools are using many workarounds, and that a statutory fix is planned for 2018 with entry into force by 2020.
The cabinet wants to submit the legislation in the course of 2018.
Het kabinet wil de wetgeving in de loop van 2018 indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Kinderen klunziger’

An MP asked the minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports that children's motor skills are declining, the effects of this, and whether physical education hours and quality have improved in primary schools. The minister acknowledged the concern, said physical education hours have not increased, and promised additional agreements with the PO-Raad, while placing primary responsibility for children's exercise with parents.
Therefore I will agree additional actions with the PO-Raad to achieve more progress in the coming years.
Daarom ga ik met de PO-Raad aanvullende acties afspreken om de komende jaren meer voortgang te realiseren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Stormachtig begin’

MPs Heerema and Dijkstra asked the minister whether the storm damage to the beach near Camperduin, where a beach pavilion closed, shows a risk to coastal safety, and whether Rijkswaterstaat should intervene against contractor Boskalis. The minister answered that sand loss is part of the dynamic coast, coastal safety is not endangered, Rijkswaterstaat monitors the coast annually, and sand nourishment will occur in spring 2018, so no intervention is needed now.
For this reason, the contractor will nourish sand in spring 2018 to maintain the coastline at Camperduin for the coming years as well.
Om deze reden zal de aannemer in het voorjaar van 2018 wel zand suppleren om de kustlijn ter hoogte van Camperduin ook voor de komende jaren te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur met het thema: ‘Misbruik in de sport’

An MP asked the health minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on abuse in sport, including reporting figures, sport-specific data, coach training, sanctions, sports federations' powers and police cooperation. The minister answered that reporting figures are only partly available (Vertrouwenspunt Sport numbers for 2014-2015), that training modules on integrity exist, that disciplinary and criminal sanctions apply, and that talks with police and prosecutors are underway to improve cooperation.
I do not have an overview of the reports that come in to these various bodies.
Een overzicht van de meldingen die bij deze verschillende instanties binnenkomen heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Update vogelgriep: beperkingen jacht nog van kracht’

An MP asked whether the state's restriction on hunting during the avian flu outbreak is unique to the Netherlands, why it does not distinguish wetland from forest hunting, and whether evidence supports the measure. The State Secretary answered that the national hunting ban was based on expert advice, that no research quantifies its effect, and that the ban was lifted on 9 December 2016 except in protection and supervision zones.
There is no research data on the relative contribution of this measure to reducing the chance of avian flu introduction on farms and further spread.
Er zijn geen onderzoeksgegevens over de relatieve bijdrage van deze maatregel aan het verlagen van de kans op introductie van het vogelgriepvirus op bedrijven en op verdere verspreiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over onderzoek naar de gezondheidsrisico’s van kunstgrasvelden

MPs Dijkstra and Heerema asked the government about health risks of rubber granulate on artificial turf, including carcinogenic substances, the Hendrik-Ido-Ambacht case, and the representativeness of a 2006 RIVM-linked study, and whether a new study including children is needed. The minister answered that RIVM sees no public health risk from current evidence, that no specific government guidelines exist beyond REACH oversight by the NVWA, and that it is too early to decide on a new study pending literature review and measurements.
It is still too early to determine whether a new study is useful.
Het is nog te vroeg om te bepalen of een nieuw onderzoek zinvol is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Visser en De Boer naar aanleiding van de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de adviesaanvraag dienstregeling 2017 en de diverse nieuwsberichten over de te verwachten cha

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about NS timetable changes on the Kennemerlijn, overcrowding, and complaints about chaos in regional rail from April 2016. The State Secretary answered that NS is responsible for the timetable, reported falling complaint numbers after extra trains were added, stated the concession terms are met, and noted NS will add Intercity and Spitsintercity stops in the 2017 timetable.
Responsibility for designing the timetable for the main rail network and consulting stakeholders such as regional governments, other operators and consumer organisations lies with NS.

De verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontwerpen van de dienstregeling voor het hoofdrailnet en het overleg daarover met belanghebbenden als decentrale overheden, andere vervoerders en consumentenorganisaties ligt bij NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het bericht “grutto of kraai, voor wie moet je kiezen?”

MPs Lodders and Heerema asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports on predation of meadow bird nests by foxes, crows and other predators, including whether predation is rising and whether predator control is needed for meadow bird conservation. The government answered that predation is monitored nationally without a clear rising trend, that predator control is one factor within a broader habitat approach, and that legal options exist under the new nature conservation law, with no commitment to new action.
As can be seen, no rising trend can be discerned in the figures, although predation has increased over the past few years after several years of low predation.
Zoals te zien is er geen stijgende trend te ontdekken in de cijfers, al is predatie de afgelopen paar jaar na enkele jaren met weinig predatie wel toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de mogelijkheid om op termijn de Grand Prix naar Nederland te halen

An MP asked the health and sport minister whether she would welcome a Dutch Formula 1 Grand Prix in 2020, what is needed, and whether she would ask the Sportraad to study feasibility. The minister is positive in general but says the initiative lies with motorsport, business and local government, that she awaits the business case (end 2016) and may then ask the Sportraad for advice.
The initiative for this does not lie with the central government, but with motorsport, business and the local government.
Het initiatief hiertoe ligt niet bij de rijksoverheid, maar bij de autosport, het bedrijfsleven en de lokale overheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, De Boer en Visser over de adviesaanvraag dienstregeling 2017 en de diverse nieuwsberichten over de te verwachten chaos in het (openbaar) vervoer in Noord-Kennemerland vanaf

Three VVD MPs asked the government about NS's 2017 timetable request for Noord-Kennemerland, the planned Velsertunnel closure and the risk of rail and road disruption and overcrowding in the region. The State Secretary answered that NS will adopt some stopping changes at Heiloo and Castricum, that the timetable is NS's responsibility, that Rijkswaterstaat has a mitigation plan, and that NS is monitoring capacity without having quantified combined economic impacts.
The timetable is the responsibility and expertise of NS.
De dienstregeling is de verantwoordelijkheid en deskundigheid van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de Rudmer Heerema en Van Dekken over de opmerking van Blatter dat het WK-bid van Nederland en België altijd kansloos is geweest

MPs Heerema and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether Blatter's claim that the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid was always hopeless is true, and whether the costs of about 10 million euros could be recovered. The minister replied that the KNVB feels misled, awaits an external audit of the Diallo payment due in June before deciding on action, and that she has put sports integrity and transparent event awards on the EU presidency agenda.
An external accountant is currently conducting an investigation, commissioned by the KNVB, into the payment to Diallo in the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid.
Momenteel loopt in opdracht van de KNVB het onderzoek door een extern accountant naar de betaling aan Diallo bij het Nederlands-Belgisch WK-bid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Rudmer Heerema over Nederland als knooppunt van wildstropers

MPs Thieme and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the Netherlands as a hub for wildlife trafficking, the enforcement of import exemptions, and the motion on banning hunting trophy imports. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the Netherlands is a key trafficking hub, described enforcement and priorities, and promised to inform the House later on the conference outcomes and trophy import ban options.

I will inform you shortly about the outcomes of the conference 'Save Wildlife: Act Now or Game Over' and about the options for introducing a ban on hunting trophies in response to the Thieme/Heerema motion.

Ik zal u op korte termijn informeren over de uitkomsten van de conferentie «Save Wildlife: Act Now or Game Over» en over de mogelijkheden om een verbod voor jachttrofeeën in te stellen in reactie op de motie Thieme/Heerema.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de financiering van sport door het Rijk

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the lack of an integrated overview of government spending on sport and whether one should be compiled and sent to parliament. The minister answered that no integral overview of all sport-related government spending exists, pointed to article 6 of the VWS budget, and considered the municipal spending study plus the VWS budget sufficient for current planning.
An integral overview of all sport-related government expenditure does not exist, and therefore I cannot provide you with a labelling of expenditure or an overview of sport-related FTE deployment.

Een (integraal) overzicht van alle sportgerelateerde overheidsuitgaven bestaat niet, en derhalve kan ik u ook geen labeling van uitgaven doen toekomen noch een overzicht van aan sport gerelateerde fte inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Bureaucratie verdrijft jacht uit Groene Hart’

An MP asks the state secretary for Economic Affairs about conflict between nature conservationists, farmers and hunters over the Natura 2000 management plan for De Wilck, and whether new administrative requirements (dynamic zone, prior notification, post-hunt reporting) are unworkable and contrary to the Wet natuurbescherming and the Heerema/Leenders amendment. The secretary replies that the plan balances hunting and nature goals, is limited in scope and workable, and that the requirements are set by the competent authorities (provincial executive and himself), not Staatsbosbeheer.
In my view, these additional requirements are limited in scope and workable.
Naar mijn oordeel zijn deze aanvullende eisen beperkt van omvang en goed werkbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Uitbraak Zikavirus: miljoenen besmettingen verwacht’ en ‘Experts waarschuwen: Zikavirus deze zomer in Zuid-Europa’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports of Zika virus outbreaks and the risk of spread to the Netherlands, including mosquito control, pregnancy advice and wetland effects. The minister answered that Aedes mosquitoes cannot establish in Europe, that monitoring by RIVM and WHO continues, and that a RIVM/NVWA policy advice on native mosquitoes is delayed to around March 2016.
As soon as I have received this policy advice, I will send it to the House of Representatives.
Zodra ik dit beleidsadvies ontvangen heb zal ik deze de Kamer doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en De Boer over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de ‘verslechtering van de treinverbinding tussen Alkmaar en Den Haag/Rotterdam’ van 27 maart 2015 en over de nieuwe

MPs Heerema and De Boer ask whether the new NS timetable from 15 December 2015 worsens the Alkmaar–Den Haag/Rotterdam rail link through longer transfer times and whether a three-minute earlier departure from Alkmaar could improve the Haarlem connection. The Staatssecretaris answers that NS achieved a travel-time gain of at least 10 minutes in the morning peak, that a further Haarlem transfer adjustment will follow in early 2016 rather than 15 December, and that the timetable is a complex trade-off among passenger groups.
This adjustment cannot take effect on 13 December 2015 anymore, but will be introduced in early 2016.
Deze aanpassing kan niet meer per 13 december 2015 van kracht worden, maar wordt begin 2016 ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over de berichtgeving ‘Dinkelland tegen besluit EZ over Natura 2000’ en ‘Geen naaldbossen in Twente’

MPs Lodders and Heerema asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reports that Dinkelland opposed an EZ Natura 2000 measure, including planting coniferous forest in a buffer zone after an interim AERIUS update. The State Secretary acknowledged local unrest, said the measure was revised after consultation to drop the conifer planting and reduce its scope, and defended the AERIUS update as necessary for the PAS's legal soundness.
After the public inspection period (TIL), the measure was reassessed, partly in light of questions about its usefulness and necessity.
Na de ter inzage legging (TIL) is de maatregel, mede in het licht van de vragen over nut en noodzaak, opnieuw beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'Verplichte opgraving na nieuwjaarsbrand Alkmaar kost modezaak 60.000 euro'

MPs Van Veen and Rudmer Heerema asked the minister whether mandatory archaeological excavation after a New Year's fire in Alkmaar, costing a shop owner 60,000 euro, reflects absurd legislation and whether insurers cover such costs. The minister answered that municipalities have discretion and tools to limit costs, that the law does not mandate excavation, that the Alkmaar municipality chose full excavation, and that the RCE will report on insurer practice by 31 December 2015.
I have no overview of which insurers do and do not cover archaeological soil investigation when rebuilding after fire or other calamity.
Ik heb geen overzicht over welke verzekeraars wel en niet archeologisch bodemonderzoek bij herbouw na brand of andere calamiteit vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Rudmer Heerema over de beantwoording in mijn brief van 3 maart 2015 van eerdere vragen over oversteekplaatsen voor otters

MPs Visser and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about measures, costs, targets and monitoring for otter crossings following a court ruling requiring 21 urgent road-otter conflict points to be resolved by 1 May 2017. The government answered that seven urgent points are being prepared, that Rijkswaterstaat budgets €665,000 for four of them, that the 79 potential hotspots carry no court-imposed deadline, and that the population target is a sustainable size defined by a 5% extinction risk over 100 years.
In the run-up to 1 May 2016 and 1 May 2017, when the 14 remaining points must be resolved, I expect to be able to inform you further about my consultations with the provinces.
Ik verwacht u in de aanloop naar de datum van 1 mei 2016, respectievelijk 1 mei 2017 waarop de 14 knelpunten opgelost moeten zijn, nader te kunnen informeren over mijn overleg met de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en de Boer over loslopende reeën ter hoogte van de Oostvaardersplassen

MPs Heerema and De Boer asked whether roaming deer near the Oostvaardersplassen, which briefly halted some Intercity services, can be prevented from disrupting trains, and whether Staatsbosbeheer should be made to secure the fencing. The state secretary answered that preventive fencing exists, the disruption was limited and brief, and Staatsbosbeheer and ProRail are coordinating on possible extra measures.
It is not possible to give an indication of the costs of a disruption, because this differs strongly per situation.
Het is niet mogelijk een indicatie te geven van de kosten van een verstoring, omdat dit per situatie sterk verschilt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht dat de kwaliteit van het Olympisch water een schande is voor Brazilië

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about reports that the water quality in Rio's Olympic waters is a disgrace, and how Dutch expertise and companies could help clean it up. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described a Dutch fact-finding mission and a joint approach with other ministries, and said the Brazilian government ultimately decides on investments and partnerships.

I am of course willing, together with Minister Schultz van Haegen and my colleagues from EZ, BZ and BHOS, to work with Dutch companies and Dutch-developed sustainable innovations to make a successful contribution to reducing pollution of Guanabara Bay and building a circular economy in Rio de Janeiro.

Ik ben uiteraard bereid om samen met Minister Schultz van Haegen en mijn collega’s van EZ, BZ en BHOS mij in te zetten om met Nederlandse bedrijven en met inzet van in Nederland ontwikkelde duurzame innovaties een succesvolle bijdrage te leveren aan de terugdringing van vervuiling van de Guanabara Bay en de opbouw van een circulaire economie in Rio de Janeiro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de Nederlandse implementatiewijze van de Vogel- en Habitatrichtlijn

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Dutch implementation of the Birds and Habitats Directives, including whether an inventory of problems across the provinces had been made for the EU fitness check, its timing, how results would reach parliament, and which laws the identified problems stem from. The State Secretary confirmed the inventory was done with the IPO and completed, referred to a separate letter with the results, and stated the problems stem from the EU directives, which will be raised with the Commission, while nationally changed matters are addressed in a pending nature protection bill.
In my view, the problems I mention in the above-mentioned letter to your House stem from the European Birds and Habitats Directives.
De knelpunten die ik in bovengenoemde brief aan uw Kamer noem, vloeien naar mijn oordeel voort uit de Europese Vogel- en Habitatrichtlijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en De Boer over de verslechtering van de treinverbinding tussen Alkmaar en Den Haag/Rotterdam

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about the worsened rail connection between Alkmaar and The Hague/Rotterdam, including longer travel times, a Haarlem transfer and missed connections. The state secretary answered that NS prioritises the largest passenger flows, admits the Haarlem transfer is missed too often, and commits to faster Intercity services in the peak from the 2016 timetable.
I share the view that the transfer is too often not made and expect NS and ProRail to work to improve this.
Ik deel de mening dat de overstap te vaak niet wordt gehaald en verwacht dat NS en ProRail zich inzetten om dit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Rudmer Heerema met betrekking tot oversteekplaatsen voor otters

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries of Economic Affairs and Infrastructure and Environment how the government will respond to a Hague appeals court ruling requiring measures for otter road crossings, including which bottlenecks will be fixed, when, at what cost, and how this relates to the national ecology programme and provincial responsibilities. The government answered that seven urgent bottlenecks will be addressed immediately, the other 14 urgent ones by about 2016 and all 21 by mid-2017, funded from the Economic Affairs budget, with provinces responsible for nature policy implementation and some costs and measures still undetermined.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (Rijkswaterstaat) and the provinces of Friesland and Overijssel will immediately start on the seven most urgent bottlenecks named in the ruling.

Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (Rijkswaterstaat) en de provincies Friesland en Overijssel starten direct met de zeven meest urgente knelpunten zoals benoemd in het arrest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van ’t Wout over het bericht «Mug met virus groeit hard in poldermoeras»

Two VVD MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers how mosquito-borne disease is monitored and whether wetland restoration raises public health risks such as dengue and West Nile virus. The minister answered that current mosquito species pose no significant disease risk, that monitoring and existing Alterra and RIVM studies continue, and that wetland expansion is a provincial matter with no current measured disease burden, so further RIVM advice is awaited.
The RIVM is currently working with the NVWA's Centre for Vector Monitoring on policy advice on the control of native mosquitoes.
Het RIVM werkt op dit moment in samenwerking met het Centrum Monitoring Vectoren van de NVWA aan een beleidsadvies over de inheemse muggenbestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over het goed samengaan van natuur en veehouderij

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a Wageningen/Dienst Landelijk Gebied study finding no negative link between farming and nature in Noordoost-Twente applies more widely, and what the government has done with it. The State Secretary answered that the study does not address ammonia deposition, that the findings are not representative of rural Netherlands in general, and that no follow-up study is planned.
I do not consider a follow-up study useful, because the research design is not suitable to support the conclusions drawn.
Een vervolgonderzoek acht ik niet zinvol, omdat de onderzoeksopzet niet geschikt is om de getrokken conclusies mee te onderbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de aangepaste begrenzing van Natura 2000-gebieden na uitspraken van de Raad van State

MPs Heerema and Dijkgraaf asked why certain land was left out of two Natura 2000 area boundaries and whether the Council of State rulings will lead to more boundary changes. The State Secretary answered that the land was excluded for lack of present Natura 2000 values or proven necessity, that no other annulments on this ground are known, and that a limited number of further boundary changes may follow rulings expected in 2015.
Yes, this is possible due to a limited number of Council of State rulings expected during 2015.
Ja, dit is mogelijk door een beperkt aantal uitspraken van de Raad van State, die in de loop van 2015 te verwachten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht “Springendal bij Vasse definitief Natura 2000-gebied, boeren teleurgesteld”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the economic impact of designating Springendal and Dal van de Mosbeek as a Natura 2000 area, whether ecology can outweigh economy in boundary decisions, and how economic interests can be considered. The State Secretary answered that economic impacts will be assessed in the management plan due in 2015, that boundaries may be set only on ecological grounds under EU case law, and that the Council of State's single boundary annulment did not produce incomplete economic calculations.
A precise determination of the consequences of a designation decision can only take place when the management plan is established.
Een nauwkeurige vaststelling van de gevolgen van een aanwijzingsbesluit kan pas bij vaststelling van het beheerplan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘‘extra geld voor controleurs natuurgebieden’’

An MP asked the ministers about a reported 100,000 euro in extra funding for training of nature-area enforcement officers (groene boa's), including its cost coverage, cost control, the content of training and whether bureaucracy will be reduced. The government answered that the funds are a structural contribution to employer costs, will be covered within the Economic Affairs budget, that an evaluation of training is under way due by year-end, and that cooperation arrangements with employers were agreed, though several questions were answered with references to future evaluation.
Based on this research, a decision will follow on whether and, if so, which adjustments should be made within the overall training system in domain II.
Op basis van dit onderzoek zal een beslissing volgen of en zo ja welke aanpassingen er binnen de gehele systematiek van opleiden binnen domein II dienen plaats te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over muizenschade bij boeren

MPs Lodders and Heerema asked whether farmers suffering vole damage not compensated by the Faunafonds can be helped, including a derogation from the grassland-ploughing ban and an adjusted nitrates calamity scheme. The state secretary refused a derogation, said grassland may be ploughed from 1 February 2015, and stated the planned calamity scheme does not cover vole damage and that no further policy is foreseen.
I have informed the province of Friesland that I do not intend to grant an exemption from the ban on ploughing grassland.
Ik heb de provincie Friesland er van op de hoogte gebracht dat ik niet voornemens ben een ontheffing op het verbod op het scheuren van grasland te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over de aanwijzing Binnenveld in Veenendaal als Natura 2000-gebied

MPs Heerema and Lodders asked the State Secretary about the designation of Binnenveld in Veenendaal as a Natura 2000 area, including the municipality's appeal, the feasibility of the management plan and its economic consequences for farmers. The State Secretary answered that the designation stands, the management plan is delegated to the provinces and water board and expected in September, and that the economic consequences will be assessed within that plan.
The designation decision only concerns the boundary of the area and the setting of the conservation objectives.
Het aanwijzingsbesluit betreft alleen de begrenzing van het gebied en de vaststelling van de instandhoudingsdoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Aanwijzingsbesluit Natura 2000-gebied Buurserzand & Haaksbergerveen houdt stand’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the designation of the Buurserzand & Haaksbergerveen Natura 2000 area, based purely on ecological grounds, upholds a balance between economy and ecology, and how compensation for affected farmers would be funded. The State Secretary answered that designation may rest on ecological grounds, that economic interests are considered when setting management measures, and that no compensation arises at this stage since measures come in the management plan run by the province of Overijssel, whose provincial reserve covers the development task.
According to settled European and national case law, the selection and delimitation of Habitats Directive areas may be based solely on ecological considerations.
Volgens vaste Europese en nationale jurisprudentie kan de keuze en de begrenzing van Habitatrichtlijngebieden louter geschieden op grond van ecologische overwegingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders naar aanleiding van het Volkskrant artikel getiteld “Wolf krijgt ‘verblijfsvergunning”

MPs Heerema and Lodders asked why the wolf should receive legal protection and what effect wolf damage claims would have on the Faunafonds, which may lack funds for goose damage. The State Secretary answered that provinces requested clarity on the wolf's status so they can use their management powers, that the Faunafonds is provincially responsibility and expected only relatively small wolf damage costs, and that the fund has no ceiling on compensation.
It is up to the provinces to give a judgement on that.
Het is aan de provincies daarover een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het bericht ‘Boeren Dinkelland halen gelijk bij Raad van State

MPs Heerema and Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Council of State ruling that the Dinkelland Natura 2000 designation, including an agricultural enclave, was insufficiently motivated and that the boundary should not expand the area. The government answered that it will supplement the motivation as the court requested, denies that compensation for De Vetpot was required, and maintains the enclave is necessary for conservation goals without changing the management plan.
I will, in line with the interim judgment of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State, still motivate the decision adequately.
Ik zal conform het tussenvonnis van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State het besluit alsnog toereikend motiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Noorden verwacht dassenexplosie’

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about a report predicting a sharp badger population increase in the north, with uncompensated damage and financing concerns. The government said badger management and damage financing are provincial responsibilities, rejected the comparison with goose problems, and reported an approved relocation of a badger family in Cuijk.
The province is responsible for management and damage control.
De provincie gaat over beheer en schadebestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Aukje de Vries over het bericht over de visie van natuurclubs op het Waddengebied in relatie tot de Natuurwet

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about natuurclubs' call to prioritise nature over economy in the Wadden area and whether tourism and harbour development should remain possible there. The government replied that the Structuurvisie allows economic development within the nature-protection aim, that the Wadden area is already well protected, and that it will present a new Natuurwet proposal balancing economy and ecology.
I will soon present my proposals for the new Natuurwet.
Ik kom binnenkort met mijn voorstellen voor de nieuwe Natuurwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over uitbreiding van vergunningsplicht bij natuur

VVD MPs Rudmer Heerema and Lodders asked whether the State Secretary would accept proposals by nature, landscape and animal welfare organisations to extend permit requirements to nature areas of national importance, to restrict netting-off (saldering) under the PAS, and to abolish the list of huntable species. The State Secretary replied that the organisations' vision document was noted, that the Nature Conservation Bill is before parliament, and that an amendment note will be submitted in spring to stress the link between economy and ecology.
I have taken note of the vision document "A new Nature Conservation Act" from the nature, landscape and animal welfare organisations.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van het visiedocument «Een nieuwe wet natuurbescherming» van de natuur-, landschaps- en dierenwelzijnsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over Natura 2000-complementaire doelen

An MP asked whether provinces may pursue complementary Natura 2000 nature goals outside the designation decrees and whether permits can be refused on such goals, citing a motion. The Secretary of State replied that designation decrees contain no complementary goals, provinces may pursue additional nature policy within management plans, and the draft Nature Conservation Act removes non-Habitat/Bird-directive objectives so permits concern only designated objectives.
The designation decrees contain no complementary goals.
De aanwijzingsbesluiten bevatten geen complementaire doelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rutte over hondsdolheid

VVD MPs Heerema and Rutte asked whether rabies poses a risk in the Netherlands, whether current policy is adequate, and whether imports of dogs from Eastern Europe and Morocco should be restricted. The State Secretary answered that Nederland is adequately prepared, that the current euthanasia, vaccination and prophylaxis policy is sufficient, and that she will consider lifting the exemption for unvaccinated puppies under three months and will write to the House early 2014.
Early 2014 I will inform you in a letter in more detail about the measures I am going to take.
Begin 2014 zal ik u in een brief nader informeren over de maatregelen die ik ga nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het uitbreiden in oppervlakte van bestaande Natura 2000-gebieden

MPs Heerema and Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs who is responsible for enlarging Natura 2000 areas such as Engbertsdijkvenen, Willinks Weust and Lopikerwaard, on what legal basis, and what the local economic effects are. The State Secretary answered that the Minister of Economic Affairs decides on designation under the Nature Conservation Act with public participation, that boundaries change only on ecological criteria, and that economic effects cannot be considered at the designation stage but may be in management plans.
The competence to adopt the designation decisions lies with the minister responsible for Economic Affairs.
De bevoegdheid van het vaststellen van de aanwijzingsbesluiten ligt bij de bewindspersoon van Economische Zaken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht Broedvogels verdwijnen uit Oostvaardersplassen

MP Heerema asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether she knows the report that breeding birds are disappearing from the Oostvaardersplassen, whether grazing pressure by large herbivores explains it, and whether population management should be tightened. The State Secretary says the trends are local to the dry part of the area, that the large grazers were introduced deliberately to favour grass-eating waterbirds, that the grazer population has declined for two years under the existing early-reactive management, and that no tightening is needed.
No. Based on the Gabor advisory report from 2010, Staatsbosbeheer applies so-called early-reactive management.
Nee. Op basis van het advies-Gabor uit 2010 past Staatsbosbeheer zogeheten vroeg-reactief beheer toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het bericht Drenthe schort verlenen vergunning op

MPs Heerema and Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Drenthe provincial executive's decision to suspend livestock permits near Natura 2000 areas until 1 February 2014, and whether the Groenmanifest framework was working. MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs for an overview of stricter-than-EU national rules (nationale koppen) affecting farmers, growers and fishers, including their regulatory-burden effects and planned reductions under the coalition agreement. The government answered that the overview was sent in September 2013 and a sector-specific regulatory-burden approach for agro and food is underway, with a table of measures and their burden effects, and no full list of nationale koppen per directive was given beyond the inventory of current rules.

requests the government to involve the anti-trafficking specialised aid and care organisations in the research criteria of these pilots
verzoekt de regering, de in mensenhandel gespecialiseerde hulp- en zorgorganisaties te betrekken bij de onderzoekscriteria van deze pilots
Motie Van Tongeren c.s. over kindersekstoerisme
Asks the government to lead international efforts against child sex tourism and examine how Dutch criminal cases can improve, informing the House.
requests the government to take the lead in the international professionalisation of prevention and combating of child sex tourism
verzoekt de regering om, het voortouw te nemen in de internationale professionalisering van de voorkoming en bestrijding van kindersekstoerisme
Motie Van der Staaij c.s. over de DEMO-instellingen
Motion asks the government to inform the House by 1 April on the new funding scheme for DEMO institutions and how expertise will be safeguarded.
requests the government, after consulting professionals, to give the House insight by 1 April into the outline of the new funding scheme
verzoekt de regering, na overleg met de betrokken professionals, de Kamer uiterlijk 1 april inzicht te geven in de hoofdlijn van de nieuwe bekostigingsregeling
Amendement van het lid Segers over een tegemoetkoming voor onevenredig hoge beveiligingskosten voor (Joodse) instellingen
Shifts 400,000 euro within the justice budget to fund a compensation scheme for disproportionate security costs of (Jewish) institutions.
With this amendment the submitter aims to make 400,000 euro available for compensation for disproportionately high security costs of (Jewish) institutions
Met dit amendement beoogt de indiener 400 000 euro ter beschikking te stellen voor een tegemoetkoming in onevenredig hoge beveiligingskosten van (Joodse) instellingen
Amendement van het lid Van der Staaij c.s. over de voortzetting van de bestaande regeling tegemoetkoming adoptiekosten
Shifts budget within the Youth article to continue the adoption cost allowance scheme after 31 December 2012 on the same conditions.
This amendment aims to allocate the money reserved in the budget for the adoption cost allowance so it can continue to be used under the same conditions.
Dit amendement beoogt het op de Begroting gereserveerde geld voor de tegemoetkoming adoptiekosten te bestemmen om het onder dezelfde voorwaarden te blijven aanwenden
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Segers en Schouw ter vervanging van nr. 12 betreffende het grotendeels terugdraaien van de bezuinigingen op het CBP
Proposes largely reversing budget cuts to the data protection supervisor (CBP), funded by reallocating money within the justice budget.
Therefore this amendment proposes to largely reverse the cuts to the CBP.
Daarom wordt met dit amendement voorgesteld de bezuinigingen op het CBP grotendeels terug te draaien.
Amendement van het lid Segers over het grotendeels terugdraaien van de bezuinigingen op het CBP
Restores much of the budget cut to the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens, the data protection supervisor, so it can carry out its supervision and enforcement tasks.
Therefore this amendment proposes to largely reverse the cuts to the CBP.
Daarom wordt met dit amendement voorgesteld de bezuinigingen op het CPB grotendeels terug te draaien.
Amendement van de leden Segers en Van der Staaij over extra budget voor vrijwilligerswerk bij de sanctietoepassing
Raises the budget for volunteer work in sanction enforcement from 1.5 million to 3 million euro per year, with offsetting shifts within the budget.
This amendment therefore increases the current budget for volunteer work from 1.5 million euro to 3 million euro per year.
Met dit amendement wordt daarom het huidige budget voor vrijwilligerswerk verhoogd van 1,5 miljoen euro naar 3 miljoen euro per jaar.
Motie Bosman c.s. over inzicht in de financiën van overheids-nv's
Asks the government to ensure the financial supervisor gets full insight into the finances of the public limited companies of Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
Asks the government to ensure the Cft gets full insight into the finances of the government NVs of Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
verzoekt de regering, ervoor te zorgen dat het Cft alle inzicht krijgt in de financiën van de overheids-nv's van Curaçao en Sint-Maarten
Motie Segers c.s. over de waarborging van kinderrechten
Asks the government to free at least 750,000 euro in the 2013 budget to strengthen child protection and children's rights programmes in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom.
requests the government to free up a budget of at least 750,000 euro within the 2013 Kingdom Relations budget.
verzoekt de regering, binnen de begroting Koninkrijksrelaties 2013 budget vrij te maken van ten minste € 750 000
Amendement van het lid Segers over het reserveren van middelen voor technische ondersteuning en expertise op het gebied van kinderrechten binnen de landen van het Koninkrijk
Amendment shifts budget within the Caribbean-Kingdom budget to reserve funds for child-rights technical support and expertise exchange among Kingdom countries.
The amendment aims to reserve budget for technical support and expertise exchange on children's rights within the Kingdom's countries.
Het amendement beoogt budget te reserveren voor technische ondersteuning en expertise(uitwisseling) op het gebied van kinderrechten binnen de landen van het Koninkrijk.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht ‘Luitenant-Kolonel van Woensel: 'De landmachtbrigades schieten op meerdere punten tekort'

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Defence ministers about a news report quoting an army officer that the Dutch army brigades fall short on several points, including NATO-identified shortcomings, the Dutch-German tank battalion cooperation, and tank availability. The government answered that the brigades are assessed as high quality, that some NATO-identified gaps are not addressed under current choices, that cooperation with Germany is considered good and will be evaluated and deepened, and that it will inform parliament on the integration.
The Netherlands supports sharing burdens and risks among allies (risk- and burden-sharing) and also makes a military contribution to this.
Nederland is voorstander van het verdelen van lasten en risico's tussen de bondgenoten (risk- en burden-sharing) en levert daar ook een militaire bijdrage aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over de bijeenkomst in Amsterdam waar David Icke zal spreken

MPs Ellian and Segers asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a planned Amsterdam event featuring David Icke, a known Holocaust denier, and what could be done to stop it. The Minister condemned antisemitism and Holocaust denial and urged the organisers to reconsider, noting that censorship is constitutionally barred while criminal speech can be prosecuted afterwards, and that IND was examining an entry ban.
I also support the municipality of Amsterdam in its request to the IND to investigate whether the person concerned can be denied entry to our country.
Ik steun ook de gemeente Amsterdam in de vraag aan de IND om te onderzoeken of betrokkene de toegang tot ons land kan worden geweigerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Paul, De Hoop, Beertema, Segers, Kwint, Bisschop en Westerveld over de berichten Klachtenregen van ouders over Trevvel: Ik kwam elke dag te laat op mijn werk en verloor zo mijn

MPs asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports of late or missing school transport for pupils in special education, caused by driver shortages. The minister acknowledged the problem, said municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, promised to pressure the VNG, gather information on affected regions, and await a monitoring study due by year-end.
However, for privacy reasons it is not possible to make the results public per municipality.
Het is vanwege privacy echter niet mogelijk om de resultaten per gemeente openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Bikker over het bericht 'Veel schoolleiders hebben geen idee wanneer de ventilatie in de klas op orde komt'

MPs Segers and Bikker asked about reports that many school leaders do not know when classroom ventilation will be fixed, and about CO2 meters, subsidies and the risk of a new COVID wave. Minister Wiersma acknowledged the urgency, explained the ventilation subsidy scheme of 140 million euros and said schools themselves are best placed to choose CO2 meters.
I acknowledge the urgency of getting ventilation in schools where insufficient steps have been taken recently up to standard as quickly as possible.
Ik erken de urgentie om de ventilatie op scholen waar de afgelopen tijd nog onvoldoende stappen zijn gezet zo snel mogelijk op orde te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over een Wob-verzoek met een intimiderend karakter dat als antisemitisch wordt ervaren

MPs Ellian and Segers asked whether the government considers a Wob freedom-of-information request by The Rights Forum to Dutch universities, seeking contacts with Jewish organisations and Israel, to be intimidating and antisemitic, and whether it will tell universities and the group not to answer or to stop. The minister answered that the request is a legitimate right under the Woo, that universities must decide how to handle it under the law, that fourteen public universities have said they will not answer parts of it, and that the minister has received many reactions from the Jewish community viewing the request as antisemitic.
It is for the university's governing board to handle this request further along the lines of the law.
Het is aan het instellingsbestuur van de universiteit dit verzoek langs de lijnen van de wet verder te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over een aangevallen Joods voetbalteam

MPs Ellian and Segers asked the Minister of Justice and Security about an attack on a Jewish futsal team, the Hitler salute at the incident, and the response to antisemitic incidents. The minister condemned antisemitism, pointed to ongoing criminal and KNVB investigations, and described existing reporting, expertise and prevention measures without committing to new concrete steps.
Because the case is still under investigation, I cannot comment on this specific case.
Omdat de zaak nog in onderzoek is, kan ik mij over dit specifieke geval niet uitlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Segers over de oproepen tot de doodstraf tegen een Nederlands Tweede Kamerlid door een Pakistaanse geestelijke

MPs Ceder and Segers asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to calls by a Pakistani cleric for the execution of MP Geert Wilders, including whether Pakistan has responded to Dutch mutual legal assistance requests and how the government handles threats from abroad. The minister says threats are unacceptable, the government has raised concern bilaterally with Pakistan, Pakistan has not responded to the 2018 legal assistance requests, and the government will keep working with Pakistan and the security services on the threat.
The cabinet is doing everything within its power to end these threats and mitigate the risks to Mr Wilders.
Het kabinet doet er alles aan wat in zijn macht ligt om een einde te maken aan deze bedreigingen en de risico’s ervan voor de heer Wilders te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Ceder en De Roon over de brief  ‘Uitkomsten en kabinetsappreciatie extern onderzoek UAWC’

MPs asked the government to disclose the Proximities report on UAWC, defend its definition of the PFLP and the choice to treat Palestinian civil society organisations as PFLP-linked, and explain aid transparency and due diligence. The government declined to publish the report, citing a do-no-harm principle, said it does not share Proximities' broader definition, and promised further EU-level assessment and tightened due diligence.
The cabinet believes that publication of the report could cause disproportionate harm to the civil society organisations concerned.
Het kabinet meent dat openbaarmaking van het rapport de betreffende maatschappelijke organisaties onevenredige schade zou kunnen toebrengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Peters over het bericht 'Bijlesbedrijven schieten als paddenstoelen uit de grond'

MPs Segers and Peters asked whether the rapid growth of private tutoring firms (schaduwonderwijs) is undesirable, given risks to educational inequality and possible subsidy funding. The minister agreed the growth is undesirable, said NPO funds may be used for private tutoring, and deferred the full research and action plan to later reports.
My intention is not to repeat this research before the National Education Programme has been completed.
Mijn voornemen is om een herhaling van dit onderzoek niet eerder te doen dan na het afronden van het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Stoffer, Segers en Mulder over gewonde burgers als gevolg van Turkse militaire activiteiten in Noordoost-Syrië

MPs asked the government whether Turkish military attacks in northeast Syria injuring civilians, including children, were lawful, and about Turkey's strategy and humanitarian protection of minorities. The government said it lacks details to judge the legality of specific attacks, condemned the Turkish operation, and described ongoing diplomatic efforts and support programmes for religious minorities.

The cabinet states that all countries, including Turkey, must act in accordance with international law, but does not have the details of the attacks in question and therefore cannot make statements on their lawfulness.

Het kabinet stelt voorop dat alle landen en dus ook Turkije conform het internationaal recht moeten handelen, maar beschikt niet over de details van de betreffende aanvallen en kan dus ook geen uitspraken doen over de rechtmatigheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Segers en Bisschop over antisemitische incidenten en bedreigingen van Joodse studenten

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about antisemitic incidents and threats against Jewish students, including how trust in reporting could be restored and how police and prosecutors respond. The minister condemned the statements, said he is concerned, pointed to existing complaint channels and prosecution guidelines on discrimination, and referred to new antisemitism and anti-discrimination coordinators.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service pay considerable attention to properly addressing criminal offences with a possible discriminatory aspect.
Bij de politie en het OM is veel aandacht voor het op een correcte wijze aandacht geven aan strafbare feiten met een mogelijk discriminatoir aspect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over de bedreigingen aan het Joods restaurant Hacarmel

MPs Ellian and Segers asked the Justice Minister about threats against the Jewish restaurant Hacarmel, which were initially registered only as insult, and whether antisemitic incidents are handled adequately. Minister Grapperhaus said both threat and insult reports were taken, outlined police and prosecutor measures on discrimination cases, and stated he sees no reason to conclude that handling is inadequate.
Because the criminal investigation in this case is still ongoing, I refrain from giving a substantive judgment on this case.
Omdat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in deze zaak nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van een inhoudelijk oordeel over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Segers over partijdigheid van de UNHRC-onderzoekscommissie naar eventuele oorlogsmisdaden door Israël en de Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij and Segers asked whether the UNHRC commission of inquiry on Israel and the Palestinians is biased, given members' past public criticism of Israel, and whether its open-ended mandate should be changed. The Minister answered that members are appointed by the UNHRC President who must ensure impartiality, that the Netherlands abstained partly over the mandate's breadth, and that the government will scrutinise future reports for one-sided positions.
