Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Segers over het systematisch lekken vanuit het Catshuisoverleg

MPs Ceder and Segers asked the Prime Minister whether leaks from the Catshuis cabinet consultations are structural, who receives the documents, and what measures prevent them. The government acknowledges that plans leak with some regularity, says it does not know the motives or channels, and points to reminders of confidentiality while stating it will keep trying to prevent leaks.
I do not have information about the motives or causes of the leak, nor about how it occurs.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de motieven of oorzaken van het uitlekken, noch over de wijze waarop dit gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat een Nederlander in Angola onder verdachte omstandigheden is overleden

Segers (CU) asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to reports that a Dutch national died under suspicious circumstances in Angola, and whether it will press Angolan authorities for an autopsy, repatriation, and cooperation with a criminal complaint. Minister Knapen confirmed the death, said the embassy requested repatriation but Angola refused, noted the body was buried locally, and said a relative had filed a complaint in Angola while the ministry can only advise and mediate.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot file a complaint abroad on behalf of a citizen.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kan niet namens een burger aangifte in het buitenland doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden leden Bikker, Ceder en Segers aan over de Afghaanse heroïnehandel en de rol van Nederland

MPs Bikker, Ceder and Segers asked ministers about the Taliban's income from Afghan heroin trade and whether the Netherlands, as a Europe-wide transit hub, bears responsibility and can act. The government said the Netherlands plays an unintended role in the heroin market, that a causal link to Taliban financing is hard to establish, and that it is pursuing a joint EU and national approach through EMPACT, the drugs strategy and a security dialogue with Turkey.

Because of its infrastructure, its current role as a producing and transit country for drugs, and the role of Dutch criminals in the drug industry, the Netherlands unintentionally also plays a role in the European heroin market.

Nederland vervult vanwege haar infrastructuur, huidige rol als productie- en doorvoerland van drugs en de rol van Nederlandse criminelen in de drugsindustrie, ongewild ook een rol in de Europese heroïnemarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Segers over de motie Bikker c.s. inzake hybride onderwijs

MPs Bikker and Segers asked the Minister of Education about follow-up to their motion on hybrid education for students with support needs, carers and chronically ill students, including dialogue with sector bodies, knowledge gaps, unreachable obligations for teachers, reports of studies being postponed, and advice for affected students. The minister answered that the issue was raised with sector councils and will be in service documents, that institutions are responsible for finding individual solutions, that the group-size limit of 75 was lifted, and that students can seek help from student organisations and the support body.
At a next administrative consultation I will ask both sector councils and student organisations what their experiences have been so far.
In een volgend bestuurlijk overleg zal ik, zowel aan sectorraden als aan studentenorganisaties, vragen wat de ervaringen in deze tot nu toe zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Ceder, Segers en Van der Staaij over de situatie van Afghaanse christenen

Four MPs asked the government about the situation of Afghan Christians and converts under the Taliban, and whether asylum policy should be loosened. The government said the situation of religious minorities was already concerning, that information is limited, and that a moratorium on decisions and departures has been imposed with a new country report and further consultation with parliament promised.
After receiving the country report, the House will be further informed about the conclusions that can be drawn from it for the country-based asylum policy.
Na ontvangst van het ambtsbericht wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de conclusies die uit dat ambtsbericht kunnen worden getrokken voor het landgeboden asielbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Van der Staaij en Segers over de zoektocht naar Samuël Boujadi

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister why Italian authorities searched inadequately for missing Dutch national Samuël Boujadi, whether the ministry would support further searches or reimburse the family's search costs, and what it would do to help recovery of his body. The minister answered that Italian authorities have jurisdiction and say they searched longer than usual, that the Netherlands cannot intervene without invitation, that specific assistance was offered but not used, and that no reimbursement was promised.
The Netherlands may not and cannot interfere in investigation and legal proceedings in another state without an invitation or permission.
Nederland mag en kan zich niet zonder uitnodiging c.q. toestemming mengen in de opsporing en rechtsgang in een andere staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken actief naar argumenten voor het ontkennen van de Armeense genocide zocht

Segers (ChristenUnie) asks whether the Foreign Ministry asked its Ankara embassy for scientific arguments denying the Armenian genocide, and why the government applies recognition conditions that could never be met in this case. Minister Kaag confirms a 2018 information request to the embassy on publications disputing the genocide label, says the government is still deciding on the Voordewind motion, and states it will reach its own independent decision on recognition.

From the core department in The Hague, contact was made with the Dutch embassy in Ankara on 7 February 2018 about possible scientific publications that would conclude the large-scale massacre of 1915 does not meet the legal term 'genocide'.

Vanuit het kerndepartement in Den Haag is op 7 februari 2018 contact geweest met de Nederlandse ambassade in Ankara over mogelijke wetenschappelijke publicaties die zouden concluderen dat de grootschalige moordpartij van 1915 niet voldoet aan de juridische term «genocide».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Westerveld en Kwint over het LinkedIn-bericht ‘Grote flyeractie in boekenpakketten!’ van 'Mr. Chadd'

MPs Segers, Westerveld and Kwint asked the minister about a LinkedIn post advertising paid homework coaching via flyers in publicly funded school book packages, and whether such advertising, its money flows and shadow education in general are acceptable. The minister confirmed awareness, said schools choose their suppliers, acknowledged risks to equal opportunity, referred to a planned repeat study and a spring 2022 update, and said the distributor's payments were unknown to him.
This is a matter between the distributor and the provider.
Dit is een zaak tussen de distributeur en de aanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van der Staaij over onderdrukking van religieuze minderheden in India naar aanleiding van onderzoek door de London School of Economics

MPs Segers and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about reported persecution of religious minorities in India, including disinformation and incitement described in an LSE/Open Doors report, and whether the Netherlands would support an international inquiry, act on media platforms, and hold officials accountable. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described existing Dutch projects, human rights dialogues and planned UN review, but did not commit to an international inquiry or to holding Indian officials accountable.
The Netherlands conveys its concerns about these developments to the Indian authorities.
Nederland brengt de zorgen over deze ontwikkelingen over bij de Indiase autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Bisschop over invoer van producten uit de Westelijke Sahara via Marokko naar de EU

MPs Segers and Bisschop asked why the Israel Producten Centrum was fined for labelling wine from the West Bank, whether such fines have occurred before, which occupied territories the rules apply to, and about export data for Western Sahara products imported via Morocco. The government answered that the labelling was misleading under EU food information rules, that the rules apply regardless of territory, that no overview of occupied areas exists, and provided tables of Moroccan export data, while stating that the NVWA's enforcement must remain objective.
It occurs very infrequently that a company is fined for an incorrect description of a product's origin.
Het komt zeer incidenteel voor dat een bedrijf wordt beboet voor een verkeerde omschrijving van de herkomst van een product.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Ceder over de vrijlating van het Pakistaanse echtpaar Shagufta en Shafqat

Two ChristianUnion MPs asked whether the released Pakistani Christian couple Shagufta Kausar and Shafqat Emmanuel face danger, whether the Netherlands will admit them as refugees, and what pressure is applied on Pakistan to repeal its blasphemy laws. The minister answered that the risk cannot be determined in advance, that asylum cannot be applied for at an embassy, and that the government raises the issue bilaterally and in EU channels while preferring quiet diplomacy.
It should be noted that the starting point of Dutch asylum policy is that a person can only apply for asylum in the Netherlands.
Hierbij dient aangetekend te worden dat het uitgangspunt van het Nederlandse asielbeleid is dat iemand enkel in Nederland asiel kan aanvragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Van der Plas, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder en Eppink over het bericht dat Indonesië dreigt met 'uitroeiing' separatisten op Papoea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Indonesia threatened to 'eradicate' Papuan separatists, the killing of an intelligence officer, fears of disproportionate military violence and displacement, Papuans' political rights, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that Indonesia has security duties but concerns about military presence, civilian harm and rights restrictions are shared, and said the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in EU dialogue without intervening in foreign court cases.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Indonesian authorities for a meaningful dialogue between all parties involved.
Nederland zal bij de Indonesische autoriteiten blijven aandringen op een betekenisvolle dialoog, tussen alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Segers over Nederlandse deelname aan Durban IV-conferentie

MPs Van der Staaij and Segers asked whether the Netherlands will boycott the Durban IV conference, citing antisemitism at earlier Durban conferences and disproportionate focus on Israel. Minister Kaag answered that the Netherlands will not attend, citing the risk of antisemitic abuse and one-sided focus on Israel, while pledging continued anti-racism work at the UN.
The Netherlands does not intend to participate in the Durban IV meeting, given the historical burden of the Durban process.
Nederland is niet voornemens om deel te nemen aan de Durban IV-bijeenkomst, gelet op de historische belasting van het Durban-proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Piri, Van der Staaij en Jasper van Dijk over de dreigende executie van een Egyptische monnik

MPs from four parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she knew of Amnesty's appeal on the death sentence of Egyptian monk Wael Tawadros, whether torture-based confession and unfair trial could be confirmed, and whether she would press Egypt and the EU to stop the execution. The minister answered that she could not independently verify the allegations, noted rising executions in Egypt, and reported that Tawadros had already been executed on 9 May 2021, with Dutch and EU concern conveyed to Egyptian authorities at senior official level.
I therefore do not have independent information that confirms or refutes these reports, and can therefore give no further judgment on them.
Ik beschik derhalve niet over eigenstandige informatie die deze berichtgeving bevestigt dan wel ontkracht, en kan daar dan ook geen verder oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat Iran is verkozen als lid van de Commissie voor Vrouwenrechten van de Economische en Sociale Raad van de Verenigde Naties

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Iran's election to the UN ECOSOC Commission on the Status of Women, questioning its suitability given women's unequal position in Iran, the secrecy of the vote, and how the Netherlands voted. The minister acknowledged Dutch concerns about Iran's women's rights record, noted the vote was secret so individual positions are unknown, and declined to publicly disclose how the Netherlands voted, referring to a confidential annex.
The Netherlands does not make public statements about voting behaviour in secret ballots, because countries must be able to rely on the confidentiality of their vote.
Nederland doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over stemgedrag bij geheime stemmingen, omdat landen moeten kunnen rekenen op de vertrouwelijkheid van hun uitgebrachte stem

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van der Staaij, Jasper van Dijk en Agnes Mulder over de veroordeling van een monnik in Turkije voor het geven van brood aan Koerdische bezoekers, in aanvulling op vragen van het li

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the conviction of a monk in Turkey for giving food to Kurdish visitors, the situation of Christian minorities, and whether EU-Turkey rapprochement and pre-accession aid should continue. The government answered that the Dutch embassy follows the case, that concerns about rule of law and religious freedom in Turkey are raised consistently, and that it has pressed for suspending pre-accession aid, though no Council support exists.
The Netherlands has serious concerns about human rights and the rule of law in Turkey and consistently raises these concerns.
Nederland heeft grote zorgen over de mensenrechten en de rechtsstaat in Turkije en stelt deze zorgen consequent aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de beantwoording tijdens het mondelinge vragenuur van dinsdag 18 februari 2020 over het bericht ‘Meeste antisemitische incidenten in Nederland in dertig ja

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Segers asked the Justice Minister to explain his remarks in parliament that a 2019 Albert Cuyp market stabbing and the 2017 HaCarmel restaurant vandalism were antisemitic/terrorist-related, despite prosecutors and courts finding no discriminatory or terrorist motive. The minister answered that he meant to keep open the possibility of an antisemitic motive, that the word 'aanslag' expressed victims' feelings, and outlined measures such as the Jewish police network and the prosecution's expertise centre to improve recognition of antisemitism.
I made my statement in answer to a question from MP Van Dijk, who asked how I would ensure that every report of antisemitism would be taken seriously.
Ik deed mijn uitspraak in antwoord op een vraag van het Kamerlid Van Dijk, die vroeg hoe ik ervoor ging zorgen dat elke melding van antisemitisme serieus zou worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Peters, Paternotte en Segers over het zo snel mogelijk invoeren van de inburgeringsplicht van Turkse asielstatushouders

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Turkish asylum status holders can be made subject to civic integration duties from 1 May 2020 before the new law takes effect, and how COVID-19 measures apply to civic integration. The minister confirmed the duty will apply from 1 May 2020, the opt-in scheme will lapse for new holders, and the civic integration deadline is extended by two months for everyone due to the crisis.
Yes, I will act on this from 1 May 2020.
Ja, ik zal hier per 1 mei 2020 gevolg aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over de brandbrief van het Strategisch Overleg Mensenhandel (SOM) aan Tweede Kamer inzake de tijdelijke werkwijze Dublinoverdrachten

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked the Minister about an SOM/ZoCo letter claiming a de facto stop on human trafficking reports because Dublin transfers proceed before victims can file complaints, and about links to Operation Koolvis. The State Secretary replied that no new procedure exists, that transfers of claimants who could not report are rare, that police are working to handle reports faster, and that a new working method and further steps are being developed.
There is no new, temporary working method.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuwe, tijdelijke, werkwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost, Voordewind en Segers over de berichten 'Iraans anti-Israëlprotest bereikt ook westerse steden' en 'CIDI: Stop haatdemonstraties Iraans regime in Nederland'

MPs Drost, Voordewind and Segers asked whether calls to destroy Israel and the United States at a demonstration in The Hague were incitement to hatred, whether police should have ended it, whether an interpreter was present, and whether Iran was behind it. The minister answered that the demonstration right allows offensive speech, police found no criminal offences, an interpreter was present, and the cabinet has no concrete indication of Iranian involvement.
The right to demonstrate also includes publicly expressing opinions or statements that may be experienced as annoying, offensive or shocking.
Het demonstratierecht omvat ook het publiekelijk uiten van meningen of uitlatingen die als hinderlijk, aanstootgevend of choquerend kunnen worden ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Segers over het bericht ‘Verscherpte aanpak klanten van jeugdprostitutie door politie en OM’

MPs Kuik and Segers asked the Justice minister about OM and police plans to target clients of youth prostitution, including numbers of minor victims, prosecutions of clients, reporting, use of online lure profiles, and EU comparisons. The minister answered that 107 suspects were prosecuted in 2015-2018 with 93 convicted, that sentencing has moved toward unconditional prison terms, and that the Samen tegen Mensenhandel programme has no specific client-side measures and no data on mandatory client reports.
No figures are currently available on the number of mandatory reports by clients of suspected sexual exploitation of minors, because such figures are not recorded in this way by the police.

Er zijn op dit moment geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal verplichte meldingen door klanten bij vermoedens van seksuele uitbuiting van minderjarigen, omdat cijfers niet op deze wijze worden geregistreerd bij de politie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Segers over het bericht ‘Ombudsman slaat alarm: 'Het centrum van Amsterdam is 's nachts een wetteloze jungle’ en daarbij het conceptrapport van de Ombudsman van Amsterdam

MPs Drost and Segers asked ministers about the Amsterdam Ombudsman's draft report on lawlessness, nightlife, ATMs, prostitution and tourism in the city centre. The government replied that these are mainly local matters, outlined police capacity increases, RIEC cooperation, ATM oversight limits, and exit programmes, while declining to take a national lead on most suggested measures.
The draft report of the Ombudsman metropolitan Amsterdam concerns a local matter.
Het conceptrapport van de Ombudsman metropool Amsterdam betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de ‘Rapportage aan het Comité voor de rechten van personen met een handicap, inzake de eerste rapportage van Nederland’

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how the government responds to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report on implementing the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, covering accessibility, local inclusion plans, guardianship, education, transport and development aid. The Minister answered that the Onbeperkt Meedoen! programme and existing measures address these concerns, while acknowledging that implementation takes time and promising follow-up letters and an evaluation meeting.
I share the College's call to make the necessary adjustments as quickly as possible so that persons with disabilities can participate as fully as possible in society.

Ik deel de oproep van het College om zo snel als mogelijk noodzakelijke aanpassingen te treffen om te zorgen dat personen met een beperking zo volwaardig mogelijk kunnen deelnemen aan de maatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Kuik over de uitzending ‘Voodoo maffia’

MPs Segers and Kuik asked the Justice Minister about a Brandpunt+ broadcast on undocumented Nigerian trafficking victims bound by voodoo rituals, and whether police should specialise in Nigerian trafficking networks. The State Secretary answered that a dedicated police specialism is not desirable, pointing to existing specialised teams, international cooperation with Nigeria, Italy, Belgium and the EMPACT framework, and expecting better radar on networks through these measures.
A specialised team within the police focused solely on this target group is not something I consider desirable.
Een specialistisch team dat zich binnen de politie alleen op deze doelgroep richt acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht ‘Meisjes zwijgen liever’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Justice about a newspaper report that girls are reluctant to report sexual exploitation and whether reporting rates are falling, and asked what will be done to lower barriers and prioritise these cases. The Minister acknowledges the seriousness of sexual exploitation, says reporting barriers are being addressed through existing measures, denies evidence that reporting is falling, and promises a plan of action on human trafficking after the summer.
After the summer I will send your House the action plan on human trafficking.
Na de zomer zal ik uw Kamer het plan van aanpak voor mensenhandel toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Segers over de berichten ‘Ander huis gezocht voor bedreigde christelijke Syriër’ en ‘Syrische christen uit Overijssel krijgt dreigbrief, van IS’

Two MPs asked how citizens threatened for their faith or views, such as a Syrian Christian receiving a threat letter, can obtain adequate protection quickly, and how such cases are registered and countered. The government answered that local authorities are responsible for protection and risk assessment, that threats should be reported to police and are registered as discrimination or threats, and that a local multidisciplinary approach to radicalisation exists.
The local authority generally bears responsibility for the safety and well-being of its citizens.
Het lokale gezag draagt in het algemeen zorg voor de veiligheid en het welzijn van haar burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Buitenweg over het overwegen van strafverzwarende omstandigheden bij geweld met een racistisch, antisemitisch of homofoob oogmerk

Two MPs (Segers and Buitenweg) asked the Justice Minister about treating discriminatory motives (racist, antisemitic, homophobic) as aggravating circumstances in criminal sentencing, including whether prosecutors can go above the statutory maximum, how often courts do so, and whether ECRI's advice to legislate for this will be followed. Minister Grapperhaus explained the Dutch system of general offences with CODIS sentencing uplifts of 50-100% requested by prosecutors, said data on court treatment is unavailable, and announced renewed review through a letter to parliament.
So far it has not been possible to answer this question.
Het is tot op heden niet mogelijk gebleken deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over financiering van Nederlandse islamitische instellingen vanuit de Golfstaten

MPs Segers, Sjoerdsma and Karabulut asked the ministers about Gulf state financing of Dutch Islamic institutions, including why the ministry withheld information from RAND researchers and from municipalities, and why Saudi and Kuwaiti information was kept confidential. The minister answered that the ministry fully cooperated with RAND, that the information was shared with other government bodies and municipalities, that the Saudi MoU would not be published at Saudi request, and that the government is exploring legal measures on transparency of funding flows.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to the best of its knowledge and belief, provided full cooperation to RAND during the research at the end of 2014 so that it could conduct research in complete freedom.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft naar eer en geweten tijdens de uitvoering van het onderzoek eind 2014 volledige medewerking verleend aan RAND om in alle vrijheid onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over wooninitiatieven voor kinderen met een beperking

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked the health minister about the SCP finding that parent-initiated small-scale housing for children with disabilities is under pressure, covering funding, regulation, support, short indication periods, the housing allowance and PGB rules. The minister answered that he will consult VNG, ZN and Per Saldo on bottlenecks and clearer information, and promised further steps on client support and the housing allowance, without committing to a formal change.
I am going to consult with VNG, ZN and Per Saldo about these bottlenecks, including governance and financing, to discuss which improvements are possible in practice.
Ik ga met VNG, ZN en Per Saldo in overleg over deze knelpunten, waaronder regie en financiering, om te bespreken welke verbeteringen in de praktijk mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Kuik over het bericht '95 procent van gemeenten heeft geen beleid voor aanpak mensenhandel'

MPs Segers and Kuik asked the State Secretary about reports that 95 percent of municipalities lack anti-trafficking policy, the responsibility of municipalities for victim care, implementation of the Lenferink commission's recommendations, and inconsistent thresholds for the reflection period across border-control agencies. The State Secretary replied that only 4.5 percent of municipalities have specific trafficking policy, promised joint work with stakeholders on victim care and a uniform reflection-period approach, and said a further plan would follow.
Following this report, I will agree further arrangements with the police, the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee and the Inspectorate SZW to reach a uniform way of offering the reflection period.

Naar aanleiding van dit rapport zal ik in overleg met de politie, de Koninklijke Marechaussee en de Inspectie SZW nadere afspraken maken om te komen tot een uniforme wijze van aanbieden van de bedenktijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Oosten, Groothuizen en Segers over het bericht ‘Grote strafzaken verhuizen van rechtbank Almelo naar Zwolle’

MPs asked whether the move of multi-judge Functioneel Parket criminal cases from Almelo to Zwolle follows from the Herziening Gerechtelijke Kaart and whether Almelo keeps enough work. The minister confirmed the move follows from 2012 agreements, that Almelo remains a main location, and gave hour figures showing fewer multi-judge hearings in Almelo in 2018.
The shift of multi-judge Functioneel Parket criminal cases to Zwolle from 1 January 2018 flows directly from agreements made in 2012 within the framework of the Judicial Map Revision Act (HGK).

De verschuiving van meervoudige strafzaken van het Functioneel Parket per 1 januari 2018 naar Zwolle, zijnde de vestigingsplaats van het Functioneel Parket in Overijssel, vloeit direct voort uit afspraken die in 2012 het kader van de Wet Herziening Gerechtelijke Kaart (HGK) zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Knops, Ten Broeke, Martin Bosma en Van der Staaij over de verboden stille tocht van Christenen voor Israël in Rotterdam

Six MPs asked why Rotterdam's mayor banned a silent march by Christians for Israel, questioning the security rationale given the comparable treatment of a Palestinian Return Centre congress and the impact on Jewish residents. The minister replied that maintaining public order is the mayor's responsibility and accountable to the municipal council, that the organisation itself chose to cancel the march, and that police capacity decisions in similar future cases rest with the mayor.
Maintaining public order in Rotterdam is the responsibility of the mayor of Rotterdam.
De handhaving van de openbare orde in Rotterdam is de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester van Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Segers en Verhoeven over het bericht dat drugs met medeweten van de politie Nederland in is gesmokkeld

MPs Van Nispen, Segers and Verhoeven asked whether police officers knowingly let cocaine shipments into the Netherlands, whether a tipster was paid, and whether the no-let-pass rule (doorlaatverbod) was breached. Minister Blok declined to address the specific questions because the criminal case is before the court, restated the legal framework for seizure and controlled delivery, and saw no reason for a further investigation.
Given that the criminal case is currently before the court, it is not appropriate for me to address these questions in substance.
Gelet op het feit dat de strafzaak momenteel onder de rechter is, past het mij niet om inhoudelijk in te gaan op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer, Segers, Pechtold, Van Haersma Buma en Klaver over openstaande vragen met betrekking tot de Teevendeal

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, D66, CDA and GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister about the open questions surrounding the Teeven deal, including why officials at Algemene Zaken had a ministry email with draft answers without the PM being informed, and asked for access to the emails. The PM answered that the email was received but not read or discussed, that no reply was sent, and that releasing the underlying internal emails is incompatible with protecting open deliberation and staff privacy.

Granting access to the underlying internal civil-service emails is not compatible with the essential interest in properly preparing decision-making, which is served by confidentiality of free and open exchange of ideas.
Verlening van inzage in onderliggende ambtelijke mails is niet verenigbaar met het wezenlijke belang dat is gemoeid met een goede voorbereiding van besluitvorming
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de rol van prostitutiewebsites bij mensenhandel

A ChristenUnie MP asked whether adult-services websites enable trafficking and contact with minors, and whether their operators are held accountable and should need licences. The minister answered that existing criminal law (art. 273f and sexual offence articles) suffices, that prosecution of operators is not separately recorded, and that the police logo use on one site has been removed.
I intend to continue this consultation.
Ik ben voornemens dit overleg voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de vernietiging van in beslag genomen nep-kleding

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the ministers whether seized counterfeit clothing is destroyed, who decides, and whether a central record exists and destruction can favour circular recycling. The minister answered that counterfeit goods are destroyed under the Criminal Procedure Code, that a central seizure portal exists but has gaps with implementation planned for 2018, and that destroyed materials can be recycled where possible.
This cross-chain central ICT system still has shortcomings.
Dit ketenoverstijgende centraal ICT-systeem kent nog onvolkomenheden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Segers over het betrekken van de pilot ‘spreekuurrechter’ bij het onderzoek naar de haalbaarheid en inpasbaarheid in de reguliere rechtspraak van een vrederechter

MPs Van Nispen and Segers asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a 'spreekuurrechter' (walk-in judge) pilot at the Noord-Nederland district court and whether its experience would feed into the study of a vrederechter (justice of the peace) model. The Minister confirmed awareness, said the Judiciary is evaluating the pilot, and said the WODC study on Belgium and France will draw on pilot experience, without specifying the study design.
It is not yet known how the study referred to in the motion will be designed.
Het is nog niet bekend op welke wijze het onderzoek als bedoeld in de motie zal worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Criminelen wijken uit naar Gelderland voor dumpen drugsafval’

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked about reports that drug waste dumping is shifting to Gelderland and why few people claim from the co-financing fund for cleanup costs, and whether the fund could pay faster or a higher share. The minister acknowledges a slight rise, explains low claim numbers (unawareness, missing documents, small amounts), refuses faster payment to keep the pro-rata system, and says talks with provinces on a higher share and a possible offender levy are ongoing.
I am in discussion with the provinces to explore the possibilities for better use of the compensation scheme.
Ik ben met de provincies in gesprek om de mogelijkheden voor betere benutting van de vergoedingsregeling te verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over ‘Golf van seks zonder vergunning’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of large-scale unlicensed prostitution advertising in eastern Netherlands, asking about trafficking risks, enforcement capacity, financial coercion, policy targets and reporting of trafficking victims. The minister answered that advertising has no licence requirement, that research finds no conclusive link between regulation and trafficking, and that enforcement is handled by regional police teams, while promising a follow-up letter after the Monitor Mensenhandel part two is published.
Once these figures are available, I will inform the House of the measures I intend to take to achieve an increase in the number of registered trafficking victims in the coming period.

Zodra deze cijfers beschikbaar zijn, informeer ik uw Kamer over de maatregelen die ik voornemens ben te treffen om in de komende periode een stijging van het aantal geregistreerde slachtoffers mensenhandel te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Swinkels, Van Tongeren en Segers over de financiering van de rechtspraak

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Security and Justice about how the judiciary is funded, including judicial independence, the role of efficiency considerations, funding for new projects and workload from new legislation, and the Warsaw declaration on objective budget criteria. The answers were referred to a separate letter ('Positionering en financiering rechtspraak', Kamerstuk 29 279, nr. 352) rather than answered in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de aanbesteding van dienstauto’s voor de brandweer

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked about the tender for fleet cars for the fire service, including the diesel requirement, sustainability criteria and tax treatment. The State Secretary replied that the diesel requirement is being dropped, that the fire service's procuring body (IFV) has been asked to pay attention to environmental aspects, and that the choice of diesel versus alternatives has cost implications.
As indicated in the reply of 13 April 2016, the diesel requirement is being dropped.
Zoals aangegeven in de beantwoording van 13 april 2016 1 wordt de dieseleis geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van Toorenburg over de 24/7 opening van Holland Casino in Rotterdam

MPs Segers and Van Toorenburg asked whether Holland Casino's 24/7 opening in Rotterdam is acceptable given gambling-addiction risks, whether mayors have say over opening hours, and whether a trial could be stopped or monitored. The State Secretary answered that opening hours are a local matter, the operator's duty of care applies at all hours, the Gaming Authority was not informed of the trial, and existing monitoring suffices.
When asked, the Gaming Authority indicated to me that it was not informed in advance.
Desgevraagd heeft de Kansspelautoriteit aan mij aangegeven niet tevoren geïnformeerd te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de registratie van jihadgangers en terugkeerders

The MP Segers asked the Minister of Security and Justice why registrations of jihadist travellers in Europol's Focal Point Travellers and EIS rose sharply since March 2015, how travellers were tracked, whether they are stopped at borders, and how many may be unregistered. The Minister explained that information sharing has grown through EU cooperation, that border checks rely on SIS II and the Stolen and Lost Travel Documents database rather than Focal Point Travellers or EIS, and that exact unregistered numbers cannot be known, while withholding details on the Paris and Brussels attackers because of ongoing investigations.
It is not possible to say with certainty how many unknown jihadist travellers are not registered in the Focal Point Travellers or the EIS, nor in any other system such as SIS II.
Het is niet mogelijk met zekerheid te zeggen hoeveel onbekende jihadgangers niet geregistreerd zijn in het Focal Point Travellers of het EIS, noch in enig ander system, zoals het SISII.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over dumping van drugsafval in Gelderland

ChristenUnie MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about the rise in illegal drug-waste dumping in Gelderland, including the cost-sharing fund, dumping figures, offender liability and cooperation with provinces. The government answered that it had not contacted Gelderland, that dumping appears to shift from Brabant toward neighbouring provinces, that a 1 million euro cofinancing fund covers all provinces with a review due by 1 September, and that it will not change its drug enforcement approach.
The total subsidy requested remains well below the available amount of 1 million euros, and the number of applications is also smaller than expected.
Het totaal aan gevraagde subsidie blijft ruim onder het beschikbare bedrag van € 1 miljoen en ook het aantal aanvragen is kleiner dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de aanbesteding voor nieuwe politieauto’s

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked whether the police tender for new patrol cars requiring diesel engines and a 140 g/km CO2 limit, and lacking further climate criteria, is consistent with air quality and sustainable procurement goals. The government answered that the diesel requirement will be dropped from the final programme of requirements, that the police are considering sustainability criteria, and that fiscal incentives (BPM and MRB exemptions) make diesel economically attractive for high-mileage vehicles.
However, this requirement will be dropped and will therefore not form part of the final programme of requirements.
Deze eis zal echter worden geschrapt en zal dus geen onderdeel uitmaken van het definitief programma van eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Maij en Segers over het gebruik door GeenPeil van de subsidieregeling referendum

MPs Verhoeven, Maij and Segers asked the Minister of the Interior whether the referendum subsidy scheme was being misused by GeenPeil, where natural persons applied for subsidies while a legal entity stood behind them and purchased services from it. The Minister replied that the independent Referendum Commission assesses applications only against the scheme's criteria, that over 40 applicants bought services from GeenPeil and disclosed this, and that he cannot judge the application himself.
It is not for me to comment on the extent to which subsidy applications and related circumstances are acceptable and permissible.
Het is niet aan mij om mij uit te laten over de mate waarin subsidieaanvragen en/of met die aanvragen samenhangende omstandigheden acceptabel en geoorloofd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht 'Eritrese intimidatie in Nederland breidt zich uit'

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked about reports of intimidation of Eritrean regime critics in the Netherlands, including threats at asylum locations and whether IND interpreters are linked to the regime. The government said it has no specific registration of such incidents, pointed to police and prosecution duties, outlined vetting and a code of conduct for IND interpreters with two interpreters dropped and an external audit, and referred back to earlier answers on regime levies.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police do not specifically record in their systems the link between offences and the Eritrean regime.
Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie registeren niet specifiek in de systemen op de relatie van delicten met het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over drugsafval in landbouwakkers

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about drug waste dumped in farmland and gierkelders, including health risks, soil contamination, cost of cleanup, and enforcement capacity. The minister answered that detected amphetamine/MDMA levels pose no health danger, that no evidence yet shows dumping at other farms, that cleanup costs fall on polluters or landowners with a €1 million annual national fund for provinces, and that Intensivering Zuid strengthens anti-drug enforcement in Brabant.
Strong efforts are therefore being made to combat drug crime and the dumping of drug waste.
Er wordt dan ook stevig ingezet op het bestrijden van drugscriminaliteit en dumping van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Segers over de BTW-plicht van gemeenten bij ambtelijke fusies

MPs Schouten and Segers asked why municipalities merging their civil service must pay VAT on services from the joint organisation, and whether an exemption would be introduced. The Staatssecretaris confirmed awareness, explained the cooperation exemption's conditions, and announced a policy change extending the exemption to services used 70% or more for non-taxed municipal activities, largely solving the problem.
I will publish this policy change in the usual way, whereby under the Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht the past will not be revisited ex officio.
Ik zal deze beleidswijziging op de gebruikelijke wijze publiceren, waarbij conform het Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht ambtshalve niet op het verleden wordt teruggekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat een Joods gezin is bekogeld met vuurwerk

MP Segers asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the government responds to reports that a Jewish family in Amsterdam was pelted with fireworks and subjected to antisemitic chants on New Year's Eve, and what protection, prosecution, and anti-antisemitism measures exist. The minister condemned antisemitism, said police opened an investigation with two minors sent home under a conduct order, and pointed to existing discrimination prosecution policy and the national action programme, while declining to comment on the ongoing investigation.
Furthermore, the police investigation is ongoing, and I cannot make any statements about it.
Daarnaast loopt het politieonderzoek, waarover ik geen uitspraken kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over drugsgebruik op het Amsterdam Dance Event (ADE)

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Security and Justice about drug use and arrests at the Amsterdam Dance Event, including the 'five-pill' policy, what the organisation's responsibility was, and whether festivals with widespread hard drug use could be banned. The government answered that licensing and enforcement are local matters for the municipality, that the organisers and venue owners bear responsibility under their permits, and that it is developing guidance and talking with mayors, without committing to a ban.
Granting and refusing permits and enforcing permit conditions are local matters.
Het verlenen en weigeren van vergunningen en het handhaven van aan vergunningen verbonden voorwaarden zijn lokale aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over adopties vanuit Bulgarije

An MP asks the Minister whether intercountry adoptions from Bulgaria, after a Brandpunt documentary alleging children are taken from parents without consent, should be investigated and paused. The Minister says all about 30 recent Bulgarian adoption files were rechecked with no reason found to think rules were broken, a working visit to Bulgaria is planned, and adoptions will not be suspended for now.
For that reason I have had all approximately 30 files of children adopted from Bulgaria over the past two years reviewed again.
Om die reden heb ik alle circa 30 dossiers van kinderen die de afgelopen twee jaar uit Bulgarije zijn geadopteerd nogmaals laten bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Segers over het onterecht in rekening brengen van informatie- en executiekosten door gerechtsdeurwaarders

MPs asked whether bailiffs wrongly charge information and execution costs, including unjustified bank attachments, and how often tax-authority attachments are pointless. The minister answered that the KBvG reported four disciplinary complaints and the BFT three investigations in five years, that no further consultation is needed, and that roughly 130,000 to 135,000 attachments are levied yearly with electronic information requests and the VISH index used to reduce pointless attachments.
In view of the information provided by the BFT and the KBvG, I see no reason to enter into additional discussions on this matter.
Gelet op de verstrekte informatie van het BFT en de KBvG zie ik geen aanleiding aanvullende gesprekken hierover aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over de mogelijkheid in een handomdraai aan een vals Syrisch paspoort te komen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the government about a press report that a forged official Syrian passport could be obtained easily, and whether Dutch services detect such documents and cooperate with intelligence services. The government answered that Syrian documents are checked extra thoroughly, that the damaged document cannot be examined for detection purposes, and that the IND cooperates with the AIVD and MIVD and with European partners.
The document described in the article was rendered unusable by the journalist.
Het document waar in het artikel over wordt geschreven is door de journalist onbruikbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber inzake verkoop van krasloten en gokverslaving

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary about scratch-card sales, gambling addiction prevalence, and whether a daily purchase limit or registration card should be introduced. The State Secretary answered that the WODC estimates show a declining trend, that the Kansspelautoriteit sees no signals requiring a change, and that no new consultation with Belgium or the regulator is deemed necessary.
The Kansspelautoriteit has no signals that gambling addiction is increasing in scope as a result of scratch-card sales.
Er zijn bij de Kansspelautoriteit geen signalen bekend dat gokverslaving in omvang toeneemt als gevolg van verkoop van krasloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het negeren van een uitspraak van de Reclame Code Commissie

An MP asked ministers why an erotic website's advertising, already ruled against by the Advertising Code Commission, could reappear on a beach banner and whether current enforcement tools are sufficient. The government answered that the Code applies to banners, that the firm complied with the earlier ruling (96% of advertisers comply), that a new complaint is being assessed, and that current instruments are adequate.
Given the high percentage of advertisers that follow a ruling (96%), I consider the current instruments sufficient.
Gelet op het hoge percentage adverteerders dat een uitspraak opvolgt (96%), acht ik de huidige instrumenten voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat er te weinig geld is voor opvang loverboyslachtoffers in verband met toename problematiek

An MP asked about reports of waiting lists at specialised shelters for loverboy victims and the risk of relapse into forced prostitution. The State Secretary acknowledged victims need prompt specialised help, pointed to VNG consultations and municipal responsibility under the Wmo and Jeugdwet, and promised to follow up with Fier Fryslân and the VNG.
I have asked both the VNG and Fier Fryslân to set up an adequate procedure and to maintain regular contact so that any bottlenecks can be resolved quickly and adequately.
Ik heb zowel de VNG als Fier Fryslân gevraagd om een adequate procedure in te richten en hier regelmatig contact over te hebben zodat eventuele knelpunten snel en adequaat kunnen worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van der Staaij over gebruik van onderzoek naar drugsresten in rioolwater als aanvullend instrument naast andere drugsmonitoringmethoden

MPs Segers and Van der Staaij asked whether wastewater analysis for drug residues is a useful supplement to other drug monitoring methods and whether it should be deployed structurally and nationally, including for designer drugs. The state secretary replied that the method has limited added value compared with national surveys and other monitoring sources, saw no need for further research, and declined to step up its use.
I therefore see no added value in further research.
Ik zie derhalve geen toegevoegde waarde in nader onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de Katwijkse aanpak van drugs

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Katwijk's combined repressive and preventive approach to underage cannabis use should serve as a model, whether other municipalities can use the Public Prosecution Service's cooperation, and whether the government will inventory local practices and share the Katwijk approach. The minister called the combination of repression, prevention and parental involvement a good approach that can serve as an example, said municipalities can consult police, prosecution and Halt on comparable problems, and declined to inventory or circulate local initiatives because policy is a matter for local government.
Drafting policy that best suits the local situation is a matter for the competent local authority.
Het opstellen van beleid dat het meest geschikt is voor de lokale situatie is een zaak van het bevoegd lokaal gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van Oosten, Rebel, Oskam, Van Tongeren en Van der Staaij over de inzet van de Koninklijke Marechaussee bij de bestrijding van mensenhandel

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Royal Marechaussee's role in combating human trafficking, its legal basis in the Police Act, and more sniffer dogs for searching lorries. The minister confirmed the KMar's frequent involvement and stated that its trafficking-combating task is covered by existing police tasks, with a review of possible legal changes ongoing and some capacity measures taken.
Consultations are currently taking place between my department, the Public Prosecution Service, the police and the KMar to further improve cooperation in combating human trafficking.

Momenteel vindt er overleg plaats tussen mijn departement, het Openbaar Ministerie, de politie en de KMar om de samenwerking op het gebied van de bestrijding van mensenhandel nog verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Recourt, Berndsen-Jansen, Segers en Van Tongeren over de uitzending van Argos over de verdwenen tapgesprekken

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about an Argos broadcast on missing wiretap recordings, including whether the ADR inquiry into the system failure was adequate, the role of the supplier, and whether the government controls the stored data. The minister replied that the broadcast revealed no new facts, that the ADR found no sign of deliberate human action, that the supplier withheld one detail for trade-secret reasons, and that the police manage the system and have taken additional measures.
It is true that the ADR investigation did not provide complete clarity on all points.
Het klopt dat het onderzoek van de ADR niet op alle punten volledige duidelijkheid heeft opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de aanpak van wraakporno en onderzoek naar sexting

A Christian Union MP asked the Justice Minister about revenge porn, whether it can only be prosecuted under insult and slander laws, the number of cases and convictions, sexting used by loverboys, and prevention material. The minister referred to an earlier letter for most questions, said convictions for slander cannot be traced to revenge porn cases, cited a WODC finding on minors pressured via sexting, and pointed to existing education and media-literacy programmes.
From the total of convictions for slander or defamation, it cannot be determined how often a link can be made to a report concerning revenge porn, because this is not recorded as such.

Uit het totaal aan veroordelingen op grond van smaad of laster, kan niet worden herleid hoe vaak een relatie kan worden gelegd met een aangifte inzake wraakporno omdat dit niet als zodanig wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over de aanpak van huiselijk geweld in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked whether the government would adopt preventive, family-centred approaches to domestic violence in Caribbean Netherlands instead of a mainly justice-based response, and whether they would fund and roll out a pilot run by the Bonaire youth and family centre. The government answered that an integrated approach covering prevention, care and justice is needed, pointed to existing measures and funding, and said it would support a Bonaire Eigen Kracht pilot and share results if successful, without committing to a rollout.
If the conference proves successful, the results will be shared with the other islands.
Mocht de conferentie een succes blijken te zijn, dan zullen de resultaten gedeeld worden met de andere eilanden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Potters, Oskam en Karabulut over het bericht dat een omstreden sjeik naar Eindhoven komt

MPs from ChristenUnie, VVD, CDA and SP asked ministers whether a controversial sheikh who was to visit Eindhoven had received a visa, how entry bans and SIS alerts work, whether the mayor and foreign partners were consulted, and whether a list of hate preachers exists. The government answered that the Italian visa was withdrawn so the sheikh may not stay in the Netherlands, that the mayor consulted the NCTV, that entry-ban and SIS procedures are explained in general terms, and that an alert list of preachers is in use but numbers are not disclosed.
I cannot provide any information on the number of persons on this list.
Over het aantal personen op deze lijst kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het proefschrift 'Captivated by fear. An evaluation of terrorism detention policy'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a dissertation evaluating terrorism detention policy, including the separate terrorist wing, international experience, and deradicalisation programmes. The government answered that it is reviewing whether the wing regime can be tailored per case and will report before the summer recess, and that a deradicalisation exit facility will be operational in September 2015.
This exercise also looks at placing these suspects and detainees on a separate ward and whether the different types of terrorism-related detainees should and could be separated from each other.
Daarbij wordt tevens aandacht besteed aan de plaatsing van deze verdachten en gedetineerden op een afzonderlijke afdeling en de vraag of de verschillende typen TA-gedetineerden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Segers over het bericht ‘Gezamenlijke ketenactie tegen arbeidsuitbuiting en mensenhandel’

MPs Van Laar and Segers asked about a joint enforcement action against labour exploitation and trafficking on Bonaire, including how few addresses were checked, why action came only now, victim shelter, and prostitution policy. The minister reported no arrests and no finding of underpayment or exploitation, promised recurring joint checks at least four times a year, and said a revised MoU is expected in June 2015.
Agreements have been made to act jointly at least four times a year, with prostitution being one of the sectors that will regularly be checked.
Er zijn afspraken gemaakt om ten minste vier keer per jaar gezamenlijk op te treden waarbij prostitutie een van de sectoren is die regelmatig zullen worden gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de uitzending ‘Ongelukkige Spoed’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a broadcast on weekly accidents involving emergency vehicles, the speed-through-red rule, use of crash-recording systems, and driver training. The minister answered that hulpdiensten are working on prevention, that police training will be phased in through 2017, and that further measures will wait for the results of existing ones.
I intend to wait for the results of the measures already taken.
Ik ben voornemens om de resultaten van de reeds genomen maatregelen af te wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Oskam over het bericht ‘Utrecht vreest komst Belgische martelsjeik’

Two MPs (Segers and Oskam) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Utrecht feared a visit by a Belgian preacher and about possible blacklists, visa measures, and cooperation against hate preachers. The minister answered that the local triangle found no legal grounds to act, that no blacklist exists though an alerting list is kept, and that the answers on intelligence and foreign contacts are limited.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat justitiebanen wegvloeien uit Leeuwarden

MP Segers asked whether justice jobs are draining from Leeuwarden and whether new justice services are being steered away from less central cities, and how the Schouten motion on Northern Netherlands employment was applied. The minister denied recognising that pattern, said employment effects were considered in past location choices and that the Rechtspraak decides on scan facilities, and stated no jobs were lost in Northern Netherlands after court map reform apart from some back-office functions moved to Groningen.
Any change to the court sitting locations must be submitted to parliament for prior consultation.
Een eventuele wijziging van de zittingsplaatsen moet bij het parlement worden voorgehangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Oskam en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Eerste stap naar vergunning voor gokbedrijven’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the Kansspelautoriteit's survey of interest in online gambling licences was justified, whether it should be halted before the bill passed, how many applications were expected, and how advertising violations by gambling firms were monitored and sanctioned. The State Secretary answered that the survey was the regulator's own decision to prepare for licensing, that he hoped licensing would be swift for consumer protection, that expected applications rested on a 2011 study and contacts with regulators, and that individual enforcement cases could not be disclosed to protect ongoing investigations.
Offering this possibility to interested parties for a licence was an independent decision of the gambling authority.
Het bieden van deze mogelijkheid aan geïnteresseerden voor een vergunning is een zelfstandige beslissing van de kansspelautoriteit geweest.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA) en Segers (ChristenUnie) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Megabenefiet-gala «Het is nu of nooit» in Utrecht (ingezonden 20 februari 2015).

MPs Omtzigt and Segers asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether they knew of a March 2015 Utrecht gala with a cleric who had endorsed jihad in Syria, and about visa screening for attendees. The ministers answered that the cleric was not known to have attended, that the cleric's 2013 message reflected a broader Sunni position on a legitimate jihad in Syria, and that no visas were known to have been requested for the gala.
No visa has been requested at the Kingdom's representations abroad in the name of the preacher (Sheikh) Assim Al-Hakeem named in the announcements.
Bij de vertegenwoordigingen van het Koninkrijk in het buitenland is geen visum aangevraagd op naam van de in de aankondigingen genoemde prediker (Sheikh) Assim Al-Hakeem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat de aanpak van zware misdaad in Noord-Nederland hapert

Segers (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the fight against serious crime in Northern Netherlands is stalling, including a backlog in criminal investigations and the effects of police reorganisation. The Minister denied a backlog in investigations, attributing the drop in complex cases to a focus on processing times, and announced measures to increase cases referred to the multi-judge chamber and to bring anti-organised-crime units up to strength.
In Northern Netherlands there is no backlog in the number of criminal investigations.
In Noord-Nederland is geen sprake van een achterstand in het aantal recherche-onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Segers over het bericht dat de Turks-Nederlandse vereniging DIDF niet welkom is in een buurthuis in Zaandam vanwege kritiek op de Turkse president Erdogan

MPs Karabulut and Segers asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it was acceptable that a Zaandam community centre excluded the Turkish-Dutch association DIDF over criticism of President Erdogan, and whether such exclusion rules and the centre's contract clause on foreign politics were compatible with freedom of expression. The minister answered that this is a private dispute between two organisations, that the municipality mediated and has no formal responsibility, and that the conflict has been resolved by agreement.
This is a dispute in social-community relations. The two parties are independent organisations and will have to agree between themselves to reach a solution.
Dit is een geschil in sociaal maatschappelijk verkeer. De twee partijen zijn zelfstandige organisaties en zullen het samen eens moeten worden om tot een oplossing te kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht ‘Polderjihadisten ‘oer-Nederlands’

An MP asked the government whether the AIVD has enough funding and capacity to handle returning jihadists, why it was reportedly overwhelmed, and how border controls on departing youths can be improved. The government replied that the AIVD is adequately resourced with extra funding for research capacity, that the surge in travelers was foreseen rather than unexpected, and it outlined existing passport-signalling and EU information-sharing measures.
There was no question of being overwhelmed.
Er was geen sprake van overrompeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Segers, Dijkgraaf en Thieme over het wachtgeld voor de voorzitter van de Europese Raad

Five MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the EU transitional allowance (wachtgeld) for the outgoing President of the European Council, who had already reached pensionable age and could draw his Belgian pension alongside it, and about pension accrual rates and job-seeking obligations. The minister confirmed the facts, said the EU rules (Regulation 422/67/EEG) cap the allowance at three years with no job-seeking duty, and said the Netherlands is willing to examine modernising and reducing the scheme, though any change requires Council action.
The Netherlands is willing to examine whether modernising and reducing the current scheme for political office holders in the EU is possible
Nederland is bereid te bekijken of modernisering en versobering van de huidige regeling voor politieke ambtsdragers in de EU mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Segers en Berndsen-Jansen over de ontnemingsschikking met Cees H. en het bericht Teeven weer in opspraak

MPs Van Nispen, Segers and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Justice about a settlement with Cees H. (EUR 750,000 agreed), the unclear actual payment flows via Luxembourg, the exclusion of the tax authority, and a prosecutor's side agreement on a pardon. The minister replied that the actual financial settlement cannot be verified further, that the agreed amount stands, that no further investigation into the pardon matter is warranted, and that the Staatssecretaris was questioned by the investigator and by the minister.
After this investigation I informed the House by letter of 3 June 2014 that I unfortunately could not inform it further about the actual financial settlement of the agreement.
Ik heb uw Kamer na dit onderzoek bij brief van 3 juni 2014 laten weten dat ik uw Kamer helaas niet verder kon informeren over de feitelijke financiële afwikkeling van de schikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Segers over draagmoederschap

Two MPs asked the government about surrogacy, including unregulated online matching, risks to children, enforcement under the Criminal Code, and the status of existing policy. The Secretary of State answered that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming investigates only when it learns of a possible surrogacy arrangement, that reporting and a new reporting structure are not needed, that enforcement is limited and largely left to the Public Prosecution Service, and that policy will await the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap, expected in 2016.
It is not inconceivable that single men also make contact with potential surrogate mothers.
Het is niet ondenkbaar dat ook alleenstaande mannen contact leggen met potentiële draagmoeders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Kooiman over de vroegtijdige plaatsing van een veroordeelde mensenhandelaar in een zeer beperkt beveiligde inrichting (zbbi)

MPs Segers and Kooiman asked why a convicted human trafficker was placed in a zbbi before serving half his sentence, why victims were informed only after his first leave, and what safeguards exist during weekly leave. The minister answered that placement follows the regime, victims were informed in time, a no-contact condition applies, and victims are not consulted on leave decisions.
There is no question of victims advising on the granting of freedoms during detention.
Van advisering door slachtoffers bij het toekennen van vrijheden tijdens detentie is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Mohandis en Segers over het bericht “Bonus directeur regionale omroep L1 onder de loep”

MPs Kerstens, Mohandis and Segers asked whether regional broadcaster L1 paid a director a bonus of over 26,000 euro, whether bonuses fall under WNT transitional law, and how unlawful bonuses are recovered and sanctioned. The Minister answered that the Commissariaat voor de Media is investigating, that bonuses agreed after 6 December 2011 are unlawful and must be recovered via a set procedure with penalty orders, and that he will consult VNG and IPO on model subsidy rules.
The Commissariaat voor de Media is currently investigating this.
Het Commissariaat voor de Media onderzoekt dit momenteel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over ‘ICT-adviseur wil gemeenten helpen aan Big Brother 2.0’

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about a report on an ICT adviser's vision of municipal data sharing ('Big Brother 2.0') and the privacy and oversight implications. The minister says the Wbp provides an adequate framework, municipalities are autonomous with no central oversight beyond the CBP, and a broader public debate is planned via a WRR advisory request.
Given the autonomy of municipalities, including in the field of information exchange, there is no supervision by the national government.
Gelet op de autonomie van gemeenten, ook op het gebied van informatie-uitwisseling, is er geen toezicht door de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over het bestraffen van chauffeurs met te hoog beladen vrachtwagens

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked why drivers of overheight trucks at the Velsertunnel are rarely fined, how often fines are issued nationally, and whether road inspectors could be given enforcement powers. The minister explained the notification procedure, reported low fine counts due to police attendance and the planned 2016 renovation, and said talks on a Rotterdam inspector pilot are ongoing.
I refer further to my answer to question 2 for an explanation of the number of height signals compared to the number of fines.
Ik verwijs verder naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 voor een toelichting op het aantal hoogtesignaleringen ten opzichte van het aantal boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de berichten dat personeel bij de rechtbanken in Leeuwarden en Assen weggehaald wordt

Segers (ChristenUnie) asked whether the Noord-Nederland court's plan to move office staff from Leeuwarden and Assen to Groningen was known to the minister, how it fits the judicial map revision and regional employment commitments. Minister Opstelten said the plan has been withdrawn, that court sittings in Leeuwarden and Assen are unaffected, and that office organisation is a matter for the judiciary itself, with the Raad voor de rechtspraak to report back.
The judgement whether a sitting location must also have an office function is primarily for the Judiciary itself.
Het oordeel of een zittingsplaats ook een kantoorfunctie moet hebben is primair aan de Rechtspraak zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam,Omtzigt en Segers over de radicale prediker ‘Tarik ibn Ali’ uit België die naar Gouda

Three MPs asked the ministers whether a Belgian imam with radical messages, invited by a Gouda mosque board, would be barred and whether criminal action was underway. The minister answered that no hateful content is currently expected, the local authority has agreed no incitement will occur, criminal action would follow if it did, and no Belgian investigation is known.
At this moment we have no indications that this person is coming to the Netherlands to proclaim a hateful or inciting message.
Op dit moment hebben wij geen aanwijzingen dat deze persoon naar Nederland komt om een haatzaaiende of opruiende boodschap te verkondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de aanpak van drugsafval

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked whether a fund could be created, financed from Plukze proceeds, to compensate landowners for clearing dumped drug waste, and what clean-up costs were in 2012 and 2013. The minister answered that no legal barriers exist but the cabinet is reluctant to create budget funds, that costs should fall on the perpetrator, and estimated Noord-Brabant clean-up costs at about 1.5 million euro in 2012 and 3 million euro in 2013.
The costs that landowners face for clearing dumped drug waste should primarily be borne by the perpetrator.
De kosten waarmee grondeigenaren worden geconfronteerd om gedumpt drugsafval op te ruimen dienen primair ten laste te komen van de dader.

Vragen van de leden Segers (ChristenUnie) en Siderius (SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Jeugdklinieken in nood door overheveling

MPs Segers and Siderius asked about reports that youth clinics face financial distress from the transfer of youth care to municipalities, and about the motion on care for victims of trafficking and honour-related violence, municipal purchasing of specialist care, and whether children can still reach specialist facilities. The State Secretaries answered that the transition is ongoing, a VNG framework and a transition arrangement support specialist providers, bridge funding exists, municipalities remain responsible for their own purchasing, and the Youth Act guarantees access to appropriate care.
We follow the transition closely. We try to support municipalities as much as possible in the transition, and also address municipalities and/or regions where problems threaten to arise.
We proberen gemeenten zoveel mogelijk te ondersteunen bij de transitie, en spreken gemeenten en/of regio’s ook aan daar waar zich problemen dreigen voor te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van der Staaij en Omtzigt over de Gaza-demonstratie van 24 juli 2014 in Den Haag

Three MPs asked the ministers about the Gaza demonstration in The Hague on 24 July 2014, including whether it was properly notified, whether police and prosecutors acted on antisemitic chants, threats to journalists, and display of ISIS flags. The government answered that the demonstration was notified as required with 50 expected participants, referred to answers given to related questions, and stated the prosecution's position that displaying IS and Hamas flags is punishable under the Penal Code.

The position is that IS (formerly ISIS/ISIL) and Hamas, banned as terrorist organisations by the EU and UN aiming at violence against certain population groups, public display of their flags constitutes a criminal offence in the prosecution's view under Articles 137d and 137c of the Penal Code.

Het standpunt houdt in dat nu IS (voorheen ISIS/ISIL) en Hamas (door de EU en de VN) verboden, terroristische organisaties zijn die tot doel hebben geweld te plegen tegen bepaalde bevolkingsgroepen, het in het openbaar tonen van deze vlaggen van deze organisaties naar het oordeel van het Openbaar Ministerie strafbaarheid oplevert
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over de anti-Israëldemonstratie die zaterdag 12 juli 2014 in Den Haag is gehouden

MPs Voordewind and Segers asked the Justice Minister whether he regretted Nazi and ISIS symbols shown at a July 2014 anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, how they would be countered, and whether mayors should get more powers. The minister said the Public Prosecution Service now treats displaying IS and Hamas flags as punishable, noted that free expression and demonstration can be restricted under ECHR and criminal law, and said existing mayoral powers appear sufficient.
At present there is no reason to assume that those powers fall short.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat die bevoegdheden tekortschieten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers, Dijkgraaf, Van Bommel en De Roon over het bericht ‘Verboden vlag overschaduwt Veteranendag’

MPs from several parties asked whether veterans were barred from carrying the Morgenster flag at the National Veterans Day parade because of sensitivities with Indonesia, and whether the government had raised the matter with Indonesian authorities. The minister replied that the organising committee decided in 2013 to allow only regimental flags at the formal parade, a rule agreed with veterans' associations and not a ban, that Indonesia had objected in past years without the committee being pressured, and that the decision is the committee's responsibility.
The committee discussed this with the veterans' associations and they agreed to it.
Het comité heeft dit met de veteranenverenigingen besproken en zij hebben hiermee ingestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Schouten over het bericht dat miljardenwinst door dwangarbeid en seks behaald wordt

MPs Segers and Schouten asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Security and Justice how the government responds to an ILO report on forced labour profits, its size in the EU and the Netherlands, migrant share, enforcement capacity, and international cooperation. Minister Asscher answered that the government is doing all it can, cites rising human trafficking prosecutions, says reliable victim estimates are lacking, and states support for the new ILO forced labour protocol.
It is my intention to ratify the new instrument as soon as possible, after going through the usual procedure.
Het is mijn intentie om het nieuwe instrument, na daartoe de gebruikelijke procedure te hebben doorlopen, zo spoedig mogelijk te ratificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over Netflix, Trouw en de Kijkwijzer

An MP asked whether the government is satisfied with Kijkwijzer uptake and whether it will press Netflix, foreign-licensed channels, and newspapers like Trouw to show Kijkwijzer age ratings and icons, and whether it will legally oblige them. The Secretary of State says uptake is good, Netflix has committed to Kijkwijzer for most of its catalogue by end 2014, but declines legal obligations or appeals to newspapers, citing EU law and editorial independence.
The Netherlands cannot, under European law, impose rules on broadcasters with a foreign licence.
Nederland kan op grond van het Europese recht geen regels stellen voor zenders met een buitenlandse licentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over het onderzoek van KWR Watercycle Research Institute naar drugsresten in rioolwater

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the government about a KWR study measuring drug residues in sewage, including whether it reliably reflects Dutch drug use and whether more monitoring is needed. The State Secretary answered that sewage measurements give only a limited indication, cannot distinguish dumped from consumed drugs for most substances, and that no new study will be commissioned.
Given the very limited added value of this type of research for prevention and enforcement, I see no reason to commission research into drug residues in sewage water.
Gezien de heel beperkte toegevoegde waarde van dit type onderzoek voor voorlichting, preventie en bestrijding zie ik geen reden opdracht te geven tot onderzoek naar drugsresten in rioolwater.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de werving, de rechtspositie en de bevoegdheden van politievrijwilligers
