An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about recruitment, legal status, powers and armament of police volunteers, including the lack of in- and outflow data, the staff ratio, allowance taxation and the basis for weapons decisions. The minister largely answers that targets and figures will follow later, defends the allowance and weapons arrangements, and agrees that individual weapons decisions should not be published.
From this year I will send your House annually the National Police management plan that I have adopted.
Ik zend uw Kamer vanaf dit jaar wel jaarlijks het door mij vastgestelde Beheersplan Nationale Politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen en Segers over de waarborgen voor voldoende landelijke specialistische opvang voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Segers asked whether specialist national shelter for trafficking victims, especially minors, will survive decentralisation of youth and women's care, and how regional inequality and funding gaps will be prevented. The State Secretary replied that from 2015 municipalities will jointly procure this shelter nationally, that a VNG transition arrangement reserves funds, and that continuity of care is guaranteed, but gave few concrete figures or time limits.
The VNG will set aside funds for shelter for this category of victims and procure this form of women's shelter centrally.
De VNG gaat middelen voor de opvang van deze categorie slachtoffers apart zetten en deze vorm van vrouwenopvang centraal inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van der Staaij over de aanslag op bezoekers van het Joodse Museum in Brussel

MPs Segers and Van der Staaij asked the Justice Minister about the Brussels Jewish Museum attack: its effect on threat levels, whether the state should bear extra security costs for Jewish institutions, and renewed consultation with local authorities on funding. The minister said no acute threat was identified for Jewish institutions in the Netherlands, that security costs are primarily the responsibility of citizens and organisations with state support where needed, and that consultations with local authorities including Amsterdam have taken place.
Security measures are taken equally for every citizen, cultural, religious or educational institution, based on threat and risk.
Voor iedere burger, culturele, religieuze of onderwijsinstelling worden op gelijke wijze beveiligingsmaatregelen genomen op basis van dreiging en risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Segers en Dijkgraaf over het rapport “The European Union Integrity System” van Transparency International

MPs Omtzigt, Segers and Dijkgraaf asked whether the government would act on Transparency International's report on EU integrity gaps (openness and corruption) and its 12 recommendations, whether it would raise the report at the European Council, and who should check EU institutions on rule of law. The minister said the government supports follow-up on transparency and anti-corruption measures in Council and EU fora, but declined to put the report on the European Council agenda, and stated the EU's rule-of-law oversight is shared with member states.
The cabinet attaches importance to the greatest possible transparency regarding European legislative and decision-making processes.
Het kabinet hecht aan een zo groot mogelijke transparantie ten aanzien van Europese wetgevings- en besluitvormingsprocessen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over het bericht dat voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel bij terugkeer in Guinee geen enkele opvang beschikbaar is

MPs Voordewind and Segers asked about reports that Guinean trafficking victims returning from the Netherlands would find no shelter, and whether deportations should be suspended. State Secretary Teeven replied that the trafficking residence scheme and asylum rules offer adequate safeguards, that a general Guinea country report will address FGM and vulnerable women and minors, and that deportation will not be suspended since minors are not returned without adequate reception.
Yes, I am willing to examine the possibilities.
Ja, ik ben bereid de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over thuisprostitutie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about enforcement against home prostitution, its scale, and worker health and safety oversight. The minister said illegal home prostitution is already targeted through national action days and facilitator investigations, that the scale is unknown pending a WODC baseline study, and that municipalities and the Arbo inspectorate oversee licensed and self-employed workers.
The total nature and scale of the prostitution sector in the Netherlands is not known to me.
De totale aard en omvang van de prostitutiesector in Nederland is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Segers over de stijging van de grafrechten

Two MPs (Bisschop and Segers) asked the Interior Minister about sharp rises in municipal grave fees and price differences of up to 7,500 euro, and asked whether the state checks that fees do not exceed actual costs, whether it will require transparency and tariff moderation, and why grave costs were omitted from the COELO study. The minister answered that fee-setting is an autonomous municipal competence, that objections and appeal to the courts are the available remedy, that a 2010 handbook on fees is being updated, and declined to act on moderation or additional monitoring.
Setting municipal grave fees is an autonomous competence and responsibility of the municipal council.
Het vaststellen van de gemeentelijke grafrechten is een autonome bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind en Dijkgraaf over de uitspraken van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het EU-lidmaatschap voor Turkije

MPs Segers, Voordewind and Dijkgraaf asked whether the Foreign Minister's remark that the Netherlands would welcome Turkey as an EU member was premature, given Turkey's rule-of-law shortcomings, the Cyprus blockade of chapters 23 and 24, and recognition of the Armenian genocide. The minister answered that accession talks are open-ended and conditional on meeting strict criteria, acknowledged serious shortcomings on press freedom and rule of law, and said concerns were raised in Ankara, while recognition of the genocide is not an accession criterion.
The cabinet particularly emphasised its concerns about press freedom and freedom of expression.
Het kabinet benadrukte in het bijzonder de zorgen over persvrijheid en vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak, Schouw, Segers en Klein over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur betreffende het satellietcomplex in Burum

MPs asked whether US forces have their own installation, SGS equipment and communication networks (USGNA, SIPRNet, JWICS, Blue Force Tracking, BGAN) at the Inmarsat teleport in Burum, and how the Dutch government supervises this. The minister answered that Inmarsat is a commercial operator subject to Dutch law, that the government has access to the site, that AIVD and MIVD found no indications of foreign intelligence activity there, and that the military part of Burum hosts only Dutch government equipment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de inrichting van de specialistische blauwe diensten bij de Landelijke Eenheid van de nationale politie

An MP asked why railway, traffic and water police specialisms were merged into the Infrastructure service of the national police's Landelijke Eenheid, whether reporting points at stations had closed, and whether specialist expertise and public safety would be preserved. The Minister answered that the reporting facilities are not materially worse, that the merger is a flexible integrated approach, and that he holds to the adopted organisation plan while monitoring specialist quality.
I adhere to what is described in the National Police Organisation Plan.
Ik houd vast aan hetgeen in het Inrichtingsplan Nationale Politie is beschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de negatieve verevening voor gemeenten waar windmolens worden gebouwd

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked whether municipalities hosting wind turbines lose much of the extra OZB revenue to negative equalisation in the Gemeentefonds, and whether this undermines local support and benefit-sharing. The ministers answered that wind turbines are equalised only at 70% of the notional OZB base, that 58% of turbine value falls under the machinery exemption and is excluded from the WOZ base, and that OZB is not an instrument for building local support, which rests on participation and financial participation schemes.
I do not recognise the problem you describe, because equalisation only concerns OZB revenues insofar as the windmill does not fall under the machinery exemption.
Het door u geschetste probleem herken ik niet omdat de verevening alleen ziet op de OZB-opbrengsten voor zover de windmolen niet onder de werktuigenvrijstelling valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob en Segers over afschaffing slavernij

MPs Slob and Segers asked why the Netherlands did not sign the 1949 UN Convention on trafficking and prostitution, whether it will do so, what anti-trafficking goals exist, and how the government addresses the legacy of slavery such as discrimination. The government answered that it will not join the convention because it would criminalise exploitation of adult voluntary prostitution, that regulation is preferred, and outlined trafficking task force and referral mechanism plans plus commemoration and anti-discrimination actions.
The Netherlands does not intend to become a party to the UN Convention.
Nederland is niet van plan partij bij het VN-Verdrag te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mali-missie in matig pak’

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked the Defence Minister whether combat uniforms for the Mali mission were chosen for financial reasons, were of inferior quality, and offered less fire protection than Dutch-made Defender M fabric. The Minister denied buying inferior clothing, said the current desert-pattern uniform meets the set requirements, and promised to inform parliament on the new combat clothing requirement later this year.
Once the requirement for the new combat clothing has been established, I will inform the House about it, in line with the Defence Materiel Process.
Zodra de behoefte aan de nieuwe gevechtskleding is vastgesteld, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren, in overeenstemming met het Defensie Materieel Proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Schouten over de realisatie van de doelstelling om te komen tot 5000 politievrijwilligers in 2015

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about reaching the target of 5,000 police volunteers by 2015, including recruitment, retention, displacement of paid work, unemployment-benefit rules, allowances, and volunteers' powers. The minister answered that recruitment is on track through planned campaigns, that the government will align volunteer status and powers with policy, and that displacement of paid labour must be avoided.
The deployment of police volunteers must not lead to displacement of paid labour.
Het inzetten van politievrijwilligers mag niet leiden tot verdringing van arbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Segers over de capaciteit van de antennes op het dak van de ambassade van de Verenigde Staten

MPs Van Raak and Segers asked whether antennas on the US embassy roof in The Hague could intercept and decode nearby communications, including those around the Binnenhof and the Prime Minister's office, and whether the government would check this with the US. The minister confirmed interception is technically possible but could not confirm it occurs, said foreign intelligence operations in the Netherlands require prior authorisation, and committed to contacting the US embassy and reporting back.
The Ministry of BZK will contact the American embassy. I will inform your House of the outcome.
Het Ministerie van BZK zal contact opnemen met de Amerikaanse ambassade. Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomst hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van Raak over het ontslag van de klokkenluider moskee-internaten

MPs Segers and Van Raak asked the minister why a whistleblower at mosque boarding schools was dismissed, whether they acted in good faith, whether Rotterdam complied with the whistleblower scheme, and how the proposed House for Whistleblowers bill would have applied. The minister declined to comment on individual employment matters or the facts, saying the courts will judge the dismissal, and said the bill's protections are hypothetical to assess.
It is now up to the court to assess that dismissal.
Het is nu aan de rechter om dat ontslag te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Segers over de rechtsgronden voor bewapening

Segers (ChristenUnie) asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the legal basis for arming police volunteers with batons, pistols and stun weapons, and whether other government personnel lack a legal basis for weapons. The minister answers that volunteers may be armed on the chief's request and his permission, that the lapse has been fixed, and that a stun-weapon pilot is planned for 2014 without a decision on its start.
The request from the police chief to grant the long baton to volunteer police officers, after proven competence, has now been duly received and permission has been granted.
Het verzoek van de korpschef tot toekenning van de lange wapenstok aan vrijwillige politieambtenaren, na gebleken bekwaamheid, heb ik inmiddels in goede orde ontvangen en de toestemming is verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de aanpak van de productie van GHB en de verkoop van grondstoffen hiervoor

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers how to tackle GHB production and the sale of its precursor GBL, including scheduling GBL, a ban on high-purity GBL, a licensing system, and denaturation. The government answered that the CAM quick scan is not yet finished, that a ban would likely be ineffective, that voluntary reporting and warnings to online sellers are in place, and that EU-level measures lacked support.
We expect such a ban would not or hardly be effective, because GBL with less than 80% purity can also be used in producing GHB.
Wij verwachten dat een dergelijk verbod niet of nauwelijks effectief zal zijn, omdat ook GBL met minder dan 80% zuiverheid kan worden toegepast bij de productie van GHB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over experimenten met cannabisverstrekking

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the ministers about a proposed Utrecht experiment supplying cannabis to psychosis-vulnerable patients, including whether the Bureau Medicinale Cannabis should supply it and whether it is approved and tested against treaties. The State Secretary answered that no exemption request has been filed yet so questions on that experiment cannot be answered, that any request will be assessed against criteria consistent with international treaties, and that the Social Cannabis Club Domstad request is under review.

No application for an Opium Act exemption has yet been submitted for an experiment (of a treatment) supplying cannabis to patients with vulnerability to psychotic disorders and severe cannabis addiction.

Er is nog geen aanvraag voor een Opiumwetontheffing ingediend voor een experiment (van een behandeling) waarbij cannabis wordt verstrekt aan patiënten met een kwetsbaarheid voor psychotische stoornissen en een ernstige cannabisverslaving.

Vragen van het lid Segers (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het stuwmeer aan overuren in relatie tot de inzet en het budget van de Nationale Politie (ingezonden 5 augustus 2013).

Segers (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether overtime budgets of several regional police units were already exhausted by May 2013, how much overtime has accumulated and is budgeted, and what the effect is on police deployment and motivation. Minister Opstelten answered that some units have exhausted overtime budgets, that about 680,000 overtime hours are budgeted for 2013 and about one million have accrued, that overtime is compensated in time off once budgets run out, and that the national police steers for a balanced annual result.
At some units the overtime budget for 2013 has indeed been exhausted.
Bij enkele eenheden is het budget voor overuren voor 2013 inderdaad uitgeput.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de vermeende angstcultuur binnen de Nationale Politie

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether disciplinary investigations within the National Police have increased, whether police staff are told not to contact unions about problems, and whether the minister will consult unions and the chief constable about an alleged climate of fear. The minister answered that internal investigations in 2013 are within the range of recent years, that channels for reporting problems exist, and that signals of an unsafe workplace will be taken seriously and discussed with those raising them.

It is important to me that the police offers a safe environment for all employees. If there are signals that this is not the case, I take them seriously and will engage in discussion with those raising the signals.

Voor mij is belangrijk dat de politie een veilige omgeving biedt voor alle medewerkers. Als er signalen zijn dat dit niet het geval is, dan neem ik die serieus en ga ik in gesprek met de aandragers van die signalen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Segers over gewetensbezwaren bij het verstrekken van biometrische gegevens

Segers (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Interior about conscientious objectors who refuse to give fingerprints for passports and ID cards, their consequences, and whether an alternative will be offered. The Minister said the group size is unknown, current law does not allow issuing documents without fingerprints, and a bill to remove fingerprints from ID card applications is pending, with a possible stop soon after adoption.
A bill amending the Passport Act is pending before the House of Representatives, which among other things provides that fingerprints will no longer be taken when applying for a Dutch identity card.

Bij de Tweede Kamer is een wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Paspoortwet 2 aanhangig waarin onder meer wordt geregeld dat bij de aanvraag van een Nederlandse identiteitskaart geen vingerafdrukken meer worden opgenomen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Online porno automatisch geblokkeer

MPs Voordewind and Segers asked about the UK plan to automatically block online pornography, whether the Dutch government agrees porn is harmful to children, whether such blocking is feasible in the Netherlands, whether it will research an automatic block, and whether search engines can be prohibited from showing child pornography results. The minister answered that porn is not banned in the Netherlands, filters have technical hurdles and limited effectiveness, the government will not commission research on an automatic block, and it cannot regulate foreign search engines though it values their cooperation.
We therefore do not consider it appropriate for the government to pursue or conduct research into an automatic block.
Wij achten het daarom niet opportuun om van overheidswege aan te sturen op of onderzoek te doen naar een automatische blokkade.
Antwoord vragen Segers over het bericht ‘Prostituees uitgebuit vanuit woning’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of exploitation of prostitutes from private homes, including whether the rising abuses reflect a lack of national coordination, the share of victims under 21, and police capacity. The minister answered that serious abuses exist, that enforcement and reporting have increased, that a novella will remove registration and vetting duties while keeping a uniform licensing system and age limit of 21, and that enforcement capacity is substantial.
It is not possible to state the number of reports coming from clients, since reporters to Meld Misdaad Anoniem are logically not registered.
Het is niet mogelijk om het aantal meldingen dat van klanten afkomstig is te benoemen, aangezien de aangevers bij Meld Misdaad Anoniem logischerwijs niet worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht meer tips over gedwongen prostitutie

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of more tips on forced prostitution, including whether the anonymous reporting campaign should be intensified and extended to prostitutes. The minister said the campaign has contributed to better insight into trafficking, that talks with Stichting M. on continuing it are ongoing, and that minors will be a specific focus in the Task Force.
I am in consultation with Stichting M. to consider how the campaign 'Schijn bedriegt' will be continued.
Ik ben in overleg met Stichting M. om te bezien op welke wijze de campagne «Schijn bedriegt» wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Eijsink en Segers over de rol van de geestelijk verzorgers bij reorganisaties

MPs Eijsink and Segers asked the Defence Minister about the role of military chaplains during reorganisation, including support for soldiers dismissed as a result. The minister acknowledged the chaplains' importance, said chaplain posts stay unchanged until 1 January 2016 with a review ongoing, and explained that dismissed personnel are followed and supported through an external placement organisation.
For the period after 1 January 2016, a study is underway.
Voor de periode na 1 januari 2016 is een onderzoek gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht ‘Meer mensenhandel, minder veroordeelden’

Segers (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the Netherlands ranks fourth among EU states for human trafficking victims and that convictions are falling. The minister answered that the high victim numbers reflect better identification and registration, that EU registration criteria differ so comparisons are misleading, and that no policy change is planned.
I therefore see no reason to adjust the policy aimed at combating human trafficking.
Ik zie hierin dan ook geen aanleiding om het beleid gericht op de bestrijding van mensenhandel aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht dat loverboyslachtoffers hun veiligste haven verliezen

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked whether no closed youth care facility for girls remains in the Netherlands after the merger of two institutions, and how safe care for loverboy victims is ensured. The State Secretary answered that capacity exists in open and closed youth care across regions, that some girls-only categorical groups exist, that professionals choose between mixed and girls-only groups case by case, and that a categorical pilot is only in an exploratory phase.
With the merger of the institutions De Lindenhorst and Almata, there are no youth care plus institutions where only girls reside.
Met het samengaan van de instellingen De Lindenhorst en Almata zijn er in de jeugdzorg plus geen instellingen waar uitsluitend meisjes verblijven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pechtold, Van Bommel, Madlener, Van der Staaij, Ouwehand en Segers over het rapport “Seventeenth Bi-annual Report: Developments in European Union Procedures  en Practices Relevant

MPs asked the foreign minister about the COSAC report on parliamentary scrutiny of EU documents, including why the Dutch parliament lacks access to Council documents marked EU Restricted and Limité that Austrian MPs can see. The minister answered that both chambers will receive direct access to all Limité documents, that Limité is a distribution code rather than a classification, and that the Dutch parliament is already as well informed as the Austrian and European Parliaments.
Antwoord vragen Segers over het bericht ‘Explosion of trafficking linked to legalised prostitution’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government would take account of a study linking legalised prostitution to more trafficking, and whether it would research or reconsider Dutch prostitution policy. The minister acknowledged the study's findings but noted its methodological limits, said the Netherlands' legalisation has positive effects, and declined to reconsider legalisation or commission new research, pointing to existing monitoring by the National Rapporteur.
I therefore consider it unnecessary to reconsider the legalisation of prostitution in the Netherlands.
Ik acht het dan ook onnodig om de legalisering van prostitutie in Nederland te heroverwegen.
Antwoord vragen Segers over de inzet van paragnosten door de politie

MP Segers asked the minister whether the police may use psychics (paragnosten), why the Instruction on Unorthodox Investigation Methods is not public, and whether it should be amended to ban such methods. The minister answered that the instruction is an internal procedural rule for exceptional cases, that the Public Prosecution Service controls method choice and must approve use, and that it will not amend the instruction.
Criminal investigations take place under the authority of the Public Prosecution Service. That is also where responsibility lies for choosing which investigative methods are used.
Opsporingsonderzoeken vinden plaats onder het gezag van het Openbaar Ministerie. Daar ligt ook de verantwoordelijkheid voor de keuze welke opsporingsmethoden worden ingezet.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber, Segers en Van der Staaij over berichten dat er binnen Europa een lijst in omloop is waarop ‘anti-choice personalities’ met naam worden genoemd

MPs asked whether a list naming 'anti-choice personalities' circulated by the European Parliamentary Forum for Population and Development (EPF), partly funded by the European Commission, is acceptable, and whether the Dutch government would raise the matter with the EPF or the Commission or question the funding. The minister answered that the EPF is a private initiative operating within EU law, that organisations choose their own strategies, and that she sees no reason to act or to question the funding.
An organisation is itself responsible for a chosen strategy to make its position clear.
Een organisatie is zelf verantwoordelijk voor een gekozen strategie om haar standpunt duidelijk te maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Segers over onvrijwillige prostitutie in Utrecht

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether he has noted the Utrecht mayor's claim that 80 to 90% of prostitutes work involuntarily, whether comparable estimates exist, how victims are helped, and whether exit programmes should be funded nationally. The minister confirms awareness, says no reliable estimate exists, describes victim-identification and support measures, and declines to change the locally based responsibility for exit programmes.
As stated in earlier letters to the House, responsibility for exit programmes lies with the municipalities, because prostitution policy is primarily a local matter.

Antwoord 4 Zoals aangegeven in eerdere brieven aan uw Kamer 4 ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor uitstapprogramma’s bij gemeenten, omdat prostitutiebeleid in eerste instantie een lokale aangelegenheid is.
Antwoord vragen Segers over mogelijke invloed van de Turkse overheid op uitzendingen van de Stichting Zendtijd Moslims

An MP asked whether the Turkish government influences the Stichting Zendtijd Moslims through the chairman's links to the Islamic Stichting Nederland, and whether this breaches the Commissariaat's criteria. The minister answered that the Commissariaat must assess any state influence, that public broadcasters must be free of government influence under the Mediawet 2008, and that the Commissariaat can refuse designation if it is likely the law will not be followed.
Whether there is ultimately state interference in the broadcaster must be assessed by the Commissariaat.
Of er uiteindelijk sprake is van overheidsinmenging in de omroep moet het Commissariaat beoordelen.

m: Motie van het lid Postma over bij toekenning van nationale innovatieprogramma's rekening houden met regionale spreiding
Asks the government to consider regional spread and regional employment when awarding national innovation programmes.
requests the government to explicitly take regional spread into account when awarding national innovation programmes
verzoekt de regering om bij de toekenning van nationale innovatieprogramma's nadrukkelijk rekening te houden met regionale spreiding
Motie van het lid Postma over mogelijkheden voor langjarige en juridisch zekere ondersteuning voor strategische sectoren
Asks the government to inform the House before Prinsjesdag on the Dutch position on state aid for energy-intensive industries, including long-term support options and effects on existing funds.
requests the government to inform the House before Prinsjesdag about the Dutch position on this dossier
verzoekt de regering om de Kamer vóór Prinsjesdag te informeren over de Nederlandse inzet op dit dossier
Motie van de leden Sneller en Postma over de voorstellen van Code-V overnemen en toepassen
Asks the government to adopt and apply the Code-V proposals to remove financing barriers for women entrepreneurs.
requests the government to adopt and apply the proposals of Code-V
verzoekt de regering om de voorstellen van Code-V over te nemen en toe te passen
Motie van het lid Postma over werken aan meerjarige stabiliteit voor investeringsregelingen
Asks the government to work toward at least ten years of multi-year stability in economic investment schemes.
requests the government to work on multi-year stability in economic investment schemes, guaranteeing a minimum security period of ten years
verzoekt de regering om te werken aan meerjarige stabiliteit in economische investeringsregelingen, waarbij een minimale zekerheidstermijn van tien jaar wordt gegarandeerd
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Postma ter vervanging van nr. 69 over het voorkomen van onnodig warmteverlies voor collectieve warmtevoorzieningen
Adds an energy-efficiency norm for heat losses in collective heating networks, set by general administrative order, with ACM able to find continued breaches.
By or pursuant to a general administrative order, norms and other rules may be set on the energy efficiency of newly built collective heating systems
Bij of krachtens maatregel van bestuur kunnen normen en overige regels worden gegeven over de energie-efficiëntie van nieuw aan te leggen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Postma ter vervanging van nr. 43 over het waarborgen dat vergroting van een warmtekavel geen significante verhoging van de tarieven meebrengt
Requires that enlarging a heat plot (warmtekavel) must not lead to a significant tariff increase for consumers in the original plot.
this does not lead to a significant increase in tariffs for consumers in the heat plot that is enlarged
dit niet leidt tot een significante verhoging van de tarieven voor verbruikers in de warmtekavel die vergroot wordt

Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Postma ter vervanging van nr. 35 over het toestaan van differentiatie van vastrechttarieven op basis van bijdrage van de kleinverbruiker aan de kosten van het wa
Amends the heat supply law to allow fixed heat tariffs for small consumers to differ by their contribution to system costs.
for fixed tariffs, distinction may be made based on the degree to which a small consumer contributes to the costs of the collective heat supply
bij de vaste tarieven onderscheid kan worden gemaakt op grond van de mate waarin een kleinverbruiker bijdraagt aan de kosten van de collectieve warmtevoorziening
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Postma en Rooderkerk ter vervanging van nr. 33 over het waarborgen van de relatieve betaalbaarheid van warmte voor huishoudens

Requires the minister to ensure relative affordability of collective heat before cost-based tariffs take effect and to send parliament affordability research reports before the relevant royal decrees.
the minister sends the States General a report of a study into the relative affordability of collective heat
zendt Onze Minister aan de Staten-Generaal een rapport van een onderzoek naar de relatieve betaalbaarheid van collectieve warmte
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Postma ter vervanging van nr. 59 over het uitsluiten van houtige biomassa als duurzame bron voor warmte

Amendment restricting woody biomass as a renewable heat source to primary-source failure or peak demand, and exempting heat companies designated or exempted under the Warmtewet from the woody biomass exclusion.
With this amendment the use of woody biomass is restricted.
Met dit amendement wordt de inzet van houtige biomassa beperkt.
Motie van het lid Postma over gedifferentieerde vaste tarieven in het Besluit collectieve warmte
Asks the government to allow differentiated fixed tariffs in the heat law where fairer, and to base peak-load differentiation on a longer period such as winter months.
requests the government to choose in the Bcw for differentiation of fixed tariffs
verzoekt de regering in het Bcw te kiezen voor differentiatie van vaste tarieven
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over de betaalbaarheid van collectieve warmte borgen
Asks the government to develop and present supporting policy so that the relative affordability of collective heat is secured for tenants and owners before phase 2 of tariff regulation.
requests the government to develop and present supporting policy so that the relative affordability of collective heat is secured
verzoekt de regering zodanig flankerend beleid te ontwikkelen en te presenteren dat de relatieve betaalbaarheid van collectieve warmte is geborgd
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over de ontwikkeling van geothermieprojecten versnellen
Asks the government, in consultation with EBN, to bring new proposals before the budget debate to speed up geothermal projects.
requests the government, in consultation with EBN, to come up with new proposals ahead of the upcoming budget debate of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth
verzoekt de regering in overleg met EBN voorafgaand aan de komende begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei met nieuwe voorstellen te komen
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over binnen vier jaar na inwerkingtreding overgaan naar op kosten gebaseerde tarieven
Asks the government to move to cost-based heat tariffs within four years and develop affordability safeguards such as price guarantees.
requests the government to do everything to move to phase 2 cost-based tariffs within four years of the law taking effect
verzoekt de regering om alles in het werk te stellen om binnen vier jaar na ingaan van de wet naar fase 2 (op kosten gebaseerde tarieven) over te gaan
Motie van het lid Postma c.s. over uitbreiding en verlenging van de Stimuleringsregeling aardgasvrije huurwoningen
Asks the government to map the extra subsidy need caused by the oversubscribed scheme for gas-free rental homes and explore extending it.
