Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Apollo Vredestein plant in Enschede, including whether state aid rules should be revised, how the ESF+ and EGF funds could support affected workers, and whether the minister would visit Enschede. The government sees no need to revise the state aid anti-relocation rules for now, explains that ESF+ is available via the labour market region, notes SZW is exploring EGF options, and declines to commit to a visit until the company's plans are clearer.
On the basis of this assessment, the cabinet currently sees no need for revision, but continues to monitor closely
Op basis van deze afweging ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen noodzaak tot herziening, maar blijft aandachtig volgen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de druk op zelfstandige winkeliers en de gevolgen voor ondernemers, consumenten en concurrentie

MP Postma asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about cost pressures on independent shopkeepers, data on closures, support instruments, competition risks, ACM oversight of concentration, and local retail diversity. The minister answers that cost pressures are a given, data on closures is unavailable, existing investment instruments are pointed to, ACM already monitors concentration, and local governments hold responsibility for retail diversity, with dialogue with branches and municipalities continuing.
No, these figures are not available.
Nee, deze cijfers zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma  over de stop van de bouw van een biobrandstoffabriek door UPM in de Rotterdamse haven

An NSC MP asked the ministers about UPM's decision to abandon a biofuel plant in the Rotterdam port, its impact on the energy transition, and calls for a Deltaplan, a coordination table, conditional subsidies and strategic industrial choices. The minister acknowledged the withdrawal as illustrative of investment-climate problems, pointed to existing cluster approaches and Groene Groei measures, declined a new Deltaplan or coordination table, and promised forthcoming industry and energy-intensive-industry letters to parliament.
An additional coordination table is not a solution to the current problems regarding the absence of investment decisions in the industrial clusters.
Een extra regietafel is geen oplossing voor de huidige problemen ten aanzien van het uitblijven van investeringsbeslissingen in de industrieclusters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het Berenschot Rapport: De effecten van energiebesparende maatregelen op de energierekening van huishoudens in energiearmoede

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a Berenschot report on energy-saving measures and energy poverty, and a TNO scenario study on energy poverty in 2025, asking whether structural insulation and heat-pump measures are preferable to repeated temporary support and how the government will act. The minister answered that structural measures are preferred but temporary support is still needed, cited the Energiefonds, Social Climate Fund plans and subsidies, and declined to commit to a cost-benefit analysis or to guarantee halving bills.
It is not easy to fully isolate the budgetary cost and impact of measures for the group of households in energy poverty.
Het is niet eenvoudig om het budgettaire beslag en de impact van maatregelen volledig te isoleren voor de groep huishoudens in energiearmoede.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma, Holman en Six Dijkstra over (cofinancierings-)aanvraag AI-fabriek en aangeven interesse AI-gigafabriek

Three NSC MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would express interest in an EU AI gigafactory before the Friday deadline, whether EU cofinancing could draw on Nij Begun funds for a Groningen AI factory, and the status of that application due 30 June. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports Nederlandse interest via a letter to the Commission without formally responding to the call, that no funds are reserved for a gigafactory, and that reallocation within departmental budgets is being explored to meet the 30 June requirement.
Via a letter to the European Commission, the Ministry of Economic Affairs will then shortly support the importance of AI gigafactories and Dutch interest.
Via een brief aan de Europese Commissie zal het Ministerie van Economische Zaken vervolgens op korte termijn het belang van AI-Gigafabrieken en de Nederlandse interesse ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de verplaatsing van industriële productie uit Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the relocation of industrial production out of the Netherlands, its causes, and possible policy responses. The government acknowledges the pressure on industry from energy costs, competition, grid congestion, nitrogen constraints and policy unpredictability, and points to measures such as extending the IKC-ETS scheme, the IBO on electricity infrastructure, and a forthcoming industry policy letter.
The exact number of industrial production companies that have withdrawn their activities from the Netherlands is not recorded as such.
Het exacte aantal industriële productiebedrijven dat hun activiteiten uit Nederland heeft teruggetrokken wordt niet als zodanig bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Postma over het tekort aan installatiehavens voor wind op zee

MPs Kröger, Thijssen and Postma asked the minister about a shortage of installation ports for offshore wind, the government's position relative to other North Sea countries, and support for the Energiehaven IJmond project, including whether the state would close an unprofitable business case gap before summer recess. The minister acknowledged the port capacity shortage and said the cabinet supports the project and signed a convenant committing to seek solutions, but will only inform parliament on concrete state support around Prinsjesdag.

As soon as there is clarity on whether the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth and the Ministry of Economic Affairs can support the project, the cabinet will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is of het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken het project kunnen ondersteunen zal het kabinet daar de Kamer over informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de Verenigde Staten en The Metals Company om diepzeemijnbouw mogelijk te maken, buiten het internationale rechtskader van de Internationale Zeebodemautoriteit (ISA) om

An MP asked the government how it views the US executive order and TMC's plan to mine the deep seabed outside the ISA framework, and whether the Netherlands will join calls for a moratorium. The government says it finds these developments worrying, upholds UNCLOS and the ISA's exclusive competence, but declines to adopt the 'moratorium' label, saying its substantive position matches the countries that use it.
The cabinet finds these developments worrying and is following them closely.
Het kabinet vindt deze ontwikkelingen zorgelijk en volgt deze nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Postma over het artikel ‘ACM nagelt elf dure energieleveranciers aan de schandpaal’

MPs Omtzigt and Postma asked whether eleven energy suppliers charging markedly higher model-contract tariffs than others, as reported by the ACM, implies market abuse or information asymmetry, and whether transparency rules and price caps are needed. The minister answers that tariff differences reflect free price setting and differing cost structures, that the ACM supervises reasonableness and can enforce, that new Energiewet transparency and comparison rules apply from 2026, and that caps and published margins are not considered necessary or desirable.
Detailed price structure and margins concern competitively sensitive information.
Gedetailleerde prijsopbouw en marges betreft concurrentiegevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op de leden Postma en Grinwis over het meerekenen van autonome vlootvernieuwing in de balanced approach-procedure

MPs Postma and Grinwis asked whether autonomous fleet renewal was counted in the reference situation and the noise target of the balanced approach procedure at Schiphol, and whether it was double-counted. The minister confirmed autonomous developments up to November 2024 are in the reference situation, said the 15% first-phase target sits on top of them, and announced a policy change for the remaining 5% so autonomous developments can contribute to it.
In the letter of 7 May to the House, the cabinet announced a policy change for the remaining percentage, so that autonomous developments can contribute to achieving the remainder of the noise target.

1 aan de Kamer heeft het kabinet voor het resterende percentage een beleidswijziging aangekondigd, waardoor de autonome ontwikkelingen wel kunnen bijdragen aan het behalen van het restant van het geluidsdoel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Six Dijkstra over de stroomstoring in Spanje en Portugal

Two MPs asked the government about the April 2025 blackout in Spain and Portugal, including the risk of a similar outage in the Netherlands, the protection of the grid, emergency plans, and public preparedness for long outages. The government answered that such a blackout is unlikely in the Netherlands, described existing grid safeguards, crisis plans and the coming Cbw/Wwke rules, and said citizens should be prepared for 72 hours of self-reliance.

In mid-2025 a multi-year public campaign (national government, other authorities, businesses and social organisations) starts to further increase societal resilience to long-term failure of daily services.

Medio 2025 start een meerjarige publiekscampagne (rijksoverheid, andere overheden, bedrijven en maatschappelijke organisaties) om de maatschappelijke weerbaarheid bij langdurige uitval van dagelijkse voorzieningen (ongeacht de aard van de dreiging) verder te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over openheid over de besluitvorming ten aanzien van geluidsreductie bij Schiphol

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management to share, under Article 68 of the Constitution, the documents and legal and official advice underlying the Cabinet's 6 May decision on how to fill the remaining noise-reduction target around Schiphol, before the vote on related motions. The minister answered that the documents cannot be made public because of the state's litigation interest, and sent them as confidential documents for members only to inspect.
In view of the state's procedural interest, these documents cannot be made public.
Gelet op het procesbelang van de Nederlandse Staat kunnen deze stukken niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Postma over de ‘crisismodus’ bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs Saris and Postma asked the ministers about the 'crisis mode' at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, including prior engagement, energy costs, subsidies, and possible support for affected workers. The minister answered that the closure is a business decision mainly for the company, described past government efforts to keep production in the Netherlands, listed received support, and declined to commit to visits or EU funding requests until the company clarifies its next steps.
This information is not public and is not known to me.
Deze informatie is niet openbaar en is niet bij mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het artikel ‘Onafhankelijk milieurapport afgezwakt na druk door Schiphol’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Schiphol and the ministry pressured the Commission for Environmental Assessment (mer) into softening its report on the Schiphol emissions rules, and whether the new flight-limit decree meets equivalence criteria. The minister denied undue pressure, said the commission only changed wording on its own authority after normal review of the draft, and maintained that the decree meets the equivalence criteria based on the 2020 MER and annual use forecasts.
No, there is no question of putting the mer commission under pressure.
Nee, er is geen sprake van het onder druk zetten van de commissie voor de mer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het artikel 'Consumenten betalen een toeslag voor groen gas, maar dat is er nog niet'

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reports that households pay a surcharge for green gas blending that is not yet in place, the delayed bill, and affordability. The minister confirmed the timeline is uncertain pending the European Commission and Council of State, said suppliers may revise contracts, and pointed to existing support measures without committing to refunds.
The cabinet considers it undesirable that energy suppliers charge costs that may not need to be incurred.
Het kabinet vindt het onwenselijk dat energieleveranciers kosten in rekening brengen die mogelijk niet gemaakt hoeven te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het artikel 'Zonnestroom is in 2027 geen cent meer waard, dus paneelbezitters zijn de dupe'

An MP asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a newspaper report that feed-in tariffs for solar power will become nearly worthless from 2027, whether suppliers may charge exit fees, and how to prevent solar owners from removing panels, and about storage incentives. The Minister argues the feed-in compensation is about 5.4 cents, that exit fees are not allowed for contracts concluded before the law, that studies on tenants are underway, and that home-battery incentives will be considered after network congestion conditions are set.
As regards the consequences for tenants, research is being carried out in cooperation with Aedes and Woonbond.
Voor wat betreft de gevolgen voor huurders wordt een onderzoek uitgevoerd in samenwerking met Aedes en Woonbond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het verder oprekken van de geluidsregels voor Schiphol door de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport

An MP asks whether the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) has repeatedly tolerated Schiphol exceeding statutory noise limits under the anticipatory enforcement policy, whether Schiphol breached the conditions in 2021 to 2023, whether the ILT's enforcement independence was compromised by ministry or Schiphol pressure, and what sanctions and disclosure apply. The minister answers that anticipatory enforcement is a ministerial instruction still in place, that the 2023 exceedance was almost entirely explained by the preferential runway rules so the ILT could not act, that the ILT is independent and the ministry did not pressure it, and that the government aims to end the tolerance situation and restore residents' legal protection.
The ILT, after investigation with Schiphol and LVNL, reached this outcome independently.
De ILT is na onderzoek bij Schiphol en LVNL zelfstandig tot deze uitkomst gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de uitspraken van de CEO van ASML over het Nederlandse vestigingsklimaat

An MP asked the ministers about ASML's CEO's remarks on the Dutch investment climate, including grid congestion, nitrogen rules, talent shortages, export controls and policy predictability. The minister answered each question, outlining the Beethoven package, grid and talent measures, ministerial committee on nitrogen, and commitments to continued dialogue with ASML.
I am in continuous dialogue with ASML about the measures needed to keep growing and investing in the Netherlands.
Ik ben voortdurend in gesprek met ASML over de maatregelen die nodig zijn om in Nederland te kunnen doorgroeien en doorinvesteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Lahlah en Postma over private financiële middelen met betrekking tot een energiefonds

MPs asked why private funding for an energy fund for low and middle income households could not be secured and what efforts were made, including the gap with the amount sought and the future of the Noodfonds infrastructure. The government explains that energy suppliers have agreed to an energy fund for 2025 but the state will carry more than two thirds of the funding to avoid state aid risks, and that the fund will open once the energy sector's contribution is settled.
The Chamber will be informed about this as soon as possible.
De Kamer wordt hier zo snel mogelijk nader over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de sterke toename van het aantal overtredingen van de regels over de door vliegtuigen minimaal aan te houden aanvlieghoogte richting Schiphol

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether low-altitude approaches to Schiphol over Sassenheim and nearby municipalities have sharply increased, and whether enforcement by the ILT is adequate. The minister replies that no violations of the approach-altitude rules have been recorded since 2022, that deviations stayed within the allowed 15% limit, and that the ILT's existing sanctioning tools are sufficient.
The LVB also stipulates that LVNL may deviate from those provisions if necessary for the safe and efficient handling of air traffic.
In het LVB is ook vastgelegd dat LVNL van die bepalingen mag afwijken als dat noodzakelijk is in verband met een veilige en doelmatige afwikkeling van het vliegverkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Vermeer, Bontenbal, Postma en Beckerman over de misleidende praktijken van energieleverancier Hollandse Energie Maatschappij (HEM)

MPs from several parties asked the minister about misleading and intimidating practices by energy supplier HEM, what consumer protection and enforcement tools exist, and whether firms like HEM can be barred from supplying energy. The minister said the Energy Act will give the ACM stronger powers (integrity screening, supply stops, licence revocation), noted bailiff-threat issues fall under the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, and answered all ten questions in turn.
In the Energy Act, the ACM is given sufficient new tools to act firmly when it deems this necessary.
In de Energiewet krijgt de ACM voldoende nieuwe handvatten om stevig op te treden als zij dat nodig acht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het onderzoek van het Nibud, in opdracht van de Mobiliteitsalliantie

MP Postma asked the government about a Nibud study commissioned by the Mobiliteitsalliantie showing that low and middle incomes face transport poverty, and what measures will restore affordable mobility and how ETS-2 affects transport costs. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the study, gave no precise figure, pointed to past tariff measures, discount products and a planned Social Climate Fund, but did not commit to a specific new measure or timeline.
There is no precise figure to give on this.
Hierover is geen precies getal te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, De Hoop, Pierik, Postma, Stoffer en Vedder over de voortgang van de verruiming van het sluizencomplex bij Kornwerderzand

MPs asked about the delayed and costlier widening of the Kornwerderzand lock complex, including whether cost increases stem from tighter Rijk standards, the salinity problem, the bridges, and whether the Rijk should bear costs. The minister answered that the cost rise reflects a more realistic estimate rather than new norms, that the regional province must make a substantial contribution, and that talks with the region are being restarted, without firm commitments on financing.

In the consultation with the deputy it was indicated that if the region chooses to realise the project, IenW first expects a substantial contribution from the regional governments towards the identified cost increase.

In het overleg met de gedeputeerde is aangegeven dat als de regio ervoor kiest het project te willen realiseren, IenW eerst een substantiële bijdrage van de regionale overheden verwacht voor de geconstateerde kostenstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het opnemen van vliegtuigen en schepen in de EU-taxonomie als «duurzame investering»

An MP asked whether aircraft and ships are being included in the EU taxonomy as sustainable investments, given environmental litigation and doubts about their contribution to Green Deal goals. The minister answered that the taxonomy rules were already adopted, that the Netherlands supported including transition activities for private capital while seeking a separate transition category, and that LNG ships meeting design criteria can qualify.
At the same time, the Netherlands has taken a general critical stance in the EU towards the current application of transition activities in the EU taxonomy for climate mitigation.
Nederland heeft zich tegelijkertijd in algemene zin kritisch in de EU opgesteld tegenover de huidige toepassing van transitieactiviteiten in de EU taxonomie voor klimaatmitigatie
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Postma over het ‘EU-Coronaherstelfonds’

An MP asks the government how much the Netherlands contributes to the EU Recovery Fund, what reforms were agreed for the first disbursement and the remaining 4.1 billion, whether the road pricing measure will be implemented, and whether replacement measures are possible. The ministers answer that EU borrowing is repaid via the EU budget, list the milestones per payment request, note several measures are under pressure including road pricing, and explain that plan changes are possible only under strict objective conditions.
The cabinet will keep the House informed of developments on this, including through the half-yearly progress report.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer op de hoogte houden van de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent, o.a. door middel van de halfjaarlijkse voortgangsrapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Vedder, Postma, Grinwis en Pierik over de visserij en ETS-2

Five MPs asked whether fisheries should be brought under the EU ETS-2 carbon market and what the consequences would be for the sector. The minister answers that the cabinet has decided not to opt fisheries in, citing lack of a viable path for the sector, EU state-aid limits and unequal competition, and that a WECR impact study will be sent to Parliament.
The cabinet has now decided not to bring fisheries under ETS2 through the opt-in.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om visserij niet onder het ETS2 te brengen middels de opt-in
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Postma over het artikel 'De bouw van snelle flexwoningen ligt mijlenver achter op schema'

MPs Welzijn and Postma asked the Minister of the Interior about a newspaper report that flexible housing lags far behind schedule, including causes such as grid congestion, objection procedures, site availability and optimistic planning. The minister acknowledged the shortfall, attributed it to multiple factors, and listed measures including a legislative amendment to speed up appeals and several support and subsidy schemes.
No data are available on the number of objection and appeal procedures concerning flexible housing or the number of flexible homes delayed as a result.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures aangaande flexwoningen of het aantal flexwoningen dat daardoor wordt vertraagd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga, Postma en Six Dijkstra over de berichten 'Verkopen op Vinted of Marktplaats? De Belastingdienst kijkt mee', 'Fiscus kijkt mee met verkoop op Vinted en Marktplaats: dit betekent he

MPs Idsinga, Postma and Six Dijkstra asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that the Tax Authority will receive data on private online sellers on Vinted, Marktplaats and Bol under DAC7, raising concerns about tax burdens, unclear entrepreneur status, and privacy risks from collecting citizen service numbers. The State Secretary replied that DAC7 creates no new tax obligations, that the 30-transaction/2,000-euro threshold balances enforcement with feasibility, that personal data collection is necessary for proper taxation and protected under GDPR, and that the Tax Authority will expand public information rather than new rules, though several questions were answered only in part.
In addition, the Tax Authority is intensifying information provision to private individuals who sell, rent out or offer their services via online platforms.
Daarnaast intensiveert de Belastingdienst de voorlichting aan particulieren die verkopen, verhuren of hun diensten aanbieden via online platformen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Postma over de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Koopmans and Postma asked the Justice minister about the delayed implementation of the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij (armed protection of Dutch merchant ships against piracy), including the status of the repair bill, ILT preparations, stakeholder engagement, the 2022 deadline and extending coverage to the Gulf of Guinea. The minister replied that the repair bill and draft decree will be submitted shortly, ILT is preparing enforcement and extra testing is planned, stakeholders are consulted regularly, the target remains entry into force this year but the new cabinet must decide, and that armed guards cannot help in coastal waters so Gulf of Guinea coverage remains under review alongside EU initiatives.
It is my aim to submit the Reparatiewetsvoorstel bescherming koopvaardij to the Council of Ministers this month and to submit it to your House as soon as possible thereafter.
Het is mijn streven het Reparatiewetsvoorstel bescherming koopvaardij nog deze maand ter behandeling aan te bieden bij de ministerraad en zo spoedig mogelijk daarna in te dienen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de achterstanden bij het CBR voor rijexamens

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the backlog of about 600,000 driving exams at the CBR after the lockdowns, including proposals to lower failure rates, flexible rescheduling and extra staff. The minister answered that the CBR has a task force, has restarted practical exams, allows schools flexible cancellation and rescheduling until 2 April, is recruiting 100 extra examiners, and will periodically inform parliament on reservation times, but gave no concrete plan yet.
As I indicated in the aforementioned letter to the House, all of the CBR's reservation measures prior to the lockdowns had already for some time been within the KPI.
Zoals ik in voornoemde Kamerbrief heb laten weten, waren alle reserveringsmaatregelen van het CBR voorafgaande aan de lockdowns al geruime tijd binnen de KPI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van den Berg over de beperkte capaciteiten voor vrachtwagenchauffeurs tijdens de avondklok

CDA MPs Postma and Van den Berg asked whether truck drivers' facilities such as fuel stations, toilets and warm food can stay open during the evening curfew, and how the minister views this. The minister answered that sanitary facilities and fuel stations may stay open, shop opening hours were moved forward, warm drinks may be served at fuel stations since 12 February, and a study on truck parking conditions is under way.
Once the study is complete, I will inform the House of its outcomes and the conclusions I draw from it.
Zodra het onderzoek gereed is, zal ik de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten en de conclusies die ik eraan verbind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Postma over het bericht "Thuiswerken met peuter of baby? Dat is een illusie''

MPs Palland and Postma asked the minister about parents struggling to combine work, schooling and childcare during the lockdown, and about calls for a temporary corona leave scheme like those in Belgium, Germany, Austria and Norway. The minister says the situation has improved since reopening, relies on employer-employee agreements and collective labour agreements, and says no feasible extra corona leave scheme was found in talks with social partners, promising to inform the House further.
I will inform you further about this in response to the Smeulders/Van Weyenberg motion of 28 January 2021.
Ik zal u hierover nader informeren als reactie op de motie Smeulders / Van Weyenberg van 28 januari 2021
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de nieuwe Bob-campagne in België om rijden onder invloed tegen te gaan.

An MP asked the ministers about a Belgian drink-driving campaign in which intoxicated drivers receive a keyring bearing the name of a child killed in a crash, and whether it could be adopted in the Netherlands with more alcohol checks. The minister said the Belgian action is a private add-on to the regular campaign, that no evaluation is planned, that the idea will be considered in the next campaign strategy with a letter to parliament after the summer, and that Dutch enforcement already intensifies alcohol checks during campaign periods.
I will include the idea and its evaluation in the strategy determination for the coming version of the BOB campaign to see whether it is a good idea to do this in the Netherlands too.
Ik zal het idee en de evaluatie hiervan meenemen bij de strategiebepaling voor de komende versie van de BOB-Campagne om te kijken of het een goed idee is dit ook in Nederland te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Postma over boetes voor te zwaar beladen grensoverschrijdend vrachtverkeer

CDA MPs Postma and Amhaouch asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about fines for overweight cross-border trucks in Selfkant, Germany, and the resulting cost and emissions burden. The minister replied that EU rules cap trucks at 40 tonnes, that member states may allow higher weights domestically but Germany does not, and that the government sees no need to lobby Germany or act beyond EU law.
No, Germany abides by European legislation.
Nee, Duitsland houdt zich aan de Europese wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de bij dodelijk ongeval verwoeste trike die weer veilig is bevonden door de RDW

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a trike destroyed in a fatal crash and later re-certified by the RDW shows that re-inspection standards for crash-damaged vehicles are adequate, and whether the RDW-website will show past driving bans. The Minister answered that RDW re-inspection checks handling, braking and safety systems, that a modernisation project is underway with a framework expected in Q1 2021, and that a change to the registration regulation to show past driving bans is due in H1 2021, expected to be operational by early 2022.
Essential to all this is that the RDW must in all cases learn as quickly as possible of every vehicle that has become a damaged vehicle, so that a driving ban can be imposed.

Essentieel bij dit alles is dat de RDW in alle gevallen zo spoedig mogelijk kennis moet hebben van elk voertuig dat een schadevoertuig is geworden, zodat een verbod voor het rijden op de weg kan worden opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over containers overboord in Duitse deel van de Noordzee

An MP asked the minister about reports that around 200 containers fell overboard in the German North Sea, including their scale, consequences for the Dutch Wadden islands, coordination with Germany, and shipping safety. The minister answered that German Coast Guard searches found no containers, the shipowner denied any loss, there are no consequences for the Wadden islands or shipping safety, and coordination with German authorities took place.
The German Coast Guard found no containers or floating cargo after investigation.
De Duitse Kustwacht heeft na onderzoek geen containers of drijvende lading aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma, Geurts en Von Martels over de kosten van kentekens van trekkers

MPs Postma, Geurts and Von Martels (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the RDW plans to charge far more than the promised maximum of €61 per new agricultural vehicle for identification and registration, and whether the RDW will be instructed to cap costs and introduce accelerated registration. The Minister acknowledges the sector's surprise, explains the cost structure, and proposes a transition period until 1 July 2021 with conversion-method registration and work toward accelerated registration, but does not commit to instructing the RDW on a €61 cap.
I have therefore entered into discussions with the RDW and the sector to reach an appropriate and swift solution in light of the law's entry into force on 1 January 2021.
Ik ben daarom samen met de RDW en de sector in gesprek gegaan om te komen tot een passende en snelle oplossing in het licht van de inwerkingtreding van de wet per 1 januari 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Amhaouch en Postma over het bericht 'Onbegrip bij provincie over weigering Rijk om informatie voor stikstofaanpak te delen'

CDA MPs asked the agriculture minister why the national government refuses to share nitrogen-related farm data with provinces on privacy grounds, and whether this delays regional nitrogen plans, and asked about a study focusing on peak-polluting farms. The minister answered that privacy-sensitive data is not essential, that provinces already hold much of the information, that work on an alternative data-access solution is ongoing, and that the study reflects only one part of the broader approach.
I am working with RVO and BIJ12 (on behalf of the provinces) on an alternative solution to make the last part of the relevant information accessible to the provinces.
Ik werk samen met RVO en BIJ12 (namens de provincies) aan een alternatieve oplossing om het laatste deel van de relevante informatie toegankelijk te maken voor de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van Helvert over beperken van geluidsoverlast A79 Valkenburg aan de Geul

Two CDA MPs asked why noise-barrier construction along the A79 at Valkenburg cannot be combined with planned road maintenance, and when residents will get clarity. The minister answered that barriers await the final noise-remediation plan (draft mid-2021, final early 2022, possible appeal), that maintenance cannot be delayed, and that barriers should be complete by 2027.

Only once the noise remediation plan Zuid-Nederland phase 2 (MJPG) is definitively adopted and irrevocable is there certainty about the noise barriers and other measures along the A79 at Goudenrood and Vroenhof.

Pas op het moment dat het geluidsaneringsplan Zuid-Nederland fase 2 (MJPG) definitief is vastgesteld en onherroepelijk is, is er zekerheid over de te realiseren geluidsschermen en andere maatregelen langs de A79 bij Goudenrood en Vroenhof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van den Berg, Palland, Postma en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Keuringsinstantie DCI Joure (NKIP) in Chinese handen'

MPs from the CDA asked the Infrastructure and Environment and Economic Affairs ministers whether the Dutch yacht certification body DCI Joure, which became fully Chinese-owned in November 2019, poses risks, whether the takeover could have been screened, and what monitoring applies. The government answered that the takeover falls outside existing investment screening, that accreditation by the RvA and supervision by the ILT ensure quality and independence, and that it sees no national security risk.
The cabinet establishes that there are no risks to national security from the takeover of this body, which oversees the quality of pleasure craft.
Het kabinet stelt vast dat er voor de nationale veiligheid geen risico’s zijn bij de overname van deze instantie, die toeziet op de kwaliteit van plezierjachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Postma en Omtzigt over de toepassing van het tonnageregime voor de offshoresector

MPs Mulder, Postma and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch tonnage tax regime is stricter than in other EU countries, whether it covers vessels used to build offshore wind farms, and what this means for cost and competitiveness. The government answered that the Dutch regime is stricter on some points (e.g. Denmark allows construction-vessel profits), that wind-farm operation profits are excluded, that transport vessels to offshore parks can qualify, and that it will await an evaluation due in early 2021 before deciding on any change.
The cabinet wants to await the aforementioned evaluation before making statements on the desirability and design of any possible adjustment to the tonnage regime.
Het kabinet wil de hiervoor genoemde evaluatie afwachten, alvorens uitspraken te doen over de wenselijkheid en vormgeving van een eventuele aanpassing van de tonnageregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Postma en Stoffer over het bericht 'Zonder meer asfalt staan we straks stil'

MPs Dijkstra, Postma and Stoffer asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a press report warning that road investment is needed, covering population growth, traffic trends since COVID-19, cost-benefit figures, MIRT budget allocation, freight corridors and the National Growth Fund. The Minister answered substantively on most points, stressing that all modes are needed, that the road budget to 2030 is largely committed, and that new road projects would need extra funding; the Minister did not recognise the cost-benefit figures cited in the article.
Investment decisions are taken together with the region via the Bestuurlijke Overleggen MIRT. Your House is involved in this through the Algemene Overleggen MIRT and Nota Overleggen MIRT.
Investeringsbeslissingen worden samen met de regio genomen via de Bestuurlijke Overleggen MIRT. Uw Kamer wordt hierbij betrokken in de Algemene Overleggen MIRT en Nota Overleggen MIRT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het bericht ‘Oudere chauffeur komt tot stilstand door dictaat Brussel’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the letter informing older professional drivers about the expiring Code 95 requirement had not yet been sent less than six weeks before the change, and whether earlier action would have avoided extra costs and driver surprise. The minister answered that the letter was delayed by the timing decision on the law's entry into force, that entry into force has been moved to 1 December 2020 at the sector's request, that the CBR had been tasked with preparing a helpdesk, and that the letter would be sent to drivers in the week of 29 September.
The letter to drivers will be sent in the week of 29 September.
De brief aan chauffeurs zal in de week van 29 september worden verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Postma over valetparkeerbedrijven n.a.v. de uitzending van ‘MAX Vakantieman’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers about valet parking company abuses after a TV broadcast and whether police, prosecutors, certification schemes and a licensing system could address them. The minister answered that there is a coordinated local approach around Schiphol, that civil and traffic-fine rules apply, and that a national licensing scheme would be too burdensome for now.
Complaints against valet parking companies are not registered separately in police systems.
Aangiftes tegen valetparkingbedrijven worden niet apart geregistreerd in de politiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van Dam over het toenemende verzet tegen geluidsoverlast door motorrijders

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Justice about rising public opposition to motorcycle noise, including enforcement, noise limits, foreign rules, flash cameras, seizure powers, and municipal authority to close roads. The government answered that it will study noise-reduction options, that enforcement and existing noise norms apply, and that municipalities may temporarily close roads to motorcycles if the traffic-law interests are served and the balancing is proportionate.
The Ministry of IenW will start a study into options to reduce noise nuisance from motorcycles.
Vanuit het Ministerie van IenW zal een onderzoek starten naar de mogelijkheden om geluidoverlast door motorfietsen te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Postma over het verwachte personeelstekort in de kinderopvang deze zomer

MPs Van Meenen and Postma asked the state secretary about an expected summer staff shortage in childcare, the sector's views on labour market tightness, and the timing of a promised labour market vision and plan. The state secretary answered that short-term shortages may persist, that the emergency childcare payment scheme provided stability, that a recession could reduce demand later, and that talks with the sector will resume with a report to parliament to follow.
I will inform your House of the outcome of these talks.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomst van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet, Palland en Postma over het bericht 'Indrukwekkend corona-protest met tientallen historische schepen bij eiland Pampus: 'Net Sail Amsterdam’'

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a protest by historic sailing charter vessels near Pampus, the sector's loss of income under COVID measures, subsidies for historic vessels, and how to preserve the sector after the crisis. The government answered that Mondriaan Fund restoration schemes apply, sets out available COVID support measures for the sailing charter sector, and says it is willing to consult municipalities, provinces and the sector, but did not answer within the two-week deadline.
Of course I am willing to consult with the other relevant departments, the mentioned subnational governments and the sector.
Uiteraard ben ik bereid om samen met de andere betrokken departementen in overleg te treden met de genoemde medeoverheden en met de sector
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld,Kwint, Gijs van Dijk, Bruins en Postma over het bericht 'Grootste Nederlandse kinderopvangbedrijf zit fiscaal op de Kaaimaneilanden'

MPs from five parties asked whether the largest Dutch childcare company, owned via investment funds in the Cayman Islands, is permissible, whether public money leaks to tax havens, and whether ownership rules should change. The Secretary of State answered that childcare quality rules apply regardless of ownership, cited existing anti-avoidance measures, declined to confirm specific dividend flows citing tax secrecy, and rejected extra ownership restrictions.
To the extent information is known to the Tax Authority, the cabinet cannot, under the statutory tax confidentiality duty, confirm or deny which payments an individual taxpayer makes and to whom.

Voor zover hierover informatie bij de Belastingdienst bekend is, kan het kabinet op grond van de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht bevestigen noch ontkennen welke betalingen door een individuele belastingplichtige worden gedaan en aan wie dat gebeurt.
Antwoord op van het lid Postma over certificering zeegaande zeilvaart

CDA MP Postma asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) refusing to issue certificates to Dutch sailing vessels that were inspected under EU Directive 2009/45/EC, and whether the ILT should be pressed to reverse course. The minister answers that the ILT lacks a legal basis after the directive was amended in late 2019 to exclude sailing passenger ships, that a structural regulatory fix and a short-term solution (temporary declarations applying the directive's rules) are being worked on.
In the short term I will ask the ILT to issue temporary declarations, pending regulatory changes, applying the directive's requirements.
Voor de korte termijn zal ik de ILT verzoeken om, vooruitlopend op aanpassingen in de regelgeving, tijdelijke verklaringen af te geven waarbij de voorschriften van de richtlijn worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Stoffer en Postma over het bericht 'Onzekere toekomst voor gebruik oldtimer openbare weg'

MPs Dijkstra, Stoffer and Postma asked the ministers about the future of historic vehicles (oldtimers) on public roads, including a national register of mobile heritage, definitions, innovative fuels and export of cultural goods. The government says it supports a sector-led register with Mondriaan Fund funding, that heritage is defined under the Heritage Act, and that it will engage on fuels and export protection through a planned commission.
I have asked the RCE to continue supporting this process with knowledge and advice.
Ik heb de RCE gevraagd om blijvend dit proces te ondersteunen met kennis en advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van der Graaf over het bericht dat de Minister geen haast heeft met het aanpakken van de N35

MPs Postma and Van der Graaf asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that she was in no hurry to tackle the N35 road, including whether a bilateral meeting with Overijssel province on planning and financing had taken place and whether it was being postponed. The Minister said the meeting had not occurred, that the province's co-financing offer is taken seriously but is not the only criterion, and that traffic research shows rising volumes with acceptable travel times and a lower-than-average accident risk, while promising to discuss findings at a later MIRT meeting and to inform the House.
At the autumn BO MIRT meeting I will then discuss the outcomes, after which I will inform you of the result.
Op het BO MIRT van dit najaar bespreek ik dan de uitkomsten, waarna ik u informeer over de uitkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Amhaouch inzake de voorspelling over toe- en afname van files en mogelijke verschuivingen naar individueel vervoer

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about forecasts of traffic congestion and a shift from public to individual transport after the COVID-19 lockdown, including foreign data, scenario modelling, working from home and parking. The Minister answered that forecasts are not comparable, that scenario modelling is ongoing with monthly-level updates and a promised report before summer, and that advice from the Denktank Coronacrisis and planning agencies is expected on 1 June.
I will inform your House before the summer about the main outcomes.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de belangrijkste uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor keuringen bij de RDW en het CBR

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the COVID-19 crisis affects APK vehicle inspections at the RDW and driving licence renewals at the CBR, including temporary leniency for expired inspections and licences and the handling of imported cars. The minister answered that inspections continue with reduced RDW services, that expired APKs may not be driven except to the garage, and that temporary coulance applies to licences expiring until 1 June 2020 while a longer-term alternative (possibly an emergency decree) is being developed.
For the reasons above, temporary leniency currently applies to all driving licence holders whose licence expires in the period 16 March 2020 through 1 June 2020.
Om bovenstaande redenen is een tijdelijke coulance momenteel van kracht voor alle rijbewijshouders wier rijbewijs verloopt in de periode 16 maart 2020 tot en met 1 juni 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het bericht ‘ Einde voor Strandrups Noordwijk: Het is te gek voor woorden‘

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Noordwijk beach vehicle (Strandrups), which faces a ban because it does not meet vehicle safety requirements, and whether a licence or municipal decision could allow it to continue. The minister answered that safety comes first, the vehicle cannot be approved under current EU rules or alternative categories, and the minister will meet the foundation again to explore a solution without asking the RDW to admit non-compliant vehicles.

Although I am willing to think along with the Foundation Outdoor4disabled in searching for a solution, I want to emphasise that I am not willing to ask the RDW to nevertheless admit vehicles that do not meet the admission rules.

Hoewel ik bereid ben mee te denken met de Stichting Outdoor4disabled in het zoeken naar een oplossing, wil ik benadrukken dat ik niet bereid ben om de RDW te verzoeken om voertuigen die niet voldoen aan de toelatingsregels toch toe te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de flinke toename van het aantal gestolen of vermiste kentekenplaten

MP Postma asked the ministers about the sharp rise in stolen or missing number plates, including whether duplicated plates should be treated like stolen ones, whether Amsterdam should align with the CJIB, and the status of RFID plate pilots and Danish-style fastening. The minister acknowledged the concern, stated that existing law already covers duplication, described RDW oversight of plate makers, promised a letter to parliament on RFID and fastening, and said the Amsterdam issue is being addressed by the municipality.
Currently I am examining together with the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management and the RDW whether RFID number plates could be a solution to combat plate fraud.
Momenteel bekijk ik samen met de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en de RDW, of de RFID-kentekenplaten een oplossing kunnen zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Postma over het mogelijk maken van het enkelvoudig in- en uitchecken in de treinketen

MPs Amhaouch and Postma asked why the government limits single check-in/check-out to a national app with location, despite a motion asking for broader solutions, and criticised privacy costs and the Ombudsman's concerns about the system. The minister answered that cost-benefit research found single check-in not worthwhile, that new payment methods and an app will be phased in, that privacy is legally protected, and promised a further update via the NOVB progress report.
I am pleased with the work of the public transport ombudsman because it helps individual travellers with incidental cases and increases travel and payment convenience for all travellers.
Ik ben blij met het werk van de OV ombudsman omdat het individuele reizigers helpt bij incidentele voorvallen en het reis- en betaalgemak van alle reizigers verhoogt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Dit zijn de gevaarlijkste (snelweg)kilometers op de Nederlandse wegen'

MPs Postma and Remco Dijkstra asked the minister about a Telegraaf report ranking the most dangerous motorway stretches, led by the A10 at the Coentunnel, and about follow-up on earlier recommendations, speed, and safety measures. The minister says the ranking uses different crash data than Rijkswaterstaat's BRON, so conclusions cannot yet be confirmed, and lists measures taken and planned for the A10, A8, A12, A1 and A16 locations.
At this moment I cannot yet say whether the conclusions are correct.
Op dit moment kan ik nog niet zeggen of de conclusies kloppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van Helvert over beperken van geluidsoverlast A79 Valkenburg aan de Geul

Two MPs from the CDA asked the minister about noise nuisance from the A79 at Valkenburg aan de Geul, including responsibility of Rijkswaterstaat, delays in the resurfacing and MJPG noise measures, and consultation with residents. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is responsible, that resurfacing is planned for 2021 with no further delay expected, and that noise measures remain in MJPG phase two, though some questions were answered only partly or in general terms.
I do not expect any further delay for these works.
Ik verwacht geen verder uitstel voor deze werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Postma over de dreigende hakbijl voor bomen in midden en zijbermen van A28 tussen Wezep en Nunspeet

MP De Pater-Postma (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about plans to clear trees along the A28 near Wezep and Nunspeet, including the 80-metre fire corridor and whether regional authorities were consulted. The Minister said the fire-corridor plans are postponed pending agreement with the municipalities, province and safety region, while urgent traffic-safety measures proceed.
Given the situation on the Veluwe, the Safety Region asked RWS for an 80-metre fire corridor.
Gezien de situatie op de Veluwe heeft de Veiligheidsregio RWS verzocht om een brandcorridor van 80 meter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Von Martels over mogelijk te hoge PFAS-waarden in strooizout

MPs De Pater-Postma and Von Martels asked whether PFAS contamination of road salt could endanger winter road gritting, whether expert follow-up research was planned, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that PFAS contamination of deep-mined salt is very unlikely, that current NEN standards do not include PFAS, that stocks for the coming winter are already purchased, and that no alternatives are needed.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, it is very unlikely that road salt, which is largely extracted from old and deep soil layers, is contaminated with PFAS.
Zoals bij het antwoord op vraag 2 is aangegeven, is het zeer onwaarschijnlijk dat strooizout dat veelal uit oude en diepe grondlagen wordt gewonnen, vervuild is met PFAS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Palland over de arbeidskrapte in de kinderopvang en het niet kunnen inzetten van gediplomeerde kraamverzorgenden

MPs De Pater-Postma and Palland asked the State Secretary about labour shortages in childcare and why qualified maternity nurses cannot be deployed in baby groups, including whether the sector-agreed list of qualifying diplomas should be revised. The State Secretary said a labour market plan will follow in the first half of next year, that the diploma list is a matter for the social partners in the collective agreement, and that a equivalence request procedure exists for candidates outside the list.
Addressing bottlenecks around the established list of training programmes is up to the social partners themselves and does not fit the role of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment.
Het oppakken van knelpunten rondom de vastgestelde lijst van opleidingen is aan de sociale partners zelf en past niet bij de rol van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en De Pater-Postma over de beruchte spoorwegovergang in Castricum

CDA MPs asked the state secretary about the dangerous Castricum level crossing, including how often trains passed while people or vehicles were on it, the causes and outcomes, progress on safer crossings, and how many unprotected crossings remain. The secretary said there were six such incidents since 1975 with one collision in 1997, listed programme progress and a joint study with the municipality, and said the target is zero fatalities at level crossings with about 180 priority NABO crossings to be tackled by 2023, 36 done so far.
Level crossing safety is a priority for me.
Overwegveiligheid is voor mij een prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Pater-Postma over niet meer kunnen blussen door een vrijwillige brandweerman vanwege extreme wachttijden Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An MP asked why a volunteer firefighter faces long CBR waiting times for license renewal, whether he must pay extra for an urgent procedure, and how many people receive such a fee letter. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained that CDE holders get priority and that urgent applications cost about 35 euro at the municipality but can sometimes be reimbursed by the CBR; the CBR sends no such fee letter.
The CBR does not charge for the urgent procedure and does not send a letter about it.
Het CBR rekent geen kosten voor de spoedprocedure, en stuurt hier ook geen brief over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en De Pater-Postma over de video 'CBR belt  politie voor vechtpartij en nu gaan we de mail van de directeur platleggen'

MPs Schonis and De Pater-Postma asked the minister about a video alleging CBR delays in medical fitness checks for young drivers, the one-year validity of theory certificates, and compensation. The minister said CBR assessments are legally required, the Gezondheidsraad is reviewing the list of conditions, compensation options are under study, and the theory certificate validity will not be extended.
I do not have exact figures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de gevolgen van lachgas in het verkeer

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about rising nitrous oxide (lachgas) use among drivers, its effects, casualty figures, enforcement options and whether recreational use should be banned. The state secretary answered that casualty data are not available, that existing criminal and CBR administrative tools can already be used, that a risk assessment is pending, and that a youth awareness campaign is planned, but did not fully answer the deadline request.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Van der Molen over het niet handhaven van het verbod op gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

MPs De Pater-Postma and Van der Molen asked why a bus driver in Limburg was reprimanded and police and employer did not support him after enforcing the partial ban on face-covering clothing in public transport, and how enforcement would be made effective. The minister replied that enforcement under the law rests with police and the Public Prosecution Service, that transport staff only address passengers and escalate, that the driver and police acted per the law, and that police response times and a conduct guideline have been agreed.
In the incident on a bus in Stein, both the bus driver and the police officer acted in accordance with the law.
Bij het voorval in een bus in Stein hebben zowel de buschauffeur als de politiemedewerker conform de wet gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Pater-Postma over de dreigende hakbijl voor bomen in middenberm van A28 tussen Wezep en Nunspeet

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether felling trees and shrubs in the A28 central reservation between Wezep and Nunspeet is necessary for road safety, and what alternatives and consultations exist. The minister answers that no extra measures beyond current works are needed, that felling of conifers is required for fire-spread risk in line with a regional approach, that small deciduous trees are kept, and that compensation and stakeholder consultation will follow.
Primarily, all conifers on this stretch of the A28 must be removed over a width of 80 metres, due to the high risk of fire spreading.
Primair dienen op dit traject van de A28 alle naaldbomen verwijderd te worden, ter breedte van 80 meter, in verband met het grote risico op brandoverslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Schonis en Remco Dijkstra over de grote problemen bij het CBR

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about data leaks at the CBR, where medical documents of one client were viewable in another's file, including how many cases there were, when they were reported, and whether affected people were informed. The minister reported 71 cases in January to June 2019 and 5 in 2018, said procedures and GDPR obligations were followed, and agreed to share monthly progress reports with the Chamber.
Yes, I am willing to share with the Chamber the monthly report that the CBR sends me within the framework of enhanced oversight.
Ja, ik ben bereid om de rapportage die het CBR maandelijks aan mij doet toekomen in het kader van het aangescherpt toezicht te delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Palland over de berichten inzake de Ketelbrug

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring malfunctions of the Ketelbrug bridge reported by De Stentor, including the cause, data transfer, communication with shipping, and prevention. The minister answered that the faulty frequency-regulator parts were replaced, the bridge was monitored for a week without new faults, communication ran through standard channels, and Rijkswaterstaat is open to talks with affected shipping groups but cannot guarantee no future faults.
Rijkswaterstaat is also open to a conversation to consider what can reasonably and within its tasks and responsibilities be additionally done to limit or prevent the inconvenience for shipping.

Rijkswaterstaat staat daarnaast open voor een gesprek om te bezien wat redelijkerwijs en binnen zijn taken en verantwoordelijkheden extra gedaan kan worden om de hinder voor de scheepvaart te beperken c.q. te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Pater-Postma over de toename van agressie tegen weginspecteurs

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising aggression against road inspectors and what the government will do. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited a campaign, higher prison penalties and ongoing work with the Justice Minister, but did not commit to a new concrete measure of its own.
I also see that the working conditions of road inspectors are becoming increasingly dangerous.
Ook ik zie dat de werkomstandigheden van de weginspecteurs steeds gevaarlijker worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Pater-Postma over de wildgroei van creatieve uitspattingen op de rijbaan

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the spread of decorative paintings on road surfaces and the safety risks for motorcyclists and vulnerable road users, and whether municipalities should be pressed to restrain them. The minister agreed such markings should be limited to road-use purposes, pointed to existing rules and guidance and to an informal knowledge network, and said she would inform the VNG, while stating that she cannot enforce rules against municipalities because there is no hierarchical relationship.
I believe the existing guidelines and regulations provide sufficient clarity for the application of markings.
Ik meen dat de bestaande richtlijnen en regelgeving voldoende duidelijkheid bieden voor het aanbrengen van markeringen.

m: Motie van de leden Krol en Van Raak over altijd een referendum bij herindelingen
Asks the government to legislate so that inhabitants of merged municipalities are always consulted by referendum.
requests the government to come with a legislative amendment to establish that inhabitants of merged municipalities are always consulted via a referendum
verzoekt de regering, met een wetswijziging te komen om vast te leggen dat inwoners van herindelingsgemeenten altijd worden geraadpleegd via een referendum
Motie van het lid Van Raak over stemlokalen inrichten voor mensen met coronaklachten
Asks the government to encourage each municipality to set up at least one polling station for voters with corona symptoms.
requests the government to encourage every municipality to set up at least one polling station for people with corona symptoms
verzoekt de regering, iedere gemeente aan te moedigen in ieder geval één stemlokaal in te richten voor mensen met coronaklachten
Amendement van het lid Van Raak over tijdelijke regels rond opiniepeilingen en kiezersonderzoeken
Bans publication of polls and early results on election days before polls close, and restricts exit-type observations.
It is not allowed to hold an opinion poll between the second day before election day and 21:00 on election day
Het is niet toegestaan tussen de tweede dag voor de dag van de stemming en de dag van de stemming eenentwintig uur een opiniepeiling te houden
Amendement van het lid Van Raak over extra middelen voor de politie
Adds €600 million structurally to the police budget, funded by a higher bank tax, to restore neighbourhood officers, police education and digital investigation.
the commitment and expenditure amounts for the police are increased by €600,000 (x €1,000)
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 600.000 (x € 1.000)
Motie van de leden Van Raak en Van der Molen over een pilotproject voor de ondersteuning van klokkenluiders
Asks the government to start a pilot providing special confidential advisers to support whistleblowers at ministries and agencies.
requests the government to start a pilot project for supporting whistleblowers at the ministries and services
verzoekt de regering, een pilotproject te starten voor de ondersteuning van klokkenluiders op de ministeries en in diensten
Amendement van het lid Van Raak over extra middelen voor het gemeentefonds
Raises the general municipal fund allocation by €1 billion to relieve municipal financial pressure.
In the bill, the amount of the general grant in article 3 is increased by €1,000,000,000.
In het voorstel van wet wordt in artikel 3 het bedrag van de algemene uitkering verhoogd met € 1.000.000.000.
Motie van het lid Bruins c.s. over de effecten van drie volmachtstemmen per kiezer

Asks the government to map the positive and negative effects of tripling proxy votes per voter in the evaluation of the re-run elections and to reconsider the extension before the next general election.
requests the government, in the evaluation of the re-run elections, to explicitly map the positive and negative effects of this extension
verzoekt de regering, in de evaluatie van de herindelingsverkiezingen nadrukkelijk de positieve en negatieve effecten van deze uitbreiding in kaart te brengen
Motie van het lid Van Raak over meer stembureaus bij de verkiezingen van 17 maart
Asks the government, together with municipalities, to ensure more rather than fewer polling stations are set up for the 17 March elections.
requests the government, together with the municipalities, to ensure that for the 17 March elections not fewer but more polling stations will be set up
verzoekt de regering, er samen met de gemeenten voor zorg te dragen dat bij de verkiezingen van 17 maart niet minder maar méér stembureaus zullen worden ingericht
Motie van de leden Van Raak en Wassenberg over het persoonlijk inkomen van de leden van het Koninklijk Huis laten vallen onder de Wet normering topinkomens
Asks the government to place the personal income of members of the Royal House under the Top Incomes Standards Act.
requests the government to bring the personal income of members of the Royal House under the Top Incomes Standards Act

This amendment reverses the temporary extension of these deadlines.

considering that the House of Representatives decides on its own budget
van mening, dat de Tweede Kamer gaat over haar eigen budget

requests the government in 2009 to reduce the hiring of external staff at ministries by 25%

Asks the government to contact whistleblower Frits Veerman, inventory the problems he faces from performing his civic duty, and find a solution together with him.

Amendement van het lid Bilder c.s. over het aanbrengen van een grenscorrectie tussen de gemeente Bergen en de nieuwe gemeente Venlo

Asks the government to include cooperation models as alternatives to municipal mergers and to propose amending the Municipalities Act to allow task differentiation among municipalities.
requests the government to make proposals to amend the Municipalities Act to allow differentiation between municipalities by task package
verzoekt de regering voorts voorstellen te doen tot wijziging van de Gemeentewet om differentiatie tussen gemeenten naar takenpakket mogelijk te maken

Asks the government not to raise ministers' incomes by 10% the following year.
requests the government not to raise ministers' incomes by 10% next year

requests the government to make the covenant funds for regionalisation also available to those regions

Asks the government to refrain from the planned budget cuts on the police.
requests the government to refrain from the planned cuts to the police

Asks the government to inventory problems with new travel-expense rules for police officers and ensure they do not lose out.
requests the government to make an inventory of the problems with the new travel-expense allowances for police officers
verzoekt de regering een inventarisatie te maken van de problemen met de nieuwe reiskostenvergoedingen voor agenten

Asks the government to oblige provinces and municipalities to deposit their savings with the Bank Nederlandse Gemeenten or a similar public body.

Asks the government to request that municipalities and provinces stop using promotion funds in competition with each other for the 2028 Olympics, arguing a single government budget should be used if the Games go ahead.
requests the government to ask the municipalities and provinces to stop the activities
verzoekt de regering de gemeenten en provincies te verzoeken de activiteiten te staken

Asks the government to report by 1 June 2009 whether the ISLA refinery complies with international environmental law or whether its closure scenario must be activated.
requests the government to report by 1 June 2009 that the Isla refinery operates according to international environmental legislation
verzoekt de regering uiterlijk 1 juni 2009 te melden dat de Isla-raffinaderij werkt volgens internationale milieuwetgeving

Rejects the cabinet's agreement with Aruba on Plant Hotel proceeds, asks the cabinet to reopen negotiations, and withholds financial means until agreement is reached.
rejects this agreement and requests the cabinet to reopen negotiations on it
wijst dit akkoord af en verzoekt het kabinet hierover opnieuw de onderhandelingen te openen
Motie Remkes/Van Raak over het doen vervallen van hoofdstuk IV van de rijksbegroting

Asks the cabinet to abolish budget chapter IV (Kingdom Relations) from 2014, ending structural and incidental autonomy funds for Aruba and the Antillean islands after 2013, except a bridging arrangement for law enforcement.
requests the cabinet to abolish chapter IV of the national budget with effect from 2014

Asks the government to tell Sint Maarten's administrative partners in good time that independence under the planned timetable is unlikely.

verzoekt de regering tijdig aan de bestuurlijke partners kenbaar te maken dat de waarschijnlijkheid dat Sint Maarten volgens de nu voorziene planning een zelfstandig land kan worden, gering is
Motie Remkes c.s. over onderwerpen die betrokken moeten worden bij de Statuutwijziging

Asks the government to include decision-making structure, division of responsibilities, wider autonomy for the constituent countries and an exit clause for all future countries in the Statute revision.
requests the government to include among other topics in the Statute revision: the decision-making structure
verzoekt de regering bij de Statuutwijziging onder meer de volgende onderwerpen te betrekken: – de besluitvormingsstructuur

Asks the government to publish the budget documents once the budget is finalised, rather than applying embargo arrangements.
requests the government, once it has finalised the budget, to make the budget documents public
verzoekt de regering op het moment dat zij de begroting rond heeft de begrotingsstukken openbaar te maken
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over Nederlandse militairen die als migrant geregistreerd zijn

An MP asked whether Dutch military personnel posted abroad are registered as immigrants in the civil registry and whether this harms their pension rights and families. The State Secretary explained that the registry term 'immigration' is used for returns after temporary stays, that no effect on rights follows, and promised to examine adding a second address and clearer labelling.
Ja, daar ben ik het mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de financiële steun aan Sint Maarten

The MP Van Raak asks whether the Dutch government will accept that financial support to Sint Maarten is oppressive or colonial, whether support depends on local political backing, and whether it will suspend aid and push a referendum on independence. The State Secretary rejects the characterisation, says political consensus is needed, requests written reassurance from Sint Maarten's Prime Minister before any suspension, and declines to initiate an independence process.
I have asked the Prime Minister of Sint Maarten for clarification and written reconfirmation of the support previously expressed for this process by both her government and the Estates.
Ik heb de Minister-President van Sint Maarten verzocht om opheldering en een schriftelijke herbevestiging van de eerder uitgesproken steun voor dit traject van zowel haar regering als van de Staten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het nog altijd veel te hoge aantal afgekeurde poststemmen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the over 4 percent invalid postal votes, still high in Doetinchem after measures, would be reduced. The Minister explained that many postal votes are set aside for valid reasons (missing ballot or pass), described a procedure to open envelopes to check for passes, and said the set-aside rate would fall significantly.

As I informed the House in my letter of Tuesday 16 March, I asked all municipalities to have postal voting boards open the ballot envelope when the return envelope contains only that envelope, to check for a voter pass.

Zoals ik in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van dinsdag 16 maart jl. heb laten weten, heb ik alle gemeenten verzocht om de briefstembureaus te vragen om, wanneer de retourenvelop uitsluitend een briefstembiljetenvelop bevat, deze envelop te openen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat veel poststemmen ongeldig zijn

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether it is harmful to trust in democracy that postal votes are invalidated over minor errors, and whether ballots sent together with the voting pass in one envelope will be counted. The minister answered that such votes should count, announced a procedure letting polling staff open the envelope to check the pass and count the ballot without viewing it, and confirmed the answers would be provided on time.
That is why, upon receiving signals from the municipalities, I immediately took action and requested guidance from the Council of State and advice from the Electoral Council.
Daarom heb ik gelijk na het ontvangen van de signalen van de gemeenten actie ondernomen en voorlichting gevraagd aan de Raad van State en advies aan de Kiesraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over eventuele voornemens het demonstratierecht te beperken

MP Van Raak (SP) asked whether the government planned extra conditions on demonstrations, including caps on participant numbers and time slots, and whether municipalities had received information the Chamber had not. Minister Ollongren answered that the normal Wom procedure applies, that bans or limits must be assessed case by case by mayors, that a Veiligheidsberaad handreiking allows participant caps for health reasons, and that the questions were answered as soon as possible.
A demonstration may only be restricted by the mayor or, in extreme cases, banned, if necessary to protect health, in the interest of traffic, or to combat or prevent public disorder.

Een demonstratie kan door de burgemeester alleen worden beperkt of, in het uiterste geval, worden verboden, als dat noodzakelijk is ter bescherming van de gezondheid, in het belang van het verkeer of ter bestrijding of voorkoming van wanordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er in Dronten vijf stembureaus minder komen

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether Dronten's polling stations are being reduced despite a motion requiring more, and whether the government will intervene. The minister confirms the reduction in polling locations (18 to 13 stemlokalen, but 18 to 20 stembureaus), says the government urges municipalities to maintain polling locations, and states that Dronten's choice is its own responsibility.
I have previously pointed municipalities to the importance of maintaining the number of polling locations at the level of the 2017 Tweede Kamer election
Ik heb gemeenten eerder gewezen op het belang van het op peil houden van de stemlokalen/locaties ten opzichte van de Tweede Kamerverkiezing in 2017
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de grote afstand naar stembureaus

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether voting should be accessible and whether long distances to polling stations, such as those for elderly residents in Eindhoven, are undesirable, and whether all municipalities should be reminded to spread polling stations well. The minister answered that voting stations should stay accessible, that Eindhoven spread its locations carefully with mobile polling at care homes, and that she sees no need to repeat the reminder because municipalities already understand the importance of spread.
I have previously pointed municipalities to the importance of keeping polling locations at the level of the 2017 Lower House election and of spreading them and making them accessible.
Ik heb gemeenten eerder gewezen op het belang van het op peil houden van de stemlocaties ten opzichte van de Tweede Kamerverkiezing in 2017 en op het belang van spreiding en toegankelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de uitvoering van de motie van de leden Van Raak en Van der Molen over een pilotproject voor klokkenluiders

Mr Van Raak (SP) asked how the motion on a pilot project for whistleblowers has been implemented. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the Secretary-General had proposed a special adviser for internal reporters but withdrew the plan after the unions and the departmental works council objected, and the minister declined to force it through.
Because of the convincing argument of the joint unions and the DOR, the Secretary-General decided to withdraw his plan.
Vanwege het overtuigende betoog van gezamenlijke vakbonden en DOR, heeft de secretaris-generaal besloten zijn voornemen in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het salaris van de top van Winair

An MP asks what the managing director of Winair earned and whether cutting the top salaries was part of the rescue operation. The government reports the CEO earned EUR 169,000 in 2019, refers to the annual state-holdings report for board pay, and states that the board's salaries were cut by 25% in April 2020 and that the loan conditions bar bonuses and dividends.
Board remuneration is reported in the annual State Holdings Management Report that the Minister of Finance sends to your House each year.
Over de beloningen van de Raad van Bestuur wordt gerapporteerd in het Jaarverslag Beheer Staatsdeelnemingen dat uw Kamer jaarlijks van de Minister van Financiën ontvangt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat het overgrote deel van de gemeenten grote tekorten heeft

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipal deficits caused by the corona crisis are unsustainable and whether hidden costs will be compensated without complicated procedures. The government acknowledges the financial strain, points to measures already taken and a February study on municipal finances, but refuses to commit to compensating all costs, leaving the amount to political-administrative weighing and deferring structural solutions to a next cabinet.

The amount and scope of real compensation requires a political-administrative weighing, with the starting point that the sub-national governments will not be worse off as a result of the corona approach than before.

De hoogte en omvang van de reële compensatie vraagt een politiek bestuurlijke afweging, waarbij het uitgangspunt is dat de medeoverheden er als gevolg van de corona-aanpak niet slechter voor komen te staan dan daarvoor.
