Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat tien procent van de mensen overweegt niet te gaan stemmen in verband met het coronavirus

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether she is concerned that about ten percent of voters may stay home from the election because of the coronavirus, and whether covid-proof 'stemstraten' (voting lanes) should be mandated for all municipalities. The minister replied that a BZK survey shows 81% are certain to vote and 5% (waarschijnlijk) not, with 22% of those citing corona; she sees no need for separate voting lanes for symptomatic voters and declined to mandate them, noting the number of polling stations is broadly on par with 2017.
I am not in favour of obliging all municipalities to set up a voting lane.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van alle gemeenten te verplichten een stemstraat in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over gevraagd losgeld om gehackte gemeentedata terug te krijgen

An SP MP asked whether the government agrees with a mayor refusing to pay ransom for hacked municipal data, whether public bodies have paid ransoms, how other municipalities are protected, and how many ransomware extortionists have been convicted. The government agreed that paying ransom is undesirable, said it does not register public-body cases separately and that there is no full picture of ransom payments, described existing cyber-resilience measures and a 2021 exercise on ransomware, and said ransomware is not a separate offence so convictions cannot be counted directly.
There is no complete picture of cases in which public institutions have paid ransom.
Er is geen volledig beeld van gevallen waarbij er door publieke instellingen losgeld is betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inzet tijdens de jaarwisseling

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about police deployment over New Year's Eve, including extra staffing, possible union actions, readiness against disorder, and whether municipalities may organise alternatives. The minister answered that deployment varies by unit with extra officers where needed, no union actions had been announced, police are prepared at regional and national level, and municipalities are free to organise alternatives.
How many officers are precisely scheduled differs per unit.
Hoeveel agenten er precies zijn ingeroosterd verschilt per eenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de vergelijking tussen hem en Escobar, Napoleon en Hitler

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations how he views Sint Maarten parliamentarians comparing him to Pablo Escobar, Napoleon and Hitler, why he trusts that the Sint Maarten parliament will cooperate given such remarks, and whether he fears this will frustrate aid to the island. The answer refers the reader to a letter on the third tranche of liquidity support for Sint Maarten, without answering the questions directly.

The written questions from MP Van Raak (SP) to the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations on the comparison between him and Escobar, Napoleon and Hitler (2020Z25129) have been answered by letter 'Agreement on third tranche of liquidity support for Sint Maarten' (Parliamentary paper 35 420, no. 203).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de vergelijking tussen hem en Escobar, Napoleon en Hitler ( 2020Z25129 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Akkoord derde tranche liquiditeitssteun Sint Maarten» (Kamerstuk 35 420, nr. 203 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de vergoedingen van leden van adviescommissies

An MP asked why the 2005 promise to publish all advisory committee member fees was not kept, and about fees, anti-cumulation enforcement and total costs of advisory and task-force bodies. The Staatssecretaris said he has no powers over individual fees, that publication lies with line ministers, stopped central cumulative publication after 2016, and does not hold the requested data, citing the effort required and the lack of a clear definition for many bodies.
I do not have the requested information.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het afluisteren van o.a. de politie en marechaussee door de National Security Agency (NSA)

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister, on behalf of the Justice and Defence ministers, whether the Dutch police and military police were spied on by the US NSA through backdoored equipment, when the government learned of it, whether the US was asked for clarification, and which Dutch services still use US-origin equipment. The government declined to discuss specific equipment, the US contacts, or the services' methods publicly, noting CTIVD oversight and that it cannot guarantee equipment not developed under its own control, pointing to the National Crypto Strategy.
Publicly I cannot make statements about the equipment these services use, because this would give insight into their working methods.
In het openbaar kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de apparatuur die deze diensten gebruiken, omdat dit inzicht zou geven in hun werkwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat in Groningen minder stemlokalen worden ingericht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Groningen plans fewer polling stations for the 2021 Tweede Kamer election and whether the government will press the municipality to add stations. The minister answers that a survey shows 51 municipalities, including Groningen, currently expect fewer polling stations, that she wants numbers kept at least stable, and that she has written to all municipalities and offered support.
As stated in your House, I have the ambition that the number of polling stations for the upcoming Tweede Kamer election remains at least at the same level.
Zoals uitgesproken in uw Kamer, heb ik de ambitie dat het aantal stemlokalen voor de aankomende Tweede Kamerverkiezing minimaal op peil blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de uitzondering voor casino’s in de coronamaatregelen op Sint Maarten

MP Van Raak asked why casinos on Sint Maarten were exempted from closing-time restrictions and whether holiday travel there should be allowed given the risk. The State Secretary answered that Sint Maarten is responsible for its own COVID measures, that it is noteworthy it chose to exempt casinos, and that alleged ties between gambling and politics are outside his remit, though the Public Prosecution Service and a Dutch-funded joint investigation team handle criminality.
I cannot make statements about alleged ties between the gambling world and politics.
Over vermeende banden tussen de gokwereld en de politiek kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over Screening politie

An SP MP asked whether police officers' personal circumstances (their environment and criminal convictions in private time) can be screened and reported to employers, and whether screening standards will hold as recruitment expands. The Minister replied that environmental screening is currently limited to security-clearance posts, that a new law on screening police officers takes effect 1 July 2021 enabling environmental checks and continuous JDS-based screening, and that screening standards will not be lowered.
From that moment on, police officers performing work with an elevated integrity risk can be subjected to an environmental check at the start of their work and during their work.

Vanaf dat moment kunnen politieambtenaren die werkzaamheden met een verhoogd integriteitsrisico verrichten, worden onderworpen aan een omgevingsonderzoek bij aanvang van de werkzaamheden en gedurende de werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht veel agenten thuiszitten in afwachting van een coronatest

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether police teams are understaffed because officers await COVID tests, whether officers get priority testing, and how enforcement can continue. The minister acknowledged officers in quarantine or awaiting results add strain but said no whole teams are unable to function, that police get only limited priority access to testing, and that local shortages are absorbed within regional units or by asking other units for help.
The Ministry of Justice and Security and the police leadership consult intensively and frequently with the unions on various subjects.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de korpsleiding spreken intensief en veelvuldig met de bonden over diverse onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de verkiezingssoftware hackbaar is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the election process should be made safer, whether a manual count should be added as a check if the vote-counting software proves hackable, and whether these questions would be answered before any legislative debate. The Minister answered only by referring to her separate reaction to a report by the foundation Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen, sent to parliament at the same time.
To answer these questions I refer to my response to the report of the foundation Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn reactie op het rapport van de stichting Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de mogelijkheid voor raadsleden in Boxmeer om in coronatijd te kunnen stemmen

An SP MP asked whether councillors in Boxmeer should be able to vote during the COVID-19 period, and whether all councillors can exercise their voting rights given health risks. The Minister replied that participation is an essential right, that the municipal council chooses its meeting format under local autonomy, and that councillors can take part in deliberation digitally but not formally vote in a physical meeting.
Taking part in deliberation and in voting are essential rights of a councillor.
Het deelnemen aan een beraadslaging en aan een stemming zijn essentiële rechten van een raadslid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de vakantie van de Koning

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether he knew of the King's holiday abroad, why he did not object, who decided the King should return, and related questions on ministerial responsibility. The Prime Minister answered almost every question by pointing to the duty to protect the unity of the Crown and the King's private life, admitted he misjudged the timing, and provided no substantive information on the decision.
This means that no information can be provided about political and/or administrative contacts relating to matters within the Crown.
Dit betekent dat geen informatie kan worden verstrekt over contacten van politieke en/of ambtelijke aard die betrekking hebben op hetgeen zich binnen de Kroon voltrekt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bericht dat de prestatie-eisen het bestrijden van misdaad dwarsbomen

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister whether performance-based funding for the Public Prosecution Service, courts and police creates financial pressure to prosecute certain cases and undermines fighting crime. The minister replied that local authorities set priorities, denied that funding forces prosecution choices, described the current funding systems, and said an independent WODC study on financing will be reported in March 2021.
There is no question of performance agreements that force a choice for criminal prosecution of specific cases.
Er is geen sprake van prestatieafspraken die dwingen tot een keuze voor strafrechtelijke afdoening van specifieke zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over digitaal vergaderen voor raadsleden mogelijk maken als dat nodig is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether all councillors should be enabled to take part in council meetings, including digitally when they cannot attend physically for health reasons, and whether the Minister would press municipalities such as Boxmeer that refuse digital participation. The Minister replied that councils decide for themselves whether to meet physically or digitally under local autonomy, that hybrid meetings are legally impossible under the temporary law, and that she sees no point in urging municipalities.
Because hybrid meetings are legally not possible, I do not consider such a call meaningful.
Omdat hybride vergaderingen juridisch niet mogelijk zijn, acht ik een dergelijke oproep niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de brandweer in Epe een man tekort kwam om uit te rukken

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about reports that Epe's fire service could not dispatch a crew due to a shortage of one volunteer, and about volunteer availability and alternative business models. The minister acknowledged daytime availability concerns, pointed to ongoing regional programmes, said the safety region would enforce agreements more strictly, and provided volunteer numbers from 2010 to 2019 showing a decline.

The Noord- en Oost-Gelderland safety region has informed me that existing agreements will be followed more strictly and additional agreements will be made to prevent such an incident from happening again.

Veiligheidsregio Noord- en Oost-Gelderland heeft mij gemeld dat gemaakte afspraken stringenter zullen worden nageleefd en er aanvullende afspraken worden gemaakt om te voorkomen dat een dergelijke incident zich nogmaals zal voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de onderwaardering van speciale politieteams

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why observation and technical (O&T) police teams have not received recognition or higher pay despite repeated requests since 2015, and whether their special allowances were abolished and their pay will be revised. The minister replied that the police are reviewing allowances and pay for special groups, with completion targeted by year-end, and that the outcome will determine whether any pay increase is warranted.
The police will, based on the outcome of the research, determine whether there is reason to increase the pay of O&T employees.
De politie zal op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek bepalen of er aanleiding is voor de verhoging van de beloning van de medewerkers van O&T.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat Achterhoekse burgemeesters boos zijn om het sluiten van cellen

An MP asked the Justice Minister why police cells in the Achterhoek region are closing, forcing officers to travel further with arrestees despite a shortage of police capacity, and what this means for social lawyers. The minister answered that closing four cell complexes frees up about 60 FTE of police capacity, that mitigating measures such as shared transport and a new facility in Elst limit extra travel, that all mayors now support the decision, and that the Legal Aid Council and bar have been informed and travel allowances exist for lawyers.

Furthermore, now that the assessment and decision-making process within the Oost-Nederland police unit has recently been concluded, I will, in line with an earlier request from your House, send the requested AEF analysis to your House on a confidential basis.

Tevens zal ik, nu het proces van beoordeling en besluitvorming binnen de politie-eenheid Oost-Nederland recentelijk is afgesloten, alsnog, conform eerder verzoek van uw Kamer, de gevraagde AEF-analyse vertrouwelijk aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over genoegdoening voor atoomklokkenluider Frits Veerman

An SP MP asked whether the government will investigate how state bodies treated nuclear whistleblower Frits Veerman, and whether it will meet him to discuss redress. The minister says the Huis voor Klokkenluiders report concerned his former employer, not the state, but offers a conversation with Veerman to see whether specific government conduct warrants new examination.

I am willing to arrange a conversation with Mr Veerman to examine whether there have been concrete acts by government organisations towards him that harmed him and that have not yet been investigated.
Ik ben bereid een gesprek te arrangeren met de heer Veerman om te bezien of er in dit kader concrete gedragingen zijn geweest van overheidsorganisaties jegens zijn persoon die hem hebben benadeeld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bedreigen van agenten

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a threat of physical violence against a police officer, made in front of his family, could not be prosecuted, and whether all threats of violence against police should be punishable. The minister replied that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, that threats of simple assault fall outside the legal threshold of Article 285 of the Criminal Code, and that the existing toolkit already offers broad scope for criminalisation without committing to a legislative change.
Ultimately, it is up to the Public Prosecution Service to determine whether a set of facts falls within that scope.
Het is uiteindelijk aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen of een feitencomplex daarbinnen valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over gevolgen van het grensconflict met Frankrijk

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister who is responsible for the Oyster Pond border dispute with France, whether France will be held to the 2014 status quo agreement, and whether the restaurant owner can rebuild without risk of arrest. The minister answered that no single party is to blame, that the Netherlands has repeatedly reminded France of the status quo agreement, and that a joint pragmatic solution is being worked on with talks planned for autumn.
The Kingdom is working on a proposal for a joint pragmatic solution to give Cactus Tree NV comfort and facilitate the reconstruction.
Het Koninkrijk werkt hiertoe aan een voorstel voor een gezamenlijke pragmatische oplossing om Cactus Tree NV comfort te bieden en de wederopbouw te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de afhandeling van de zaak van een agent die door zijn eigen collega’s ten onrechte werd gearresteerd

An MP asked why the Public Prosecution Service's judgement in the case of a police officer wrongly arrested by colleagues could be overturned by an internal police advisory committee, and about related disciplinary handling, integrity culture and measures against ethnic profiling. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case as it is before the court and still under internal review, explained the separate criminal and disciplinary procedures, and pointed to ongoing measures and a forthcoming CBS study and motion follow-up.
Because it concerns an individual case that is still before the court, I cannot make statements about it.
Omdat het een individuele casus betreft die nog onder de rechter is kan ik hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er grootschalige handel plaatsvindt in privégegevens verkregen via callcenters

MP Van Raak asked the State Secretary of Interior about reports of large-scale trade in personal data obtained through corrupt call centre staff, whether such cases were known at tax, unemployment and student finance call centres, and about the share of temporary and external staff and salary levels there. The State Secretary answered that he knows of the report, that the tax, UWV and DUO agencies know of no such cases, and gave staffing and contract figures.
The Tax Helpline, UWV and DUO all report that no cases are known in which information was obtained in this way via the call centres of these government agencies.
Zowel de BelastingTelefoon, het UWV en DUO melden dat er geen gevallen bekend zijn dat op deze manier informatie is verkregen via callcenters van deze overheidsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat veel gemeenten de regels met betrekking tot de mogelijkheid om gratis huwelijken aan te bieden, overtreden

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are breaching the rules requiring free weekly wedding slots, and whether she knows which ones do and how she will ensure compliance. The Minister says she sees no supporting evidence in the news report, that the law sets a minimum number of free slots without income distinction, that she sees no reason to actively identify non-compliant municipalities, and that municipalities must follow the law, with no grounds for intervention.

Although I am aware of the news reports on this in the past, I see no reason at this time to actively look for municipalities that do not or insufficiently offer the possibility of a free wedding ceremony.

Hoewel ik bekend ben met de nieuwsberichten die hierover in het verleden zijn verschenen, zie ik op dit moment geen reden nadrukkelijk op zoek te gaan naar gemeenten die de mogelijkheid van een gratis huwelijksvoltrekking niet of onvoldoende bieden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Raak over de kosten voor niet-digitale aanvragen bij gemeenten

An MP asked whether some municipalities charge far more (over 2.5 times) for non-digital applications of certificates than for digital ones, and whether the government would end these price gaps. The minister answered that municipal fees are a matter of municipal autonomy for the council to decide, and only noted that digital applications generally involve fewer costs.
Setting the tariffs for municipal services falls under municipal autonomy.
Het vaststellen van de tarieven van gemeentelijke dienstverlening behoort tot de gemeentelijke autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Hijink over de keuze voor Facebook om mensen te informeren over kabinetsbesluiten

Two SP MPs asked the Prime Minister why the government chose Facebook to inform the public about cabinet decisions, noting not everyone uses it, and why Parliament was not informed first, and whether this makes Facebook the new communication policy and whether pre-Prinsjesdag documents will be leaked there. The Prime Minister answered that Facebook is one channel for reach, that the post shared no new cabinet decisions, that the same information is always available on government websites, that Parliament had already received the relevant OMT advice, and denied any change in communication policy or future leaks.
Incidentally, no new cabinet decisions were shared in the relevant post.
Overigens zijn in het betreffende bericht geen nieuwe kabinetsbesluiten gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er een dreiging is van een extreme tak van IS

Mr Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about warnings that local authorities underestimate the Hazimi movement, the number of its adherents, coordination with municipalities on reintegration and deradicalisation, national steering after Arnhem, and any foundations linked to the movement. The Minister replied that Hazimi adherents are more hostile to other Muslims but not a higher violent threat than ISIS supporters, that numbers are stable at a few dozen, that municipalities are supported and consulted, that the national strategy is under evaluation, and that no known foundations are run by adherents.
There are currently no known institutions or foundations run by adherents of the Hazimi current that promote the Hazimi ideology.
Er zijn op dit moment geen instanties of stichtingen bekend die bestuurd worden door aanhangers van de Hazimi-stroming en die het Hazimi-gedachtegoed uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de aanbesteding voor koffie-, drank- en snackmachines over de Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland op Saba en Statia

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations why the Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland prioritises tendering coffee, drink and snack machines for its staff on Saba and Statia during the COVID-19 crisis, and why it is split into four lots and not sourced from local suppliers. The State Secretary replied that the tender is a regular process, that it is local-first with local suppliers invited and the lots reflect what local suppliers can deliver, and he also outlined the emergency support packages for Caribbean Netherlands.
The tender is part of regular processes that serve the staff.
De aanbesteding is onderdeel van reguliere processen die ten dienste staan van het personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de persvrijheid op Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about reported press-freedom restrictions on Curaçao during the COVID-19 crisis, whether a free press matters especially in crises, and whether financial aid could be conditioned on press freedom. The State Secretary answered that independent journalism is vital in crises and applies to all Kingdom countries, that aid conditions focus on the financial sector but may extend beyond it, and that the answer was delayed for care and coordination.
Without judging the specific cases, I believe there must also be room during the crisis for the informing and controlling role of journalists.
Zonder over de casuïstiek te oordelen, vind ik dat er ook tijdens de crisis ruimte moet zijn voor de informerende en controlerende rol van journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over steun voor The Daily Herald op Sint Eustatius en Saba

An SP MP asked whether The Daily Herald, a Sint Maarten paper serving Sint Eustatius and Saba, should be supported during the coronavirus crisis, given its dependence for local news and its financial strain. The ministers answered that the government values local information provision, that a one-off emergency fund for Caribbean Netherlands media has been created, and that The Daily Herald will be able to claim a fixed amount per island.
Yes. The Daily Herald will be able to claim a fixed amount per island within its service area in the Caribbean Netherlands from the OCW-Caribbean Area department of the RCN.
Ja. The Daily Herald zal bij de afdeling OCW-Caribisch Gebied in RCN aanspraak kunnen maken op een vast bedrag per eiland binnen haar verzorgingsgebied binnen Caribisch Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat openbare orde en veiligheid te koop is

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about alleged close ties between former VVD politicians and security multinational G4S, the scale of public-private projects and sensing projects with public money, and why the House was not informed. The minister answered that post-ministerial lobbying rules were not breached, gave no exhaustive overview of projects, stated that the police have no sensing cooperation with private parties, and rejected the idea that the government should curb security firms, while noting the government invested in policing.
I do not have an exhaustive overview of the public-private projects in which G4S is involved.
Ik beschik niet over een uitputtend overzicht van de publiek-private projecten waar G4S bij betrokken is.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Raak over het niet naar behoren beantwoorden van Kamervragen

An MP asked the Defence Minister, on behalf of the Interior Minister, whether the government invokes state interest per question when declining to answer his questions about Dutch involvement in the Rubicon espionage operation and the Maximator eavesdropping network, and for each refusal to give reasons, risks and expected harm. The government replied that no state-interest exemption under article 68 of the Constitution was invoked because no information was refused, that intelligence matters are handled confidentially via the CIVD, and it referred to the 'open unless' principle.
There is no invocation of the state interest under article 68 of the Constitution in answering your questions, because no information is being refused.

Er is bij de beantwoording van de door u gestelde vragen geen sprake van een beroep op het belang van de staat als bedoeld in artikel 68 van de Grondwet, omdat er geen sprake is van het weigeren van verstrekking van informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Özütok en Van Raak over het bericht ‘Van 2 uitvaarten per week naar 2 per dag: uitvaartondernemer Marjan Damen draait overuren’

MPs asked the ministers about reports that funeral directors were overstretched by rising COVID-19 deaths, including capacity in mortuaries, the role of Defence and coordination, protective equipment, coffin supply and Islamic and Jewish burial rights. The minister answered that the sector is coping, that a coordination point and Defence support can be arranged if needed, that mortuary and coffin capacity is sufficient with contingency plans, and that burial options exist.
I indeed receive questions from the funeral sector about the Corona crisis, including about the cabinet's measures and RIVM guidelines.
Ik ontvang inderdaad vragen uit de uitvaartsector over de Corona-crisis, waaronder ook over de maatregelen van het kabinet en de richtlijnen van het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf en een pand dat voor een spotprijs is verkocht aan een malafide ondernemer

The SP MP Van Raak asked whether the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf sold Noordeinde 64 to the municipality of The Hague, which resold it a day later for a bargain price to a dubious entrepreneur, and asked about sale price, reasons, knowledge of resale, whether such sales should be banned, anti-resale clauses, and how often similar constructions occur. The Staatssecretaris answered that the sale followed the reallocation procedure at a notarised price of EUR 1,735,000 based on an independent valuation, that an ADR investigation is ongoing, that the reallocation procedure will be changed with a policy decision in autumn, that a 10-year surcharge clause applies instead of an anti-resale clause, and provided an overview of sales since 2003.
Furthermore, I wish to inform you that I am currently having an ADR investigation carried out into the sale of this property, the results of which I expect before the summer.
Verder wil ik u in dit verband melden dat ik momenteel een ADR-onderzoek laat uitvoeren naar de verkoop van dit pand, waarvan ik voor de zomer de resultaten verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Özütok over de beknotting van de persvrijheid op Aruba

MPs Van Raak and Özütok asked whether journalists on Aruba may be barred from working during the COVID-19 curfew, how a journalist was arrested, and whether aid conditions should protect press freedom. The State Secretary replied that journalists were not an exempt category under the curfew regulation, that three journalists were later allowed out during curfew, and that no aid conditions on press freedom were warranted.
No exemption ground has been included for journalists.
Voor journalisten is er geen uitzonderingsgrond opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de hoge kosten van rouwvervoer voor overleden coronapatiënten

An SP MP asked whether relatives of COVID-19 patients transferred to other hospitals for capacity reasons are charged high funeral transport costs, and whether the minister would press insurers or create a fund to cover them. The minister confirmed such costs are sometimes passed on, said insurers usually cover them and some funeral firms show leniency, and committed to having his ministry reimburse the extra costs for about thirty affected families, with the Ombudsman for Funeral Services as contact point.
I am willing to bear these extra costs and have obtained the agreement of the Ombudsman for Funeral Services to serve as contact point for any affected persons.
Ik ben bereid deze extra kosten te dragen en heb de Ombudsman voor het Uitvaartwezen bereid gevonden om als aanspreekpunt voor eventuele gedupeerden te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het niet naar behoren beantwoorden van Kamervragen

MP Van Raak asked the Defence Minister why questions he posed on 14 April about the Dutch role in intelligence operations Rubicon and Maximator were treated as actual and operational matters. The Minister replied that, in line with earlier answers, the government does not comment publicly on the knowledge and methods of the intelligence services, since confirming or denying operations or cooperation could reveal those methods.

Answering questions about possible operations or cooperation arrangements amounts to confirming or denying that these operations or arrangements exist, and can thereby give insight into the methods and knowledge level of the services.

Het beantwoorden van vragen over mogelijke operaties of samenwerkingsverbanden is een bevestiging of ontkenning van het bestaan van deze operaties of samenwerkingsverbanden en kan daarmee inzicht geven in de werkwijze en het kennisniveau van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van Nederland bij spionageoperatie ‘Rubicon’ en afluistergenootschap ‘Maximator’

Van Raak (SP) asked the Interior Minister, answered by Defence Minister Bijleveld-Schouten, about the Dutch role in the alleged 'Rubicon' espionage operation and the 'Maximator' eavesdropping alliance, including timing of knowledge and decisions, which companies were involved, and whether agents were deployed without company staff knowing. The government declined to discuss the knowledge level and methods of the intelligence services, saying only that cooperation with foreign services is necessary and that the CTIVD oversees lawful use of powers.
Publicly, no statements are made about the knowledge level and working methods of the intelligence and security services.
In het openbaar worden geen uitspraken gedaan over het kennisniveau en de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Dam en Van Raak over het bericht ‘Onderzoeker: we moeten meer begrip hebben voor ‘morele verwondingen’ bij ex-militairen’

MPs Van Dam and Van Raak asked the Justice and Security Minister about moral injury among police and ex-military and about PTSD compensation for police officers, including restschade procedures, the Beroepsincidenten Regeling, and volunteer police. The minister answered in detail on the current compensation and procedural framework, acknowledged difficulties in the process and promised a reform of the system, while not addressing moral injury beyond a definition.

Within the framework of improving the system for occupational diseases, occupational incidents and service accidents, the system of compensation for pain and suffering and residual damage is being revised.
In het kader van de verbetering van het stelsel beroepsziekten, beroepsincidenten en dienstongevallen wordt het systeem van smartengeld en restschade herzien.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Raak over het meewerken van Aruba Airlines aan de uitzetting van dissidenten uit Cuba

An MP asked whether Aruba Airlines helped Cuba deport dissidents, and whether the Dutch government knew and could have approved it. The minister answered that aviation is an Aruban matter, the airline denies knowingly facilitating forced deportation, Aruba's government was not informed beforehand, and the Kingdom countries could adopt rules if they wish.
Aviation is a matter for Aruba.
Luchtvaart is een aangelegenheid van Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het onjuist informeren van de Kamer over een historische kunstverkoop door het Koninklijk Huis

MP Van Raak asked the Prime Minister why the Chamber was misinformed about the sale of the Munnicks van Cleeff atlas from Princess Juliana's estate, including the claimed binding condition that it remain in the Netherlands, whether it can be resold and split, and whether Utrecht institutions were offered it. The government answered that privacy and constitutional protections prevent full disclosure of the estate settlement, that the earlier information was accurate, that private agreements are legally relevant but the atlas's stay in the Netherlands is expected, and that the Utrecht exploration found no funds.

The general laws and rules protecting personal privacy, as guaranteed in the Constitution, the GDPR and other provisions, prevent a full account of the concrete settlement of the estate among the private heirs and other parties.

De algemene, voor alle Nederlanders geldende wet- en regelgeving ten behoeve van de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, zoals gewaarborgd in de Grondwet, de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG), de uitvoeringregelgeving van de Grondwet en deze verordening alsmede andere bepalingen van de Grondwet, waaronder artikel 1 van de Grondwet, en wetgeving, staan er aan in de weg volledig in te gaan op de concrete afwikkeling van de nalatenschap tussen de verschillende particuliere erfgenamen en andere betrokkenen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Dam, Bosman, Diertens, Van der Graaf, Van Raak, Kuiken, Krol, Kuzu en Bisschop over de aanleg van wegen op Sint Eustatius

MPs asked why road works on Sint Eustatius (Cherry Tree Road) have barely progressed since 2018, whether tendering rules and European-style technical requirements excluded local contractors, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the delay, explains the tender chose a simplified international approach open to local bidders, and says the island's public works department will finish Cherry Tree itself, backed by about 9.5 million euro in funding.
For the Cherry Tree project, after the contract with the contractor was terminated, the public body chose to complete it itself.
In het geval van het project Cherry Tree heeft het openbaar lichaam er na beëindiging van het contract met de aannemer voor gekozen dit nu in eigen beheer af te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over verkiezingswaarnemers op Sint Maarten

MP Van Raak asked whether the Netherlands paid for election observers on Sint Maarten, why the Sint Maarten premier claimed no funds existed, and whether observers could still be sent before the 9 January election. Minister Knops confirmed the ministry paid for observers in the past, regretted that no observation request came from Sint Maarten for the January election, and said organising observation takes preparation time.
It is up to the government of Sint Maarten to provide clarity on this.
Het is aan de regering van Sint Maarten om hier duidelijkheid over te verschaffen.
Antwoord op  vragen van het lid Van Raak over de politie-inzet in verschillende gemeenten

MP Van Raak (SP) asked the Justice Minister about police capacity shortages forcing cities such as Amsterdam, Rotterdam and Utrecht to scale back services, and whether further erosion of primary police tasks is acceptable and whether capacity will fall further. The minister acknowledges workload concerns, says local authorities must manage demand within available capacity, cites €91m plus €10m in funding and structural strengthening, and expects pressure to persist for the coming year before recruitment effects are felt from 2021.
The cabinet has made €91 million available to relieve the pressure on deployability in the coming years.
Het kabinet heeft € 91 miljoen beschikbaar gesteld om de druk op de inzetbaarheid in de komende jaren te verlichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bericht de uitspraken van de minister in de media inzake de strijd tegen georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Van Nispen and Van Raak asked the Minister of Justice about media statements on a special brigade against organised crime, its staffing, funding, preventive measures, intelligence services' role and possible cuts to regional police. The minister answered that the team is additional to existing capacity, outlined a funding plan to be decided in spring, and said intelligence services have no role in the current design.
The expansion of police capacity for the multidisciplinary intervention team comes on top of the existing capacity.
De uitbreiding van de capaciteit (van politie) van het multidisciplinair interventieteam komt bovenop de bestaande capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat mensen niet meer naar buiten durven vanwege een gebrek aan openbare toiletten

MPs Hijink and Van Raak asked why many municipalities do not provide public toilets and whether a national minimum norm should be imposed. Minister De Jonge answered that municipalities are responsible for deciding how many public toilets are needed, pointed to voluntary programmes and alternatives, and said a national norm is not appropriate.
Municipalities themselves have the freedom and responsibility, together with residents with and without disabilities, to determine how many (semi-)public toilets are needed.
Gemeenten hebben zelf de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid samen met inwoners, met en zonder beperking, te bepalen hoeveel (semi)openbare toiletten nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over dubbele functies bij veiligheidsregio’s

An MP asked whether it is desirable for a safety region director also to serve as regional fire chief, how many dual functions exist and whether rules govern them, and whether anyone exceeds the WNT pay cap through combined roles. The minister answered that the Bpv sets no rules on dual functions, that regional boards decide themselves (about 18 of 25 regions combine the roles), and that no WNT violations by safety region top officials have been reported.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het protest van de eilandraadsleden van Saba

Parliamentarian Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior about the walkout of Saba's island council members protesting insufficient structural funding for policy, and whether Saba should have more freely spendable budget. The Minister answered that Saba has substantial structural funds, agreed in principle that structural tasks should be financed structurally, and committed to review Saba's budget autonomy and to continued contact with the island council.

Yes. In the governance agreement 2019–2022 (the 'Saba Package') that I concluded, it was agreed that the Public Body of Saba and the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will strive to cover structural tasks with structural funds.

Ja. In het door mij afgesloten bestuursakkoord 2019–2022 (de «Saba Package») is afgesproken dat het Openbaar Lichaam Saba en het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zich zullen inspannen om structurele taken ook met structurele middelen te dekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een klokkenluider bij de politie naar huis is gestuurd

An SP MP asked the Justice minister whether a Leiden police team chief was suspended after raising concerns, how that squares with whistleblower protection, and whether independent investigation of workplace safety is warranted. The minister denied any suspension, said the chief will not return to her unit with an independent mediator offered, and declined an independent inquiry while stating the force chief has full latitude.
Are you now willing to have an independent investigation carried out into workplace safety at the police? If not, why not?
Bent u nu wel bereid onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar veiligheid op de werkvloer bij de politie? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een uitvaartverzekeraar mensen met een psychische aandoening weigert

An SP MP asked whether funeral insurers may refuse people with psychiatric conditions and whether this discriminatory practice should be banned. The minister answered that insurers are free to set acceptance policy, that the Equal Treatment Act already bars direct discrimination on disability or chronic illness, and that individuals can turn to the College voor de rechten van de mens or the courts.
If consumers believe that the acceptance policy of funeral insurers is in individual cases contrary to the law, they can submit this to the College voor de rechten van de mens or the judge.

Indien consumenten van mening zijn dat het acceptatiebeleid van uitvaartverzekeraars in individuele gevallen strijdig is met de wet, dan kunnen zij dit voorleggen aan het College voor de rechten van de mens of de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een uitvaartverzekeraar mensen met een psychische aandoening weigert

MP Van Raak asks whether funeral insurers refuse or surcharge people with psychiatric or other health conditions, and whether such grounds should be banned. The minister acknowledges the practice, says insurers may set their own acceptance policy within anti-discrimination law, and refers consumers to the College voor de rechten van de mens or the courts.
I am aware that funeral insurers apply criteria on the basis of which people with an increased mortality risk are refused or charged a higher premium.
Het is mij bekend dat uitvaartverzekeraars criteria hanteren op basis waarvan mensen met een verhoogd sterfterisico worden geweigerd of een hogere premie krijgen opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Raak over het bericht dat het CETA verdrag lokaal beleid bedreigt

MPs Alkaya and Van Raak asked whether CETA's investor-state arbitration could expose municipalities and Dutch residents to damages claims over local policy, and whether the government would protect them. The minister answered that no CETA claims are foreseen, that the treaty affirms governments' right to regulate and that damages are capped at actual loss, and declined to guarantee full protection beyond stating the existing legal position.
Individual municipalities cannot be directly sued under the CETA treaty.
Individuele gemeenten kunnen niet rechtstreeks worden aangesproken onder het CETA verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de politie niet op tijd is bij spoedmeldingen

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police response times to urgent calls had not improved in the first half of 2019, whether system-technical registration explained longer times in rural areas, and what would ensure timely arrival. Minister Grapperhaus answered that response times are published as targets rather than statutory norms, that local authorities and police manage improvements, and that the system itself had not changed.
The response times the police publish on their website are target figures and not statutory prescribed response or arrival times.
De reactietijden die de politie op haar website publiceert zijn streefcijfers en geen wettelijke voorgeschreven reactie- of aanrijtijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over grote misstanden in de uitvaartzorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether reported abuses in funeral services (bodies kept at high temperatures, swapped coffins, cremations abroad at cheaper rates) violate the Burial Act, whether the trade association is powerless, whether regulation is lacking, and what will be done. The minister answered that the Burial Act does not explicitly regulate storage conditions, that the reported case concerned one entrepreneur, and that she is in talks with the sector and will return to parliament in November.
I am already in discussion with the sector about this and will soon also come back to your House on it.
Daarover ben ik reeds met de branche in gesprek en zal ik binnenkort ook met uw Kamer over komen te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Jasper van Dijk over de vermogenstoets voor kwijtschelding van lokale belastingen

MPs Van Raak and Van Dijk asked whether the asset limit for remission of local taxes should be raised to reduce debt problems and the poverty trap. The minister answered that the limits mirror national rules, acknowledged an earlier letter wrongly suggested a single figure, and declined to raise the limit because a higher threshold would worsen the poverty trap.
However, if the remission limit were raised to be closer to or equal to the social assistance norm, this would increase the poverty trap.
Echter, indien de kwijtscheldingsnorm zou worden opgehoogd om dichter of gelijk aan de bijstandsnorm te staan, zou dit de armoedeval vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de voortgang van het behoud van het dossier 'Sanders'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the 'Sanders' file transferred to the National Archives in 2001 had been digitised as promised in 2017, and if not, how it would be made accessible. The minister answered that the film reels were digitised between April and July 2018 and are now accessible, though a privacy restriction on the BNV archive applies until 1 January 2025 and access requests go to the Chief National Archivist.
For the BNV archive, of which the 'Sanders' file is part, a restriction on public access applies out of respect for the privacy of living persons.
Voor het BNV-archief, waarvan het dossier «Sanders» onderdeel is, geldt een beperking op de openbaarheid vanwege de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van nog levende personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het herstel van de luchthaven van Sint Maarten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations why Sint Maarten's government and parliament hesitate to accept the Dutch offer to finance airport reconstruction, and whether the population is harmed by local political games. The State Secretary answered that the government and parliament have repeatedly committed to the financing plan, that Dutch conditions on airport governance professionalisation and security vetting of its board are in place, and that the airport should become less vulnerable to local political influence.

Approval of the World Bank and EIB financing plan in the trust fund steering group was also subject, by me, to a number of conditions aimed at structural improvement and professionalisation of the airport management.

Aan goedkeuring van het financieringsplan van de Wereldbank en de EIB in de stuurgroep van het trustfonds werden daarnaast door mij een aantal voorwaarden verbonden die moeten zien op structurele verbetering en professionalisering van het luchthavenbestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over “exorbitante salarissen aan de top van overheidsbedrijven op Curaçao”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs why salaries at the top of state-owned companies on Curaçao exceed the Prime Minister's pay, why these pay levels are not public, and whether the financial supervisor Cft has insight into their finances, and whether public officials should never earn more than the Prime Minister. The State Secretary answered that pay supervision on Curaçao and Sint Maarten is a matter for those countries, that Cft cannot supervise such entities under the Rft but requests information regularly, and that he encourages Curaçao to act.
The remuneration of directors of state-owned limited companies on Curaçao and Sint Maarten and the supervision thereof is a matter for the respective countries.
De bezoldiging van bestuurders van overheids-nv's op Curaçao en Sint Maarten en het toezicht daarop is een aangelegenheid van de desbetreffende landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de positie van de nieuwe voorzitter van de OVV

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the newly appointed OVV chair was known to be a candidate for an IMF post when the appointment was made, and whether this undermines the OVV's independence. The minister answered that no IMF vacancy existed at the time of the appointment and that the chair remains suitable, with the candidacy not affecting his position at the OVV.
At the time of the decision on appointing a new chair of the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) in April 2019, there was not yet a vacancy for the position of director at the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

Op het moment van het besluit over de benoeming van een nieuwe voorzitter van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) in april 2019 was er nog geen sprake van een vacature voor de positie van directeur van het Internationaal Monetair Fonds (IMF).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht ‘sterke groei van dwangsommen voor de Nationale Politie’

An MP asked why the national police had to pay penalty payments (dwangsommen) to over 500 officers in 2018 for late handling of internal objections, and whether staffing shortages were to blame. The minister acknowledged limited legal capacity and attributed the 2017–2018 peak to reorganisation procedures, which are now concluded, and promised process improvements.
The police organisation is keen to handle objections within the stipulated deadlines as a good employer.
De politieorganisatie is er veel aan gelegen om als goed werkgever de bezwaren binnen de gestelde termijn te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een grensconflict tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Republiek Frankrijk in Oyster Pond op Sint Maarten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Oyster Pond border dispute with France on Sint Maarten has lasted since 1996 without negotiations, whether French incursions occurred, whether other territory is claimed, and what support the affected restaurant owner will receive. The minister explained preparatory technical work delayed by Hurricane Irma, described the dispute as concerning one restaurant and marina, and said the Netherlands will raise the issue with France to give the owner assurances.
In my next meeting with the French Minister for Overseas Territories, which will take place in a month, I will again emphasise the importance of this.
In mijn volgende onderhoud met de Franse Minister van Overzeese Gebieden, dat over een maand zal plaatsvinden, zal ik het belang hiervan nogmaals benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het opnieuw lekken van een Prinsjesdagplan

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether he would send the leaked Prinsjesdag plan on the health insurance premium to parliament, not only to the press, and do so before 6 September. The Prime Minister declined to send the plan early, saying the government will share its Prinsjesdag plans with parliament at the designated moments, during the budget debates and related bills.
The cabinet's Prinsjesdag plans are shared with your House at the designated moments.
De plannen van dit kabinet voor Prinsjesdag worden op de daarvoor aangewezen momenten met uw Kamer gedeeld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het opnieuw lekken van een Prinsjesdagplan

The SP MP Van Raak asked the Prime Minister to send the Prinsjesdag housing policy plan, leaked to the press, to parliament before 6 September 2019. The Prime Minister declined to send the plan early, stating it will be shared at the proper moments during the budget debates and related legislative procedures.
The cabinet's Prinsjesdag plans will be shared with your House at the designated moments.
De plannen van dit kabinet voor Prinsjesdag worden op de daarvoor aangewezen momenten met uw Kamer gedeeld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de top van de Nationale Politie interne meldingen over discriminatie, intimidatie en ander ongewenst gedrag zou negeren

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the police leadership ignores internal reports of discrimination and intimidation, and whether it is distant from the workforce, how many officers were reprimanded, whether a team chief was gagged, and whether independent research into workplace safety will be done. The minister denied tolerance of such conduct, pointed to existing internal channels and planned publication of disciplinary figures from 2020, but declined independent research, citing the MedewerkersMonitor.
I have informed your House that the police aims to publish an anonymised annual overview of imposed disciplinary measures starting in 2019.
Ik heb uw Kamer aangegeven dat de politie ernaar streeft om met ingang van 2019 jaarlijks een geanonimiseerd overzicht van opgelegde disciplinaire maatregelen te publiceren.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Raak over het dat agenten op werkvakantie gaan

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police capacity planning accounts for large tourist influxes, such as in Amsterdam and Zeeland, and whether volunteer police deployments solve shortages caused by the hiring freeze. The minister denied any planning gap, described peaks as handled through burgomaster requests and existing capacity, and presented volunteer deployments as an innovative, temporary measure to continue.
No. When allocating strength, account is taken of the average workload and the related need for police capacity.
Nee. Bij de toedeling van sterkte wordt rekening gehouden met de gemiddelde werkdruk en de daaraan gerelateerde behoefte aan politiecapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er tientallen schorsingen zijn bij de politie om integriteitszaken

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether dozens of police suspensions over integrity cases were only the tip of the iceberg, whether the 'Wie praat, die gaat' report could be sent to parliament, whether the Rijksrecherche lacks capacity for integrity cases, and what training is planned against criminal influence. The minister replied that the report concerns drug crime in Central Netherlands and not police suspensions, that it is public and is being sent, that the Rijksrecherche is coping through cooperation and case transfers, and listed existing police integrity training measures.
The report, including the passage the Algemeen Dagblad relied on, gives a picture of the scale of undermining drug crime, which has no relation to police suspensions for integrity matters.
Het rapport geeft, onder andere in de passage waarop het Algemeen Dagblad zich baseert, een weergave van de omvang van het probleem van ondermijnende drugscriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over gratis internetbankieren vanaf de BES-eilanden

An MP asked whether residents of the Caribbean Netherlands can open online bank accounts, whether this can be free, which local rules hinder advertising, why accounts must be opened by post, and whether ABN AMRO can be pushed to offer digital banking quickly. The minister replied that current law allows it under conditions, that the government is examining with DNB and the AFM whether to clarify licensing rules, that account fees apply regardless of location, that advertising will be examined, that digital opening is possible only for addresses in Europe, and that findings will follow in a letter by end 2019.
I am entering into discussion with the sector and will report the outcomes to you in my letter at the end of 2019.
Ik ga met de sector in gesprek en meld u de uitkomsten in mijn brief eind 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat Yarden klanten toch laat bijbetalen voor hun uitvaart

MP Van Raak asked whether funeral costs have risen significantly, whether insurer Yarden can pass extra costs to policyholders through an en-bloc clause, whether such unilateral changes undermine insurance reliability, and what the government will do about funerals becoming unaffordable. The minister answered that costs rose about 30% from 2006 to 2018, largely due to inflation, that a package policy downgrade from 2020 affects about 380,000 policies under an en-bloc clause with a cancellation right, and that there is no indication a dignified funeral has become unaffordable for many people.
I have no indications that a dignified funeral has become unaffordable for many people as a result of Yarden's financial problems.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat voor veel mensen een waardige uitvaart als gevolg van de financiële problemen bij Yarden onbetaalbaar is geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Van Raak over  het  lekken van de plannen voor Prinsjesdag (eerste set vragen)

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister why the cabinet's Prinsjesdag budget plans were leaked to a newspaper before being shared with parliament, and whether the plans would be sent to the Chamber. The Prime Minister replied that he values adequate information for parliament, that deliberations are ongoing, and that the plans will be shared at the designated moments before the budget debates.
The cabinet's plans for Prinsjesdag will be shared with your Chamber at the designated moments so they can be discussed during the general political and financial deliberations.
De plannen van dit kabinet voor Prinsjesdag worden op de daarvoor aangewezen momenten met uw Kamer gedeeld zodat het besproken kan worden tijdens de algemene politieke beschouwingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het lekken van de plannen voor Prinsjesdag (derde set vragen)

MP Van Raak (SP) asked Prime Minister Rutte whether leaked proposals on the transfer tax (overdrachtsbelasting) would be sent to parliament and whether answers to the leak questions would be shared today. Rutte replied that the budget decision-making is not finished, that he values adequate information to parliament, and that the plans will be shared at the designated moments during the budget debates.
The decision-making process on this is not yet completed.
Het besluitvormingsproces hierover is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Van Raak over het opnieuw lekken van de plannen voor Prinsjesdag (tweede set vragen)

An MP asked the Prime Minister to send the detailed Prinsjesdag plans on tax cuts, corporate tax and housing investment to parliament, and whether leaked figures were correct. The Prime Minister stressed the importance of information to parliament but said the decision process was ongoing and the plans would be shared at the designated moments during the budget debates.
The decision-making process on this is not yet complete.
Het besluitvormingsproces hierover is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak  over het bericht dat partijen open staan voor illegale donaties

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether parties willing to accept anonymous large donations had acted illegally and how the law on party financing would be tightened, including closing the route of donations via foundations. The minister said no actual transaction took place so no violation occurred, will address parties in writing and in talks rather than amend the law now, and will propose transparency measures on the natural persons behind donating legal entities later.
I will also urge them to take measures to prevent the impression from arising again in the future that they are willing to cooperate in constructions that run counter to the legislature's intent.

Ik zal er hierbij ook op aandringen dat zij maatregelen gaan treffen om te voorkomen dat in de toekomst wederom het beeld kan ontstaan dat zij bereid zijn om mee te werken aan constructies die ingaan tegen de intentie van de wetgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Raak over een grensconflict tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Republiek Frankrijk in Oyster Pond  op Sint Maarten

An SP MP asked why the Kingdom and France have not resolved the disputed border around a restaurant and marina at Oyster Pond, Sint Maarten, and what the status and planned negotiations are. The government answered that the 1648 treaty does not fix the border there, that the status quo was agreed in 2014, that France carried out inspections in 2016, that land-border negotiations are being prepared, and that Sint Maarten is responsible for rebuilding.
The land border negotiations are expected to begin at the end of this year.
Naar verwachting zullen de landgrensonderhandelingen eind van dit jaar aanvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de weigering van parlementariërs op Sint Maarten om te bezuinigen op hun eigen hoge vergoedingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Interior about Sint Maarten's delayed 2019 budget, Dutch liquidity loans, and Sint Maarten parliamentarians' reluctance to cut their own allowances. The State Secretary answered that the budget was completed on 2 July, that 10% salary cuts for ministers and a budget reduction for MPs were included, and that any 2019 liquidity support is conditional on cutting MPs' salaries or allowances.
Any liquidity support for 2019 is in any case conditional on lowering the salaries and/or emoluments of the members of the Staten.
Aan eventuele liquiditeitssteun over 2019 is in ieder geval het verlagen van de salarissen en/of de emolumenten van de Statenleden als voorwaarde verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat buitenlanders parkeerboetes ontlopen

An MP asked why foreign drivers avoid parking fines and whether Germany and Poland hide behind EU rules to withhold residents' data. The minister agreed foreign visitors should follow the same parking rules, explained that unpaid parking charges are municipal tax assessments outside the EU cross-border enforcement directive, and said municipalities may use wheel clamps while the government will consult Germany about resuming data exchange.
I will, together with my colleague at BZK, consult with my German counterparts to see how we can resume this exchange.
Ik zal samen met mijn ambtsgenoot van BZK met mijn Duitse collega’s in overleg treden om te bezien, hoe we deze uitwisseling weer kunnen hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Nispen over illegale drugsdumpingen

Two SP MPs asked who is responsible for cleaning up illegal drug waste after the Raad van State ruled that landowners need not pay, and asked about the status of inter-governmental talks, funding, and urgency. The Minister answered that regional and local authorities bear responsibility, that the cabinet will provide EUR 1 million per year structurally for co-financing direct clean-up costs, and that proposals for a structural co-financing scheme will come before the summer recess.

The cabinet now makes available structurally EUR 1 million per year for the period 2019 through 2024 on the budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security to (co)finance the direct costs of clean-up of drug dumping.
Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 mln. per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een gesponsorde reis van een Arnhemse topambtenaar naar Saoedi-Arabië

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether a senior Arnhem civil servant's trip to Saudi Arabia, reportedly paid for by third parties including Ernst & Young, breached the municipal code of conduct, and how the trip was assessed. The minister declined to judge the individual municipal case, saying it is for the mayor, college and council of Arnhem, and said she did not know who paid, while noting the municipality has a legal code of conduct and may clarify it.
I consider this an internal matter for the municipality of Arnhem and leave it to the mayor, the college and the council of Arnhem to give a judgment on this from their respective responsibilities.

Ik acht dit een interne gelegenheid van de gemeente Arnhem en laat het aan de burgemeester, het college en de raad van Arnhem om hierover vanuit hun respectievelijke verantwoordelijkheden een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het ‘wobben’ van SMS-verkeer met de CEO van Unilever in verband met de dividendbelasting

The MP asks whether the Prime Minister will provide SMS traffic with the Unilever CEO about abolishing dividend tax under the Wob, and whether that data was destroyed. The Prime Minister states the SMS was not retained, that it predates the Raad van State ruling, and that the communication was handled by SMS and phone.
The SMS message to which the Wob request relates was not retained.
Het SMS bericht waarop het WOB verzoek betrekking heeft is niet bewaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er actie nodig is om brandweerposten open te houden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reduced fire-brigade staffing and crewing changes in Midden- and West-Brabant, including whether these fit the Besluit veiligheidsregio's and whether budget cuts or late arrivals occurred. The minister said the region is exploring alternative operating models while keeping service and safety guaranteed, found no signs of a mass exodus of volunteers, reported budget cuts of about 7.9 million euro in 2013–2016 but no late-arrival overview, and noted the inspectorate monitors follow-up.
I do not have an overview that links understaffing to fire units arriving late.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht waarin de relatie wordt gelegd tussen onderbezetting en te laat arriveren van brandweereenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een onafhankelijke inspectie onderzoek zou moeten doen naar een brand

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether an independent inspectorate should investigate the 2016 fire in Hellevoetsluis, and whether the Wet Veiligheidsregio's evaluation will cover the Weesp and Hellevoetsluis cases. The minister declined an independent investigation, saying the safety region investigated itself, the Inspectorate found no further study necessary, and the evaluation is conducted by an independent commission that sets its own scope.
A further investigation it did not consider necessary.
Een nader onderzoek achtte zij niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de provincie Utrecht meebetaalt aan campagnes

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether the province of Utrecht subsidises individual European Parliament candidates' campaigns and whether this is permitted. The minister replied that the NOS corrected its report (the €750 went to the Utrecht CDA branch, not a candidate), and that the Political Parties Financing Act covers only national parties' receipts, not donations to candidates on party lists.
In general, for the financing of political parties and candidates, the Political Parties Financing Act applies only to national political parties and not to local or regional parties.

In het algemeen geldt voor de financiering van politieke partijen en kandidaten dat de Wet financiering politieke partijen zich alleen richt op landelijke politieke partijen en niet op lokale of regionale partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Laçin over het bericht dat er een kwart miljoen verkeersboetes zijn uitgeschreven voor 1 kilometer te hard rijden

MPs Van Raak and Laçin asked whether nearly a quarter million speeding fines for exceeding the limit by 1 km/h were issued since 2012, and whether this undermines support and resembles a fine quota. The minister confirmed the figure over seven years, explained measurement corrections and the 4 km/h threshold, rejected the quota claim since its 2011 abolition, and guaranteed fines serve road safety rather than revenue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raak over het bericht dat buitenlandse bedrijven Europese partijen sponsoren

MPs Leijten and Van Raak asked whether buying influence over parties through foreign corporate donations and Dutch shell companies is undesirable, and what the government will do to make European party financing more transparent and block corporate funding. The minister agrees buying influence is undesirable, announces a bill banning non-EU donations to Dutch parties, and says EU-level changes to Regulation 1141/2014 can only come via the scheduled 2021 review.

Given the increased risk of foreign influence, the cabinet will, in addition to the existing transparency rules in the Wfpp, prohibit donations from outside the EU (except from Dutch voters residing abroad) and require full transparency for donations from other EU countries.
Gelet op het toegenomen risico van buitenlandse beïnvloeding zal het kabinet in aanvulling op de bestaande transparantieregels in de Wfpp giften van buiten de EU verbieden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de gemeente Groningen een cursus gemeentepolitiek aanbiedt

Labour MP Van Raak asked whether subsidised ProDemos 'Politiek Actief' civic courses, which train citizens in local politics, undermine party-based recruitment and political diversity, and whether they should be stopped or subsidy conditions changed. The minister answered that the course costs about 131,000 euro per year, is neutral and aims to raise civic knowledge, and declined to stop or change the subsidy.
No. The ProDemos courses contribute to a vital local democracy.
Nee. De cursussen van ProDemos dragen bij aan een vitale lokale democratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een betalingsherinnering door overheden

MP Van Raak asked why government bodies, unlike businesses, are not required to send a payment reminder before charging fees, and whether a uniform norm should be set. The minister replied that the Awb leaves the decision to charge a fixed reminder fee to each administrative body, that differences between bodies are acceptable, and that a noodstopprocedure for people in debt is being developed.
Thus the government, just like businesses, has an obligation to first send a reminder (payment reminder).
Zo heeft de overheid net als bedrijven een verplichting om eerst een aanmaning (betalingsherinnering) te sturen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de trouwkosten per gemeente fors verschillen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior why wedding fees differ across municipalities, why Friday weddings cost more, whether a wedding should be affordable for everyone, whether income can be considered, and why there is no maximum fee. The minister replied that fees are a matter of local autonomy and cost-based, that free weddings must be offered by law, that income cannot be taxed by municipalities, and that councils can lower fees if they are seen as too high.
A maximum tariff for wedding fees would not do justice to locally made democratic choices and local cost differences.
Een maximumtarief voor trouwleges zou geen recht doen aan lokaal gemaakte democratische keuzes en lokale kostenverschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de VNG onderneemt met belastinggeld

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the VNG's commercial activities funded by municipal money are improper, how its decision-making and representativeness work, and whether its model regulations give it undue influence. The minister answered that member municipalities decide on the VNG's services and fees, that internal governance is primarily the VNG's responsibility, and that municipalities freely choose whether to use model regulations.
The VNG is a members' association and it is up to the members, the municipalities, to decide on the type of services they offer and the costs charged for them.
De VNG is een ledenvereniging en het is aan de leden, de gemeenten, om besluiten te nemen over het type dienstverlenging dat ze aanbieden en de te berekenen kosten daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Raak over het bericht dat de topman van ABN AMRO niet wil dat de overheid treuzelt met de verkoop

MPs Alkaya and Van Raak asked the Finance Minister to request that ABN AMRO publish any future scenarios it drew up in 2018, including ones assuming a sales halt, and whether the parliamentary information duty applies to state-majority companies. The minister said he is not aware of such scenarios, that a sales halt is not on the table under the coalition agreement, that publishing them is not opportune, and that the information duty applies only to ministers and state secretaries, not to companies in which the state holds a majority stake.
I therefore do not consider it opportune to ask ABN AMRO to make such scenarios public, should they exist.
Ik vind het dan ook niet opportuun om ABN AMRO te verzoeken dergelijke scenario’s, mochten deze al bestaan, openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de controle van Nederlanders bij aankomst op Bonaire

An SP MP asked whether Dutch passport holders arriving on Bonaire are subjected to a thorough Marechaussee check counting their days of stay, and whether this is lawful given that the WTU-BES only allows a thorough check of aliens. The Staatssecretaris confirmed that European Dutch are checked on maximum stay, acknowledged the statutory gap, and announced a legislative amendment and expanded database checks while continuing current practice meanwhile.
I am preparing an amendment to the WTU-BES that proposes adapting the law on this point.
Ik bereid een wijziging van de WTU-BES voor waarin wordt voorgesteld de wet op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een schikking met KPMG

An MP asked ministers why KPMG's Curaçao affiliate received a small settlement for facilitating money laundering, whether the settlement should have waited for ongoing cases, and whether the Dutch prosecution service was involved. The minister answered that the decision lies with the Curaçao prosecution service, which is outside Dutch responsibility, and gave no further commitment.

In this case it is for the Curaçao prosecution service to decide whether to proceed to prosecution of the suspect in an individual criminal case and which disposal modality is appropriate and warranted.
Het is in dit geval aan het OM Curaçao om te beslissen of in een individuele strafzaak tot vervolging van de verdachte wordt overgegaan en welke afdoeningsmodaliteit passend en geboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat sommige gemeenten liever geen geld uitgeven aan verkiezingsborden

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipalities are reducing election billboards, and whether the government will act on this and earmark municipal fund money for elections. The minister replied she has no overview, supports turnout measures, reminded municipalities by circular and will do so again, but said municipal funds cannot be earmarked.
I have no overview of municipalities that have decided to place fewer election billboards for the upcoming elections.
Ik heb geen overzicht van gemeenten die hebben besloten minder verkiezingsborden te plaatsen voor de aankomende verkiezingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de externe inhuur bij provincies soms meer dan 30 procent is

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister for figures on external staff hiring (externe inhuur) per province, after a report that it sometimes exceeds 30 percent. The minister replied that provinces are autonomous and accountable to their own elected councils, so the central government keeps no such figures and sets no targets, and apologised for the late answer.
For this reason, the central government neither keeps figures on external staff hiring at provinces nor has targets in relation to external staff hiring at provinces.
Om deze reden houdt het Rijk noch cijfers bij over externe inhuur bij provincies, noch heeft het Rijk doelstellingen in relatie tot externe inhuur bij provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het voorstel op Sint Maarten om het geld voor wederopbouw te gebruiken voor de bouw van een heel duur nieuw parlement

An MP asks whether reconstruction funds for Sint Maarten after hurricane Irma could be used for a costly new parliament building, and about high MP salaries on the island. The Secretary of State says the proposal is not in parliament, excludes such prestige projects from the trust fund, and that the salary cut for the Statenleden remains pending.
