The Netherlands will only be able to agree to financing projects that, where necessary, contribute to the reconstruction of Sint Maarten.
Nederland zal alleen akkoord kunnen gaan met financiering van projecten die, waar nodig, bijdragen aan de wederopbouw van Sint Maarten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de politiebonden woedend zijn over verbod politieactie

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether it is wrong that the Hague mayor partly banned a police union pension protest without giving reasons, and whether she would contact the mayor. The minister replied that the demonstration will go ahead as announced, so the assumed situation does not apply, and that restrictions must always be reasoned by the competent mayor, with no reason currently to contact the mayor.
In general, restrictions on or a ban of a demonstration must always be motivated by the competent authority (the mayor).
In algemene zin geldt dat het stellen van beperkingen aan of het verbieden van een demonstratie altijd zal moeten worden gemotiveerd door het bevoegde gezag (de burgemeester).
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Van Raak over het inhuren van KPMG door de Rijksoverheid

The MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior Affairs which ministries hired KPMG over 2009-2018 for advice, audits or assignments and at what cost per case and in total. The minister declined to give the detailed information, citing commercial confidentiality and procurement rules, but offered Rijksbrede spend data for 2010-2017 to the Chamber confidentially.
The requested information cannot be provided publicly and in detail.
De gevraagde informatie kan ik niet openbaar en in detail verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het graaigedrag rondom een Nederlandse topambtenaar op Curaçao

An SP MP asked why a senior Dutch civil servant received a foreign-posting allowance of 2,319 euro per day present for 18 days of work over nine months despite living in the Netherlands, and whether the excess will be recovered. The government answered only by referring to an earlier letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII and IV, nr. 89), without addressing the questions on substance.

The written questions from MP Van Raak (SP), question number 2018Z21681, were answered by means of the letter 'The profiteering around a Dutch senior civil servant on Curaçao' (Parliamentary paper 35 000 VII and 35 000 IV, no. 89).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raak(SP), vraagnummer 2018Z21681 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Het graaigedrag rondom een Nederlandse topambtenaar op Curaçao» (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII en 35 000 IV, nr. 89 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het RST op Curaçao

An MP asks whether internal management problems at the RST recherche team in the Caribbean Netherlands delayed or affected investigations, including the murder of politician Helmin Wiels, and why signals from whistleblowers were not acted on sooner. The minister replies that cooperation with partners is in order, that the police chief says the Wiels investigation was not frustrated, that signals were followed up with talks, a team coach and harmonised labour rules, and that an interim team leader has been appointed while the RST's future positioning is to be decided.
I will of course continue to keep your House informed about relevant developments regarding the functioning of the RST.
Over relevante ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot het functioneren van het RST zal ik uw Kamer uiteraard blijven informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het dreigement van accountants dat zij geen controle willen uitoefenen op topinkomens

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the accountants' association's (NBA) threat not to carry out WNT pay-cap controls and asked about their involvement in simplifying the rules. The minister says the NBA's concerns about complexity will be discussed within the second statutory evaluation, that the NBA helped draft the 2018 control protocol, and that politicians, not accountants, should set pay norms.
I want to conduct the further discussion on this on the basis of facts within the framework of the second statutory evaluation.
De nadere discussie daarover wil ik voeren op basis van feiten in het kader van de tweede wetsevaluatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak over de vluchtelingencrisis op Curaçao

SP MPs asked whether Curaçao requested Dutch help during the Venezuelan migrant crisis, what aid could be given, and whether returning migrants to Venezuela was part of the border-reopening deal. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao requested support, that the Netherlands provided expertise visits and a EUR 132,000 detention contribution pending a proposal, and that returns to Venezuela were not part of the agreement.
This is also not part of the agreement, which was published on the central government website following the Zembla FOI request.
Dit is ook geen onderdeel van het akkoord dat n.a.v. het WOB-verzoek van Zembla is gepubliceerd op de website van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de Nederlandse verantwoordelijkheid voor offshore in het Koninkrijk

MP Van Raak asked the Finance Minister about Dutch responsibility for offshore financial services in the Kingdom, including the Nieuw Fiscaal Raamwerk, possible links to online gambling operations and Malta, and whether agreements were kept secret. The minister answered that tax and financial regulation is the autonomous responsibility of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, that Dutch tax confidentiality and lack of administration prevent disclosure of many details, and that the Netherlands supports the countries via law-enforcement cooperation.
No Dutch government body keeps records of which companies in the Netherlands, whether or not providing financial services, also hold e-gaming licences in those countries.

Er wordt niet door een Nederlandse overheidsinstantie geadministreerd welke bedrijven in Nederland, die al dan niet financiële dienstverlening verrichten, tevens e-gaminglicenties bezitten in de genoemde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de stijging van externe inhuur bij gemeenten

An SP MP asks the Interior Minister why municipal reliance on external hired staff rose again after falling, especially in large cities, and whether a Roemer-style 10 percent cap should apply to municipalities. The minister replies that municipalities are autonomous and accountable to their councils, that external hiring can be necessary for projects, notes ministries' near-stable external hiring against the cap, and declines to extend the cap to municipalities.
Subnational governments are autonomous tiers of government that are themselves responsible for their operations and the spending of their funds, and therefore also for external hiring.
Medeoverheden zijn autonome bestuurslagen die zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering en besteding van hun middelen, en daarmee ook de externe inhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de korpsleiding agenten verbiedt actie te voeren voor een betere cao

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether police leaders were told not to support union cao actions and whether all police staff may join such actions. The minister answered that all police staff, including leaders, have the right to take part, that participation is an individual choice, and that the strategic leadership agreed among themselves not to take part directly.
All police employees, including managers, have the right to take part in actions announced by their union; that right is not up for discussion.
Alle politiemedewerkers, inclusief leidinggevenden, hebben het recht om door hun vakbond aangezegde acties te voeren; dat recht staat niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raak over het bericht dat een bende cocaïnesmokkelaars is geïnfiltreerd bij de Belastingdienst

MPs Leijten and Van Raak asked whether a Tax Authority employee was arrested for leaking confidential information to a drug smuggling gang, how such access is possible, how common official collusion with criminals is, and whether customs and tax officials are being bribed on a large scale. The State Secretary confirmed one Tax Authority employee is suspected, declined to discuss the ongoing criminal investigation, cited 2017 statistics and a WODC study, reported no known serious cases at customs in 2017-2018, saw no indication of large-scale bribery and therefore no inquiry, and said the government is strengthening its approach to undermining crime.
As far as this case is concerned, I cannot make any statements about a concrete criminal investigation.
Voor wat deze zaak betreft geldt dat ik geen mededelingen kan doen over een concreet stafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de toekomstplannen van de NPO

An MP asked the minister whether the NPO plans to replace the current affairs programme EenVandaag with a soap opera and how this fits the Media Act's public mission and the NPO's investigative journalism plans. The minister answered that no decision has been taken, that entertainment is permitted under the Media Act and the NPO's entertainment policy, and that performance agreements with the NPO will be strengthened.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de blusinstructie voor de brandweer bij vuurwerk en vuurwerkopslagplaatsen

An MP asked the Justice and Interior and Infrastructure ministers about firefighting instructions for fireworks fires, including whether water can extinguish burning fireworks, safety distances, sprinklers, blast venting, and warnings after the Culemborg and 2005 European container tests. The minister answered that the 2005 circular governs firefighter conduct, that fireworks storage rules in the Vuurwerkbesluit were not changed, and that the government sees no reason to amend the current rules.
I see no reason to amend the current Vuurwerkbesluit regarding the existing pressure-relief provision via the door.
Ik zie geen reden om het vigerende Vuurwerkbesluit aan te passen rond de huidige druk ontlastende voorziening via de deur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Leijten over het bericht dat ouderen er de dupe van zijn dat er bij sommige gemeenten alleen gepind kan worden

MPs Van Raak and Leijten asked whether it is wrong that some municipalities accept only card payments, which can hurt elderly people and debt-restructuring clients, and whether the government will force municipalities and public bodies to accept cash. The minister agrees that card-only payment should not block access to official documents and is willing to consult municipalities and public bodies on accepting cash, but does not commit to binding measures.
I am willing to consult further with municipalities and public institutions on the acceptance of cash.
Ik ben bereid tot nader overleg met de gemeenten en publieke instellingen over de acceptatie van contant geld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het aandelenbezit van de Koning

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the King holds shares in Shell or other companies with a royal designation, whether the royal family previously held Shell shares, and whether financial transparency about the head of state should be increased. The government replied that the King holds no shares in royally-designated companies, that his asset dealings fall under Article 41 of the Constitution and the privacy sphere per the Council of State's 2010 advice, and it did not commit to greater disclosure.
This article guarantees the room the King has for organising his Household.
Dit artikel waarborgt de ruimte die de Koning heeft voor de inrichting van zijn Huis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bericht dat Meld Misdaad Anoniem gegevens doorverkoopt

MPs Van Nispen and Van Raak asked the Justice Minister whether Meld Misdaad Anoniem sells anonymous tips, whether municipalities and agencies must pay per tip, and whether police should investigate before arrests based on anonymous tips. Minister Grapperhaus rejected the claim of selling tips, explained the subsidy and fee arrangement, and stated that anonymous tips are only guiding information requiring independent verification, while promising to review the public-private financing with the supervisory board.
There is no question of "sale of anonymous tips".
Er is geen sprake van «verkoop van anonieme tips».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat schietbanen van de politie onveilig zijn

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether police shooting ranges meet safety and health requirements, whether the work instruction is followed, and how many hearing damage reports exist. The minister answered that 2017 risk assessments found the ranges compliant when instructions are followed, that the 2015 work instruction was not fully implemented and will now be, and that the police do not track hearing damage reports.
The police do not have figures on reports of hearing damage among police officers.
De politie beschikt niet over aantallen van meldingen van gehoorbeschadiging bij politiemedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak “over goudsmokkel vanuit Venezuela naar Aruba, Curaçao en Bonaire”

MP Van Raak asked whether the government can claim no signals of gold smuggling from Venezuela via Aruba, Curaçao and Bonaire, given a recent Aruban gold smuggling case and earlier convictions. The State Secretary replied that he relies on information from the autonomous authorities, which report no signals, and that the Aruban case is under ongoing investigation so no statements can be made; he declined to say whether gold smuggling is being investigated.
Given that this concerns an ongoing investigation, no statements can therefore be made about this case.
Gelet op het feit dat het hier gaat om een lopend onderzoek, kunnen er derhalve geen uitspraken over deze zaak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Raak over “het gebrek aan informatie van gemeenten aan burgers door ondoorzichtige bestuurlijke constructies als Zeestad in Den Helder”

An MP asked why citizens of Den Helder must go to court to obtain information about the Zeestad theatre company, and whether such private-law vehicles escape freedom-of-information and council oversight. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, explained the Wob applies only to public bodies or private bodies under decisive municipal influence, and pointed to the council's audit committee and existing guidance while saying no overview of comparable constructions exists.
The Zeestad case is currently before the court. For that reason I do not consider it appropriate to make statements about it now.
De casus-Zeestad is momenteel onder de rechter. Ik acht het om die reden niet opportuun daar nu uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Leijten over nepnieuwsbestrijders van de EU die Nederlands nieuws beoordelen maar geen Nederlands spreken

SP MPs asked why the EU's EUvsdisinfo fake-news unit, which has no Dutch-speaking staff, rates Dutch news, how its volunteer numbers and €1 million budget add up, and whether the government would distance itself from it. The minister answers that the unit's Dutch-language articles were wrongly published and rectified, that the government opposes its method and has raised it with the EEAS, and that the EU Commission is not responsible for it.
No, the cabinet will therefore carry out the motion submitted by MPs Kwint and Yesilgöz-Zegerius (Parliamentary paper 21 501-34, no. 290).
Nee, het kabinet zal daarom de motie van de leden Kwint en Yesilgöz-Zegerius (Kamerstuk 21 501–34, nr. 290 ) uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het feit dat een mantelzorger opdraait voor de kosten van een begrafenis

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a caregiver paying for a deceased care recipient's funeral was intended under the Burial Act, whether municipalities could have acted differently, and whether the law should be revised. The minister said such cases are regrettable, explained that the burgomaster bears funeral costs only when no heirs or surviving relatives exist, noted municipalities have discretion to cover costs, and committed to discussing with municipalities how to make the rules better known.
The law does leave municipalities room to make their own assessment and still take the costs on their account.
De wet biedt overigens ruimte voor gemeenten om een eigen afweging te maken om alsnog de kosten voor haar rekening te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de verantwoordelijkheid van Nederland voor de offshore en de gokindustrie op Aruba, Curaçao en Sint Maarten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations whether the Dutch government was responsible for offshore gambling on Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, including its supervision and enforcement before 2010 and the safeguards against money laundering. The government answered that licensing, supervision and enforcement of offshore gambling fall under the autonomous competence of those countries, and that Dutch cooperation and prosecution support exist, but it did not answer the historical questions substantively and said the questions sent to Curaçao in 2016 remain unanswered.
The drafting and adoption of a national ordinance is done by the government and parliament of Aruba, Curaçao or Sint Maarten.
Het opstellen en aannemen van een landsverordening geschiedt door de regering en het parlement van Aruba, Curaçao of Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de slechte omgang van de politie met zieken

The SP MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the National Police mistreats sick officers, fails to re-integrate them, and keeps receiving UWV wage sanctions, and how it will stop this. Minister Grapperhaus replied that good employer policy has full attention, that sanctions stem partly from past administrative failures, that a new re-integration policy and a plan to reduce sick leave will be sent to parliament before the May recess, and that over 80% of sick-leave files now meet the Poortwachter rules.
As promised, I will send you this action plan before the May recess.
Conform toezegging zal ik u dit plan van aanpak voor het mei-reces aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het door ‘EU vs Disinfo’ bestempelen van journalistieke verslaggeving tot nepnieuws

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister why the EU's EU vs Disinfo unit labelled a journalist's report on a political event as fake news, and whether this endangers press freedom. The minister replied that the unit's task is to identify and rebut disinformation without targeting journalists, that journalists are responsible for how they report, not for what is said at events, and refused to ask the EU to stop funding the unit.

It is important, however, that these actions focus on identifying, naming and factually refuting disinformative (elements of) reporting, and not on identifying and naming journalists and their journalistic reporting as disinformation.

2 Het is hierbij wel zaak dat deze acties zich richten op het identificeren, benoemen en feitelijk weerleggen van desinformerende (elementen van) berichtgeving en niet op het identificeren en benoemen van journalisten en hun journalistieke verslaglegging als zijnde desinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de illegale goudsmokkel uit Venezuela

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether gold smuggling from Venezuela via Aruba, Curaçao and Bonaire occurs under military supervision, whether money laundering infrastructure exists, and which bodies should control it. The government answered that no official Venezuelan figures exist, that Aruban and Curaçaoan authorities report no known signals of smuggling, that customs and the Kustwacht carry out controls, and that Bonaire customs found no gold and the OM BES has no signals of such trade.
There are no signals known to the OM BES that point to illegal gold trade via Bonaire.
Er zijn bij het OM BES geen signalen bekend die wijzen op illegale handel in goud via Bonaire.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het rapport inzake Voorinvesteringen en medezeggenschap in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs why politicians in Sint Maarten receive the highest allowances in the Kingdom, how often their parliament meets, whether they are always paid at least one year of severance, and whether they will respond to a call to cut pay by thirty percent. The State Secretary answered that the allowances are a matter for Sint Maarten itself, pointed to a public attendance overview, confirmed the severance rule, and said he would raise the call in his own political contacts.
That is difficult to explain. An explanation for this will first have to be given by Sint Maarten, because the level of the allowances is a matter for the country.
Dat is moeilijk te verklaren. Een verklaring hiervoor zal allereerst gegeven moeten worden door Sint Maarten, omdat de hoogte van de vergoedingen een landsaangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat politievrijwilligers zich ondergewaardeerd voelen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether police volunteers are sufficiently valued, whether they receive proper training and conditions, and how the shortage of officers and the extra two million euros will be used. The minister said volunteer recognition and conditions are being improved through a nationwide policy due early 2018, training pathways are being funded, and the extra funds serve volunteer training rather than solving the officer shortage.
I am aware that the police will face a challenge in the coming years in replacing personnel due to large outflows.
Ik ben bekend met het feit dat de politie de komende jaren voor een uitdaging komt te staan bij de vervanging van personeel, als gevolg van grote uitstroombewegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de AIVD en het kabinet burgers misleiden

MP Van Raak asks whether the AIVD may already intercept cable communications when targeted, and why its website says the new law lets it investigate cable communication that it could not previously reach, and whether the website should be changed. The minister answers that interception of identified persons via cable is already allowed under the old law, that the new law adds power to intercept cable traffic without a specific identified target, and that the website text is accurate but has been clarified.
Because your question shows that parts of the passage may be open to multiple interpretations, the text has been further clarified.
Omdat uit uw vraag blijkt dat delen van de passage voor meerdere interpretaties mogelijk zijn, is de tekst verder verduidelijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat raadsleden zich buitenspel voelen gezet

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether it is concerning that many council members do not know which inter-municipal cooperation bodies their municipality belongs to, and whether the proliferation of such bodies creates a democratic deficit that training or higher allowances cannot solve; he also asked about the benefits of municipal mergers. The Minister acknowledged the concerns, said the Wgr will be amended to improve political accountability and councils' controlling role, promised a policy letter in spring 2018 and an action plan on local democracy in summer 2018, and said the question on mergers concerns cooperation research rather than mergers and refers to an earlier reply.
Decision-making in a joint arrangement must be transparent and the councils involved must be better able to carry out their controlling role and, if necessary, intervene.
Besluitvorming in een gemeenschappelijke regeling moet transparant zijn en betrokken gemeenteraden moeten hun controlerende rol beter kunnen uitvoeren en zo nodig kunnen ingrijpen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de Douane

Van Raak (SP) asked why customs (Douane) is not designated to use blue lights and sirens, despite earlier commitments and promises to align with the shop floor. The ministers answered that the application was rejected under the criteria because use would be too infrequent to guarantee safe driving, and that a speed-limit exemption and police cooperation are sufficient.
Based on assessment against the criteria used for this, however, this application was rejected.
Op basis van toetsing aan de criteria die hiervoor worden gehanteerd is deze aanvraag echter afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van Raak over het onderzoek ‘Verkenning Meldprocedures en Integriteitsvoorzieningen 2017’

MPs asked about a 2017 Huis voor klokkenluiders survey finding only 48% of employers have whistleblowing procedures meeting the Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders, and about weak reporting culture, especially in semi-public sector and firms without works councils. The minister acknowledged the gaps, said work remains, and pointed to ministry activities in 2018 and recommendations to works councils and branch organisations, without new binding measures.
The Ministry of SZW will also devote attention in 2018 to the importance of a safe work culture, including by organising meetings and drawing attention to developed instruments.

Het Ministerie van SZW zal ook in 2018 aandacht besteden aan het belang van een veilige werkcultuur, onder meer door het organiseren van bijeenkomsten en door het extra onder de aandacht brengen van ontwikkelde instrumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Den Boer en Van Raak over zwangere volksvertegenwoordigers

MPs Özütok, Den Boer and Van Raak asked whether a Nijmegen councillor's resignation, forced by the rule barring temporary replacement in the last 16 weeks of a term, amounts to pregnancy discrimination and whether adoption leave can be covered. Minister Ollongren said there is no discrimination, but she will prepare a bill to allow temporary replacement throughout the term, while refusing a constitutional amendment for adoption.
I am willing to prepare a separate bill for this purpose and will aim to present the bill to your House shortly.
Ik ben bereid daartoe een separaat wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding te nemen en zal ernaar streven het wetsvoorstel op korte termijn aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een zakenprins illegale activiteiten onderneemt

The SP MP Van Raak asked the ministers about a report that a prince of the royal family, Bernhard, runs illegal rental practices such as charging key money, possibly unregistered tenants, and asked whether royals must obey the law. The minister answered that rental law applies to everyone, that the ACM supervises the rental market and municipalities can fine unregistered occupancy, and declined to comment on the specific case.
Laws and regulations, such as those on rental, apply to everyone. I see no reason to address this specific situation.
Wet en regelgeving, zoals ten aanzien van verhuur geldt voor iedereen. Ik zie geen aanleiding om op deze specifieke situatie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de aantasting van de positie van de Algemene Rekenkamer van Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Dutch Minister of Interior Affairs whether the Curaçao government withdrew a pending cassation appeal, without the Audit Chamber's knowledge, that would have allowed audits at telecom company UTS, and whether the government would act to restore the Chamber's position. The state secretary answered that Curaçao's Audit Chamber and its powers are a matter for Curaçao itself, that the Dutch government will not interfere in court proceedings or the withdrawal, declined to speculate on gambling links, and refused to engage with the Curaçao government.
However, it is not for the Dutch government to interfere in the court's ruling in the UTS case or in the Curaçao government's withdrawal of the cassation appeal.
Het is echter niet aan de Nederlandse regering om zich te mengen in de uitspraak van de rechter ten aanzien van de zaak UTS of de intrekking van het cassatieberoep door de regering van Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een belofte van vice-premier De Jonge

The MP asks when the minister will deliver on the Deputy PM's promise to quickly provide concrete examples of Russian-spread fake news in the Netherlands, and whether the answer will be sent by a set deadline. The minister points to earlier letters with examples of state influence on public opinion, promises a further letter before the Christmas recess, and agrees to send the answer on time.
In the debate on my ministry's budget last week I indicated that I will inform your House further before the Christmas recess.
Ik heb in het debat over de begrotingsbehandeling van mijn ministerie vorige week aangegeven dat ik uw Kamer voor het Kerstreces nader informeer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het dreigement van een politicus op Sint Eustatius om Europees Nederlandse militairen te vermoorden en te verbranden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a threat by a Sint Eustatius politician to kill and burn Dutch military personnel, asking who 'they' are, the government's response, whether military remain on the island, and whether citizens are safe. The state secretary condemned the remarks as unacceptable, said the threat was not directed personally and the target was unclear, reported a police presence of three marechaussee and no planned expansion, and noted that the public prosecutor declined to start a criminal investigation while the complaint was still considered the right choice.
This threat was not made personally and in that manner.
Dit dreigement is niet persoonlijk en op die wijze geuit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Kwint over het bericht dat een NRC-journalist in de cel zat omdat hij weigerde foto’s af te staan

SP MPs asked whether a NRC journalist was jailed for refusing to hand over photos without a judge's authorisation, and what would prevent recurrence. The Minister confirmed the incident, said the prosecution service apologised, acknowledged no judicial review took place contrary to the guidelines on coercive measures against journalists, and said the case will be discussed widely within the prosecution service.

When the Public Prosecution Service wants material held by a journalist, the public prosecutor must submit a request to the investigating judge under Article 105 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to obtain an order to surrender it.

Wanneer het Openbaar Ministerie wil beschikken over materiaal dat onder een journalist berust moet de Officier van Justitie ex artikel 105 Wetboek van Strafvordering, bij de Rechter-Commissaris een vordering indienen om van de Rechter-Commissaris een bevel tot uitlevering te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat het project met de slimme camera’s in de haven van Rotterdam stil ligt

MPs Van Raak and Van Toorenburg asked about reports that the smart camera project in the Rotterdam port had stalled, including whether cameras are being read, a funding deadlock, and a claimed one-fifth interception rate for cocaine. The government replied that a convenant is about to be signed, operational rollout is planned for 2018–2021, it has no basis for the one-fifth figure, and the Haventafel held its first meeting on 5 September.
I am not aware of the basis for the estimate of one fifth.
Het is mij niet bekend waarop de schatting van een vijfde is gebaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Raak over het landsbesluit van Curaçao nr. 17/1922 van 5 september 2017

MPs Bosman and Van Raak asked the minister about a Curaçao decree creating a ministerial regisseur and supervisor for the new hospital project and its rising costs. The minister said the Curaçao hospital is a country matter, that Curaçao must cover any overruns itself, and that the Cft will assess the budget effects, while leaving the funding and staffing questions to Curaçao.
This is not known to me, but that is also not necessary since it concerns a country matter.
Dit is mij niet bekend, maar dat hoeft ook niet aangezien het een landsaangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Hijink over het bericht dat Fox-IT zeggenschap van de staat afhoudt

MPs Van Raak and Hijink asked whether Fox-IT, now owned by UK-based NCC Group, has met its agreements on protecting state secrets and why it will not write the state's demands into its articles of association. The minister replied that additional conditions under the ABDO security framework are being negotiated constructively and are near completion, and that contractual security requirements and state supervision mitigate risks.
The discussions on this between Defence and Fox IT are proceeding constructively and are in a concluding phase.
De gesprekken hierover tussen Defensie en Fox IT verlopen constructief en bevinden zich in een afrondende fase.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de minister gemeenten en provincies een brief heeft gestuurd naar aanleiding van het vonnis van de rechtbank Midden-Nederland in een zaak van een raadslid uit

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior how he consulted the VNG and IPO about a court ruling on a councillor's allowance in Noordoostpolder and his letter to municipalities and provinces, and whether those bodies agreed with his conclusions. The Minister replied that the letter's content was coordinated at official level with IPO and VNG on his behalf, and noted that the VNG and Noord-Holland were communicating in line with the ruling.
I had the content and structure of the letter extensively coordinated with the IPO and VNG through the Director-General.
De inhoud en opzet van de brief heb ik door de Directeur-Generaal uitgebreid laten afstemmen met IPO en VNG.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Raak over de Wet normering topinkomens 3

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the documents for the planned Wet normering topinkomens 3 (extending the WNT pay cap to all public and semi-public staff) would be sent to the House by 28 September 2017. The minister declined, explaining the bill was not pursued and that the Council of State advice, explanatory note and bill would be published by the next cabinet as required by law.
As I have informed the House on several occasions, I am leaving the decision on whether to submit the bill extending the personal scope of the WNT to the next cabinet.
Zoals ik de Kamer bij diverse gelegenheden heb gemeld 3 laat ik het besluit om het wetsvoorstel uitbreiding personele reikwijdte WNT in te dienen over aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het passief kiesrecht

MP Van Raak asked whether politicians convicted of fraud or corruption should be barred from office and why passive voting rights are rarely removed, and whether the law should be tightened. The minister agreed integrity is essential, said vetting is primarily a party responsibility and cited a handreiking for parties, and stated that the parliamentary amendment replacing loss of voting rights with an aggravating circumstance means no legislative change is planned.
Against this background, I see no reason to propose amending the legislation.
Ik zie tegen deze achtergrond geen aanleiding voorstellen te doen tot wijziging van de wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de brandweer bijna geen bevelvoerders meer heeft

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the shortage of volunteer firefighters is growing, whether the minister will intervene given that regional safety boards are responsible for staffing, whether talks with the volunteer firefighters' union continue, and whether the safety regime should be revised. The minister answered that two studies are underway with results expected by year end, that regional boards bear responsibility for staffing while the Inspectorate supervises, that he meets the union yearly, and that the Wet veiligheidsregio's will be re-evaluated in 2019.
The boards of the safety regions are responsible for the adequate organisation of fire brigade services.
De besturen van de veiligheidsregio's zijn verantwoordelijk voor een adequate organisatie van de brandweerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over twijfelachtig recherchewerk brengt brugwachter aan de afgrond

An SP MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about municipalities and provinces hiring private investigation firms for integrity probes, including a case where private investigators allegedly placed tracking devices on a government employee's car, and whether central government does the same. The minister answered that local authorities decide themselves whether to use private bureaus for reasons of capacity, expertise and independence, that such bureaus must be licensed under the WPBR with conduct rules, that the tracking device practice is only allowed for business-used vehicles within the relevant period, and that central government sometimes outsources such investigations while preferring in-house work.
Municipalities and provinces are themselves responsible for deciding whether or not to use an external private bureau to carry out an integrity investigation.
Gemeenten en provincies zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het besluit al dan niet gebruik te maken van een extern particulier bureau voor de uitvoering van een integriteitsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat Google gebruikersgegevens in buitenlandse datacentra moet overhandigen aan de VS

Two SP MPs asked whether personal data held by UWV and other government bodies, including data stored abroad, can be guaranteed to stay out of reach of the US government after reports that Google must hand over user data. The government answered that it cannot give such a guarantee because legal bases such as mutual legal assistance treaties allow transfers to the US, and it does not plan extra measures against foreign storage beyond case-by-case risk assessment.
No, I cannot give that guarantee.
Nee, die garantie kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de filmrollen van de geheime dienst die mogelijk betrekking hebben op de 'affaire Sanders'

An SP MP asked why microfilm rolls transferred from the intelligence service to the National Archives in 2001 have not been digitised, whether their quality is deteriorating, and whether they will be digitised and their contents made public. The minister replied that digitisation is not required unless the material condition demands it, that microfilms can last 200 to 500 years, that AIVD and the Archives are now studying how to digitise them, and that public access is restricted until 2025 for privacy reasons.

When the archive of the Bureau Nationale Veiligheid was transferred to the National Archives, a restriction on public access to the entire archive until 2025 was imposed to respect the privacy of those involved.

Bij het overbrengen van het archief van Bureau Nationale Veiligheid naar het Nationaal Archief is, met het oog op de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de betrokkenen, een beperking aan de openbaarheid van het hele archief gesteld tot 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over capaciteitsgebrek bij sporenonderzoek

MPs Van Nispen and Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice what caused the late start of forensic investigation after a fatal armed robbery, how large the capacity shortage is, how often such delays occur, and what measures will prevent staffing problems from hindering evidence collection in serious cases. The minister replied that the police had forensic officers on scene within an hour, that priority goes to the most serious cases with assistance from other units when needed, and pointed to the ongoing personnel reorganisation and recruitment of specialists.
The police information shows that in this case there was no late start to the forensic investigation.
Uit de informatie van de politie blijkt dat er in deze zaak geen sprake is van te laat starten met het sporenonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over de aanbesteding van mobiele telefonie

MPs Hijink and Van Raak asked how government data, including phone traffic of civil servants, is stored and protected against foreign access such as under the USA Freedom Act, and what contract conditions apply to the new mobile telephony tender. The minister answered that data location is assessed per case, that EEA-only processing, notification duties and termination rights were included in the new contract, and that the Vodafone-Ziggo joint venture did not trigger termination.
To prevent data being processed or shared by the contractor in breach of Dutch law, requirements have been included in the contract.
Om te voorkomen dat in strijd met Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving gegevens door de opdrachtnemer worden verwerkt of gedeeld, zijn eisen in het contract opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Kwint over de kwaliteit van lokale media

MPs Van Raak and Kwint asked the government about the decline of local journalism, its role in democratic oversight of municipalities, the funding of local media, and municipal communications staff. The state secretary answered that declining advertising revenue drives media cuts rather than the 2017 public broadcasting cut, that a separate fund for local journalism is not warranted given existing subsidies, and that municipalities may communicate as they wish.
You will receive the research outline before the summer recess.
U ontvangt de onderzoeksopzet voor het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over filmrollen van de geheime dienst die mogelijk betrekking hebben op de 'affaire Sanders'

An MP asked whether the AIVD deposited film reels at the National Archives relating to the 1946 'Sanders affair', whether they are in poor condition and inaccessible, and whether the AIVD must pay for restoration and how public access will be ensured. The minister confirmed the archive transfer in 2001, said the material is only partly public and not yet digitised, and said the National Archives and AIVD are jointly examining how to digitise the reels.
The National Archives and the AIVD are jointly examining how, given the fragility of the material, the film reels can be digitised.
Het Nationaal Archief en de AIVD bezien in gezamenlijkheid op welke manier, gelet op de kwetsbaarheid van het materiaal, de filmrollen gedigitaliseerd kunnen worden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de gemeente Groningen de ICT-voorzieningen privatiseert

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Groningen's plan to privatise generic ICT services, despite expert objections, could guarantee data safety, why the BIT could not review the project, and whether national rules are needed. The Minister answered that outsourcing decisions and data protection responsibilities lie with municipalities, that BIT has no remit over municipal projects, and that no national rules are planned.
The bureau has no authority to advise on ICT projects at municipalities.
Het bureau heeft geen bevoegdheid om te adviseren over ICT-projecten bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat Google gebruikersgegevens in buitenlandse datacentra moet overhandigen aan de VS

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Google must hand over user data stored in foreign data centres to the US, and whether Dutch government data and citizens are protected from foreign surveillance. The Minister of the Interior answered that location decisions are left to each responsible body within existing rules, that full protection and an overview of data locations cannot be guaranteed, and that US court ruling and Judicial Redress Act issues apply only in limited ways.

It is not appropriate for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to have an up-to-date overview of where the data of all ministries, provinces, municipalities and semi-public institutions are stored.

Het is niet aan de orde dat de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties moet beschikken over een actueel overzicht van de locatie waar de data van alle ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en de semipublieke instellingen zijn opgeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de weigering van gemeenten om te stoppen met de ontwikkeling van een stemapp

MP Van Raak asked the Interior Minister why municipalities, including Molenwaard, refuse to stop developing a voting app despite no legal basis, which municipalities are involved, the total cost, and how they will be stopped. Minister Plasterk replied that electronic voting in legal elections is not permitted, that the app is only for consulting residents on local matters rather than testing election voting, and that he will work with the ministry on digital participation expertise.
Municipalities likewise have no room to make their own choices regarding statutory elections.
De gemeenten komt ook geen ruimte toe om ten aanzien van de wettelijke verkiezingen eigen keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het moeten terugbetalen van huurtoeslag na een uitkering in verband met een brandverzekering

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a couple who had to repay a year of rent allowance because a fire insurance payout sat on their account on 1 January, and asked whether insurers have a duty of care, whether the tax authority can make exceptions, and whether payouts can be excluded from assets. The State Secretary answered that the civil duty of care does not extend to knowing a client's benefit receipts, that the law leaves no room for case-specific exceptions to the 1 January asset test, and that no new exception will be created.
I see no reason to create a new exception for these cases.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om voor deze gevallen een nieuwe uitzondering te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de verkoop van lockpick guns

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the online sale of lockpick guns to burglars and how this fits with the government's burglary prevention campaign, and whether the free sale would be stopped. The minister shares concern about misuse, says current law (model APV and criminal preparation offences) already allows sanctions, and notes a planned bill extending the offence of burglary preparation.
Current legislation provides sufficient means to sanction the preparation of a burglary involving this kind of equipment.
Huidige wetgeving biedt voldoende mogelijkheden om de voorbereiding van een woninginbraak, waarbij gebruik gemaakt wordt van dit soort apparatuur, te sanctioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er in Almelo per app gestemd kan worden

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the government was involved in a municipal trial of app-based voting in Almelo and how the secret ballot would be guaranteed. The minister replied he was not involved, that internet voting carries serious risks, that the law only permits paper voting in booths, and that any future trial would need transparent, verifiable state requirements.
I am not involved in the plans that the municipalities of Almelo, Emmen, Hollands Kroon, Molenwaard and Lingewaard have to trial internet voting with an app.
Ik ben niet betrokken bij de plannen die de gemeenten Almelo, Emmen, Hollands Kroon, Molenwaard en Lingewaard hebben om proeven te doen met het stemmen per internet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van staatsbank Fortis bij omkoping van Italiaanse politici

An MP asked whether state-owned Fortis Bank failed to report unusual transactions by Francesco Corallo that may have funded bribery of Italian politicians, and what role KPMG and supervisor DNB played. The Minister of Finance explained the Wwft reporting duties, said compliance is assessed by DNB and the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, and declined to comment on individual institutions.
It remains the institution's own responsibility to report all unusual transactions.
Het blijft de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een instelling om alle ongebruikelijke transacties te melden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het mislopen van toeslagen vanwege incidenteel hoger uitvallen van het jaarinkomen

MP Van Raak asked whether employees can lose their childcare, housing and healthcare allowances when a one-off payout from the Individual Choice Budget (IKB) raises their annual income, and whether the government would investigate how often this happens and find solutions. Secretary Wiebes answered that allowances are tied to annual taxable income by design, that an IKB payout normally does not raise taxable income because the budget is paid out within the calendar year, that any loss of allowances cannot be separated from personal circumstances, and that he sees no reason to change the principle or investigate further.
It was a deliberate choice by the legislature to use this income measure as the benchmark for the citizen's ability to pay.
Het is een bewuste keuze van de wetgever geweest om dit inkomensgegeven als maatstaf te kiezen voor wat betreft de in aanmerking te nemen draagkracht van de burger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat topinkomens blijven stijgen

An MP asked whether municipalities may not cut subsidies when top salaries are paid, and why the transitional rules of the WNT are not being applied as intended amid reports of rising top incomes. The minister answered that subsidy conditions may not be disproportionate, that the transitional regime is not being breached as far as he can tell, and that the WNT-3 extension bill is awaiting Council of State advice.
After receiving the advice, I will take up the bill again.
Na ontvangst van het advies zal ik het wetsvoorstel weer ter hand nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Futselaar over het bericht dat de politie weer niet op tijd is bij spoedmeldingen

MPs Van Raak and Futselaar asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether, after reports that police again missed response-time targets for urgent calls, the government still stood by its earlier claim that safety in rural areas had improved and whether it would act to restore capacity. Minister Blok answered that response times are broadly stable nationally, that the targets are not yet met in rural areas for structural reasons, that local optimisation is ongoing, and that bureaus are closed only in consultation with local authorities and vehicle capacity is not being cut.
There are sufficient police vehicles available and no savings are being made on them.
Er zijn voldoende politievoertuigen beschikbaar en hier wordt niet op bezuinigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Raak over het bericht dat de CIA kwetsbaarheden in met het internet verbonden apparaten misbruikt

MPs Voortman and Van Raak asked whether the CIA uses smartphone and smart TV vulnerabilities to spy on people, including Dutch citizens, whether it withholds vulnerabilities from developers, and whether Dutch services will gain similar powers under the new intelligence law. The government said it has no concrete evidence of unlawful intrusion on Dutch citizens, referred to earlier letters on vulnerability handling, declined to judge the CIA's conduct on the basis of leaked material, and saw no reason to raise the matter with US authorities.
Based on the information published by Wikileaks, the cabinet cannot conclude that the American authorities have been negligent.
Op basis van de door Wikileaks gepubliceerde informatie kan door het kabinet niet worden geconcludeerd dat de Amerikaanse autoriteiten nalatig zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het mogelijk 'cadeau doen' van klokkenluider Edward Snowden door president Poetin aan president Trump

MP Van Raak asked whether the government shares concerns that Russia might hand Edward Snowden to the US as a gift to Trump, whether it shares concerns about Trump calling Snowden a traitor who should be executed, whether Snowden will get a fair trial in the US, what importance his NSA revelations have for the Netherlands, and whether the government will grant him asylum quickly. Minister Koenders answered that the government has no information that extradition is imminent, reaffirmed opposition to the death penalty, saw no indication Snowden would not get a fair trial, referred to earlier letters on the revelations, and noted that an asylum request can only be made in person in the Netherlands and Snowden has not made one.
The cabinet has no information indicating that extradition of Mr Snowden by Russia to the United States is imminent.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie waaruit blijkt dat uitlevering van de heer Snowden door Rusland aan de Verenigde Staten aanstaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de veiligheid van gevangenis Pointe Blanche op Sint Maarten

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior about security at Pointe Blanche prison on Sint Maarten, including the risk of escape and riot, the Kingdom's responsibility for human rights, and measures to improve the situation. The minister shares the concerns, notes Sint Maarten bears primary responsibility, says the Dutch side is willing to help if asked, but makes no concrete new commitment beyond the existing improvement plan.

I am of the view, as also follows from the letters referred to above, that the government of Sint Maarten should keep its agreements and that the executive services, including the prison, should be enabled to carry out the necessary improvements.

Ik ben, zoals ook volgt uit de brieven waar hiervoor naar wordt verwezen, van mening dat de regering van Sint Maarten haar afspraken dient na te komen en dat de uitvoerende diensten – de gevangenis inbegrepen – in staat dienen te worden gesteld om de noodzakelijke verbeteringen door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een Brits bedrijf het IT-beveiligingsbedrijf dat Nederlandse staatsgeheimen beveiligt, heeft overgenomen

MPs Van Raak and Jasper van Dijk asked why the state relies on a private firm to secure state secrets, whether the UK takeover of Fox-IT endangers them, and why the NCTV and MIVD were not informed or able to block the deal. The ministers answered that the state needs specialised private expertise, that contractual and legal security requirements guard against unwanted access, that no notification duty existed and Dutch law offers no grounds to restrict such takeovers, and that the MIVD lacks power to block them.
Under the existing contractual arrangements with the company concerned, there was no obligation to inform the NCTV of a proposed takeover.
Op grond van de bestaande contractuele afspraken met het betreffende bedrijf bestond niet de verplichting om de NCTV op de hoogte te stellen van een voorgenomen overname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de slechte bereikbaarheid van de politie

Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police phone lines are still poorly reachable and what will be done to improve response times, and whether WhatsApp contact with youth will be explored. The Minister answered that 73 percent of calls were answered within 20 seconds in January 2017, that a taskforce is working on improvements with effects expected in the medium term, and that WhatsApp contact is being studied alongside privacy and reliability concerns.
A Taskforce RSC has been set up to support units.
Er is een Taskforce RSC ingericht om eenheden te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak over stembureaus op MBO-scholen

MPs Van Dijk and Van Raak asked whether the government supports placing polling stations at MBO schools, universities of applied sciences and universities to increase youth turnout, and whether it will consult education bodies and the VNG before the 15 March election. Minister Plasterk agreed in principle that accessible polling locations help youth turnout, noted that most municipalities had already designated polling stations and printed passes, and said he will encourage municipalities to pay attention to school-based polling stations for the 2018 municipal elections.

However, I am willing to suggest to municipalities that they give extra attention to the possibility of setting up polling stations in educational institutions for the municipal elections of 21 March 2018.

Ik ben echter bereid om gemeenten in overweging te geven om voor de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen van 21 maart 2018 extra aandacht te besteden aan de mogelijkheid van het inrichten van stembureaus in onderwijsinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over bijklussende burgemeesters

An MP asks why mayors hold commercial side jobs, whether this endangers local governance, and why the ministry did not check mayors' and aldermen's disclosed side income. The minister answers that the mayor's post is a task-based function, that side jobs are permitted and disclosed under municipal law, that municipal boards are responsible for assessing and offsetting side income while the ministry only facilitates, and that an evaluation of the offsetting system will be sent around summer.

The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is solely responsible for calculating the amount that may need to be offset and facilitates the offsetting process by providing a web application and a helpdesk.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties draagt uitsluitend zorg voor de berekening van het eventueel te verrekenen bedrag en faciliteert het verrekenproces door middel van het beschikbaar stellen van een webapplicatie en een helpdesk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de veiligheid van onze verkiezingen

Two MPs asked the Interior Minister why OSV election software was not examined earlier, what safeguards exist, and whether votes will be counted on paper before the result is final. The minister answered that OSV will not be used at the next election out of precaution, that the next election will be evaluated including how the Kiesraad handled earlier warnings, and that there are no indications of past election manipulation.
In the evaluation I will also closely examine the process of calculating the result and the tools used, to determine how this process should be organised in future.

Ik zal in de evaluatie ook het proces van het berekenen van de uitslag en de hulpmiddelen die daarbij worden gebruikt goed onder de loep nemen om na te gaan hoe dit proces in de toekomst moet worden ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat 1 op de 5 gemeenten geen informatie op de website heeft over de locatie van stembureaus

An MP asked whether one in five municipalities lacks online information about polling station locations and whether the minister will urge them to publish it. The minister says he knows of no data beyond the cited website, agrees online publication is a good supplement to legal notification duties, and will ask municipalities to add the information.
I will soon ask municipalities (well before the election) to include information on their websites about polling station locations, insofar as they have not already done so.
Ik zal gemeenten binnenkort (nog ruim vóór de verkiezing) vragen om, voor zover zij dat nog niet gedaan hebben, informatie op hun website op te nemen over de locaties van de stembureaus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Raak over Russische hackers die gebruikmaken van Nederlandse server

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Russian hackers used a Dutch server, and whether such attacks can be prevented and how Dutch email vulnerabilities are addressed. The minister declined to comment on the specific case, said the government will keep parliament informed through general threat reports, and stated that political parties are primarily responsible for their own information security while the government raises cybersecurity awareness.
The cabinet does not make public statements about specific cases.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over specifieke casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het oppakken van een politicus die gebruik maakt van zijn vrijheid van meningsuiting

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior why SP chair Theo Coskun was arrested while flyering at a Rotterdam RET transit area, whether RET security staff may detain politicians in public space, and whether freedom of expression requires no permit. The Minister explained the arrest followed refusal to leave after two fines under the Passenger Transport Act, and confirmed freedom of expression is constitutionally protected but restrictable, with no permit requirement possible.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that the arrest was made on the basis of article 184 of the Criminal Code, failure to comply with an official order.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij bericht dat de aanhouding is verricht op grond van artikel 184 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht, het niet opvolgen van een ambtelijk bevel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over chakra-cursussen voor ambtenaren in Heemskerk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the chakra-based training courses bought by the municipality of Heemskerk for its civil servants, at over EUR 422,000, should be halted or recovered from the municipality. The Minister replied that municipalities set their own training budgets, that the municipal council is responsible for judging this, and that recovering funds from the municipal fund would not fit the constitutional relationship between central and local government.
Municipalities themselves determine the training budget and training policy for their civil servants.
Gemeenten stellen zelf het opleidingsbudget en het opleidingsbeleid vast van hun ambtenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de aanslag op Theo van Gogh

MP Van Raak asked whether the CTIVD saw the 152 wiretap passages withheld from journalist Wierenga, whether the Chamber can be given confidential access to them, and whether the lone-actor conclusion on Bouyeri is convincing. Minister Plasterk confirmed the CTIVD reviewed all wiretap transcripts, declined to provide the passages, and maintained that the CTIVD found no concrete evidence of accomplices.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Swinkels, Van Toorenburg en Van Raak over het bericht dat een terreurverdachte op het vliegtuig naar Turkije kon stappen

MPs asked why a terror suspect could board a flight to Turkey after a German SIRENE alert was not passed on urgently due to a telephone outage and an unmonitored email inbox. The minister explained the outage, the procedures for passing on alerts, and measures taken, but declined to share the outage report in full, citing security concerns.
Because of the detailed information about the internal systems of the National Police and their vulnerability to possible misuse, I will share the outage evaluation confidentially with your House.

Vanwege de gedetailleerde informatie over de interne systemen van de Nationale Politie en de kwetsbaarheid daarvan ten aanzien van mogelijk misbruik, zal ik de storingsevaluatie vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Nispen over beperkingen van het demonstratierecht

MPs Van Raak and Van Nispen asked whether a mayor may require only 'positive messages' at demonstrations, as the mayor of Geleen did, and how this fits constitutional rights and controls on emergency measures. Minister Plasterk answered that the Wom bars content-based restrictions, that the mayor's conduct can be reviewed by the council and courts, and that local authority is responsible, while the Minister lacks instruction powers.
Imposing a demonstration ban based on the content of the thoughts or feelings to be expressed is not permitted.
Het opleggen van een demonstratieverbod op grond van de inhoud van de te openbaren gedachten of gevoelens is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het gebruik van het regeringsvliegtuig tijdens het staatsbezoek aan Australië

An SP MP asked whether using the government aircraft, which flew largely empty, cost €250,000 on the Australia state visit, and why the Australian offer of an aircraft was declined. The minister answered that the government plane was chosen after comparing costs with a local charter, that the aircraft's limited range required the delegation to fly commercially, and that the aircraft carried baggage ahead of the trip, with the estimated cost of the outbound and return legs at €293,929.27.
The Australian offer was of course considered in preparing the state visit.
Het Australische aanbod is uiteraard betrokken bij de voorbereiding van het staatsbezoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een integriteitsonderzoek binnen de Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen

MP Van Raak asks whether an internal investigation into integrity complaints at the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen is commercial, whether its leadership and culture are examined, and whether its investigators have personal ties to officers, raising doubts about objectivity. The Minister confirms the study covers leadership and culture, that an external training and advisory firm conducts it following procurement rules, and that one investigator has a police background, with the works council and union informed and sitting on a supervisory committee.
One of the investigators has a police background and therefore knows people within the police organisation.
Een van de onderzoekers heeft een politieachtergrond en kent daardoor mensen binnen de politieorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over gelukscursussen voor ambtenaren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior how many municipal civil servants attended a happiness course ('Sturen op geluk in het publieke domein'), its cost, how many municipalities have happiness coordinators or budgets, and why such funds are not spent on care or re-integration. The Minister replied that municipalities set their own training budgets and that the ministry does not monitor participation, costs, happiness coordinators or budgets, so most questions could not be answered; the course price was referenced at EUR 4,995 and the Minister declined to judge municipal spending choices.
Decentralised governments (including municipalities) themselves determine the training budget and training policy for their civil servants.
Decentrale overheden (waaronder gemeenten) stellen zelf het opleidingsbudget en het opleidingsbeleid vast van hun ambtenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de gokindustrie op Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the master/sub-licence structure of Curaçao's gambling industry lacks a legal basis, whether UTS reports unusual transactions to the FIU, and whether UTS and KPMG's services and tax responsibility raise concerns. The Minister declined to answer on substance, stating these are matters for the autonomous country of Curaçao, and said he would forward the questions to the Curaçao government.
I cannot comment on these questions because they concern a matter for the autonomous country of Curaçao.
Ik kan mij over deze vragen niet uitlaten omdat het vragen zijn die een aangelegenheid van het autonome land Curaçao betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over verzekeraar Ennia op de Antillen

MP Van Raak asked the ministers of Finance and Interior about the Ennia insurer in the Caribbean: the valuation of the Mullet Bay resort, conflicts of interest, auditing by KPMG, remedies for policyholders, and who screened Hushang Ansary. The ministers declined to answer the valuation and conflict questions citing DNB's confidentiality duty, answered the audit and screening questions only partly by pointing to the former Bank Nederlandse Antillen and the CBCS, and referred to earlier answers on policyholder remedies.
For these reasons I do not have the information to answer these questions.
Om die redenen beschik ik niet over informatie om deze vragen te kunnen beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over online-casino’s vanuit Curaçao in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about online casinos licensed from Curaçao operating in the Netherlands, including ownership, oversight, a telecom provider's role, and the gambling sector's revenue. The minister answered that the Dutch Gambling Authority has investigated such operators and ended violations through informal enforcement, but that online gambling oversight on Curaçao is a matter for Curaçao's government and Public Prosecutor, won't answer questions on individual companies, and will raise concerns with Curaçao's Justice Minister.
It is not possible to answer questions about individual Curaçao companies, business structures and citizens.
Het is niet mogelijk om vragen over individuele Curaçaose bedrijven, bedrijfsconstructies en burgers te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over grootschalige illegale gokactiviteiten vanuit Curaçao en de rol van KPMG

An MP asked the government about large-scale illegal online gambling run from Curaçao, the telecom company UTS's role, and KPMG's ties to UTS and other state-owned companies. The minister answered that Curaçao's gambling oversight is a Curaçao matter, that the Dutch gambling authority lacks enforcement powers there, and declined to answer questions about individual companies and citizens.
It is therefore a matter for the government and the Public Prosecution Service of Curaçao to properly regulate the oversight of online gambling.
Daarmee is het een aangelegenheid van de regering en het Openbaar Ministerie van Curaçao om het toezicht op online-kansspelen goed te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het inkomen van een directeur bij Delta

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the reported €400,000 salary offered to a new director of Delta, far above the WNT norm, is inappropriate and whether the minister will contact Delta's supervisory board as he did with Alliander. The minister answered that pay at government-owned companies outside WNT scope is for shareholders and supervisory boards to decide, and that he sees no reason to convey his views to Delta.

Given the existing scope of the WNT, however, it is not the task of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to convey this message separately each time to government holdings that fall outside the scope of this act.

Gegeven de bestaande reikwijdte van de WNT is het echter niet de taak van de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om deze boodschap telkens afzonderlijk over te brengen aan overheidsdeelnemingen die buiten de reikwijdte van deze wet vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de stijging van externe inhuur bij gemeenten

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why municipalities increasingly hire external staff, whether this is undesirable, and whether the government will work with the VNG to apply the 'Roemernorm' cap to municipalities. The minister answered that municipalities are autonomous and responsible for their own operations, that the increase stems from decentralisation tasks, and declined to take the initiative.

Given the own responsibility of the decentralised governments, I will not take over your request to work together with the VNG on proposals for how the 'Roemernorm' can also be applied to municipalities.

Gegeven de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheden zal ik uw verzoek om samen met de VNG, met voorstellen te komen hoe de «Roemernorm» ook bij gemeenten toegepast kan worden, niet overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht over de wankele fundamenten van de e-overheid

MP Van Raak asks the Minister of Interior about press reports that the e-government's foundations are fragile, including ICT project risks, reliance on external contractors, the BRP operation's budget and timing, and the powers of the Digital Commissioner. The Minister rejects the 'dream machine' framing, agrees early risk signalling matters, says in-house ICT capacity and reduced external hiring are being pursued, gives no guarantee against further budget overruns, and says the Digital Commissioner's role does not cover specific projects.
I will keep your House informed of the programme's progress through semi-annual reports and interim reports where necessary.
Ik houd uw Kamer op de hoogte van de voortgang van het programma via halfjaarlijkse rapportages en indien nodig tussentijds
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht ‘Dat salaris is nu eenmaal afgesproken’

Mr Van Raak (SP) asked the minister whether it is improper that the director of HVC, a public-task company owned by municipalities and water boards, earns above the WNT pay norm, and whether the minister will contact HVC or its shareholders about lowering the salary. The minister replied that HVC falls outside the WNT, that extending the WNT to decentralised public companies is being studied, and that it is for shareholders and supervisory boards to set pay, so he sees no reason to convey his views to HVC's shareholders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van Curaçao bij een gokschandaal in Australië

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether Curaçao licensed EmuCasino, linked to illegal Australian gambling, and about its ownership structure, sublicensing and accountant. The Minister declined to answer all seven questions, saying they concern a country matter (landsaangelegenheid) of Curaçao.
I cannot comment on these questions because they concern a country matter of Curaçao.
Ik kan mij over deze vragen niet uitlaten omdat het vragen zijn die een landsaangelegenheid van Curaçao betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van Curaçao bij een gokschandaal in Australië

The MP asks the Minister of Interior Affairs about Curaçao's regulation of internationally operating online casinos, including the legislation, the number and identity of master-licence holders, the supervising body, and who oversees the sublicensed operators. The Minister declines to answer, stating these are matters for Curaçao as a country within the Kingdom and referring to earlier questions.
I cannot comment on these questions because they concern a national affair of Curaçao.
Ik kan mij over deze vragen niet uitlaten omdat het vragen zijn die een landsaangelegenheid van Curaçao betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een Curaçao's online casino dat zich richt op de Nederlandse markt

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Bellmark Casino, a Curaçao online casino targeting the Dutch market, is legal, who supervises it, and about its Curaçao licensing structure and turnover. The minister declined the Curaçao questions as a matter for Curaçao and said the Dutch Gambling Authority is responsible for supervising foreign operators active in the Netherlands.
I cannot comment on these questions because they concern a country matter of Curaçao.
Ik kan mij over deze vragen niet uitlaten omdat het vragen zijn die een landsaangelegenheid van Curaçao betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Ulenbelt en Van Raak over riante beloning van de top van UWV

MPs Voortman, Ulenbelt and Van Raak asked why UWV top officials earn above the WNT pay cap, whether transitional rules and side jobs can be stopped, and whether the transitional arrangement should end. Minister Asscher answered that UWV complies with the WNT, that remaining above-cap pay is protected by transitional law and European property rights, and that side functions are permitted if done in own time.
UWV has informed me that it will enter into discussion with the non-top officials concerned about their remuneration relative to the WNT maximum.
UWV heeft mij laten weten met betrokken niet-topfunctionarissen het gesprek aan te gaan over hun bezoldiging in verhouding tot het vastgestelde bezoldigingsmaximum van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inmenging in de rechtszaak tegen Van Rey

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior why he tweeted about the ongoing criminal case against politician Van Rey, how this fits the separation of powers, whether he can rule out influence on the proceedings, and whether he would act similarly again. The minister replied only that he testified in court as a witness on 18 April 2016 and had nothing to add.
I have nothing to add to this testimony at this time.
Aan dit getuigenis heb ik op dit moment geen zaken toe te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een doodgeboren kindje niet wordt erkend

An SP MP asks why stillborn children cannot be recorded in the personal records database and whether the legal wording that a child stillborn is deemed never to have existed can be changed. The minister explains that stillborn children get a civil registry act but no BRP entry, promises research into registration options and forwards the wording question to the Minister of Justice and Security for advice.
Yes, I will investigate the possibilities for registration both within and outside the BRP.
Ja, ik ga onderzoek doen naar de mogelijkheden van registratie zowel binnen als buiten de BRP
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over inmenging in de rechtszaak tegen Van Rey

Opposition MP Van Raak asks why Minister Plasterk tweeted about the ongoing court case against politician Van Rey, how this fits with separation of powers, and whether he will answer by a set deadline. The minister declines to answer any further questions before appearing in court, as the court has invited him to testify.
Now that the court has decided to invite me, I will not answer any further questions in this case beforehand.
Nu de rechtbank heeft besloten mij uit te nodigen, beantwoord ik voordien geen nadere vragen in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Bosman over mogelijke betrokkenheid van KPMG bij (illegale) gokpraktijken op Curaçao en Sint Maarten

MPs Van Raak and Bosman asked about reports of illegal online sports betting on Curaçao, possible links to the US market, and KPMG's alleged role auditing casino owner Francesco Corallo on Sint Maarten. The minister replied that gambling oversight is primarily a local matter for the Public Prosecution Services, pointed to a 2015 protocol and the Bientu conviction, and declined to comment on individual companies.
The gambling world and the handling of possible abuses within it is primarily a local matter.
De gokwereld en de aanpak van mogelijke misstanden daarbinnen is primair een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de kosten van Koningsdag

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister why the municipality of Zwolle's Koningsdag 2016 costs of €920,000 were considered proportionate, who decides the programme and who pays, when Zwolle knew of its €595,000 share, and whether municipalities hosting the celebration would get financial support.
