The government answered that Zwolle sets and pays for the programme from its own budget, the council approved the budget on 21 March 2016, and a specific national subsidy does not fit the municipal fund system.
It is up to the municipality of Zwolle to determine which costs it incurs to organise this day.
Het is aan de gemeente Zwolle om te bepalen welke kosten deze maakt om deze dag te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het besluit van de gemeente Zutphen om geld voor het referendum aan andere dingen uit te geven

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether Zutphen municipality spent less than the full referendum budget on the referendum, whether this breaks the rules, and whether the minister raised the national referendum budget for municipalities from 20 to 30 million euro. The minister confirmed the increase, said municipalities decide how to spend the general fund allocation within existing rules, and stated that municipalities do not have to account to the national government for such spending, so no overview is available.
Municipalities do not have to account to the national government for how they spend funds from the municipal fund.
Gemeenten hoeven over de besteding van de middelen uit het gemeentefonds geen verantwoording af te leggen aan het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over ‘de stempassen van PostNL’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs why the government did not disclose during Question Time that PostNL, a printer of polling cards, had written voting advice on them, and pressed on municipal responsibility, referendum-commission warnings, and foreign observers. The minister answered that municipalities choose whether to use PostNL's offered flyer text and are responsible for it, that the Referendum Commission had asked municipalities to use its information, that the summary was not cause for alarm, and that ODIHR declined the invitation to send observers.
Municipalities do not print and send the polling cards themselves, but outsource this.
Gemeenten verzorgen het drukken en verzenden van de stempassen niet zelf, maar besteden dat uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de Groene Draeck

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister why the Kamer was allegedly misinformed for years about the true maintenance costs of the royal yacht Groene Draeck, why budgets were not realistic, why a second opinion is needed, and why the government appears to juggle figures on royal household costs. The government answered that the cost increase was disclosed in September 2015 and in the 2016 budget, that the 2015 Kersten report underpinned the raise, that a second opinion is underway and will be sent to the Kamer, and that the Algemene Rekenkamer found no material errors in royal household accounts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er aanhoudingen zijn gedaan bij de ontruiming van het gemeentehuis van Winterswijk

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister why the Winterswijk town hall was cleared during a protest, whether this fits with party group meetings, whether the clearance was justified, and whether care workers may protest over their pay conditions. The minister said the mayor ordered the clearance because protesters did not follow imposed conditions, that party group meetings are unaffected, that justification is for the mayor to assess and account for to the council, and that care workers may protest with conditions set by the mayor.
The assessment of whether this clearance was justified falls to the mayor concerned.
De beoordeling van de gerechtvaardigdheid van deze ontruiming komt toe aan de betrokken burgemeester.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de technocraten van het CPB het financiële lot van gemeentes bepalen

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether the CPB's budget projections for municipal cuts were reliable and whether municipalities would be compensated for a larger-than-expected cut of about 759 million euros. The minister answered that the cumulative downward revision is about 500 million, half from lower wage and price growth and half from extra cuts, that the CPB made no calculation error, and that no compensation is planned under the existing 'samen de trap op, samen de trap af' norm.
There is no question of erroneous calculations by the CPB.
Er is geen sprake van foutieve berekeningen van het CPB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de onderhoudskosten van de Gouden Koets en de Glazen Koets

An SP MP asked whether maintenance costs of the Gouden Koets and Glazen Koets are a state secret, for the pre-investigation and budget breakdowns, and whether the condition report on the Gouden Koets will be published. The Prime Minister answered that costs fall under Begroting I article 2 and are controlled via the budget and annual report with audits, but that detailed individual expenditure need not be made public under article 41 of the Constitution, and the Gouden Koets report will not be released.

The research report on the condition of the Gouden Koets cannot be provided because this would intrude on the constitutional authority of the King to organise his household, taking into account the public interest.

Het onderzoeksrapport naar de staat van de Gouden Koets kan niet worden verstrekt omdat dan getreden zou worden in de grondwettelijke bevoegdheid van de Koning om, met inachtneming van het openbaar belang, zijn Huis in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inzet van de burgemeester van Hilversum als 'steunzender' in het referendum

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether the mayor of Hilversum had been recruited as a 'supporter' of the government's referendum campaign without consent, and about similar outreach to other bodies, companies, unions and parties. The government replied that the list reported in the media was only the output of an internal brainstorm of possible opinion makers, not a record of agreements made, and that it says nothing about those people's views.
It is not an overview of people and organisations with whom agreements have been made.
Het is geen overzicht van mensen en organisaties waarmee afspraken zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inzet van de burgemeester van Hilversum als 'steunzender' in het referendum

An SP MP asked the government about the Hilversum mayor's reported role as a supporter in the government's 'yes' campaign for the Dutch referendum, about the timing of commitments and consultation, about other mayors involved, and about whether fewer polling stations in municipalities were part of the campaign. The minister said the list of named people was merely an internal brainstorm of possible opinion-makers, not agreed commitments, and that polling station numbers are a municipal responsibility.

The list of persons and organisations that appeared in the media is nothing more than the result of an internal brainstorm at working level about possible opinion-makers who could get involved in the debate.

De lijst van personen en organisaties die in de media terecht is gekomen is niets meer dan het resultaat van een interne brainstorm op werkniveau over mogelijke opiniemakers die zich in het debat zouden kunnen mengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat de Al Fitrah-moskee dubieus geld heeft ontvangen

MPs Karabulut and Van Raak asked whether the Al Fitrah mosque's funding from Kuwait, including ties to an entity once on a US sanctions list, was checked by intelligence and tax authorities, what the municipality knew, and what action the government would take. The minister declined to comment on the specific case, said the municipality had known of the Kuwaiti funding since 2014, and deferred the mosque-funding question to a forthcoming letter on salafism.
In general, I do not make statements about specific cases.
In zijn algemeenheid doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over ‘het tekort aan stembureaus’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why fewer polling stations were set up for the Ukraine referendum in some municipalities, whether villages lost their stations, and why municipalities were not funded to keep all regular polling places. The minister said municipalities decide on polling stations, that some reversed cuts after council pressure, that no national overview exists, and that the government added up to 10 million euros, with the evaluation of the referendum to address accessibility.
I do not have a national overview of the number of polling stations that municipalities will set up for the upcoming referendum.
Ik beschik niet over een landelijk overzicht van het aantal stembureaus dat gemeenten voor het aanstaande referendum zullen inrichten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de sluiting van stembureaus voor het komende referendum over Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether reduced polling station numbers for the Ukraine referendum in several municipalities had been reversed, and for full figures per municipality and any cost compensation. The minister said polling station designation is a municipal council matter, referred back to his earlier answers on the same points, and gave no new figures.
As long as I have no indications to the contrary, it is not for me to have views on the decision-making process on this matter at local level.
Zolang ik geen aanwijzingen heb voor het tegendeel, is het niet aan mij om opvattingen te hebben over het besluitvormingsproces ter zake op lokaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een politiek onderzoek in Nederland door de Amerikaanse geheime dienst

The SP MP asked whether the Dutch government shares the US intelligence view that Russia orchestrated the Ukraine association referendum and Corbyn's Labour election, and how the US had informed the government of a political investigation in the Netherlands. The minister denied both claims, said the press article does not show them, and stated that foreign intelligence services may not operate in the Netherlands without government permission while declining to comment publicly on any Dutch intelligence investigations.
It is well known to the American intelligence services that it is not permitted to carry out intelligence operations in the Netherlands without the permission of the Dutch government.
Het is de Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten genoegzaam bekend dat het niet toegestaan is inlichtingenoperaties in Nederland uit te voeren zonder toestemming van de Nederlandse regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Van Raak over het bericht dat er ruim zes ton is betaald aan een ex-topman van een woningcorporatie

MPs Bashir and Van Raak asked the ministers about reports that a former housing corporation executive received over six hundred thousand euros, and whether this was a sham consultancy arrangement harming tenants. The minister replied that the severance was allowed under a court ruling, that no sham arrangement was found since a real change of board occurred, and that the government will consider WNT extension and tackle such constructions in the evaluation process.

A sham construction exists when a top executive of an organisation falling under the WNT changes function and in name no longer acts as executive but de facto still leads the organisation, in order to obtain a higher salary than allowed.

Van een schijnconstructie is sprake als een topbestuurder van een organisatie die onder de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) valt, van functie wisselt en in naam niet meer als bestuurder optreedt maar de facto nog steeds leiding geeft aan de organisatie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een wethouder die zijn inkomen aanvult met wachtgeld

An SP MP asked why a Albrandswaard alderman supplements his part-time salary with transitional allowance (wachtgeld), and whether the law allows this and could be changed. The minister replied that this is a legal consequence of the Appa offset rules, intended by the legislature in 2001, that the municipality is responsible for applying, and that he has no power to annul the municipal decision.
The application of the Appa for aldermen is a municipal responsibility.
De toepassing van de Appa voor wethouders is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het misbruik dat DUO maakt van de Roemernorm

MP Van Raak asked whether DUO's handling of the Roemer norm (capping external staffing at 10% of personnel costs) was a pretext to send temporary agency workers home while keeping expensive top consultants, and how the minister would intervene. The minister denied any such intent, explained that DUO cut 18 external advisers and limited agency rostering for December due to seasonal patterns and leave, and stated that DUO treats agency workers as valued staff.
That is not the case. In enforcing the Roemer norm at DUO, all categories of external staff were examined.
Daarvan is geen sprake. Bij de handhaving van de Roemernorm door DUO is naar alle categorieën externen gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over flexwerkers in dienst bij DUO, het UWV en de Belastingdienst

MP Van Raak asked about the share of temporary agency workers at DUO, UWV and the Belastingdienst, including call centre staff, and whether they receive the same conditions as permanent staff. Minister Blok answered with percentages and conversion figures, explained the inlenersbeloning principle, and said a flexpool for call centre staff is not appropriate.
Obtaining the information needed to answer the questions took some time and made it impossible to send the answers to the House before the plenary debate on the 2016 Interior budget.

Het verkrijgen van de benodigde informatie voor beantwoording van de vragen vergde enige tijd en maakte het niet mogelijk de antwoorden aan uw Kamer te sturen voor de plenaire behandeling van de begroting 2016 van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over mogelijke integriteitsschendingen op Aruba, in het bijzonder rondom een aanbesteding voor een ziektekostenverzekering voor Arubaanse studenten in Nederland

The MP asks whether the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations shares concerns about possible integrity violations on Aruba in a tender for health insurance for Aruban students in the Netherlands, citing a 2015 Aruban court ruling questioning the insurer's capacity and the conduct of the responsible minister's circle, and asks why no investigation is planned. The minister answers that the matter is an Aruban autonomous affair outside Article 3 of the Statute, that the ruling was a provisional summary-proceedings judgment, and that any suspicion of crimes is for the Aruban Public Prosecution Service.
The underlying matter (the conduct of the tender for health insurance for Aruban students in the Netherlands) is not named in Article 3 of the Statute as a Kingdom affair.
De onderliggende aangelegenheid (de gang van zaken rondom de aanbesteding voor een ziektekostenverzekering voor Arubaanse studenten in Nederland) wordt niet genoemd in artikel 3 van het Statuut
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Van Raak over de extra kosten bij de verbouwing van Huis ten Bosch

MPs Pechtold and Van Raak asked why the renovation of Huis ten Bosch cost almost double the earlier estimate and whether the cost figure would hold. The minister said the higher cost reflects detailed technical research and a higher per-square-metre price, and that the budget of 59 million euros is binding, with the requested documents partly released under the Wob.
For security reasons, among others, part of the information could not be made public.
Om onder meer veiligheidsredenen kon een deel van de informatie niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de afwezigheid van de gevolmachtigde minister van Curaçao bij de Troonrede

MP Van Raak (SP) asked the Prime Minister why Curaçao's authorised minister was absent from the Speech from the Throne and when the Curaçao government informed the government of this absence. The Prime Minister answered that the minister was accompanying Curaçao's Prime Minister on a working visit to Milan and Rome, notified the government by letter of 8 September, and was replaced by a deputy so that Curaçao was represented.
The authorised Minister of Curaçao accompanied the Prime Minister of her country on a working visit to Milan and Rome from 14 to 17 September 2015.
De gevolmachtigde Minister van Curaçao vergezelde de Minister-President van haar land bij een werkbezoek aan Milaan en Rome van 14 tot en met 17 september 2015.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Raak over een reis van de top van het ministerie naar Curaçao

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations for the precise costs of a trip by the top of the Kingdom Relations directorate to Curaçao, broken down by cost type and average per participant. The Minister answered with total costs of €56,326.75 for 54 participants (about €1,043 per person), itemised by travel, accommodation and programme costs, with a supporting table.
The costs of this trip for 54 participants are: – travel costs €21,992.31 – accommodation costs (lodging and meals) €27,810.53 – programme costs €6,593.91 Total costs €56,326.75
De kosten van deze reis voor 54 deelnemers zijn: – reiskosten € 21.992,31 – verblijfskosten (logies en voeding) € 27.810,53 – programmakosten € 6.593,91 Totale kosten € 56.326,75
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar lekken

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether there were concrete indications that Prinsjesdag budget plans had leaked from ministries, whether he supported a criminal investigation into the leaks proposed by a minister, and when it would start. The government replied that a criminal investigation into leaks can be ordered but that the circle of people with access may be so broad that an investigation would be costly and fruitless, so no investigation is requested.
In this case, therefore, no criminal investigation is requested.
In dit geval wordt daarom niet verzocht om een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het watertekort op Saba

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a water shortage on Saba, high water prices, threats to businesses and tourism, and whether the navy would again supply water. The minister answered that the government and the island authority are working on storage and supply upgrades, that navy assistance would be considered only if a formal request came, and that no such emergency exists currently.
Since 2012 the cabinet has worked with the Saba island executive on both temporary measures and more structural solutions to the water problem during severe drought.
Het kabinet werkt sinds 2012 samen met het bestuurscollege van Saba om zowel tijdelijke maatregelen als meer structurele oplossingen voor het waterprobleem in tijden van grote droogte te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het lekken van de plannen voor Prinsjesdag

An MP asks the Prime Minister about leaks of the Prinsjesdag budget plans, the embargo, possible penalties and whether a leak complaint was filed. The government says it will not comment on the accuracy of the leaks, no complaint has been filed, and there are no concrete indications that ministers or officials leaked confidential information.
The cabinet has no concrete indications that confidential information was leaked by ministers or officials.
Het kabinet heeft geen concrete aanwijzingen dat vertrouwelijke informatie door bewindspersonen of ambtenaren is gelekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het weigeren van nabestaanden bij een begrafenis

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether relatives should always be able to attend a funeral, whether municipalities may refuse relatives who cannot pay, and what rules govern municipal funerals. The minister replied that relatives should in principle be able to attend, that municipalities may recover costs from the estate or obligated relatives, and that the matter is a municipal responsibility under local autonomy.
This is otherwise not a matter of concern for the national government.
Dit is verder geen voorwerp van zorg voor het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de gemeente Haarlemmerliede en Spaarnwoude zichzelf in de verkoop zet

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipal cuts and decentralisations are forcing Haarlemmerliede en Spaarnwoude to seek merger with neighbouring municipalities, and whether the government will help solve its financial problems. The minister replied that the municipal council decides on mergers and budgets, that no municipalities are known to have run into financial trouble from the recent task transfers, and that the province, not the ministry, judges compliance with the balanced-budget rule.
It is primarily for the municipal executive, and not for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, to judge whether administrative independence is desirable.
Het is primair aan het gemeentebestuur en niet aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om te oordelen over de wenselijkheid van bestuurlijke zelfstandigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de integriteit van een lobbyist

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether former minister Bot, lobbying the Public Prosecution Service in a criminal case involving a Libyan businessman, gave the appearance of seeking a favour, whether he should have disclosed himself as a lobbyist, and what measures will ensure lobbyists disclose themselves and whether mandatory membership of a trade association would help. The minister declined to comment on the specific case given the prosecution's independence, said former office-holders should be mindful of their position, and said he would look at transparency options but considered mandatory disclosure hard to enforce and mandatory membership not a solution.
Given the independent position of the Public Prosecution Service, I do not consider it appropriate to enter into this specific case.
Gelet op de onafhankelijke positie van het Openbaar Ministerie acht ik het niet passend om in deze specifieke casus te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat er drie ultraorthodoxe sjeiks uit België in Utrecht komen spreken

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that three ultra-orthodox Islamic preachers from Belgium would speak in Utrecht, including whether a preacher had a criminal conviction, the visa status of speakers, the foundation alFitrah's role and its recognition as a training company, and its subsidies and ANBI status. The government answered that free speech is protected and the event was not licensable, that the preacher named was not present and visa/criminal information could not be checked under the Schengen rules, that alFitrah is recognised as a training company only by the vocational education centre and the placement is being reassessed, and that the foundation received no subsidies and has no ANBI status.
Requesting this information is only possible insofar as it is in the interest of combating future criminal offences
Het opvragen van deze informatie kan alleen voor zover dat in het belang is ter bestrijding van toekomstige strafbare feiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de uitspraken van het hoofd van de AIVD over Edward Snowden

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the AIVD director-general's remarks calling Snowden's claims 'absolute bullshit', possible AIVD help to the NSA, the 'Nine Eyes' relationship, whether the AIVD isolates Snowden, and why he is not granted asylum. The Minister refused to discuss the AIVD's cooperation with foreign services in public, referred to earlier CTIVD reports finding no systematic unlawful data acquisition, denied any strategy to isolate Snowden, and explained that an asylum request can only be made in person in the Netherlands, so Snowden's request could not be treated as an asylum application.
No public statements can be made about how cooperation between Dutch and foreign services is arranged.
Over de invulling van de samenwerking tussen Nederlandse en buitenlandse diensten kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de kosten voor promotiecampagnes van de waterschappen

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister why water boards spend very different amounts on promotional campaigns for their elections, whether the national government steers this, which budget lines fund it, and whether such campaigns are worth the roughly 4 million euros spent. The minister answered that each water board decides its own campaign and budget under its autonomous powers, that the costs come from a separately approved elections budget line, and that the effects are not yet known pending an evaluation.
The national government does not steer this, given the water boards' autonomous powers of regulation and administration.
De landelijke overheid voert hier geen regie op gelet op de autonome bevoegdheid van de waterschappen tot regeling en bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over foto's van Shabir Burhani waarop hij met wapens poseert

An SP MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers how the state acts against radicalised people photographed with weapons, including Shabir Burhani, and whether training with the Taliban and a statement endorsing the Charlie Hebdo attack constitute a threat. The Justice Minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to general criminal provisions and the Integrated Jihadism Action Programme, and said whether the statement is a threat is for the courts to decide.
As stated, I cannot make any statements about investigations into individual cases.
Zoals gemeld kan ik over onderzoek naar individuele zaken geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de nauwe banden op Curaçao tussen het bestuur en de (illegale) gokindustrie

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about close ties on Curaçao between the government and the illegal gambling industry, including criminal investigations, party funding and KPMG's role with the state telecom firm, and about the government's responsibility. The minister answered that law enforcement, including supervision of gambling, is an autonomous matter of Curaçao and that Curaçao's prosecution priorities show it takes responsibility, without addressing the specific questions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inhuur van externe voorzitters door de gemeente Dordrecht

An SP MP asked why Dordrecht hired external 'gespreksleiders' to chair council committee meetings, what they cost, and whether the minister would reverse the decision as contrary to the law. The minister agreed the arrangement is de facto chairing contrary to the spirit of the law, said the municipality must comply, and reported he had already asked the council to bring the arrangement in line with the law after receiving a request for annulment.

I have already received a request for annulment from several council members (factions) in Dordrecht. In response, I have written to the municipal council requesting that the arrangement for chairing the council committees be brought into line with the law.

Ik heb reeds een verzoek om vernietiging ontvangen, afkomstig van enkele raadsleden (fracties) uit Dordrecht. In reactie daarop heb ik de gemeenteraad aangeschreven met het verzoek de invulling van het voorzitterschap van de raadscommissies in overeenstemming met de wet te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de gemeente Dronten, die ‘vergat’ de premies voor de WAO en de WIA af te dragen voor haar personeel

MP Van Raak asked why the municipality of Dronten failed for years to remit mandatory WAO/WIA social premiums for its staff, why internal controls and Belastingdienst supervision did not catch it, and which other municipalities were affected. The minister replied that the matter falls within municipal autonomy and is accounted for to the municipal council, that the error dates from July 2011 and appears to be an isolated human error, and that the Belastingdienst is investigating whether broader action is needed but cannot disclose specifics.
This matter falls within the autonomy and own responsibility of the municipality and its internal bodies.
Deze kwestie behoort tot de autonomie en eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente en haar interne organen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het pleidooi van de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten dat er een rechterlijke toets vooraf moet gaan aan het onderscheppen van telefoongesprekken en e-mails tussen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about the Dutch Bar Association's call for prior judicial review before intelligence services may intercept lawyer-client communications, and about the CTIVD finding that the AIVD wrongly processed some such conversations. The minister answered that protections for lawyers are sufficient, that the CTIVD found the AIVD's safeguards adequate, and that no prior judicial review is needed, while refusing to extend a judicial-review requirement from journalists to lawyers.
In view of the above, I see no need to introduce the proposed judicial review in this context.
Gelet op het bovenstaande zie ik geen noodzaak tot het voorgestelde invoeren van een rechterlijke toets in dit kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de nauwe banden op Curaçao tussen het bestuur en de (illegale) gokindustrie

An SP MP asked the Dutch ministers about the scale of legal and illegal gambling on Curaçao, alleged money laundering, weak oversight by the Gaming Control Board and the lottery foundation, possible party financing from the gambling industry, and whether the Kingdom will investigate party financing. The minister answered that gambling oversight and law enforcement are autonomous matters of Curaçao, that the Curaçao Public Prosecution Service handles money laundering suspicions, and that the Duradero project with Curaçao strengthens enforcement capacity.
Supervision of casinos and lotteries is an autonomous matter of the Country of Curaçao.
Toezicht op casino's en loterijen is een autonome aangelegenheid van het Land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de geheime dienst van Curaçao

The MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the acquittal of a former Curaçao security service head, the appointment and vetting of his successor, the theft of VDC data, AIVD information exposure, and whether the CTIVD would investigate. The minister declined to judge court rulings or Curaçao government decisions, neither confirmed nor discussed AIVD cooperation, and said the CTIVD lacks the legal basis, pointing to Curaçao's own oversight commission.
The CTIVD does not have the legal basis necessary to conduct an investigation into the VDC.
De CTIVD beschikt niet over de wettelijke basis die nodig is om onderzoek naar de VDC te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de uitlatingen van Snowden over Nederland en de NSA

An MP asked why Snowden's asylum request was not processed, how the government views claims that Dutch intelligence services are subordinate to US services, why promised new cooperation criteria with the US have not appeared, and whether intelligence services should cooperate on equal terms. The government answered that asylum cannot be applied for abroad under the Vreemdelingenwet, that the Wiv 2002 and CTIVD oversight govern cooperation, that new criteria are being addressed in a planned Wiv amendment, and that it agrees services should not be a proxy for foreign services.
On the content of those talks we can only inform the House through the appropriate channels.
Over de inhoud van die gesprekken kunnen wij de Tweede Kamer alleen via de daartoe geëigende kanalen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het afluisteren van journalisten

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether Dutch journalists or researchers could have been intercepted by British intelligence, how the Dutch procedure for surveillance of journalists works, and whether such surveillance has occurred in the past 25 years. The minister said interception cannot be excluded, that intelligence services do not disclose working methods, and described the legal framework and the pending amendment requiring judicial approval for surveillance aimed at journalistic sources, without giving concrete cases.
Pending the legislative amendment, in practice the government is working in accordance with the ECHR ruling.
In afwachting van de wetswijziging wordt in de praktijk gewerkt in overeenstemming met de uitspraak van het EHRM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het stopzetten van een project voor sociale huurwoningen op Sint Eustatius

An MP asked whether the minister shares enthusiasm for housing corporation Woonlinie's social rental projects on Saba and Sint Eustatius, why the Statia island government withdrew from agreements, and whether discrimination, fraud or cronyism should be investigated. The minister praised Woonlinie's commitment, explained that the Statia island executive unilaterally put the agreed renovation and reorganisation cooperation on hold, and said the Eilandsraad is primarily responsible for questioning the executive, without announcing an investigation.
In the first instance, it is up to the Island Council to question the Sint Eustatius executive about the motives for its conduct.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de Eilandsraad om het bestuur van Sint Eustatius te bevragen op de motieven voor zijn handelwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Gesthuizen en Van Raak over het ontbreken van een geboortedatum op verblijfsdocumenten en in de basisregistratie personen

Four SP MPs asked why residence documents and the BRP carry placeholder birth dates such as 00-00 and whether a single fictitious date would be adopted. The minister acknowledged the problem, said Wet BRP article 2.17 now takes the fictitious date from the Justice Minister, and declined to retroactively assign dates to existing cases because of the consequences for acquired rights.
It was therefore decided, when article 2.17 of the Wet BRP was drafted, not to make such an arrangement for these existing cases.
Er is daarom bij de totstandkoming van artikel 2.17 Wet BRP besloten af te zien van het treffen van een dergelijke regeling voor deze bestaande gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat jihadist Jermaine W. een onderwijsorganisatie leidde

Two MPs asked whether a jihadist who reportedly left for Syria led an education foundation despite surveillance, whether extremist teachers are allowed to teach children, and whether such foundations receive subsidies or foreign funding and should be inspected. The government said it cannot comment on individual investigations, that private unrecognised education falls outside the Inspectorate's supervision, that foreign funding is not illegal, and that it will push for more transparency under its anti-jihadism action programme.
That does not alter the fact that we will intervene when there are signs of practices that are not acceptable.
Dat neemt niet weg dat wij zullen ingrijpen wanneer er tekenen zijn van praktijken die niet door de beugel kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de huisvesting van de belastingdienst in Tilburg

An MP asked why the Defence building in Tilburg was ruled out for Tax Authority offices, given the municipality disputes that talks took place, and why extra rented space is kept open in Eindhoven and Breda while a state-owned building is available in Tilburg. The minister says no match with demand existed at the time, that Defence was consulted, and that Tilburg options will be reviewed in the masterplan update, though current Eindhoven and Breda plans are defended on efficiency grounds.
In the meantime, the alderman for Economic Affairs has been informed that the possibilities of the central government in Tilburg will be examined again during the update of the masterplans.
Inmiddels is aan de wethouder van Economische Zaken toegelicht dat de mogelijkheden van de rijksoverheid in Tilburg nogmaals zullen worden bekeken bij de actualisering van de masterplannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het inperken van het verzekerd pakket in Caribisch Nederland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the insured benefits in Caribbean Netherlands would be cut to match the European Netherlands from 1 January 2015, including the loss of physiotherapy coverage, and whether this is justified given socio-economic conditions. The minister confirmed the scaling-back of physiotherapy coverage, stated that the Statute allows differing rules, and rejected concerns about the viability of physiotherapy and the appropriateness of the measure.
I do not share that view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het terugvorderen van decoraties

An SP MP asked why a motion calling for no active recovery of honours from deceased recipients's heirs has not been implemented, and how the government will ensure heirs are not pressured to return decorations. The minister replies that the settled practice (spontaneous or polite-reminder return, a year's grace, no active collection of deposits) already reflects the motion, which the Chamber had supported.
The starting point remains that heirs are asked to return the honour, if desired only after a year.
Uitgangspunt blijft dat van nabestaanden wordt gevraagd het onderscheidingsteken terug te sturen, desgewenst pas na een jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de relatie tussen prins Bernhard en de geheime diensten

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether Prince Bernhard ordered the BVD in 1995 to provide information on a US intelligence file about him, what other orders he gave, whether he informed the PM, and whether the CTIVD should investigate his contacts with security services. The government answered that Bernhard was not a commissioning party of the BVD or other services, that the services acted within legal frameworks, and that a parliamentary motion for an investigation was rejected in December 2013.
The late Prince Bernhard was not a commissioning party of the BVD or other secret services.
Wijlen prins Bernhard was geen opdrachtgever van de BVD of andere geheime diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het functioneren van de gevolmachtigde minister van Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister which law says he cannot have a good conversation with the Curaçao plenipotentiary minister about her performance, and why he fears that conversation. The Prime Minister replied that his earlier answer contained no suggestion or fear, only a reference to advisory opinion from the Council of State.
The answer to earlier questions contains no suggestions or fear, but a reference to the advisory opinion of the Council of State's Advisory Division.
De beantwoording van eerdere vragen bevat geen suggesties of angst maar een verwijzing naar de voorlichting van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Raak over het bericht ‘Curaçao: De bokkensprongen van Marvelyne Wiels’

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether he would hold a good talk with the Curaçao plenipotentiary minister after a media report about the conduct of Marvelyne Wiels. The Prime Minister replied that media reports do not change the constitutional relationship between the plenipotentiary minister and the Curaçao government, referring to a Council of State advisory opinion.
Media reporting does not change the constitutional relationship between the plenipotentiary minister and the government of the country concerned.
Berichtgeving in de media brengt geen wijziging in de staatkundige verhouding tussen de gevolmachtigde Minister en de regering van het betreffende land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het niet vervolgen van massale verkiezingsfraude op Sint Maarten

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a court's 'class justice' finding about unprosecuted vote-buying on Sint Maarten, allegations about a party leader's donations and his re-election, and concern about the lack of investigation were justified. The Minister declined to comment on court rulings and on the unverified allegations, noting that vote-buying is a rule-of-law concern for the Kingdom.
It is not for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to comment on court rulings and judgments.
Het is niet aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om gerechtelijke uitspraken en vonnissen van commentaar te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het tekort aan wijkagenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether there is a shortage of neighbourhood police officers (wijkagenten) in many Dutch cities, and for regional figures. The minister denied a widespread shortage, gave regional numbers (3,444 active against 3,413 planned), and said filling open vacancies is subject to agreed personnel-reorganisation rules.
No, it is not correct that there are too few neighbourhood police officers in many cities in the Netherlands.
Nee, het klopt niet dat er in veel steden in Nederland te weinig wijkagenten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het uitblijven van de rechtszaak tegen een parlementariër op Sint Maarten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the delayed prosecution of parliamentarian Patrick Illidge on Sint Maarten (bribery, facilitating prostitution, illegal weapons) undermines public trust, whether the case is serious enough to be prioritised, whether other politicians were heard as suspects, and whether Illidge could claim the generous severance scheme after elections. The Minister answered that it is not for him to judge the timing of Sint Maarten prosecutions, that he has no information on who was heard as suspects, and that the severance question is for the competent authority on Sint Maarten.

It is not for me as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to judge the period within which criminal cases in Sint Maarten are handled by the Public Prosecution Service and the Joint Court of Justice

Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om een oordeel te vellen over de termijn waarop strafzaken in Sint Maarten door het OM en het Gemeenschappelijk Hof worden afgedaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over botresten op de begraafplaats in Bladel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether it is unacceptable that visitors to the Bladel cemetery were confronted with bone remains, whether this violates the dignity of the dead, and why the cemetery did not follow the national handbook on exhumation and clearance. The minister agreed visitors should not encounter remains, said clearance must be done respectfully, and explained that cemetery managers decide on clearance and methods.
In principle it is up to the manager of a cemetery, municipal or private, to decide whether graves are cleared and, if so, which method is used.
Het is in beginsel aan de beheerder van een begraafplaats, gemeentelijk dan wel bijzonder, om te bepalen of graven worden geruimd en zo ja welke werkwijze daarbij wordt gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het Ontwerpbesluit tot wijziging van het Besluit personenvervoer 2000 en andere besluiten in verband met de Wet afschaffing plusregio’s

MP Van Raak asked why the draft decree implementing the abolition of the plusregio's was submitted for consultation during the summer recess, whether this conflicts with the rules on consultation periods, and why it was not postponed until the Senate had dealt with the underlying bill. The Staatssecretary answered that the consultation period was extended to 30 September 2014 under the rules for recesses, that the earlier letter is supplemented rather than withdrawn, and that the draft could be submitted before the Senate finished the bill because the delegation scope is fixed once the House has adopted it.
The letter of 14 July 2014 is supplemented with this letter and not withdrawn.
De brief van 14 juli 2014 wordt met deze brief aangevuld en niet ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over Amerikaanse spionage

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the government shares the German Chancellor's view that US espionage breaks trust, which spying cases since 1945 are known, whether US spies were expelled, whether Dutch parliament was spied on, and whether the US embassy near the Binnenhof should be closed. The minister declined to judge the German-US relationship, said the AIVD investigates foreign espionage but will not publicly disclose results, found no indication of spying on the Tweede Kamer, and refused to close the embassy.
No statements can be made publicly about the content and results of this investigation.
Over de inhoud en de resultaten van dit onderzoek kunnen in de openbaarheid geen uitspraken worden gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de motie waarin de Eilandsraad van Sint Eustatius unaniem uitspreekt geen vertrouwen te hebben in de nieuw benoemde rijksvertegenwoordiger voor Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would respond to a unanimous Sint Eustatius island council motion expressing no confidence in the newly appointed Rijksvertegenwoordiger, and whether the consultation procedure had been followed. The Minister regretted the council's doubts, stated that the island councils had no formal role under the WOLBES appointment procedure (only the island executives were consulted), and said the procedure was carefully followed and the new representative would take office on 1 September 2014.
For the island councils, the WOLBES does not provide a role in the appointment procedure.
Voor de eilandsraden is in de WOLBES geen rol weggelegd in de benoemingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over bespioneren van Nederlanders door de NSA

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of the Interior whether US section 702 of FISA allows the NSA to collect communications of non-Americans abroad, whether Dutch citizens are being spied on, and what the government will do to protect Dutch privacy, including whether the AIVD uses PRISM-derived or GCHQ-style methods. The Minister answered that the NSA reports the Netherlands is not a target but certainty cannot be given, that the AIVD and MIVD monitor foreign intelligence activity, that concerns were raised with the US and European norms are being negotiated, and that the CTIVD found no structural unlawful acquisition of data by the AIVD.
The AIVD and MIVD also conduct structural research into intelligence activities of foreign powers in the Netherlands and against Dutch interests.
De AIVD en MIVD verrichten daarnaast structureel onderzoek naar inlichtingenactiviteiten van buitenlandse mogendheden in Nederland en tegen Nederlandse belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de asielaanvraag van klokkenluider Snowden

MP Van Raak asked why whistleblower Snowden received no reply to his asylum request in the Netherlands, why the Chamber was not informed about it, and whether the request will be processed. The State Secretary answered that a Dutch asylum request can only be filed in person in the Netherlands, so it was not treated as an asylum application, that there is no practice of proactively informing the Chamber about individual protection requests, and that the request will not be taken up.
There is no practice whereby the cabinet proactively informs the Chamber about individual protection requests.
Er bestaat geen praktijk waarbij het kabinet de Kamer proactief informeert over individuele beschermingsverzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de bewoners van Oudenhoorn kiezen voor Hellevoetsluis

MP Van Raak asked whether residents of Oudenhoorn choosing to join Hellevoetsluis should be respected and why Bernisse has not started a boundary correction. Minister Plasterk answered that Bernisse and Spijkenisse deliberately excluded the correction from the merger procedure, that a correction can only follow identical council decisions by Nissewaard and Hellevoetsluis (earliest 1 January 2016), and that it is not for the minister to bring it about.
In this case it is not for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to bring about a boundary correction.
Het is in dit geval niet aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om een grenscorrectie te bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over mogelijke bedreiging en poging tot omkoping van een eilandsraadslid op Bonaire

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether an investigation would follow the complaint by Bonaire island councillor Santana about threats with a revolver and an alleged 120,000-dollar bribe offer aimed at toppling the executive, and whether politicians' financing and his safety would be examined. The Minister replied that police found insufficient support for the threat complaint, the Public Prosecution Service saw no indication for a bribery investigation or other financial links to politicians, and protection of local officials is a local responsibility, while declining to discuss security measures taken.
The Public Prosecution Service has no other signals of possible criminal financial transactions or services by the named person in relation to politicians or political parties.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft geen andere signalen van mogelijk strafbare financiële transacties of dienstverlening door de genoemde persoon in relatie tot politici of politieke partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Raak over de uitkering voor voormalig politici

MPs Ulenbelt and Van Raak asked the Minister of the Interior about the Appa pension benefit for former political office holders, covering numbers, regional differences, re-employment times, job-search exemptions, total payments, and enforcement of the job-search obligation. Minister Plasterk answered that much of the data is held decentrally or is not broken down as requested, gave central-contract figures for 2011–2013, and said evaluations are forthcoming.
The Ministry of the Interior does not keep track of how many Appa benefits there are at provinces, municipalities and/or water boards.
Het Ministerie van BZK houdt niet bij hoeveel Appa-uitkeringen er zijn bij provincies, gemeenten en/of waterschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de onwil van de gemeente Amsterdam om duidelijkheid te geven over de inhuur van externen

MP Van Raak asked the Interior Minister why Amsterdam will not clarify its spending on expensive external hires, whether accounting tricks hide it, and whether medeoverheden should adopt the Roemer norm and cut external staffing. The minister replied that Amsterdam's spending is an internal matter for the municipal council, that BBV rules are transparent, and that medeoverheden are autonomous and responsible for their own cuts and staffing choices.
For this reason, the central government does not keep figures on external hiring.
Om deze reden houdt het Rijk geen cijfers bij over externe inhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat diverse wethouders in Helmond, Asten, Gemert-Bakel en Eersel het inkomen aanvullen met wachtgeld

MP Van Raak asked whether wethouders in four municipalities who took part-time posts topping up their income with wachtgeld (Appa benefits) was acceptable, which municipalities use this, and how the perceived gap would be closed. Minister Plasterk answered that there is no top-up but a consequence of the Appa offsetting rules, that the 2001 amendment deliberately allowed this, that the government does not track cases, and that no legal gap exists.
The Ministry of BZK does not keep such data.
Het Ministerie van BZK houdt dergelijke gegevens niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over misstanden bij crematies

MP Van Raak asked whether incomplete cremation and mixing of ashes at a commercial crematorium was acceptable, why the public prosecutor's investigation relied on the company and paper checks, and whether this related to an earlier case. The minister replied that the OM investigated, heard witnesses and gas data, found no suspected crime, and that the NRC case is unrelated to the earlier column.
The public prosecution service (OM) did in fact launch an investigation following the report that incomplete combustion and mixing of ash remains had occurred at crematorium Maaslanden.

Door het openbaar ministerie (OM) is naar aanleiding van de melding dat er bij crematorium Maaslanden sprake zou zijn van onvolledige verbranding en vermenging van asresten wel degelijk een onderzoek ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw en het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat ‘de marechaussee niet wilde dat Brenno de Winter over NSS-top schreef’

MPs Schouw and Van Raak asked the ministers about reports that military police wanted to stop journalist Brenno de Winter from writing about the NSS summit, including why journalists are observed and registered in public space and whether this restricts press freedom. The minister denied any policy of observing or registering journalists, said registration rests on the Politiewet 2012 and Wet Politiegegevens, and said no measures were taken to restrict investigative journalism.
It is therefore not police policy to observe and register journalists in public space.
Het is dan ook geen beleid bij de politie om journalisten in de publieke ruimte te observeren en te registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inzet van onbevoegd personeel op Schiphol tijdens de nucleaire top (NSS)

An MP asked whether temporary agency workers without standard screening or Schiphol passes were deployed airside at Aviapartner Cargo during the nuclear security summit, and whether this amounted to strike-breaking. The minister answered that the Royal Marechaussee found all agency workers were screened and held passes, that the ban on strike-breaking applies to all employers, and that the Inspectie SZW investigation into possible strike-breaking was still ongoing.
The Inspectorate SZW supervises the Waadi (the Act on the allocation of labour through intermediaries).
De Inspectie SZW houdt toezicht op de Waadi (de Wet allocatie arbeidskrachten door intermediairs).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak en Sjoerdsma (D66) over het bericht dat Nederlandse data mogelijk zijn gebruikt bij drone-aanvallen

MPs from SP and D66 asked whether Dutch intelligence from MIVD, shared for antipiracy operations off Somalia, may have been used for US drone targeted killings, and about the legal basis and data-sharing arrangements with the US. The government answered that it does not work with illegal targeted killings, cannot confirm or deny the specifics of partner use or the number of drone strikes, will not comment publicly on NSA or partner-service cooperation, and sees no indication that the shared intelligence was used in breach of international law.

If it were shown that a foreign partner demonstrably carries out illegal targeted killings for which Dutch information is also used, this will lead to a renewed assessment of whether such intelligence is shared with that partner.

Als zou blijken dat een buitenlandse partner aantoonbaar illegale targeted killings uitvoert, waarvoor ook Nederlandse informatie wordt gebruikt, zal dit leiden tot het opnieuw beoordelen van de vraag of dergelijke inlichtingen met die partner worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het afluisteren door de NSA van alle telefoonnummers in een land

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of the Interior whether the government knew of the NSA's MYSTIC program, which reportedly recorded all phone calls in a country, and whether Dutch citizens, telecom providers or Dutch intelligence services were involved. The minister answered that the cabinet is not aware of a program under that name and has no indications that Dutch citizens were targeted, and agreed to answer before the plenary debate.
The cabinet is not aware of an NSA program under the name Mystic.
Het kabinet is niet op de hoogte van een NSA-programma onder de naam Mystic.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Raak over het bericht dat staatsraden nevenfuncties hebben bij loterijen

MPs Schouw and Van Raak asked whether two Council of State councillors holding side positions at lottery organisations, and councillors with close ties to lottery bodies in the advising section, create a conflict of interest and undermine the Council's advisory authority. Minister Plasterk answered that the side positions are public, no councillors with lottery ties sit in the section handling the online gambling bill, and that appointments are vetted under the Council of State Act and recusal rules.
In the section of the Advisory Division currently handling the bill amending the Betting and Gaming Act, there are no councillors with side positions at lottery organisations.

In de sectie van de Afdeling advisering die momenteel het voorstel van wet tot wijziging van de Wet op de kansspelen ... in behandeling heeft, zitten geen staatsraden met nevenfuncties in loterijorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een ernstige misstand bij het ruimen van een graf

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a reported grave-clearance error in which a second, male set of remains was cremated with a woman's body, and whether the Handleiding opgraven en ruimen should be made mandatory. The minister said the facts are still being investigated and a fuller reply will follow by mid-May, and declined to make the handbook mandatory because municipalities already act carefully.
At this moment it is still being investigated what happened here and what the exact course of events was.
Op dit moment wordt nog uitgezocht wat hier is gebeurd en wat de exacte gang van zaken is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het wetsvoorstel afschaffen precariobelasting voor nutsbedrijven

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipal precario tax revenues are rising, whether utility network operators bear the highest burden in a way that spreads costs to all users, and why a bill exempting utilities from precario tax, drafted since 2011 with a Council of State advice in 2012, has not yet been sent to parliament. The minister confirmed rising precario revenues, estimated about 70 municipalities levy it on utility networks, and said the Council of State advice required further study, with a decision on the chosen variant expected in the first half of 2014.
Your House is expected to be informed about this in the first half of 2014.
Uw Kamer zal daarover naar verwachting in de eerste helft van 2014 worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de agressie van de gevolmachtigde minister van Curaçao tegenover een journalist

The SP MP Van Raak asked the Prime Minister about the alleged assault by the Curaçao plenipotentiary minister on a journalist, asking whether it is acceptable, why bodyguards followed the journalist, and what the Prime Minister can do. The Prime Minister answered that the matter falls under the authority of Curaçao's own authorities and he will not take a position on it.
The matter to which the questions relate falls within the competence of the authorities of the country of Curaçao.
De aangelegenheid waarop de vragen betrekking hebben, behoort tot de bevoegdheid van de autoriteiten van het land Curacao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Raak over de verandering in de wijze van bekostiging van de waterschapslasten

MPs Van Gerven and Van Raak asked the ministers whether the shift of water board charges from agriculture to households is real, and whether the Delfland-inspired tariff differentiation and cost-allocation changes are consistent with the principle that charges are paid in proportion to benefit. The minister confirmed the shift is linked to water boards' growing urban role, that the 2012 amendment widening tariff differentiation was used by seven boards with provincial approval, and provided a table of cost shares for 2010 and 2013.

It is indeed the case that the water boards' task performance has changed substantially over the past decades and that they have taken more measures that serve the interests of urban areas and therefore of households.

Het is inderdaad zo dat de taakuitoefening van de waterschappen de laatste decennia ingrijpend is veranderd en dat zij meer maatregelen zijn gaan treffen die in het belang van het stedelijk gebied en daarmee van de huishoudens zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een brief van de provincie Noord-Holland

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether he would send the Noord-Holland Commissioner of the King's letter and report on the taken and powers of the new-style province. The Minister answered yes, enclosing the letter, which relates to ongoing government discussions on the instruments of a merged northern-wing province.
Yes, enclosed I send you the relevant letter from the Commissioner of the King of the province of Noord-Holland including the annex.
Antwoord 1 Ja, bijgaand 1 stuur ik u de desbetreffende brief van de Commissaris van de Koning van de provincie Noord-Holland inclusief bijlage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak, Schouw, Segers en Klein over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur betreffende het satellietcomplex in Burum

MPs asked whether US forces have their own installation, SGS equipment and communication networks (USGNA, SIPRNet, JWICS, Blue Force Tracking, BGAN) at the Inmarsat teleport in Burum, and how the Dutch government supervises this. The minister answered that Inmarsat is a commercial operator subject to Dutch law, that the government has access to the site, that AIVD and MIVD found no indications of foreign intelligence activity there, and that the military part of Burum hosts only Dutch government equipment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de methode datamining

An MP asks two ministers whether the ARGO II intelligence processing system amounts to data mining, given that the Interior Minister in 2010 rejected data mining while Defence was preparing ARGO II. The Defence Minister answers that ARGO II only processes SIGINT already collected within the 2002 intelligence law and does not exploit databases indiscriminately, so the two positions are reconcilable.
ARGO II replaces ARGO I, the MIVD's current processing system for SIGINT (Signals Intelligence).
ARGO II vervangt ARGO I, het huidige verwerkingssysteem van SIGINT (Signals Intelligence – verbindingsinlichtingen) van de MIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid lid Van Raak over wachtgeld voor een ex-gedeputeerde van Noord-Holland

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether former Noord-Holland deputy Hooijmaijers, convicted by a court, should have his severance (wachtgeld) stopped and reclaimed, and whether the Appa pension law should be amended. The minister answered that benefits can only be stopped once a person is actually deprived of liberty by a final judgment, that the benefits received so far cannot be reclaimed, and that no legal amendment is planned.
Since Mr Hooijmaijers is entitled to the Appa benefit, I see no possibilities to reclaim the benefit granted so far.
Aangezien de heer Hooijmaijers recht heeft op de Appa-uitkering, zie ik geen mogelijkheden om de tot nu toe toegekende uitkering terug te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Segers over de capaciteit van de antennes op het dak van de ambassade van de Verenigde Staten

MPs Van Raak and Segers asked whether antennas on the US embassy roof in The Hague could intercept and decode nearby communications, including those around the Binnenhof and the Prime Minister's office, and whether the government would check this with the US. The minister confirmed interception is technically possible but could not confirm it occurs, said foreign intelligence operations in the Netherlands require prior authorisation, and committed to contacting the US embassy and reporting back.
The Ministry of BZK will contact the American embassy. I will inform your House of the outcome.
Het Ministerie van BZK zal contact opnemen met de Amerikaanse ambassade. Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomst hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Bisschop over het ontslag van de Gezaghebber op Bonaire

MPs Van Raak and Bisschop asked whether the resignation request of the Island Governor of Bonaire serves integrity, whether a no-confidence motion filed by a UPB faction leader suspected in a corruption case is appropriate, whether the governor should be supported, and whether dismissal will be granted or deferred until trial ends. The minister answered that the Island Council's no-confidence vote is primarily its own matter, reaffirmed integrity principles and the presumption of innocence without judging the motion, and noted the governor will resign on 1 March 2014 respecting the council's wishes.
The Island Council of Bonaire adopted a motion of no confidence against the Island Governor on Tuesday 26 November 2013.
De Eilandsraad van Bonaire heeft op dinsdag 26 november 2013 een motie van wantrouwen tegen de Gezaghebber aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak, Pechtold en Van Ojik over de zaak De Roy van Zuydewijn

MPs Van Raak, Pechtold and Van Ojik asked the Prime Minister about a 2003 confidential DKDB report on a security investigation into Mr De Roy van Zuydewijn, a partner of a royal relative, and about who ordered and knew of it. The Prime Minister answered that the report was released under freedom-of-information rules in 2003, that DKDB acted on its statutory task with Prince Bernhard as protected person, found no security risks, and declined to publish the report to protect private life.
No. The report contains data on the private life of Mr De Roy van Zuydewijn, his former spouse and various other persons.
Nee. Het rapport bevat gegevens met betrekking tot de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de heer De Roy van Zuydewijn, zijn voormalige echtgenote en verschillende andere personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van Raak over het ontslag van de klokkenluider moskee-internaten

MPs Segers and Van Raak asked the minister why a whistleblower at mosque boarding schools was dismissed, whether they acted in good faith, whether Rotterdam complied with the whistleblower scheme, and how the proposed House for Whistleblowers bill would have applied. The minister declined to comment on individual employment matters or the facts, saying the courts will judge the dismissal, and said the bill's protections are hypothetical to assess.
It is now up to the court to assess that dismissal.
Het is nu aan de rechter om dat ontslag te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een bezoek van klokkenluider Snowden aan de Tweede Kamer

An SP MP asked whether the government would enable a visit by whistleblower Snowden to the Tweede Kamer, and whether it would guarantee his safety from extradition. The minister answered that the Kamer may speak with Snowden without him travelling to the Netherlands, that his passport was revoked so he cannot enter, and that an extradition treaty with the US prevents ruling out extradition requests, so no assurance letter is appropriate.
The Kamer is of course free to speak with Mr Snowden.
Het staat de Kamer uiteraard vrij om met de heer Snowden te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de gevolmachtigde minister van Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Minister-President and the Minister of Interior about reports that Curaçao's plenipotentiary minister hired family and friends without the usual recruitment procedures, and whether her CV was verified. The minister replied that it is not for the Dutch government to assess recruitment procedures in another country and referred back to that answer for the CV questions.
It is not for the Dutch government to assess the recruitment procedures for posts in other countries.
Het is niet aan de regering van Nederland om de sollicitatieprocedures voor functies in andere landen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de acties van de regering van Sint Maarten om een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar goed bestuur te dwarsbomen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether he disapproved of the Sint Maarten prime minister barring civil servants from cooperating with an integrity investigation ordered by the Kingdom Council of Ministers. The minister answered that he expects Sint Maarten to cooperate, points to the Kingdom's responsibility to address governance concerns, and declined to comment on requests not made by the Sint Maarten government.
I assume that the government of Sint Maarten will cooperate with the investigation in accordance with the decision of the Kingdom Council of Ministers.
Ik ga er van uit dat de regering van Sint Maarten zal meewerken aan het onderzoek conform besluit van de Rijksministerraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Raak over het boek ‘naar één nationale politie’

MPs Kooiman and Van Raak asked whether the minister knew of a book on the creation of the national police, whether it was commissioned, what the police contributed and whether every officer received a copy at what cost. The minister confirmed knowledge of the book, said it was an initiative of the publisher and author, described the police's contribution as interviews and photo material, and stated the book was given to all permanent staff at a total cost of EUR 415,000.
This book is an initiative and publication of publisher Kerckebosch and author Louis Cornelisse.
Dit boek is een initiatief en uitgave van Uitgeverij Kerckebosch en auteur Louis Cornelisse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en van Raak over de dreigende sluiting van de brandweerpost Diever

MPs Kooiman and Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the planned closure of the Diever fire station, its effects on response times, and whether the Drenthe safety region complies with the law and the Kooiman motion. The minister answered that responsibility lies with the municipality and then the safety region, that the regional coverage plan does not yet meet legal requirements, and that he has asked the region to fix it by end 2013.
I have asked the safety region to improve the coverage plan as quickly as possible so that it meets the legal requirements.
Ik heb de veiligheidsregio verzocht op zo kort mogelijke termijn het dekkingsplan zodanig te verbeteren dat het voldoet aan de wettelijke vereisten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over het besluit van de gemeente Amsterdam om door te gaan met exorbitante vergoedingen voor leden van bestuurscommissies

MP Van Raak asks the minister whether he remembers distancing himself from Amsterdam's plan to pay district committee members €1,500 per meeting and whether the city followed up after consultation. The minister replies that he rejected an AWVN-based proposal, that the city's draft ordinance differs (€500 per regular meeting, capped at €1,500 gross per month) and complies with the law, so no further measures are planned.
I note that the college did not adopt the AWVN advice in the draft ordinance.
Ik constateer dat het college in de ontwerp-verordening het AWVN-advies niet heeft overgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over het gevaar dat het Amsterdamse internetknooppunt AMS-IX gegevens moet afstaan aan de Amerikaanse National Security Agency (NSA)

MP Van Raak asks whether AMS-IX, if it expands into the United States, risks being forced under US law to hand data to the NSA, and whether he can be assured Dutch citizens' data stays safe before any US activity. Minister Plasterk answers that US law applies to activities on US soil with court-supervised compelled cooperation, that AMS-IX is seeking legal advice, that the NCSC will not advise on this, and that Dutch firms may establish abroad but must meet Dutch data-transfer rules, so no such assurance is given.
No. Dutch companies are free to establish themselves abroad.
Nee. Het staat Nederlandse bedrijven Vrij om zich in het buitenland te vestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over bezuinigingen als gevolg van niet-aangenomen wetten

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether the planned €18 million cut to the municipal fund from 2015 follows from the rejected Heijnen bill on reducing council seats, and how municipalities should compensate. The minister replied that the cut stems from the coalition agreement rather than the bill, that the agreed savings targets remain binding, and that municipalities must find savings themselves.
It is correct that €18 million will be withdrawn from the municipal fund from 2015.
Het klopt dat er een uitname van € 18 miljoen uit het gemeentefonds plaatsvindt vanaf 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid  Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) bij een onderzoek naar de heer De Roy van Zuydewijn

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether Prince Bernhard instructed the Kabinet der Koningin to request BVD information on De Roy van Zuydewijn in 2000, why the 2003 government did not disclose this, and for comment on a journalist's account of the prince's remarks. The government answers that the 2003 letter and parliamentary debates contain its position, that the earlier answers were given in good faith, and that statements by the former editor-in-chief are his own responsibility.
Statements by the former editor-in-chief are for his own account.
Uitlatingen van de voormalig hoofdredacteur komen voor diens rekening.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het afluisteren van Kamerleden (ingezonden 6 augustus 2013).

MP Van Raak asks whether foreign intelligence services can access Dutch MPs' phones via Vodafone and how Vodafone is prevented from passing data abroad, and when the government will seek clarification from the US about mass surveillance of Dutch citizens. The minister says Vodafone shares data only after formal requests under Dutch law, and that the EU has already raised the matter with US authorities and experts are examining it jointly.
Vodafone has confirmed to me that data is only provided to Dutch investigative and security services after a formal request, within the framework of Dutch laws and regulations.
Vodafone heeft mij bevestigd dat gegevens alleen na formeel verzoek daartoe binnen de kaders van Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving aan Nederlandse opsporings- en veiligheidsdiensten worden versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over Amerikaanse financiering van Nederlandse geheime diensten

An MP asked whether US or other foreign intelligence services or organisations have ever financed Dutch intelligence services (AIVD, MIVD or predecessors) over the past 68 years, with amounts and agreements. The ministers answer that there is currently no such financing, that the former BVD received direct CIA financial support from 1950 to 1966 with ministerial approval, and that cost-sharing in joint operations cannot be detailed publicly.
More concretely, no public statements can be made about this.
Meer concreet kunnen daarover in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het voornemen in Amsterdam om leden van bestuurscommissies exorbitante beloningen te geven

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether he would distance himself from Amsterdam's plan to pay members of district committees between 1,373 and 1,555 euros per meeting, why the city hired AWVN, what the study cost, how this fits with social spending cuts, and whether the plans comply with the law abolishing sub-district councils. The minister said he would discuss the matter with the city and report back, but declared the city's choices about advisers, costs, budget priorities and the legal-status regulation to be local matters.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam to decide whether and by whom it has itself advised.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam om te bepalen of en door wie zij zich laat adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het onderzoek van de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) naar een politicus

The SP MP Van Raak asked why the AIVD's use of special powers against a former politician, the decision not to notify, and whether parliament's intelligence committee was informed must remain secret. The minister confirmed the target was a former member of a party's representative body, noted the CTIVD found the lawfulness not disputed, said the non-notification decision will be reconsidered following the CTIVD's finding it should not have been taken, and declined to comment in public on the period and on committee briefings.
As I wrote in my letter of 17 July 2013, I will reconsider the concrete notification decisions named in the report, including the decision mentioned above.

Zoals ik heb geschreven in mijn brief van 17 juli 2013 (kamerstuk 29 924, nr. 99 ), zal ik de in het rapport genoemde concrete notificatiebesluiten, waaronder het hierboven genoemde besluit, heroverwegen.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over het afluisteren van internetverkeer

An MP asked about Argo II, Symbolon and AMS-IX, and why a commercial firm was contracted to tap internet traffic at AMS-IX, including links to Israeli intelligence and use of data mining. The minister explained the projects, stated the Intelligence and Security Services Act 2002 does not permit untargeted tapping of AMS-IX, and refused to disclose the functional specifications and supplementary briefing as state secret.
The functional specifications for the new platform give insight into the MIVD's modus operandi and are therefore classified as state secret.
De functionele specificaties voor het nieuwe platform geven inzage in de modus operandi van de MIVD en zijn derhalve staatsgeheim gerubriceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en en Van Raak over Nederlandse jihadisten

MPs Van Bommel and Van Raak asked whether the AIVD contacted a Dutch jihadist returnee codenamed 'Salem', whether he was turned away by the Tripoli embassy, and what the government does to gather information from returning jihadists. The minister declined to give concrete public information on AIVD contacts, said the embassy inquiry could not be resolved given the anonymous source, and stated the AIVD prioritises research into jihadist travel and return.
I cannot make any concrete public statements about AIVD contacts.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over contacten van de AIVD.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de financiële positie van gemeenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities can spread losses of EUR 4.4 billion on land purchases over several years, and about unclear BBV accounting rules affecting Breda. The minister answered that losses must be booked immediately under the BBV and that municipalities should apply the BBV notes of 2012 and 2013 in their 2012 accounts.
