The regulations, namely the Decree on budgets and accounts for provinces and municipalities (BBV), clearly establish that losses may not be capitalised and must therefore be recognised immediately when the losses become known.

In de regelgeving, te weten het Besluit begroting en verantwoording provincies en gemeenten (BBV), is duidelijk vastgelegd dat verliezen niet mogen worden geactiveerd en dus direct moeten worden genomen wanneer de verliezen bekend worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de benoeming van Marco van Kalleveen in een commissie voor goed bestuur

An SP MP asked why Marco van Kalleveen, a former Bain Capital vice-president, was appointed to a commission drafting a governance code for the semi-public sector, and whether his role contributed to misconduct there. The minister replied that the commission was balanced and that Van Kalleveen's private-sector experience in advising boards on strategy and oversight is valuable, without addressing the misconduct question directly.
When composing the commission, the aim was a balanced distribution of experience and expertise on governance and oversight in the (semi-)public and private sectors.
Bij het samenstellen van de commissie is gezocht naar een evenwichtige verdeling van ervaring en expertise op het terrein van bestuur en toezicht in de (semi)publieke en private sector.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) bij een onderzoek naar de heer De Roy van Zuydewijn

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether Prince Bernhard in 2000 had instructed the Queen's Cabinet to request information from the BVD about Mr De Roy van Zuydewijn, why the 2003 cabinet did not disclose that the initiative came from the Prince, and why an intelligence service inquiry beyond a standard security check was considered justified. The government answered by referring to the 10 March 2003 letter to parliament and the earlier debate and motions, without restating the substance.
The letter of 10 March 2003 contains the cabinet's position on this subject and the grounds on which it rests.
De brief van 10 maart 2003 bevat het kabinetsstandpunt over dit onderwerp en de gronden waarop het berust
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over het beleid bij mogelijke belangenverstrengeling bij de beantwoording van vragen uit de Tweede Kamer

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether the government accepts a duty to answer parliamentary questions properly, and whether the minister's husband, employed at Slotervaart hospital, creates a conflict of interest and what safeguards were agreed. The Prime Minister answered yes to the first question and denied the husband sits on the hospital's board, stating no conflict of interest exists.
There is therefore no question of a conflict of interest, see also the answers to previous questions on this matter.
Van belangenverstrengeling is derhalve geen sprake, zie ook de beantwoording van vorige vragen ter zake.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de onafhankelijke beantwoording van vragen uit de Tweede Kamer

A Socialist Party MP asked the Prime Minister what policy applies when a minister's close associates may be involved in, or subject of, parliamentary questions, and how independent answers will be ensured. The government answered that the Handbook for incoming ministers' integrity framework applies, requiring ministers to avoid any appearance of biased decision-making, and that the health minister can handle questions on the Slotervaart hospital within that framework.
Within this framework, ministers are responsible for performing their duties with the required objectivity and avoiding any appearance that decision-making would not be objective.

Binnen dit toetsingskader zijn bewindspersonen er verantwoordelijk voor dat zij de uitoefening van hun functie met vereiste objectiviteit verrichten en iedere mogelijke schijn vermijden dat er van objectieve besluitvorming geen sprake zou zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de benoeming van een commissaris van de Koningin in de provincie Utrecht

MP Van Raak asks why the minister intends to appoint Rosenmöller as interim commissaris van de Koningin in Utrecht without a formal selection procedure, without support from the provincial states, and before a concrete merger plan exists. The minister replies that the appointment is a temporary (waarnemend) one under article 76 Provinciewet, that the provincial states will be heard, that confidentiality applies to the name, and that the merger procedure is at an early, consultative stage.
Before doing so, it shall hear the provincial states, unless serious reasons oppose this.
Alvorens daartoe over te gaan hoort zij provinciale staten, tenzij gewichtige reden zich daartegen verzetten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over het optreden van de AIVD in de zaak Sabir K.

The SP MP Van Raak asked whether the AIVD investigated the Sabir K. case early on, whether it acted for the CIA or also examined CIA conduct, whether evidence obtained through torture in Pakistan can be excluded, and why the Netherlands does not prosecute K., a Dutch national, itself. The ministers declined to say publicly whether the AIVD investigated early, said the AIVD does no work on behalf of other services, relied on US court findings and treaty obligations on torture evidence, and explained that prosecution in the US is most logical given the location of the offence, evidence and extradition request.
I cannot make any public statements about this.
Ik kan hierover in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Nader Onderzoek Doods Oorzaak (NODO) meldplicht (ingezonden 1 maart 2013).

An MP asks the Interior Minister about research showing that only about 51.4% of deaths of minors were reported to municipal coroners under the NODO reporting duty in 2010, and what will be done to raise compliance. The state secretary replies that the low rate reflects early unfamiliarity and reluctance among doctors, that reporting is not tracked centrally, and that awareness campaigns and communication to civil registry officials will be stepped up.
In consultation with professional associations and the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG), awareness of the reporting duty will be increased.
In overleg met beroepsverenigingen en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) zal de bekendheid van de meldplicht worden vergroot.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Raak en Heijnen over het artikel “Patrick Illidge seen in tape apparently accepting bribe”

Three MPs asked the Interior Minister whether a reported video showing a Sint Maarten official apparently accepting a bribe linked to prostitution, and whether the Kingdom's guarantee function should be invoked. The minister replied that the Sint Maarten Public Prosecutor is investigating and has seized material, that the Dutch Rijksrecherche can only act on Sint Maarten at its request, and that the guarantee function does not apply.
It is for the Public Prosecutor's Office of Sint Maarten to conduct further investigation and determine whether and who should be prosecuted.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie van Sint Maarten om nader onderzoek te verrichten en te bepalen of en zo ja wie vervolgd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inzet van bijzondere bevoegdheden door de geheime diensten tegen politici, in het bijzonder tegen Roel van Duijn

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the secret services' use of special powers against politician Roel van Duijn was improper, as the National Ombudsman suggested, and whether further investigation and rules are needed. The minister said the case concerns the pre-2002 BVD, that the CTIVD has no remit for it, that he will meet Van Duijn, and that politicians receive notification under the same rules as others, while declining to give operational details.
The Review Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD) has no task or powers to conduct an investigation in this case.
De Commissie van Toezicht voor de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (CTIVD) heeft in dit geval geen taak en bevoegdheden om onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over ministers die meer verdienen dan het ministersalaris

MP Van Raak asked why ministers may exceed the ministerial salary norm without appearing on the top-earners list, and whether their total incomes will be published. The minister says the 2011 and 2012 income overviews have been made public in a letter to the Chamber, and explains that some Commissioners of the Queen appear on the list only because of the fiscal addition for a private-use car.
In the letter sent to the Chamber today (Kamerstuk II 30 111, no. 58), the cabinet has made the income overviews for 2011 and 2012 public.
In de heden aan de Kamer gezonden brief (Kamerstuk II 30 111, nr. 58 ) heeft het kabinet de inkomensoverzichten over 2011 en 2012 openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over mogelijke financiële chantage van gemeenten

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether offering financial incentives for municipal mergers amounts to financial blackmail, and questions whether mergers solve municipal financial problems. The minister says he wants to encourage consolidation to at least 100,000 inhabitants, that positive financial incentives such as the Gemeentefonds allocation criteria may be used, and that he will not engage in financial blackmail.
I will not engage in financial blackmail.
Ik zal geen financiële chantage plegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Raak over de aankoop door de Rijksgebouwendienst van een kantoorpand in Den Haag

SP MPs Paulus Jansen and Van Raak asked why the Rijksgebouwendienst bought an office building in The Hague near the Eurojust site, questioning the fit with the vacant-office convenant and whether vacant state property could have been used, and asked for an overview of state-owned offices. The minister confirmed the purchase for €7.9 million as part of arrangements for a possible future Eurojust expansion, said it does not conflict with the convenant, and promised an overview plus a forthcoming joint plan with the municipality.

With the purchase of the building, effect is given to the agreements between the Dutch State and Eurojust to make a possible future expansion of Eurojust feasible in the immediate vicinity of the new building.

Met de aankoop van het pand wordt invulling gegeven aan de afspraken tussen de Nederlandse Staat en Eurojust om een mogelijke uitbreiding van Eurojust in de toekomst mogelijk te maken in de directe nabijheid van de nieuwbouw.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de financiering van Europese politieke partijen

The SP MP Van Raak asks the Interior Minister whether, despite broad Dutch parliamentary criticism, a majority of EU states could force the Commission's proposal on European political parties on the Netherlands, and whether the Luxembourg Accord and democratic safeguards should apply. The minister replies that the Netherlands cannot block the measure alone under qualified majority voting, that the cabinet will still lobby to amend the disputed parts (including a visit to Strasbourg), and that the Luxembourg Accord has lost practical value after the Lisbon Treaty.

That nevertheless leaves unaffected that the cabinet, strengthened by the broad support in the House of Representatives, will fully endeavour to amend the parts of the proposal against which the Dutch objections are directed.

Dat laat echter onverlet dat het kabinet zich, gesterkt door de brede steun in de Tweede Kamer, ten volle in zal spannen om de onderdelen van het voorstel waar de Nederlandse bezwaren zich op richten, te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over meldingen van misstanden

Van Raak (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether reports of suspected misconduct were assessed for criminal conduct under the BIOS protocol, and whether the facts were established before concluding that reports did not warrant labelling as a misstand. Minister Rosenthal answered that assessment follows a BZ protocol derived from the BIOS guideline, which always includes a check for criminal conduct, and referred to question 1 for question 2.
The assessment took place in line with the BIOS protocol.
Beoordeling heeft plaatsgevonden in lijn met het protocol van BIOS.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over meldingen van misstanden

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether written reports of suspected misconduct and possible criminal acts by ministry officials in 2008-2010 were received, whether they were classed as suspected misconduct under the integrity rules, and whether they were investigated independently. The minister confirmed reports were received, that 13 officials and 31 local staff were disciplined, that the content did not warrant classing them as suspected misconduct, and that investigations applied hearing both sides and inspection of relevant documents.
If the outcome of the investigation gives cause for disciplinary follow-up, the legal-status framework for employment forms the starting point.
Als de uitkomst van het onderzoek aanleiding geeft tot een disciplinair vervolg dan vormen de rechtspositionele kaders daarvoor het uitgangspunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak over corruptie van politici op Bonaire

MP Van Raak asked whether a corruption probe on Bonaire, triggered by 2007 information from a governance foundation, was stalled and whether the Bonaire state reform or political pressure played a role in ending it, and what the minister would do to ensure independence. The minister answered that the investigation was halted by the investigating judge's decision and resumption ordered by the Court, that he has confidence in judicial independence and sees no sign of political interference, and referred to earlier answers for the timing questions.
I have firm confidence in judicial independence, and have no indication that the decisions mentioned are the result of political pressure or interference.
Ik heb vast vertrouwen in de rechterlijke onafhankelijkheid, en heb geen enkele aanwijzing dat de genoemde beslissingen het gevolg zijn van politieke druk of inmenging.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de kosten voor reizen van ambtenaren naar Saba, St. Eustatius en Bonaire

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about the travel costs of civil servants to Saba, Statia and Bonaire, including a Commissariaat voor de Media visit to Saba despite no TV media there, and whether such trips are unnecessary. The minister said only BZK's total of €580,588 (2010 to August 2012) could be provided, defended the trips as necessary for new rules and oversight, and rejected the claim that they are wasteful.
I cannot provide you with an overview of the total travel costs of all departments. This falls under the responsibility of each individual department.
Ik kan u geen overzicht van de totale reiskosten van alle departementen verschaffen. Dit valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van elk afzonderlijk departement.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over uitlatingen van een politiewoordvoerder in Den Haag

An SP MP asked why a police spokesperson publicly linked the arrests of two protesters carrying a coffin to a memorial in Lommel, and whether this was proper. The minister answers that the arrests were based on breaking agreements and not complying with police orders, that the spokesperson merely pointed out the coffin could be seen as inappropriate, and that no ban on the coffin existed.
There has explicitly been no ban on carrying a coffin.
Van een verbod tot het meevoeren van een lijkkist is nadrukkelijk geen sprake geweest.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over de raffinaderij op Aruba

An SP MP asked the ministers of Interior and Economic Affairs about the possible closure of the Aruba refinery, Aruba's efforts to keep it open, and Dutch support for that effort. The government answered that Aruba is primarily responsible for its own economic policy, that the Netherlands supports it through diplomacy, trade missions and a 2011 cooperation protocol, and that further support was pledged.
As a country within the Kingdom, Aruba is primarily responsible for its own economic policy.
Als land binnen het Koninkrijk is Aruba primair verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen economisch beleid.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over de dreigementen van de gevolmachtigd minister van Curaçao

MP Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of the Interior whether the plenipotentiary minister of Curaçao's threatening remark about two former ministers criticising the government was meant as a threat and whether it was endorsed by the Council of Ministers, and how the former ministers and the practice would be protected. The minister replied that the intended meaning is unknown, that the remark falls under Curaçao's own government, that the plenipotentiary did not speak for the Rijksministerraad, and that it is an internal Curaçaose matter for Curaçao's government and parliament.
It is primarily up to the government and the States of Curaçao to determine whether statements by a member of this government call for measures.
Het is primair aan de regering en de Staten van Curaçao om te bepalen of uitlatingen van een lid van deze regering eventueel vragen om maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak Het opnieuw lekken van informatie uit de geheime dienst van Curacao

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether leaked Curaçao intelligence data passed to third parties and Colombia, whether the Curaçao security service can still be trusted, and what protection a whistleblower will receive. The minister answered that Curaçao is primarily responsible, that the AIVD and MIVD are inquiring, that the third-party rule was not waived, and that they await further investigation by Curaçao's government.
The functioning of the Curaçao Security Service (VDC) is primarily a matter for the country of Curaçao and its government.
Het functioneren van de Veiligheidsdienst Curaçao (VDC) is primair een aangelegenheid van het land Curaçao en van zijn regering.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over de bescherming van privacygevoelige gegevens van Nederlandse burgers tegenover de overheid van de Verenigde Staten

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Dutch citizens' sensitive data held by cloud providers can be accessed by US authorities under the Patriot Act, and how the government will protect it. The state secretary answered that US law may compel US-headquartered firms to disclose data regardless of location, that the proposed EU Data Protection Regulation does not yet clarify the consequences, and that the Commission is primarily responsible; a letter on the state's own data would follow in about six weeks.

Specifically on the question of what consequences US legislation has for personal data belonging to the State, the Minister of the Interior will inform your House in more detail by letter in about six weeks.

Specifiek over de vraag welke consequenties de wetgeving van de Verenigde Staten heeft voor persoonsgegevens die aan de Staat toebehoren zal de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties uw Kamer over circa zes weken per brief nader informeren.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over het niet publiceren van verbeurde dwangsommen door overheden

An SP MP asked why ministries and lower governments do not publish how much they paid in penalty payments for missing decision deadlines, and asked for a breakdown by ministry plus commitments to yearly publication. The minister promised all ministries will publish their penalty payment figures online for 2010 and 2011 before summer 2012 and will report them yearly going forward, but said publication by lower governments is up to their own autonomy and is not required by law.
As for lower governments, I refer you to my answer to question 5.
Voor wat betreft de lagere overheden verwijs ik u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 5.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over de ongebruikelijke transacties van de minister-president van Curaçao

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about unusual financial transactions involving Curaçao's prime minister, including when the government knew and whether they should have blocked his appointment. The minister declined to give a view on the appointment as a matter for Curaçao's own bodies, said the screening raised no grounds for prosecution, and stated Curaçao is autonomous with intervention only a last resort.
It is for the States of Curaçao to assess whether the administrators made a sound judgment when appointing the prime minister.
Het is aan de Staten van Curaçao om te beoordelen of de bestuurders een goede afweging hebben gemaakt bij de benoeming van de minister-president.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over het sluiten van diverse belastingkantoren

An MP asked why the Tax Administration offices in Emmen, Helmond and Heerenveen are being closed, why this was not discussed with parliament first, and what the job losses and dismissal risks are. The minister replied that no final decisions on Emmen have been taken, the Helmond and Heerenveen leases were terminated for efficiency reasons, and the office location policy is indicative and will be worked out in provincial masterplans, with no forced dismissals intended.
It is not customary to share housing changes with the House first.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om huisvestingsveranderingen eerst met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent, Bosman, van Bochove, van Raak, Recourt, Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de ticketprijzen van vliegtarieven van en naar Nederland vanaf Caribische eilanden

MPs asked why airfares from Dutch Caribbean islands to the Netherlands differ despite similar distances, how taxes apply to flights within the Kingdom, and whether the minister would discuss fares with airlines. The government answered that airlines set fares commercially under the new Kingdom aviation protocol, that intra-Kingdom flights are not subject to turnover tax, and that the aviation authorities intervene only for extremely high or low fares.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over vergoedingen aan de Commissaris der Koningin van de provincie Utrecht

An SP MP asked whether the Utrecht Commissaris der Koningin exceeded the Wopt pay norm, whether a 24,655 euro payment for tax on private use of his service car was improper, and whether the car and chauffeur were used for paid side jobs. The minister answered that the Wopt norm is a disclosure norm rather than a hard cap, that the car compensation is a provincial matter under provincial autonomy, and that no intervention or recovery is warranted.
I see no reason to intervene in provincial autonomy.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hier in te grijpen in de provinciale autonomie.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over trainen op de openbare weg met optische en geluidssignalen (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

MP Van Raak asked whether police training on public roads with sirens and lights, permitted under the traffic branch guideline but not the Regeling optische en geluidssignalen, is lawful, who is liable in accidents, and whether simulators could replace it. The minister acknowledged the regulation lacks a basis for such training, said road training remains necessary, and committed to amending the regulation to create a formal legal basis for police and fire brigade training.

I will examine how the Regeling optische en geluidssignalen should be amended so that there is a formal legal basis for training with optical and sound signals on public roads for police and fire brigade.

Ik zal bezien hoe de Regeling optische en geluidssignalen dient te worden aangepast zodat er een formele grondslag komt voor het trainen met optische- en geluidssignalen op de openbare weg voor politie en brandweer.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het falen van veiligheidsscanners op Schiphol (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether current Schiphol security scanners miss small firearm cartridges, why they are still considered justified, why Schiphol plans more scanners while Germany stopped using similar ones, and whether TNO's alternative detection equipment could be supported. The minister replied that the scanners meet international detection standards, that Schiphol's purchase reflects its own operational and business considerations, that TNO has no scanner equipment of its own, and that he supports new equipment where it can improve security.
The security scanners used at Schiphol have been extensively tested and meet internationally established detection standards.
De security scanners die op Schiphol worden gebruikt zijn uitvoerig getest en voldoen aan internationaal vastgestelde detectienormen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en justitie over de aanhouding van actievoerders tijdens de intocht van Sinterklaas (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why activists wearing 'Zwarte Piet is racisme' shirts were arrested at the Sinterklaas arrival in Dordrecht, on what basis, whether a demonstration ban applied, and whether the arrest was proportionate. The minister said the people were arrested for not obeying police orders to leave (art. 184 Sr) after repeated orders, and that the case is under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, so no further details can be given.
At the request of the Public Prosecution Service this case is under investigation. For that reason no further statements can be made at this time.
In opdracht van het Openbaar Ministerie is deze zaak in onderzoek. Om die reden kunnen op dit moment geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een tolk voor een raadslid op Bonaire (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

MP Van Raak asks whether Bonaire's island council will hire an interpreter for a Spanish-speaking councillor and what language requirements apply to council members. Minister Donner replies that no such decision is pending, that language mastery is not a legal membership requirement, and that hiring an interpreter is an autonomous matter for the island authority.
Whether to provide this is an autonomous competence of the public body Bonaire, provided budget coverage is present.
Het is een autonome bevoegdheid van het openbaar lichaam Bonaire om hier al dan niet in te voorzien, mits uiteraard daarvoor dekking op de begroting aanwezig is.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over problemen in meldkamers (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

MP Van Raak asks the Minister of Security and Justice about staffing shortages, vacancies, and 65-hour work weeks at police control rooms (meldkamers) of the KLPD and the Utrecht regional police, and about staffing across all Dutch control rooms. The minister answers that KLPD staffing is 51.2 of 62 fte with a vacancy freeze, that Utrecht had 7 vacancies with 3 filled and 65-hour periods occurring only from averaging, and that nationally there is no structural understaffing, with the Arbeidsinspectie responsible for working-time compliance.
The staffing and performance of the KLPD control room are structurally reviewed and measures are taken where necessary.
De bezetting en de prestaties van de KLPD meldkamer worden structureel bekeken en indien nodig worden maatregelen genomen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de onderbezetting van meldkamers (ingezonden 1 november 2011).

The MP asks the minister whether police control rooms (meldkamers) are understaffed ahead of the national police merger, how officers can be prevented from withdrawing their applications due to uncertainty about control room locations, and when certainty on number and locations will exist. The minister refers to earlier answers, says a decision on the control room model will be taken in early 2012 with location choices to follow, and leaves it to staff to judge whether location uncertainty deters applications.
Early 2012 decision-making will take place on the organisation of the control room domain in the Netherlands.
Begin 2012 vindt besluitvorming plaats over de organisatie van het meldkamerdomein in Nederland.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over fouten in het computersysteem van de politie (ingezonden 24 augustus 2011).

MP Van Raak asked why about 8,000 deceased and 2,800 acquitted persons remain in police computer systems, what harm this causes and how it can be corrected, and what other errors exist. Minister Opstelten answered that the WRR data came from frozen annual archive extracts not checked against the operational HKS, that flagged persons are automatically deleted within legal time limits, and that citizens can request correction under the Politiegegevens Act; the HKS will become part of a new police ICT base.
I attach importance to the data being up to date and correct in the interest of the citizen. The police forces will ensure this.
Ik hecht er aan dat de gegevens in het belang van de burger actueel en juist zijn. De korpsen zullen hiervoor zorg dragen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de veiligheidsdiensten (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

Rep. Van Raak (SP) asked whether Dutch intelligence services secretly investigated political parties to stir internal conflict, were co-financed by foreign powers, helped found parties, or collected data on citizens merely for party membership. Minister Donner answered that the AIVD may investigate any organisation or person, including parties and members, only under the statutory threshold of a serious suspicion of threat to the democratic legal order or national security, that such investigations are never foreign-financed, and that CTIVD oversees lawfulness, while declining to comment on specific cases.
As I also indicated in the aforementioned General Consultation, I cannot go into more concrete detail.
Zoals ik eveneens in het hiervoor genoemde Algemeen Overleg heb aangegeven, kan ik mij meer concreet niet uitlaten.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen (PvdA), Koopmans (CDA), Van Raak (SP) en Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bemoeienis van het college van B e

MPs asked whether the Roermond municipal executive improperly interfered in the sale of a former prison and court complex, and whether the state lost money when a developer with a lower bid obtained it. The state secretary replied that the highest bidder won after a second round, the state suffered no financial loss, the municipality cancelled the planned meeting with bidders after objections, and the evaluation report by the RijksAuditdienst was attached.

Although I distance myself from the wording he chose in the article, a meeting at the time could have led to unclarity about the State's position as seller of the complex and the transparency of the sales process.

Hoewel ik afstand neem van diens gekozen bewoording in het artikel, had destijds een gesprek kunnen leiden tot onduidelijkheid over de positie van de Staat als verkoper van het complex en de transparantie van het verkoopproces.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de toegang tot archieven in beheer van het Marechausseemuseum in Buren (ingezon

An MP asks whether a private museum may refuse researchers access to its archives on the ground of alleged commercial intent, whether the archive holder may judge that a topic is already sufficiently described, how requesters can tell if private archives contain public records, and whether the Erfgoedinspectie will mediate access for historians studying the Bende van Oss. The state secretary answers that the private foundation may decide who gets access, that the Erfgoedinspectie does not mediate, and that it is checking possible government records held by the museum, with the KMar investigating and the inspectorate to act depending on the outcome.
The Erfgoedinspectie is not there to mediate in disagreements between historians and independent museums.
De Erfgoedinspectie is er niet om te bemiddelen in onenigheid tussen historici en onafhankelijke musea.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het feit dat mensen geen aangifte kunnen doen van oplichting (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why victims of a repeat fraudster could not file a police report, and whether police and prosecutors have enough means and powers to tackle such fraud. The minister acknowledged the police wrongly treated the case as civil rather than criminal, apologised through the regional police head, and said the police and prosecution have sufficient resources and powers.
The regional police chief of Gelderland-Zuid asked that the complainant be invited to receive an apology and be given the opportunity to file the report after all.
De korpsbeheerder van de politieregio Gelderland-Zuid heeft verzocht de aangever uit te nodigen om verontschuldigingen aan te bieden en hem alsnog in de gelegenheid te stellen aangifte te doen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het afhaken van politiestudenten (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police students are confused about their pay, how mass dropout of aspiring officers fits with maintaining police numbers, how 1100 students will start this year, and whether the government will fix the Police Pay Decree and reverse the salary cut if recruitment falls short. The minister replied that pay information is normal, that the salary cut follows a 2010 package deal, that dropout reasons were not the pay cut, that 1850 aspirants must be appointed in 2011 with a follow-up letter promised, that he has reminded regional forces to apply the rules correctly, and that he intends to honour the agreement.
I have again drawn the regional forces' attention to the regulations and to their correct application.
Ik heb de korpsen nogmaals op de regelgeving en op een correcte uitvoering daarvan geattendeerd.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over afluisteren door particuliere recherchebureaus (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice how a private detective could wiretap without a police report being possible, whether the government's 2009 promise of better police oversight of private investigation agencies was kept, whether such agencies may only tap lines under strict conditions, and what measures will improve compliance with the privacy code and prevent illegal eavesdropping. The minister replied that a report was possible and was in fact taken, that oversight has been strengthened through a risk-analysis tool and better access to agency records, that the legal exception for line owners applies except in cases of manifest abuse, and that enforcement and sector self-regulation will be used.
Together with the police and the security sector associations I started a process that has resulted in measures to strengthen oversight of private security organisations and investigation agencies.

Samen met de politie en de brancheorganisaties in de veiligheidszorg heb ik een traject gestart dat heeft geresulteerd in maatregelen ter versterking van het toezicht op de particuliere beveiligingsorganisaties en onderzoeksbureaus.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de opkomsttijd van de brandweer in de Veiligheidsregio Brabant Zuid-Oost (ingezonden 1 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister why the Brabant Zuid-Oost safety region wants to raise fire brigade response times from eight to ten minutes and how this fits the Besluit veiligheidsregio's rules, and whether the region should be reminded of the decree. The state secretary answered that deviations are allowed only for specific, motivated locations with compensating measures, that no generic increase is permitted, and that an Inspectorate investigation into response times across all regions is underway.
With the deviation power in the Besluit veiligheidsregio's it is not possible for response times to be generically raised upward for the whole safety region.
Met de afwijkingsbevoegdheid uit het Besluit veiligheidsregio's is het niet mogelijk dat de opkomsttijden generiek en voor de hele veiligheidsregio naar boven worden bijgesteld.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bouwleges (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

MPs Jansen and Van Raak asked the minister about building permit fees (bouwleges) and whether municipalities use the VNG transparency model, and whether fees are checked against the maximum cost-recovery criterion. The minister answered that only 38 of 200 surveyed municipalities use the VNG model, that a monitor by Deloitte is underway with results due in June 2012, and that fee levels and any cost-recovery test are for municipalities and ultimately the courts.
I am not currently commissioning any research into the fee rates.
Ik laat op dit moment geen onderzoek uitvoeren naar de legestarieven.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over externen bij de vtsPN (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice who holds administrative responsibility for the police cooperation facility (vtsPN) since May 2011, why external hiring rose sharply from November 2010, and why a private firm is being hired to better use external staff's knowledge. The minister answered that responsibility lies with him as KLPD corps manager, that external hiring is needed for continuity and ICT, that it will be cut back toward the 10% norm except for specialist work, that no external firm is being hired for that purpose, and that he will report to parliament only if warranted.
If there is reason to do so, I will address this further in the regular accountability to the House.
Indien daar aanleiding toe bestaat zal ik in de reguliere verantwoording aan de Kamer hier nader op ingaan.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de Gemeenschappelijke Meldkamer Midden- en West-Brabant (ingezonden 18 juli 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about alleged problems at the joint emergency call centre (GMK) in Midden- en West-Brabant: incidents, staff qualifications, handling of reports, response times. The Minister answers that the regional safety board and police deny the problems, describes staff selection and training, and reports that 84% of priority-1 calls were attended within 15 minutes.
The General Board of the safety region is primarily responsible for maintaining the emergency call centre.
Het Algemeen Bestuur van de veiligheidsregio is primair verantwoordelijk voor het in stand houden van de meldkamer
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitbreiding van NuStar op Sint Eustatius (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether the Sint Eustatius island council decides on the NuStar expansion, how archaeological and cultural heritage is protected, how the UNESCO appeal is handled, whether irreversible steps can be prevented, and whether a referendum should be held. The minister answered that the island body decides under its spatial plan with heritage zoning, that the infrastructure minister assesses maritime heritage impacts, that UNESCO's reaction is for the island to consider, that the ministry cannot guarantee against irreversible steps, and that only the island government can decide on a referendum.
It is not for the Minister of BZK to guarantee that no irreversible steps are taken.
Het is niet aan de minister van BZK om te waarborgen dat geen onomkeerbare stappen worden gezet.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het afluisteren van mobiele telefoons van ministers (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

MP Van Raak asks why EenVandaag was not involved in the investigation into phone tapping of ministers' voicemail, whether the investigation's conclusions can be trusted, whether foreign intelligence could have tapped ministers, and whether a new investigation will be held. The minister replies that EenVandaag added no new facts, that the investigation found voicemail of only two ministers accessed on 21-24 March, that state security was not endangered, that foreign tapping cannot be fully excluded, and that he sees no reason for a new investigation.
I see no reason for such a new investigation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een dergelijk nieuw onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over stroomstoring KPN en gevolgen voor de hulpdiensten (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the cause of the KPN crossconnect failure, its effects on emergency services' C2000 and P2000 communications, and whether back-up and future safeguards exist. The minister explained the technical fault, described the disruption and fallback measures used, and said KPN and Alcatel Lucent are investigating and the Inspectie OOV was asked to examine the incident.
Based on the outcome of the investigation, I will urgently ask KPN to take the measures that help prevent such a failure.
Ik zal KPN aan de hand van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek dringend verzoeken de maatregelen te nemen die bijdragen aan het voorkomen van een dergelijke storing.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de samenwerking van de AIVD met de veiligheidsdiensten in Marokko (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior why Saddik Sbaa, reportedly acquitted in the Netherlands, was extradited to Morocco where he risks torture, whether AIVD shared his data with Moroccan services, how such data sharing can be checked, and how many people have been sent to Morocco or the Middle East after failed prosecutions. The minister corrected that the case was dismissed rather than acquitted and that Sbaa left voluntarily, declined to comment on concrete cooperation cases, pointed to the CTIVD report and complaint and oversight routes, and said no overview exists of people who cannot be prosecuted.
I cannot publicly make any statements about the (possible) cooperation of the AIVD with foreign services in concrete cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de (eventuele) samenwerking van de AIVD met buitenlandse diensten in concrete gevallen.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de mogelijkheid om te studeren op het onbewoonde eiland Nava

An SP MP asked why students on Bonaire, Saba and Statia can receive study finance for study on the uninhabited island of Navassa, and how the safety of Dutch students there would be guaranteed given a past diplomatic dispute. The government answered that Navassa is listed only for completeness in the study finance regulation, is a theoretical option with no institutions present, and that it would act as the situation arises.
This is of course a theoretical possibility, since there are currently no educational institutions on the island.
Het betreft uiteraard een theoretische mogelijkheid, aangezien er thans geen onderwijsinstellingen op het eiland zijn.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over klokkenluiders bij de politie (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the government disagrees with police union ACP and the Commission Integriteit Overheid on whistleblower protection in the police, the handling of the Goudswaard case, and anonymous reporting. The state secretary replied that the 2009 whistleblower decree was agreed with police unions, that no grounds existed for disciplinary or criminal investigation, that the disclosure of the whistleblower's identity was regretted, and that anonymous reporting would not be introduced, with an evaluation after five years.
At this moment I do not consider it necessary to carry out research into whether officers can report misconduct anonymously.
Ik acht het op dit moment niet nodig om onderzoek te verrichten om te bezien of agenten anoniem misstanden kunnen melden.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kosten van het nieuwe rijkslogo (ingezonden 6 juli 2011)

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the roughly 15 million euro cost of the new government logo and house style, whether it exceeded estimates, and why certain training courses, gifts, and consultant salaries were paid for. The minister answered that costs stayed within the 18.5 million euro budget, that the courses and gifts were justified as personal effectiveness and testing purposes, and that consultant salaries were anonymised for privacy and fell within norms.
The salary details of PP, EE, CC, QQ and PPP have been anonymised for privacy reasons.
De salarisopgaven van PP, EE, CC, QQ en PPP zijn geanonimiseerd uit privacy-overwegingen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over problemen bij de politie Utrecht (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

MP Van Raak asks the minister about police staffing shortages, use of experienced officers for custody and report-taking, vehicle shortages and C2000 radio coverage gaps in the Utrecht district Eemland Zuid. The minister answers that staffing exceeds the planned level, that custody duties are a necessary part of policing, that no vehicle shortage exists, and that the coverage gap is under investigation.
Based on information from the Utrecht police force, I establish that in the Eemland Zuid district, given the authorised establishment, there is no shortage of staff.
Op basis van informatie van het politiekorps Utrecht stel ik vast dat er in het district Eemland Zuid, gelet op de toegestane formatie, geen sprake is van een tekort aan mensen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over bezuinigingen op politiebeveiliging evenementen (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

MP Van Raak asks the Minister of Security and Justice why 30 million euros is being cut from police budgets, whether unions were consulted, and whether 300 officers will be lost, asking also for the timing and effects of the proposal to charge event organisers for security costs. The minister replies that the cut reflects a coalition agreement measure on charging organisers, that the bill is in consultation and will go to Parliament in 2011, that any shortfall will be covered by other measures without affecting police strength, and that police capacity pressure is expected to fall.
The proposal is in consultation and will, based on the responses, be adjusted where necessary and then submitted to the Council of State.
Het voorstel is in consultatie en zal op basis van de reacties daar waar nodig worden aangepast en vervolgens worden voorgelegd aan de Raad van State.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het falen van de AIVD om de notificatieplicht uit te voeren (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

MP Van Raak asked why the AIVD has failed to carry out its statutory duty to notify citizens who were subject to surveillance, and whether an investigation into the failure would be ordered. Minister Donner answered that the CTIVD's 2010 review found the AIVD largely compliant with the notification duty, with a few erroneous decisions the AIVD has since reconsidered, and that the CTIVD monitors notification ongoingly.
The CTIVD finds that the AIVD, with a single exception, has implemented the notification duty in accordance with the statutory requirements.
De CTIVD constateert dat de AIVD, een enkele uitzondering daargelaten, de notificatieplicht overeenkomstig de wettelijke vereisten ten uitvoer heeft gelegd.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Commissie integriteit overheid (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

MP Van Raak asks the Minister of the Interior about the Commission on Government Integrity (CIO), including its role in protecting whistleblowers, criticism from the expert group and others, and whether the CIO keeps a central role under the proposed advice and referral point. The Minister disagrees that whistleblowers are difficult people, agrees a different body is needed, and says he is working to replace the CIO with a government integrity reporting point with investigative powers.
I am working on replacing the CIO with a government integrity violations reporting point with investigative powers.
Ik werk aan vervanging van de CIO door een meldpunt integriteitsschendingen overheid met onderzoeksbevoegdheid.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de inzet van journalisten door de veiligheidsdiensten (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether the AIVD has infiltrated political organisations since WWII, whether it was involved in activities resulting in violence, how many journalists it deploys and whether the minister knew of such activities. The minister refused to disclose operational details, stated that agents may be deployed under Wiv 2002 rules, and declined to confirm whether an infiltrant also worked as a journalist.
In public I cannot make statements about concrete operational activities, including infiltration of organisations carrying out political activities, by the AIVD or its predecessor the BVD.

In het openbaar kan ik geen mededelingen doen over concrete operationele activiteiten, waaronder begrepen infiltratie in organisaties die politieke activiteiten verrichten, van de AIVD of diens voorganger de BVD.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de manier waarop de Kamer wordt geïnformeerd over zaken betreffend

Van Raak asks why the crown prince's private payments via a tax haven were disclosed only to the Commissie IVD, why this was treated as secret, which other Royal House matters that committee discussed, and whether it is intended to keep information unwelcome to government from the public. The minister-president answers that the payments are private with no public interest affected, that the information will not be shared with the committee again, refers to the committee's annual reports for past topics, agrees the committee is not meant to suppress unwelcome information, and explains the VIRBI classification rules.
Given the private nature of the payments, I see no reason to provide further information on this to the House of Representatives.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding, gelet op het privékarakter van de betalingen, nadere informatie hierover aan de Tweede Kamer te verstrekken.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het ruimen van graven in de gemeente Ede (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

An MP asked whether Ede municipality cleared forty graves without informing all relatives, and whether bones were found afterwards. The minister replied that the law does not require notifying relatives of clearance, that the municipality follows a procedure with signs and notices, and that the municipality will return the remains for reburial.
There is no legal obligation to report the clearance to the relatives.
Er is geen wettelijke plicht om de ruiming te melden bij de nabestaanden.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Defensie over de aanpak van cyberspionage (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An MP asks why Defence will invest 90 million euros against digital attacks while Justice and Security sets up a National Cyber Security Centre, and who leads the approach to cyberespionage. The ministers answer that the activities are complementary, with Justice and Security coordinating and Defence building its own cyber capacity, and that a joint approach exists.
The mentioned activities of the ministries of Security and Justice and of Defence in the field of cyber security are complementary.
De genoemde activiteiten van de ministeries van Veiligheid en Justitie en Defensie op het terrein van cyber security zijn complementair.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verbod van brandweerlieden om kritiek te leveren (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

Van Raak asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a letter disciplining volunteer firefighters in Kennemerland for media criticism, which municipal regional management later withdrew, and about whether other regions impose similar restrictions and whether firefighters may speak to MPs and journalists directly. The Minister declines to judge the withdrawn letter, says regional registration is not central and is the employer's responsibility, agrees in principle that agreed media contact rules should be followed, and says MPs' access to firefighters' views is not affected.
Under these circumstances it is not for me to pass judgment on that letter.
Het is onder deze omstandigheden niet aan mij om een oordeel over die brief uit te spreken.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de strijd tussen de regering en de veiligheidsdienst op Curaçao (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the Curaçao government is pressuring the leadership of its security service, including calling acting heads to ministers and sending a deputy on leave, and whether the Dutch AIVD was informed and whether the Minister will investigate. The Minister answered that the Curaçao security service is the responsibility of the Curaçao government and that the Curaçao Staten, not the Dutch government, should hold it to account.
The security service of Curaçao falls under the responsibility of the government of Curaçao.
De veiligheidsdienst van Curaçao valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de regering van Curaçao.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitbreiding van het Amerikaanse oliebedrijf NuStar op Sint Eustatius

MP Van Raak (SP) asked ministers whether oil company NuStar's planned expansion on Sint Eustatius from 58 to 25-40 more tanks, its share of island land, tax-zone implications, jobs, tourism, environmental rules, resident involvement, a referendum and business promotion should be a concern. The government answered that no formal expansion request has been filed yet, that the island authority decides development direction and must weigh costs and benefits, that environmental permits (MER, MRA, VR, BBT) will apply, and that residents can consult and use appeal rights, while declining a national referendum.
The island government of Sint Eustatius is free to organise a referendum on this subject.
Het eilandbestuur van Sint Eustatius is vrij om een referendum over dit onderwerp te organiseren.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over bureaucratie bij de VtsPN (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a rule requiring police call-centre staff at VtsPN to log their reasons for unavailability, including toilet visits, and whether supervisors check this, questioning its purpose and compatibility with the bureaucracy reduction plan. The Minister said supervisors check presence rather than reasons, and that from 1 May staff will no longer need to record the reason for absence.
I will ensure that from 1 May it no longer needs to be recorded what reason the absence has.
Ik zal ervoor zorgen dat vanaf 1 mei niet meer bijgehouden hoeft te worden welke reden de afwezigheid heeft.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kritiek van de regering van Sint Maarten op het financiële toezicht (ingezonden 8 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the Sint Maarten government's failure to present a balanced budget and its criticism of financial supervision undermine agreements, and questions the Finance Minister's refusal to admit a supervisory adviser and Sint Maarten's lack of a College representative. The minister answers at length that the Cft's judgement is binding, that the budget dispute continues, that a directive (aanwijzing) is being considered, and that the Finance Minister's view on debt relief is rejected.
On 4 April I will hold a discussion with the Sint Maarten government based on the substantive judgement of the Cft.
Op 4 april zal ik een gesprek voeren met de regering van Sint Maarten op basis van het inhoudelijke oordeel van het Cft.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het versturen en ontvangen van processtukken op de Antillen (ingezonden 11 februari 2011)

An SP MP asked whether court documents can be forced to be served on Curaçao and how a case by Mrs G. was blocked when her appeal summons did not reach the defendant there. The minister replied that service is legally valid once made at the Dutch-side prosecutor's office, that the Curaçao prosecutor tried registered mail in 2008 and 2010 but the defendant refused to accept the papers, and that the government has no information on why or on any influence.
As I indicated in answer to questions 1, 2 and 7, the criterion is not whether the defendant receives the documents, but whether service was legally valid.
Zoals ik in antwoord op vragen 1, 2 en 7 heb aangegeven, is het criterium niet of gedaagde de stukken in handen krijgt, maar of er rechtsgeldig is betekend.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over slachtoffers die hulp mislopen (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice why about 15,000 crime victims miss psychological, legal and practical help, what measures will ensure all victims get help, how affected victims can still access Slachtofferhulp, and what fault in the computer system causes referral failures and why the House was not informed. The State Secretary answered that questions 1, 4 and 5 are answered in a previous reply, and that analyses show no system fault: victim data is passed on automatically when the police officer ticks that data may be forwarded.
The analyses that have been made show no indication that there is a fault in the system.
Uit de analyses die zijn gemaakt blijkt niet dat er sprake is van een fout in het systeem.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het korps Friesland dat agenten wil verhuren (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

The MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice when he learned of Friesland police's plan to rent out officers to municipalities, why this was not reported in a recent debate, who would be responsible for such officers, and how this fits the plan for a national police. The Minister replies that there is no plan by the Friesland force to rent out officers, refers to earlier answers, and states that the answers supplement those on a related earlier question.
As I indicated in answer to the questions from MP Brinkman about this report, the force has no intention of renting out officers.

Zoals ik in antwoord op de vragen van het lid Brinkman over dit bericht (Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2010–2011, nr. 2030 ) heb aangegeven is er geen voornemen van het korps om agenten te verhuren.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de brandweer Rotterdam-Rijnmond, die in de helft van de gevallen te laat komt (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the Rotterdam-Rijnmond fire service arrives late in half of incidents, how response times will be restored, what the 4.5 million euro cuts mean for coverage, and whether the minister will respond to a works council study. The minister answered that the regional board disputes the late-arrival finding, that cuts are managed by the regional board, and that the minister will not judge the regional board's decisions and has no current overview of response times in other regions.
Given the responsibility of the general board of the safety regions, laid down in the Safety Regions Act, I consider it appropriate to exercise restraint in giving a judgement.
Gezien de verantwoordelijkheid van het Algemeen Bestuur van de veiligheidsregio's, die is vastgelegd in de Wet veiligheidsregio's, past mij terughoudendheid bij het geven van een oordeel.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over bezuinigingen op de spoorwegpolitie (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the KLPD wants to close eight railway police locations, why parliament was not informed, and for the relevant documents. The minister answered that talks with the NS are exploratory, that locations with mainly office or training functions may be merged or closed to free up police capacity, that public counters will stay, and that no concrete decision has been taken yet.
The consultation between the KLPD and the NS was and is in an exploratory phase. If there is a concrete decision, I am of course willing to inform your House further.
Het overleg tussen het KLPD en de NS bevond en bevindt zich in een verkennende fase. Indien sprake is van een concreet besluit ben ik vanzelfsprekend bereid uw Kamer nader te informeren.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de beloning van de voorzitter van de Raad voor Veiligheid (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the special pay, car and chauffeur, and office renovation arrangements for the new chair of the Dutch Safety Board, and about differences with the previous chair. The minister answers that the Board is responsible for its own internal operations and gives cost figures, but declares no concern about the new chair's conduct.
The Safety Board, as an independent administrative body, is itself responsible for operational matters such as the internal layout of the building.
De onderzoeksraad is, als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan, voor bedrijfsvoeringsaangelegenheden zoals de interne inrichting van het gebouw, zelf verantwoordelijk.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over mogelijke fraude en corruptie bij de aanschaf van het nieuwe dienstpistool (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the purchase of a new police service pistol involved fraud or corruption, given links to a previously investigated pepperspray tender, and why TBM was involved. The minister answered that Rijksrecherche and Rijksauditdienst investigations found no irregularities or grounds for excluding the intermediary, and that the tender process was designed to make improper influence unlikely.

Based on the investigations by the Rijksauditdienst and the Rijksrecherche, which conducted their research independently of each other, I have concluded that no irregularities appeared during the entire tender process for the new pistol.

Op basis van het onderzoek van de Rijksauditdienst en de Rijksrecherche, die onafhankelijk van elkaar onderzoek hebben verricht, heb ik geconcludeerd dat er gedurende het gehele aanbestedingsproces van het nieuwe pistool niet gebleken is van onregelmatigheden.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de inhuur van dure externen (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

MP Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of Interior about a reported rise in costly external hires in the public sector and how the government would curb them, including long-serving 'near employees'. The Minister answered that the Atos report did not measure actual hiring growth in government, so no new measures were needed, and that existing external-hiring controls already cover these concerns.
For me, the research is therefore not a reason to adjust the control instruments for external hiring used within central government (spending norm and maximum hourly rate) or to take other measures.

Voor mij is het onderzoek derhalve geen aanleiding het sturingsinstrumentarium externe inhuur zoals dat binnen de rijksoverheid wordt gehanteerd (uitgavennorm en maximumuurtarief) aan te passen of andere maatregelen te treffen.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het feit dat SP’ers niet mogen inspreken in de raad van de gemeente Oude IJsselstreek (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Oude IJsselstreek municipality acted lawfully by barring members of political parties from speaking at council meetings, and whether other municipalities do the same and whether the minister would seek annulment. The minister answered that the council may set its own public-speaking rules under the Gemeentewet, that citizens may still speak, that no similar arrangements are known, and that no unlawfulness or public-interest breach was found, so annulment is not at issue.
I have found no evidence of conflict with the law or the general interest, so a proposal for annulment does not arise.
Van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is mij niets gebleken, zodat een voordracht tot vernietiging niet aan de orde is.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over politieauto’s zonder winterbanden (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why some police surveillance cars in several regions still lack winter tyres, which regions are involved, whether budget cuts are the cause, and whether winter tyres should be mandatory as in Germany. The Minister answered that tyre choice is up to each force, no national registry exists, the German situation is not comparable, and he will ask the KBB and RKC to draft a national guideline on winter tyres.
There is no national guideline or regulation regarding the use of winter tyres on (police) vehicles.
Er is geen landelijke richtlijn of regeling omtrent het gebruik van winterbanden bij (politie)voertuigen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over dalende misdaadcijfers (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

Mr Van Raak (SP) asked whether reports that police crime statistics may be unreliable, possibly due to backlogs in the BVH registration system, undermine the falling crime figures, and when 2010 figures would be sent. Minister Opstelten answered that the figures come largely from the CBS and are sound, acknowledged the BVH introduction may affect insight into crime, committed to asking the Algemene Rekenkamer to examine this, and said the figures remain usable for policy.
I have asked the Algemene Rekenkamer to also investigate the consequences of the introduction of the BVH for insight into crime and the associated caseload.
Ik heb de Algemene Rekenkamer gevraagd om ook onderzoek te doen naar de gevolgen van de invoering van de BVH op het inzicht in de criminaliteit en het daaraan verbonden zaaksaanbod.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat moordenaars vrijuit gaan door geldgebrek (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether unsolved murder cases are left unsolved for lack of money and capacity, how many old murder cases remain open, and which police forces have cold case teams. Minister Opstelten said he shares concern, that victims must be involved in prioritising cold cases, and that there is no national overview of unsolved murders, while listing which regions have cold case teams.
There is, however, no national overview of old murder cases that were never solved.
Er is echter geen landelijk overzicht van oude moordzaken die nooit zijn opgelost.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verzet tegen de afschaffen van de bonnenquota (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether he shares outrage over a regional police head's letter opposing the abolition of traffic-ticket quotas, and whether other force heads have objected. The minister answers that the letter was rejected, all officers in that region were asked to stop quotas, no other such approaches were received, and force heads confirm they will implement the abolition.
I replied that this way of working contains steering on ticket quotas and that this can no longer be the case.
Ik heb geantwoord dat deze werkwijze sturing op bonnenquota bevat en daarvan geen sprake meer kan zijn.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over prestatieloon voor gemeenteambtenaren (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a performance-based pay scheme for municipal civil servants in Aalten, whether similar schemes exist elsewhere, whether it complies with law, and whether unions were consulted. The minister replied that the cabinet has no control over municipal pay, which is decentralised, and that municipalities have discretion under the CAR/UWO to apply flexible pay instruments, declining to judge legality or comment further.
The cabinet has no control over the manner in which municipal civil servants are paid.
Het kabinet heeft geen zeggenschap over de wijze van beloning van de gemeenteambtenaren.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kosten voor verkiezingsborden (ngezonden 14 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether it is undesirable that Apeldoorn plans to charge political parties for placing election posting boards to save money, and which other municipalities plan the same. The minister replied that municipalities may charge cost-recovery fees under the Municipal Act, that the council decides on desirability and amount, and that he is not aware of other municipalities with such plans.
It is up to the municipal council concerned to decide on the desirability and the amount of the costs.
Het is aan de betreffende gemeenteraad om zich over de wenselijkheid en over de hoogte van de kosten uit te spreken.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bonnenquotum in Utrecht (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Utrecht are still judged on the number of traffic tickets issued, despite the abolition of ticket quotas, and what the government will do about it. State Secretary Teeven answered that quotas are undesirable, that he phoned the Utrecht mayor and police leadership who committed to dropping quotas, and that no critical signals from other forces had been received.
It is undesirable for the police to work with ticket quotas or to let the suggestion of steering through them hang over the market.
Het is ongewenst dat de politie met bonnenquota werkt of de suggestie van sturing daarmee boven de markt laat hangen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het feit dat agenten geen thermische (onder)kleding kunnen bestellen (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

MP Van Raak asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether police officers can no longer order fur hats and thermal underwear due to budget cuts, and whether the minister will reverse this and arrange quick supply with chief constables. The minister answers that officers can still order these items, that no budget cut was made, and that a new approval procedure was relaxed so thermal clothing can be ordered directly again while the fur hat procedure remains via approval.
Police officers can still order fur hats and thermal (under)clothing.
Agenten kunnen nog steeds bontmutsen en thermo (onder)kleding bestellen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over overtredingen van de Arbeidstijdenwet bij de brandweer Zuid-Limburg (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

The MP asked the minister about reported repeated breaches of the Working Hours Act by the Zuid-Limburg fire brigade, their causes, consequences for volunteers and whether the problem is national. The minister could not confirm the figure of over 100 breaches, said responsibility lies with employers and the Labour Inspectorate, and saw no reason to intensify inspections.
I cannot confirm that the Working Hours Act was breached more than 100 times between July and October 2010.
Ik kan niet bevestigen dat de Arbeidstijdenwet tussen juli en oktober 2010 meer dan 100 keer is overtreden.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over opsporingsberichtgeving en contracten tussen het Openbaar Ministerie en de media (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and prosecutors give exclusive access to investigation broadcasts through contracts, as reported by De Telegraaf, and why commercial considerations should play no role. The minister answered that contracts are permitted under the 2009 guideline on investigative broadcasting, that they do not grant exclusivity, that the choice of media is a case-by-case tactical decision, and that the new guideline already allows wider reach.
Making exclusive agreements with a media partner is not in the interest of the police and the public prosecution service.
Het maken van exclusieve afspraken met een mediapartner is niet in het belang van de politie en het openbaar ministerie.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verlof van een veroordeelde die agressie pleegde tegen politieagenten (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a Polish man convicted of attempted murder of police officers was released on leave pending appeal, whether he was still required to serve a Latvian sentence, and how he is being sought after absconding. The state secretary admitted leave was wrongly granted because the extradition information was overlooked, announced internal measures and a review, and declined to exclude such suspects from leave in principle.
It appeared that the penitentiary institution did have the extradition information, but it was wrongly not considered when weighing whether to grant the person leave.

Gebleken is dat in de penitentiaire inrichting de informatie met betrekking tot de uitlevering wel aanwezig was, maar ten onrechte niet aan de orde is geweest bij de afweging om betrokkene al dan niet verlof te verlenen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bezuinigingen bij het politiekorps Friesland (igezonden 4 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about cuts at the Friesland police force, including the loss of 144 jobs, causes of its financial problems, service impact, reduced counter access, and whether the cuts should be reversed after a motion. The minister attributed the deficit to budget reductions, wage costs and interest, said the 144 posts cut bring savings of about 8.5 million, and promised a consultation with the police board on the national intensification.
I will shortly enter into consultation with the police board council on the consequences of this intensification and how it is distributed across the forces.
Ik treed binnenkort in overleg met het korpsbeheerdersberaad over de gevolgen van deze intensivering en de wijze waarop deze over de korpsen wordt verdeeld.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de problemen rondom de screening van ministers op Curaçao en het ontslag van het hoofd van de veiligheidsdienst (ingezon

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the vetting of Curaçao ministers and the dismissal of the head of the Netherlands Antilles security service, which was investigating the Schotte cabinet's ministers. The minister replied that the security service and vetting are autonomous matters for Curaçao, that the AIVD is not involved, and that intervention would be a last resort, though he would monitor the process critically.
The direction and functioning of the Security Service is an autonomous matter, in this case of the country Curaçao.
De aansturing en het functioneren van de Veiligheidsdienst is een autonome aangelegenheid, in dit geval van het land Curaçao.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de meldkamer van het politiekorps Hollands Midden (igezonden 4 oktober 2010).

MP Van Raak asks the minister about staffing shortages at the Hollands Midden police control room, including non-police telephonists taking 112 emergency calls and unanswered calls. The minister replies that the shortage is temporary, Teleservice is a police unit with adequate experience, monitoring shows no quality loss, and the 112 line must always be reachable.
The situation is continuously monitored and there are no reasons to assume that the temporary measures taken have a negative effect on the quality of handling reports.
De situatie wordt continue gemonitord en er zijn geen redenen om aan te nemen dat de genomen tijdelijke maatregelen een negatief effect hebben op de kwaliteit van de afhandeling van meldingen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de huur van privéjets door ministers (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether ministers facing large spending cuts should be restrained in renting private jets, whether previous ministers followed the rules requiring government or defence aircraft first and coordinator-arranged charters, and whether ministers would be reminded of the rules and asked to use scheduled flights or trains. The Prime Minister answered that the decree already implies restraint, that not all flights went through the coordinator though the decree allows exceptions under ministerial responsibility, that ministers were informed in formation documents, and that each trip requires an individual assessment including safety and time.
As the various decisions taken following the RTL Nieuws freedom-of-information request show, not all flights were chartered through the flight coordinator.
Zoals uit de verschillende besluiten die zijn genomen naar aanleiding van het Wob-verzoek van RTL Nieuws blijkt, zijn niet alle vluchten ingehuurd door tussenkomst van de vluchtcoördinator.
