Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en de Vereniging Nederlandse Gemeenten (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a court ruling that the VNG (association of Dutch municipalities) is not an administrative body under the Wob, its role in ministry consultations and policy work, funding from the ministry, and whether the Wob reaches policy documents. The state secretary answered that the VNG is not an administrative body, that the ministry does not keep a full register of contacts, cited specific funded programmes, and declined to see a gap in the Wob, while promising a later overview on the Tromsø Convention.
The central government does not keep a register of all official and administrative contacts with the VNG.
Het Rijk houdt geen register bij van alle ambtelijke en bestuurlijke contacten met de VNG
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over herindelingsperikelen in Limburg (ingezonden 7 september 2010).

MP Van Raak asks the state secretary about a dispute between the municipalities of Bergen and Gennep over 180,000 euro in merger preparation costs and the legal basis of Gennep's claim. The state secretary answers that the costs relate to preparatory work for a pending merger bill, that the claim rests on article 79 of the Wet arhi, that the municipal boards must settle costs by mutual agreement, and that the province has a correct, limited role under article 79 and the Gemeentewet, with mediation falling to the province.
Under article 79, second paragraph, of the Wet arhi, the Provincial Executive has the task of promoting the reaching of mutual consultation between the municipalities concerned.
Gedeputeerde Staten hebben op grond van artikel 79, tweede lid, Wet arhi de taak om de totstandkoming van het onderling overleg te bevorderen tussen de betrokken gemeenten
Vagen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het databestand voor vingerafdrukken in paspoorten (ingezonden 22 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether known 'lookalike' ID fraud figures would be shared with parliament, how the ECtHR Marper ruling affects the Dutch passport fingerprint database, and whether a prosecutor's view that ordinary shoplifting could justify access to the fingerprint register is acceptable. The state secretary denied withholding figures (saying she does not have them), referred to earlier letters on the Marper ruling, and said prosecutor access will be set by a general administrative measure with strict conditions still to be drafted.
The prosecutor's access to the data in the travel document administration will be laid down in a general administrative measure.
De «toegang» van de officier van justitie tot de gegevens in de reisdocumentenadministratie zal worden vastgelegd in een algemene maatregel van rijksbestuur.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak (SP) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bouwleges als melkkoe voor gemeenten (ingezonden 17 august

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether building permit fees (bouwleges) are used by municipalities as a cash cow, whether fees differ widely, and whether a maximum tariff should be introduced. The government replied that fee differences are permitted as long as total fees do not exceed costs, that transparency agreements with the VNG and IPO are being evaluated in 2012, and that a statutory transparency rule will be prepared if needed.
This is not known, since no agreements have been made with municipalities on the level of tariffs.
Dit is niet bekend aangezien er zijn geen afspraken met gemeenten zijn gemaakt over de hoogte van tarieven.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken over de bezuinigingen bij het politiekorps Midden en West Brabant. (ingezonden 19 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether regional mayors were excluded from setting budget cuts for the Midden- en West-Brabant police, whether closing counters and cutting 170 staff fits local-control policy, and whether cuts should pause given a motion. The minister replied that all mayors sit on the regional college and were involved via its finance committee, that citizens can still report crimes at four walk-in locations, and that budget responsibility lies primarily with the force manager and regional college, with no commitment to halt the cuts given the caretaker cabinet.
As is known, all mayors in the region sit on the regional college.
Zoals bekend hebben alle burgemeesters in de regio zitting in het regionale college.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Justitie over het opnemen van politieverhoren (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

An MP asked how the new prosecutorial directive on audio and audiovisual recording of interrogations is monitored, how many recordings are made, why mandatory recording is limited, and whether it will be expanded. The minister replied that the directive mostly formalises existing practice, central registration is being set up, verbatim transcripts are only ordered in specific cases, and an evaluation two years after entry into force will decide on extending recording to other offence categories.
Two years after the entry into force of the Directive on audio and audiovisual recording of interrogations of complainants, witnesses and suspects, an evaluation will take place.
Twee jaar na de inwerkingtreding van de Aanwijzing auditief en audiovisueel registreren van verhoren van aangevers, getuigen en verdachten zal een evaluatie plaatsvinden.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over toepassing van de wachtgeldregeling in enkele gemeenten (ingezonden 5 augustus 2010).

MP Van Raak asks whether using the Appa unemployment benefit to top up the salaries of part-time aldermen in Hoogezand-Sappemeer and Grootegast is acceptable and whether the scheme should be amended. The State Secretary replies that the municipalities applied the statutory rules correctly, that the benefit is deliberately designed to compensate former aldermen returning part-time, and that any change is for the next cabinet and parliament to decide.
It is up to the legislature to judge the desirability of this provision in the Appa and ultimately to amend it if that judgement showed that its application in municipalities should be different.

Het is aan de wetgever om over de wenselijkheid van deze bepaling in de Appa een oordeel te geven en uiteindelijk aan te passen als uit het oordeel zou blijken dat de toepassing in gemeenten anders zou moeten.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over oneigenlijk gebruik van wachtgeld door wethouders (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

MP Van Raak asks whether part-time aldermen top up their pay with severance (wachtgeld) paid by municipalities, and whether the rules should be closed. The state secretary denies that part-time aldermen get a top-up, explains the Appa offset rule that keeps former full-time aldermen at full-time income levels, says the ministry does not track how many use it, and rejects a legal gap.
The Ministry of the Interior does not keep such data. Application of the Appa to aldermen is a municipal responsibility.
Het ministerie van BZK houdt dergelijke gegevens niet bij. De toepassing van de Appa voor wethouders is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent (GroenLinks) en Van Raak (SP) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de vakantie van Z.K.H. kroonprins Willem Alexander en H.K.H. prinses Maxima te Mozambique (ingezonden

MPs Van Gent and Van Raak asked the Prime Minister whether the Crown Prince's family's holiday in Mozambique, at a villa tied to a controversial development, is consistent with his pledge to sell the villa once finished, and whether the minister knew of the trip in advance. The Prime Minister confirmed the visit, said the couple will sell the villa after completion, said the trip was a private matter, and referred the wider constitutional question to a pending Council of State advisory opinion.
For the rest I refer to the advice I recently requested from the Council of State on the tension between articles 10, 41, 42 and 68 of the Constitution.
Voor het overige verwijs ik naar de voorlichting die ik onlangs heb gevraagd aan de Raad van State over de spanning tussen de artikelen 10, 41, 42 en 68 van de Grondwet.

Vragen van de leden Van Raak en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de aangiftestop van winkeliers die het slachtoffer zijn van winkelcriminaliteit (

Two SP MPs asked why shopkeepers increasingly do not report shoplifting, citing time cost and unclear outcomes, and asked about reporting rates, clearance rates, online reporting and police capacity. The minister acknowledged the problem, said police and business are reviewing the intake process with pilots and possible national rollout, and said prioritisation of police deployment is for the regional triangle.
The clearance rate cannot be broken down by shoplifting.
Het ophelderingspercentage kan niet worden uitgesplitst naar winkeldiefstal.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de brandveiligheid in Limburg-Zuid (ingezonden 7 juni 2010).

Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of Interior about fire safety in South Limburg, including alleged Working Time Act violations at the fire service, a plan to add 200 hours of work, and cuts to municipal fire-fighting funds. The minister said the region claims it meets legal standards, that the Labour Inspectorate issued a warning and is monitoring compliance, and that staffing, working time and budgeting are local responsibilities.
Complying with the Working Time Act is the employer's responsibility, with the Labour Inspectorate enforcing it.
Het voldoen aan de Arbeidstijdenwet is een verantwoordelijkheid van de werkgever, waarbij de Arbeidsinspectie handhavend optreedt.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Justitie over het beledigen en bedreigen van religieuze en seksuele minderheden (ingezonden 23 juni 2010).

An MP asks ministers whether threats and insults against religious and sexual minorities are increasing, whether police incident registrations have risen, and what measures will protect victims and punish perpetrators. The minister answers that antidiscrimination bureau and police figures show no national rise in antisemitic or anti-gay incidents, notes that underreporting makes trends hard to measure, and describes existing enforcement, police and monitoring measures.
The figures from the antidiscrimination bureaus do not show a national increase in antisemitism.
De cijfers van de antidiscriminatiebureaus laten geen landelijke stijging van antisemitisme zien.

m: Amendement van het lid Bashir over een verplicht verzekerde garantie ten behoeve van opdrachtgevers, gebruikers en derden
Requires a mandatory insured guarantee for private building clients as an alternative to the municipal preventive check, which is being dropped under the building quality law.
This amendment introduces a mandatory insured guarantee for clients, users and third parties as an alternative to the preventive municipal check
Dit amendement introduceert een verplicht verzekerde garantie ten behoeve van opdrachtgevers, gebruikers en derden als alternatief voor de preventieve gemeentelijk toets
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Bashir ter vervanging van nr. 9 over ten minste 5% van de herbouwwaarde in het reservefonds
Proposes that Verenigingen van Eigenaren need not make annual reserve-fund contributions once the fund holds at least 5% of the building's rebuild value.
The annual reservation does not need to take place if the reserve fund contains at least 5% of the rebuild value of the building.
De jaarlijkse reservering hoeft niet plaats te vinden indien het reservefonds ten minste 5% van de herbouwwaarde van het gebouw omvat.

Amendement van het lid Bashir dat regelt dat de wettelijke verplichting tot het maken van jaarlijkse reserveringen voor het reservefonds niet nodig is indien in het reservefonds al ten minste 5% van d
Removes the mandatory annual reserve contribution for owners' association reserve funds where the fund already holds at least 5% of the rebuilding value.
The annual reservation need not take place if the reserve fund comprises at least 5% of the rebuilding value of the building.
De jaarlijkse reservering hoeft niet plaats te vinden indien het reservefonds ten minste 5% van de herbouwwaarde van het gebouw omvat.
Amendement van de leden Van der Linde en Bashir ter vervanging van nr. 15 over aanpak van overlast door Airbnb verhuur
Amends the Airbnb-related nuisance rules so that a last (order) can also be imposed on landlords renting to non-registered occupants, and fixes a ministry reference.
The amendment provides that action against the landlord is only possible in case of serious nuisance by tenants not registered as residents
Het amendement regelt dat het aanpakken van de verhuurder alleen mogelijk is bij ernstige overlast door huurders die niet als ingezetene staan ingeschreven
Amendement van het lid Bashir over een heffingsvrije voet van 50 woningen
Raises the tax-free threshold for rental property from 25 to 50 dwellings to relieve small landlords of administrative burden.
raises the tax-free threshold from 25 to 50 dwellings
verhoogt de heffingsvrije voet van 25 naar 50 woningen
Motie van het lid Bashir over meer zeggenschap voor huurders bij de verkoop van sociale huurwoningen
Asks the government to give tenants a say (consent right) when social rental homes are sold to parties other than sitting tenants or housing corporations.
requests the government to give tenants more say when social rental homes are sold to parties other than sitting tenants or other corporations
verzoekt de regering om huurders meer zeggenschap te geven bij verkoop van sociale huurwoningen aan anderen dan de zittende huurders of andere corporaties
Motie van de leden Bashir en Van Weyenberg over gelijke behandeling in arbeidsvoorwaarden voor payrollwerknemers
Asks the government to implement the earlier Hamer motion on equal treatment of payroll workers and present proposals by 1 February 2017.
to implement and present proposals on this by 1 February 2017 at the latest
uit te voeren en hier uiterlijk 1 februari 2017 voorstellen voor te doen
Motie van het lid Bashir over duidelijke criteria en zekerheid vooraf voor ondernemers
Asks the government to quickly draw up clear criteria for the Wet DBA and give entrepreneurs advance certainty when those criteria are applied.
requests the government to draw up clear criteria as quickly as possible and, if work is done under these criteria, to give entrepreneurs advance certainty
verzoekt de regering, zo snel mogelijk duidelijke criteria op te stellen en, indien volgens deze criteria wordt gewerkt, ondernemers zekerheid vooraf te geven
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over intrekken van het wetsvoorstel Wet fiscale maatregelen rijksmonumenten en scholing
Asks the government to withdraw the bill on tax measures for listed monuments and education, rather than pursue an alternative scheme.
requests the government to withdraw the bill Wet fiscale maatregelen rijksmonumenten en scholing
verzoekt de regering, het wetsvoorstel Wet fiscale maatregelen rijksmonumenten en scholing in te trekken
Motie van de leden Grashoff en Bashir over aanscherpen van de eis voor de S&O-verklaring
Asks the government to tighten the S&O declaration requirement so innovations must be new to the Netherlands, not just the firm, to limit innovation box abuse.
requests the government to tighten the R&D declaration requirement so an innovation is at least new to the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, de eis voor een S&O-verklaring aan te scherpen zodat een innovatie ten minste «nieuw voor Nederland» is
Motie van de leden Bashir en Grashoff over monitoren van de kapitaalvlucht naar box 2
Asks the government to closely monitor capital flight from box 3 to box 2 and to act quickly with measures to stop it if needed.
requests the government to intensively monitor capital flight to box 2 and, if necessary, quickly come up with measures
verzoekt de regering, kapitaalvlucht naar box 2 intensief te monitoren en zo nodig snel met maatregelen te komen
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over een gesprek met veldpartijen over financiële steun voor het onderhouden van rijksmonumenten
Asks the government to consult stakeholders on financial support for listed monuments and training without treating a cut as the starting point.
requests the government to enter into talks with stakeholders on the design of financial support for maintaining listed monuments
verzoekt de regering, met veldpartijen in gesprek te gaan om de vormgeving van financiële ondersteuning voor het onderhouden van rijksmonumenten
Amendement van de leden Bashir en Gesthuizen over het niet verlengen van de eerste schijf in de Vpb
Replaces the corporate tax rate tables so the first bracket's rate is cut to 19.5%, 19.1% and 18.75% instead of the planned extension of the 20% first bracket.
Therefore it is proposed to reverse the gradual extension of the first tax bracket in the Corporate Income Tax Act 1969.
Daarom wordt voorgesteld om de stapsgewijze verlenging van de eerste tariefschijf in de Wet vpb 1969 terug te draaien.
Amendement van de leden Bashir en Van Gerven over het indexeren van de accijns op tabaksproducten
Proposes restoring automatic annual indexation of tobacco excise duties for cigarettes and fine-cut tobacco, dropping the bill's plan to end it.
The Tax Plan drops the current annual excise adjustment, so tobacco excise is no longer automatically indexed.
In het Belastingplan worden de huidige jaarlijkse accijnsaanpassing losgelaten waardoor de tabaksaccijnzen niet meer automatisch geïndexeerd worden
Amendement van het lid Bashir over het verlagen van de verhuurderheffing
Lowers the landlord levy rate and raises the corporate tax rate on the second bracket, so housing corporations can cut social rents.
This amendment makes possible a rent reduction for social tenants of housing corporation homes.
Dit amendement maakt een huurverlaging voor sociale huurders van woningcorporatiewoningen mogelijk.
Amendement van de leden Grashoff en Bashir over het verhogen van de algemene heffingskorting en ouderenkorting
Amendment raising the general tax credit and elderly credit and adjusting tax brackets, funded by lowering the third bracket threshold; a tax policy change without a check on the executive.
that the maximum general tax credit rises by 250 euro compared with the bill.
dat de maximale algemene heffingskorting ten opzichte van het wetsvoorstel met € 250 omhoog gaat
Motie van de leden Bashir en Van Vliet over de LTV-limiet voor 2017 behouden
Asks the government to keep the maximum loan-to-value ratio at 102% for 2017 in the temporary mortgage credit regulation.
requests the government to include in the temporary mortgage credit regulation that the LTV stays at 102% for 2017
verzoekt de regering, in de Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet op te nemen dat de LTV voor 2017 behouden blijft op 102%
Motie van de leden Ronnes en Bashir over aard en omvang van het inhuren van voormalig rijksambtenaren
Asks the government to inform the House every two months about the nature and scale of rehiring former central government employees.
requests the government to inform the House every two months about the nature and scale of hiring former employees of the central government
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer tweemaandelijks te informeren over aard en omvang van het inhuren van voormalige medewerkers van het Rijk
Motie van het lid Bashir over het wettelijk mogelijk maken van een huurverlaging
Asks the government to make a rent reduction for social housing legally possible by lowering the landlord levy and financing it with a corporate tax increase.
requests the government to take a first step towards rent reductions by lowering rents of social housing units
verzoekt de regering om, een eerste stap te zetten voor huurverlagingen door de huren van corporatiewoningen te verlagen
Motie van het lid Bashir over geen bezuiniging op de Huurcommissie doorvoeren
Asks the government not to cut funding for the Huurcommissie while talks on its efficiency are ongoing, protecting an independent tenant dispute body.
not to carry out a cut to the Huurcommissie as long as talks on a more efficient way of working are ongoing
geen bezuiniging op de Huurcommissie door te voeren zolang de gesprekken over een efficiëntere werkwijze van de Huurcommissie nog gaande zijn
Motie van de leden Schouten en Bashir over het laten vervallen van de bestuursverklaring voor mensen in doorstroomwoningen
Asks the government to abolish the administrative declaration (bestuursverklaring) for people moving into transitional housing via reception institutions and amend the implementing decree.
to abolish the administrative declaration for people in transitional housing via social reception institutions
de bestuursverklaring voor mensen in doorstroomwoningen via maatschappelijke opvanginstellingen te laten vervallen
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over niet opleggen van naheffingen tenzij de opdrachtgever duidelijk niet van goede wil is
Asks the government not to impose back-payment assessments on clients unless the client is clearly not acting in good faith.
requests the government not to impose back-payment assessments unless the client clearly is not acting in good faith
verzoekt de regering om geen naheffingen op te leggen, tenzij de betreffende opdrachtgever duidelijk niet van goede wil is
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over voor 1 november een voortgangsrapportage aan de Kamer sturen
Asks the government to send a progress report by 1 November and a final report and status update on the DBA law by 12 December, with a decision on the law's progress.
requests the government to send a progress report on 1 November
verzoekt de regering, op 1 november een voortgangsrapportage te sturen
Motie van het lid Bashir c.s. over uitvoeren van de motie-Hamer over gelijke behandeling bij de arbeidsvoorwaarden voor payrollwerknemers
Asks the government to implement the earlier motion-Hamer on equal working conditions for payroll workers and present proposals by 31 December 2016.
requests the government to implement the motie-Hamer on equal treatment in working conditions for payroll workers and to present proposals for this by 31 December 2016.
verzoekt de regering, de motie-Hamer over gelijke behandeling bij de arbeidsvoorwaarden voor payrollwerknemers uit te voeren en hier uiterlijk 31 december 2016 voorstellen voor te doen
Motie van de leden Bashir en Van Weyenberg over uiterlijk per 1 december wegwerken van de achterstanden in de beoordeling van contracten
Asks the government to clear the backlog in assessing contracts under the DBA law by 1 December, to reduce uncertainty for self-employed workers.
requests the government to clear the backlogs in the assessment of contracts by 1 December at the latest
verzoekt de regering, de achterstanden in de beoordeling van contracten uiterlijk per 1 december weg te werken
Motie van het lid Bashir over een oproep aan de minister om te stoppen met symboolwetgeving
Calls on the minister to stop enacting symbolic legislation and focus on ensuring enough affordable housing.
Motie van de leden van Bashir en Ronnes over het afzien van het opnemen van een markttoets in de AMvB
Asks the government to drop a market test, in any form, from the general administrative order enabling temporary expansion of housing associations' work areas to house permit holders.
requests the government to refrain from including a market test, in any form
verzoekt de regering, af te zien van het opnemen van een markttoets, in welke vorm dan ook

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de hypotheekrenteaftrek die in sommige gevallen een hypotheekrentebijtelling blijkt

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance to confirm that a taxpayer in the fourth bracket can end up with a net mortgage-interest addition under the eigen woning tariff measure, and whether this is intended. The State Secretary confirms the calculation, explains the phased reduction of the deduction rate, notes that fiscal partner allocation or not filing is not a practical escape, and states the measure was deliberately designed to apply only a lower rate to deductible costs.

The measure therefore intends that the benefits from owner-occupied housing are not taxed at a different rate than the table rate, but only that a lower rate applies to the amount of deductible costs.

Met de maatregel is derhalve beoogd de voordelen uit eigen woning niet tegen een ander tarief dan het tabeltarief te belasten, maar uitsluitend een lager tarief toe te passen op het bedrag van de aftrekbare kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over mogelijke privacyrisico’s in de online belastingaangifte

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority records and retains every edit a taxpayer makes in the online tax return, and on what legal basis, after a privacy complaint by the Taxpayers' Association. The State Secretary answered that only the current state of the return is stored, with prior versions overwritten, and that only process login data is retained for up to 18 months for monitoring, proof and service purposes, with no use for enforcement.
Operations the taxpayer performs before formally submitting the return are not collected or stored.
Bewerkingen die de belastingplichtige uitvoert voor het formeel insturen van de aangifte worden niet verzameld of bewaard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Bashir over schijnconstructies bij de aanleg van de Centrale As in Friesland

MPs Karabulut and Bashir asked whether sham self-employment and underpayment in building the Centrale As road in Friesland, and the Inspectorate's findings, would be addressed by enforcement, a review of provincial tendering rules, and back pay for workers. The minister replied that the courts must decide on employment status and back pay, that the Tax Authority will not comment on individuals, and that the province as main contractor can be held to account and has pledged to act.
The province of Friesland can be called upon in its role as main contracting authority to put matters in order.
De provincie Friesland kan in haar rol van hoofdopdrachtgever aangesproken worden om orde op zaken te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de ongevraagde voorlopige aanslag 2017 en de vermogensrendementsheffing

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the 2017 provisional assessment and the box 3 wealth tax, including the forfait return used for savers, whether a box 3 shift to BVs occurs, and whether the Tax Service tackles advisory firms offering loopholes. The State Secretary defended the 2.871% forfait return as attainable with a savings-investment mix, said data cannot trace box 3 money moving into BVs, and stated that advisers are monitored with possible fines or prosecution.
The Tax Service systems cannot trace whether capital contributed to BVs originates from box 3.
Uit de systemen van de Belastingdienst valt niet te herleiden of in bv’s ingebracht vermogen afkomstig is uit box 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het tekort aan aangepaste woningen en  ouderenwoningen

An SP MP asked the Minister about a shortage of affordable and accessible housing for seniors and people with disabilities, the waiting times for such homes, and whether the removal of accessibility rules in the building code would reduce supply. The Minister replied that housing corporations have ample financial means to lower rents and build more, that waiting times for seniors are one to three years, that local agreements are the main route, and that the existing accessibility requirements are carried over unchanged into the new building regulation.
The annual increase or decrease in the number of adapted and senior housing units in the social rental sector is not tracked.
De jaarlijkse toe- of afname van het aantal aangepaste- en ouderenwoningen in de sociale huursector wordt niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het terugbetalen van een toeslagschuld na een scheiding

MP Bashir asks why only the toeslag applicant, not the ex-partner, is approached by the Tax Administration to repay a childcare/benefit debt after separation, and whether the problem is known. The State Secretary explains the applicant is legally liable under the Awir, the ex-partner is jointly liable but only pursued when needed, and the applicant can recover payments from the ex-partner via regress.
Under the Awir the (ex-)partner is jointly and severally liable for the benefit debt, meaning the Tax Administration can personally hold him or her liable for payment.

De (ex-)partner is op grond van de Awir hoofdelijk aansprakelijk voor de toeslagschuld, hetgeen inhoudt dat hij persoonlijk door de Belastingdienst kan worden aangesproken op het voldoen van de schuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over nieuwe voorrangsregels bij een Amsterdamse woningcorporatie die leiden tot verzet bij huurders

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing why housing corporation De Key changed its statutes to prioritise students and starters without involving tenants, and why the minister approved this despite the municipality's objection. The minister replied that the tenant council was consulted under the Wohv, that the statutes meet the Woningwet requirements, and that municipalities cannot file formal objections but can use performance agreements and allocation ordinances.
Submission of a view by the municipality is not a requirement for the Aw to process a request for a statutory amendment.
Afgifte van zienswijze door de gemeente is geen vereiste voor het in behandeling nemen van een aanvraag statutenwijziging door de Aw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de ontwikkeling van huurprijzen

An SP MP asks the housing minister to explain a large rent increase for a small Amsterdam (De Pijp) dwelling over 1994-2016, including a year-by-year account, and whether scarcity points introduced in 2011 should be removed from the rent points system instead of being offset against WOZ values. The minister attributes the rise to successive changes in the WWS rent points system, notes that the example would largely not apply to a pre-war dwelling and that the rise is far above the national average, and states that scarcity points were abolished in October 2015 while the maximum rent per point was adjusted to keep average earning capacity.
As indicated in the letter to the House of Representatives of 21 November 2014, the scarcity points were abolished with the amendment of the WWS that took effect on 1 October 2015.

Zoals is aangegeven in de brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 21 november 2014 (Kamerstuk 27 926, nr. 237 ) zijn de schaarstepunten vervallen met de wijziging van het WWS die per 1 oktober 2015 in werking trad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de reis van de Minister naar Azië om beleggers naar de Nederlandse huursector te lokken

An SP MP asks the Minister for Housing why he travelled to Southeast Asia to attract investors into the Dutch rental sector, questioning the choice of region, the goals, the role of housing associations and the costs. The minister answers that the trip aimed at starting long-term contacts rather than concluding deals, that sales of association homes are governed by rules and local decisions, that he will inform parliament before summer, and that private sector bodies paid their own costs.
Yes, I will inform you about that before the summer.
Ja, ik zal u voor de zomer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de openbare gegevens in het kadaster

MP Bashir asked ministers about publicly accessible personal data in the Kadaster after a broadcast showed how easily identity numbers and marriage details could be obtained. The minister defends the openness of the registers for legal certainty, notes that searching by person requires a subscription or written request, and says the government will review the balance with privacy and safety and consult the Dutch Data Protection Authority.

I will therefore consult with the Kadaster to examine whether the current balance between accessibility in the interest of legal certainty on the one hand and protection of personal data, including security aspects, on the other is still appropriate.

Ik zal daarom in overleg met het Kadaster bezien of de huidige balans tussen toegankelijkheid in het belang van de rechtszekerheid enerzijds en bescherming van de persoonsgegevens inclusief veiligheidsaspecten anderzijds nog steeds passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over jonge statushouders die gaan studeren

MPs Bashir, Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked the Minister about poor coordination between COA and municipalities that leaves student housing for young refugees underused, and about how the gaps in study guidance and information will be addressed. The Minister replied that municipalities are responsible for housing, that the Rijk has introduced early screening of refugees' education and work background, and that study guidance is a task of the educational institutions, with specialised support from UAF.
Municipalities are responsible for the housing of refugee status holders.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de huisvesting van statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Leijten over het bericht dat er meer mensen onder de brug slapen

MPs Bashir and Leijten asked the government about reports of more people sleeping under a bridge in Rotterdam, rising homelessness, and the causes and policy response. The state secretary answered that causes of homelessness are diverse, that responsibility for shelter capacity lies mainly with municipalities, and listed measures such as housing reforms, a Platform31 experiment and a quality framework, without giving a full account of why earlier policy failed.
Responsibility for shelter capacity and for the flow from shelters into housing therefore lies at these levels (municipal and regional).
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de capaciteit in opvangcentra en de doorstroom vanuit de centra naar huisvesting ligt dan ook op deze niveaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad dat ZZP’ers hun huur kunnen aftrekken

MP Bashir (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Supreme Court ruling that self-employed people can deduct rent for a home office, including questions on who qualifies, budgetary cost, retroactivity and whether the rules will be changed. The State Secretary answered that the ruling has no retroactive effect, estimated the current cost at about 20 million euros with possible growth, and announced an amendment in the Belastingplan 2017 to align rented and owned home-office treatment, offset by a higher deduction percentage for mixed costs.
I do not consider the outcome of the ruling of 12 August 2016 balanced and therefore I am preparing an amendment note within the Belastingplan 2017 package.
Om voormelde redenen acht ik de uitkomst van het arrest van 12 augustus 2016 niet evenwichtig en daarom bereid ik in het kader van het pakket Belastingplan 2017 een nota van wijziging voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over belastingrente

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the asymmetry in tax interest: interest is charged on a reclaimed tax credit but not paid on a refund from backward loss offset, and about the falling amounts of interest paid since the regime changed. The State Secretary declined to comment on a pending Supreme Court case, defended the deliberate legislative choice, and largely answered the factual questions with figures, though he refused to reconsider the regime.
As long as cases are before the courts, it is not appropriate or desirable to give a judgment on them.
Zolang zaken onder de rechter zijn, is het niet gepast en gewenst om daarover een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over onduidelijkheid over hoofdverblijf bij huurwoningen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about unclear rules on what counts as a main residence (hoofdverblijf) in rented homes, after a family was evicted by a housing corporation for living abroad. The minister answered that the case is still before the courts, that the concept is not defined in law but shaped by case law, and that the judge decides, while corporations should clarify their expectations to tenants.
Ultimately it is up to the judge to assess whether there is a main residence or not.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te beoordelen of sprake is van hoofdverblijf of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de buitensporige belastingdruk voor eenverdieners

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the high tax burden on single-earner households, including the Reformatorisch Dagblad calculations that a rise in gross pay can leave net income unchanged or lower, and asked whether the government would propose measures to make work pay for single earners. The State Secretary disputed the newspaper's figures, said net income rises with higher gross pay though marginal pressure is high due to benefit phase-outs, stated the government will decide on income measures after the summer based on the latest forecasts, and offered no concrete new proposal.

The cabinet will decide after the summer, based on the latest purchasing power figures in the Macro Economic Outlook, whether there is a need to take measures to improve the purchasing power of specific groups.

Het kabinet zal na de zomer op basis van de meest recente cijfers over de koopkracht, die zijn opgenomen in de Macro Economische Verkenning, besluiten of er een noodzaak is maatregelen te nemen om de koopkracht van specifieke groepen te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Gesthuizen over digitale platforms voor verhuur van woningen aan toeristen, zoals Airbnb en Wimdu

Two SP MPs asked the Ministers for Housing and Economic Affairs about short-term tourist rental of homes via platforms like Airbnb, including whether social rental homes may be rented out and whether a notification duty is needed. Minister Blok answered that social housing must not be used for tourist rental, that existing laws (Huisvestingswet, Woningwet, Wro) already give municipalities enough enforcement tools, and that no notification duty is planned for now, while the government is working on a tax-data provision and on local agreements with platforms.
Due to privacy considerations, there is currently no possibility to oblige Airbnb to provide the data of providers or users of its services to the government.
In verband met de privacy is er op dit moment geen mogelijkheid om Airbnb te verplichten de gegevens van aanbieders of gebruikers van hun diensten aan de overheid te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet en Bashir over het bericht dat het Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw de woningwet blokkeert

MPs Van Vliet and Bashir asked whether the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw is blocking housing corporations from splitting their social (DAEB) and commercial (non-DAEB) activities, and why it requires mortgage power over all property. The minister replied that corporations must submit splitting proposals to the Aw by 1 January 2017, that no proposals had yet been filed, that WSW's collateral demands are meant for financial stress, and that WSW will publish conditions for releasing collateral, with no risk fee charged in 2017.
WSW requests a power of attorney over all collateral because in situations of financial stress the value of the underlying collateral can drop quickly.
Het WSW vraagt volmacht op al het onderpand, omdat in situaties van financiële stress de waarde van het onderliggende onderpand snel terug kan lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over huurverlaging bij inkomensdaling

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked why housing corporations need not reduce rents when tenants' incomes fall, and why the government does not expand rent reductions after income decline. The minister replied that the law already allows tenants with income falling after income-dependent rent increases to request a reduction, that he is not willing to widen this, and that he will survey corporations on how often reductions were granted.
In the committee debate of 25 May 2016 I committed to asking the housing corporations this autumn how often they have lowered the rent at the tenant's request due to income decline.

In het AO Diverse woononderwerpen van 25 mei 2016 heb ik toegezegd dat ik dit najaar bij de woningcorporaties ga navragen hoe vaak zij de huurprijs op voorstel van de huurder wegens inkomensdaling hebben verlaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over opvallende vastgoeddeals van ING

MPs asked the ministers whether they were involved in, or aware of, questionable real estate deals by ING and how housing corporation Rochdale could lose 35 million euro on the sale of the Frankemaheerd office building to ING. The minister answered that the deals are private transactions outside state pre-approval, that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties found Rochdale acted within the rules, and that the sale price reflected a long, difficult process, while stating ING and Rochdale did not know of an 18 million option.
I note that these are agreements between private parties.
Ik stel vast dat het hier om overeenkomsten gaat tussen private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smaling over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst een bom legt onder gratis OV voor ouderen

MPs Bashir and Smaling asked whether the Tax Authority should bring free public transport for elderly residents under the VAT compensation fund and why it targets Capelle aan den IJssel. The state secretary replied that providing free transport is a municipal choice, that the VAT compensation law excludes benefits given to individual third parties such as transport cards, and that the Capelle audit was routine supervision.
Whether or not to provide public transport free of charge is a decision made by decentralised governments.
Het al dan niet gratis verstrekken van OV is een afweging, die door decentrale overheden wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Bashir over het feit dat ouderparen waarvan één partner ernstig ziek is fiscaal ongelijk behandeld worden

MPs Siderius and Bashir (SP) asked whether couples where one partner is seriously ill are unfairly treated by the tax system compared with single parents, given lower child benefit and a higher tax burden, and whether they will be compensated. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the comparison is partial, that income support for the chronically ill runs through other schemes and municipal SMI, that the combination credit is a participation tool not meant for income support, and that the SMI policy will be reviewed with a vision letter this autumn.
There is no question of exclusion from income support for couples in which one partner is seriously ill.
Er is geen sprake van uitsluiting van inkomensondersteuning voor ouderparen waarvan één partner ernstig ziek is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over vochtproblemen of schimmel in huis

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about mould and damp in homes, citing reports of widespread problems and corporations' claims they lack funds for maintenance. The minister answered that corporations are responsible for their stock, that tenants can turn to the Huurcommissie, courts or municipality, and that no additional national measures are needed.
I therefore see no reason to assign myself a larger role.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden mijzelf een grotere rol toe te dichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Bashir en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat driekwart van de studenten teveel huur betaalt

MPs Bashir and Van Dijk asked the Minister for Housing about an LSVb survey finding that 74% of students pay too much rent, and about enforcement, local rent-check teams and how the Rent Tribunal's rulings were communicated. The Minister replied that betaalbaarheid is on the platform's agenda and in the monitor, that municipalities decide on rent teams, that Rent Tribunal rulings were published in a public register, and that existing information and rent-check tools suffice, so no additional measures are planned.
I see no need to take additional measures for this target group.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om voor deze doelgroep aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Bashir over een BTW- constructie bij de schadeafwikkeling van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a VAT construction in compensation for Groningen earthquake damage, where NAM allegedly deducted VAT on property purchases and payments went to a NAM-chosen notary. The State Secretary answered that tax confidentiality (art. 67 AWR) prevents answering the case-specific questions, while answering general VAT rules on compensation, invoicing and the Supreme Court ruling of 2015, and announced withdrawal of a 2011 tolerance decision.
Given the tax confidentiality obligation, it is not possible to give you information about a specific taxpayer.
Gelet op de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht is het niet mogelijk aan u informatie over een specifieke belastingplichtige te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smaling over het energiezuinig maken van huurwoningen en het voordeel voor huurders

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Housing about the Amsterdam audit office's recommendation on energy-saving measures in social rental housing, the gap between expected and actual energy savings, and whether tenants financially benefit from energy renovations and an energy performance fee. The minister said the audit office did not recommend reconsidering specific measures, that municipalities have discretion and tools, declined to give a general figure on tenant costs, and rejected a mandatory rent-cost guarantee.
I cannot state in general terms what the financial advantage or disadvantage is for tenants when their home is made energy-efficient.
Ik kan niet in algemene zin aangeven wat het financiële voor- of nadeel is voor huurders wanneer hun woning energiezuinig wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de uitvoering van de motie over belasten van het werkelijk rendement op vermogen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance, in 13 questions, what has been done to implement the motion on taxing actual returns on wealth, how the Tax Authority's investment agenda and pre-filled tax return constrain such legislation, and what obstacles financial institutions face. The State Secretary answered that a study is ongoing, a progress report will follow on Prinsjesdag, and that feasibility and data questions cannot yet be settled.
On Prinsjesdag this year you will receive a progress report on this study.
Op Prinsjesdag dit jaar ontvangt u een voortgangsrapportage van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het opkrikken van de huurprijs door gesjoemel met de energie-index

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing whether the energy-index used to set rents, and the data behind it, should be disclosed to tenants on request, and why the sample check and 8% margin were considered adequate. The minister opposed a mandatory disclosure duty, pointed tenants to the Huurcommissie for disputes, and said quality assurance lies with the certification system, with an audit already underway.
No, I am not in favour of this obligation.
Nee, ik ben niet voor deze verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over onduidelijkheid en onwetendheid bij gemeenten over de nieuwe Woningwet

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about municipalities' unpreparedness and knowledge gaps regarding the new Housing Act (Woningwet), citing BMC and Binnenlands Bestuur research. The Minister replied that information provision, handbooks, congresses and tools have been offered, that municipalities are responsible for their own role and tenant participation, and that a fuller picture of housing visions will follow at end 2016.
The Ministry of BZK facilitates municipalities by making the relevant financial housing-corporation information available in an accessible way.
Het Ministerie van BZK faciliteert gemeenten door de relevante financiële corporatie-informatie overzichtelijk ter beschikking te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over een proefschrift over de wijkaanpak

An SP MP asked the minister for Housing and Central Government Affairs about a TU Delft PhD thesis on housing corporations' role in neighbourhood renewal, probing market-versus-state tensions, consolidation, tenant participation and the role of the WRR advice. The minister replied that the Woningwet 2015 clearly delineates corporations' neighbourhood liveability role, that effects cannot yet be assessed, and that municipalities should lead local neighbourhood policy.
It is too early to make statements about the effects of the Housing Act.
Het is te vroeg om uitspraken te doen over de effecten van de Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over zeer kleine woningcorporaties

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about a Platform 31 report on very small housing associations, their definitions, the role of tenant bodies in the advice given, whether mergers and outsourcing could raise rents, the continued support for these associations, and the landlord levy. The Minister replied that the report reflects strategies of participants rather than advice, that the Woningwet implementation is the associations' own responsibility, that the levy paid by very small associations totals about 10 million euro, and that he will not abolish the levy for them but will address their position in its evaluation.
In the evaluation of the landlord levy I will also pay attention to the position of smaller housing associations.
Bij de evaluatie van de verhuurderheffing zal ik ook aandacht besteden aan de positie van kleinere woningcorporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over verrekenen van toeslagen en uiterste aanvraagdatum van toeslagen

MP Bashir asked the State Secretary of Finance whether benefit clawback (dwangverrekening) only applies to benefit debts, when it occurs, whether other debts can trigger it, and why the 1 September application deadline exists. The State Secretary answered that clawback applies only to benefit debts after a payment arrangement fails, that the tax authority offers a standard 24-month plan and individual arrangements, that payments can be suspended under the Awir for address doubts, and that he sees no need to change the 1 September deadline or the rules.
Offsetting of benefits under this power only arises where there is a benefit debt and not where there is a tax debt.
Verrekening van toeslagen op grond van deze bevoegdheid is alleen aan de orde als er sprake is van een toeslagschuld en niet als er sprake is van een belastingschuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over fiscale trucs voor vermogenden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax schemes allowing wealthy people to reduce tax by moving savings from box 3 into a BV or business account, the use of loss relief, dga salaries, and the business succession facility. The State Secretary answered that business accounts do not escape wealth tax under the asset-labelling doctrine, that data on such cases is unavailable, and that the succession facility's evaluation is still being studied.
It is not possible to determine with the available data how much use is made of this and what the budgetary impact is.
Het is niet mogelijk om met de beschikbare data te bepalen hoeveel hiervan gebruik wordt gemaakt en wat het budgettair beslag is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het ontduiken van btw-regels door internetbedrijven die zich op de Nederlandse markt richten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how VAT on electronic services sold to Dutch consumers by foreign providers is collected, whether foreign providers face the same VAT-number and payment-provider obligations as Dutch firms, and whether online ad sales fall under electronic services. The State Secretary answered that foreign providers can register via the one-stop shop (about 3,000 per quarter in 2015, roughly 50 million euro net), that the Tax Authority supervises through risk-based enforcement, that there is no unfair competition, and declined to meet payment providers.
As indicated above, there is no unfair competition between domestic and foreign entrepreneurs.
Zoals hiervoor is aangegeven is er geen sprake van oneerlijke concurrentie tussen binnenlandse en buitenlandse ondernemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het opkrikken van de huurprijs door een hoog energielabel

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about a case where an old rental home received a high energy label that raised the rent, and about how rent-related energy assessments are verified and whether fraud occurs. The minister said the Energy-Index is set by certified advisers, tenants can get the underlying data or appeal to the Huurcommissie, fraud is only a matter for courts, and only a few adjustments occurred in four years.
The judge will rule on the nature of the evidence documents in a court case.
Over de aard van de bewijsstukken in een rechtszaak zal de rechter een uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Bashir over de voortgang van de aanpak van koopkrotten in Rotterdam Zuid

The SP MP Bashir asked the Minister for Housing about delays in tackling roughly 10,000 privately owned dilapidated homes in Rotterdam-Zuid, the funding gap of about EUR 40 million, and whether tenants and housing corporations should be shielded from paying for it. The Minister acknowledged the delay and disagreement between the municipality and corporations, said the national government is supporting the process, promised to inform parliament before 1 April 2016 on the motion implementation, and confirmed the 10,000-home ambition remains.
Before 1 April 2016 I will inform the House about this.
Vóór 1 april 2016 zal ik uw kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het tekort aan huurwoningen voor statushouders en andere woningzoekenden

The MP Bashir (SP) asked the Minister for Housing about the shortage of rental homes for refugees with residence permits and other housing seekers, including why monthly placements fell and how many are waiting. The Minister answered that municipalities are on track to meet their quota, that the figure of 23,400 is the half-year quota rather than people waiting, and that he sees no need for extra measures such as halting sales or demolition of social housing.
Therefore I see at this moment no reason to take additional measures, such as those proposed in question 9.
Derhalve zie ik op dit moment geen reden om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen, zoals die in vraag 9 worden voorgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Bashir over een mogelijke btw-deal bij de schadeafwikkeling van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs Smaling and Bashir asked whether a VAT integration-supply or other VAT arrangement applies to earthquake damage settlements in Groningen, why NAM routes payments via notaries, and how VAT treatment works for the Groninger Forum. The minister declined to comment on any specific VAT ruling, citing the tax inspector's exclusive competence and secrecy, described the general VAT deduction rules, and said NAM follows a standard settlement and deposit procedure without commenting on individual cases.
The tax inspector has the exclusive, statutorily established competence to rule on this arrangement.
Het is de exclusieve, wettelijk vastgelegde bevoegdheid van de belastinginspecteur om een uitspraak te doen over deze constructie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de papieren werkelijkheid van passend toewijzen

MP Bashir asks the minister why, in his view, the 95% fit-allocation norm for housing corporations is unworkable and whether the norm should be relaxed or its interaction with the planned rent-harmonisation system addressed. The minister rejects the claim that the norm is unworkable or should be relaxed, argues corporations can meet it through careful allocation and rent setting, and declines to provide sanction and regional compliance figures before the 2017 budget debate, pointing to the 2016 reporting cycle.
Unfortunately it is not possible for me to provide the requested data for the 2017 budget debate.
Het is mij helaas niet mogelijk om de gevraagde gegevens te verstrekken voor de begrotingsbehandeling 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de dreigende kaalslag in de huursector in Rotterdam

An SP MP asks the housing minister about Rotterdam's plan to cut 20,000 social rental homes via demolition or renovation pushing rents above the liberalisation limit, and whether the government was consulted. The minister replies that housing policy is a municipal matter, that residents and housing associations have consultation and agreement routes, and that the municipal housing vision is still a draft.
It is not my role to respond substantively to the plans.
Het is niet mijn rol om inhoudelijk op de plannen te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Van Raak over het bericht dat er ruim zes ton is betaald aan een ex-topman van een woningcorporatie

MPs Bashir and Van Raak asked the ministers about reports that a former housing corporation executive received over six hundred thousand euros, and whether this was a sham consultancy arrangement harming tenants. The minister replied that the severance was allowed under a court ruling, that no sham arrangement was found since a real change of board occurred, and that the government will consider WNT extension and tackle such constructions in the evaluation process.

A sham construction exists when a top executive of an organisation falling under the WNT changes function and in name no longer acts as executive but de facto still leads the organisation, in order to obtain a higher salary than allowed.

Van een schijnconstructie is sprake als een topbestuurder van een organisatie die onder de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) valt, van functie wisselt en in naam niet meer als bestuurder optreedt maar de facto nog steeds leiding geeft aan de organisatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bashir over de weinig coulante houding van de Belastingdienst bij vermissingszaken

MPs Van Nispen and Bashir asked why the Tax Administration persisted with a payment order and showed little leniency toward the relatives of a missing taxpayer, and whether it follows a protocol for missing persons. The State Secretary acknowledged the handling was regrettable, described an ongoing protocol with Slachtofferhulp Nederland and a planned verification via the national missing persons register.

The letter the trustee sent to the Tax Administration should have led to immediately blocking all ongoing activities and pursuing settlement of outstanding tax matters in consultation with the trustee.

De brief die de bewindvoerder aan de Belastingdienst heeft gestuurd, had ertoe moeten leiden alle lopende activiteiten onmiddellijk te blokkeren en in overleg met de bewindvoerder afwikkeling van lopende belastingaangelegenheden na te streven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over het gemak van inbraken bij sociale huurwoningen

MPs Kooiman and Bashir (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Housing about burglary risks in social rental housing, including the share of doors and windows with weak locks and whether the government will fund better protection. Minister Van der Steur answered that prevention is locally led and primarily the responsibility of residents and landlords, announced a 2 million euro co-financed fund for hotspot neighbourhoods, and said no national data on burglaries in social rental housing are kept.
No national figures are kept on the number of burglaries in social rental housing.
Over het aantal inbraken bij sociale huurwoningen worden landelijk geen cijfers bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Van Gerven over het onderschatte gevaar van koolmonoxide

MPs Bashir and Van Gerven asked the ministers about the underestimated carbon monoxide danger identified by the Safety Board, including modern boilers being involved, mandatory inspections, detector testing, and public information. The minister replied that a cabinet position would be sent in spring 2016, acknowledged that modern appliances are involved in many incidents, rejected mandatory inspections for now, and defended existing rules while deferring most concrete measures to the forthcoming cabinet position.
The minister of VWS and I are currently working on a cabinet position that will respond to the report.
Momenteel werken de minster van VWS en ik aan een kabinetsstandpunt waarin een reactie op het rapport wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over het bericht dat huurverhogingen leiden tot armoede

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked whether rent increases cause poverty and whether the government will curb rents and help affected tenants. The minister answered that income drops drive payment problems, that the rent-cap agreement and bill are in progress, refused a rent freeze, and pointed the tenant to rent reduction and housing-allocation options.
No, I am not willing to oblige landlords to freeze rents.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid verhuurders te verplichten de huren te bevriezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over huurbemiddelaars die nog steeds onterechte kosten in rekening brengen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing whether the government and ACM are aware that some rental intermediaries still charge tenants illegal double brokerage fees, what will be done, whether DirectWonen really works only for tenants, how many brokers go bankrupt and restart to avoid refund claims, and whether the minister will meet brokers and trade associations to urge refunds. The minister replied that ACM is aware and will enforce against collective violations, that existing law already prevents such fees and allows bankruptcy curators and director liability to be used, and that talks with trade associations would have little use since offending brokers are often not members.
I do not have figures on the number of brokers that declare bankruptcy or cease their business to continue it in another legal entity.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers van de aantallen bemiddelaars die zich failliet laten verklaren of hun bedrijf staken om het in een andere rechtspersoon voort te zetten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over een aanpassing van de Stimuleringsregeling Energieprestatie Huursector (STEP-regeling)

The SP MP Bashir asks whether Minister Blok will simplify the STEP scheme for energy improvements in rented flats and what the status is of its low uptake in the four largest cities, which the minister had promised to investigate. The minister replies that no specific barriers were found in the big cities, that lower uptake reflects local trade-offs between rent, investment and maintenance, and that he will explore improvements with stakeholders and report in spring 2016.
This consultation has now shown that there are no specific obstacles to using the scheme in those municipalities.
Uit dit overleg is inmiddels gebleken dat er geen specifieke belemmeringen voor gebruik van de regeling in die gemeenten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Koolmees, Ronnes en Van der Linde over aankoop van Dekemahiem door Vereniging Doarpskorporaasje Jirnsum

MPs asked the minister whether housing corporation Elkien's plan to demolish 24 affordable homes for elderly and starters in Jirnsum without rebuilding, and the sale to a village cooperative, required an Inspectorate review and a residual valuation, and why the process took so long. The minister answered that local housing policy is for the municipality, that sales to third parties need the regulator's consent at no less than market value, that the residual valuation request was refused, that the earlier rules applied, and that the 12-week decision period was not exceeded.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees, Omtzigt en Bashir over de informatie over de bonus van de voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van NS

MPs Koolmees, Omtzigt and Bashir asked the Finance Minister whether NS had emailed the ministry in April 2015 that its board received a 17.5% bonus, and why the ministry only checked the status of the bonuses on 17 June. Minister Dijsselbloem confirmed the April email, said agreement on the CEO bonus existed but payment could not occur until the CFO salary compensation was agreed on 30 May, and pointed to previously public documents for the communication request.
It is correct that NS sent an email on 14 April about a possible communication line on the variable pay awarded to NS's statutory board.
Het klopt dat NS op 14 april een e-mail heeft gestuurd over een eventuele communicatielijn over de toegekende variabele beloning van de statutaire directie van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over staatssteun en woningcorporaties

An MP asked whether the European Commission's growing influence over Dutch social housing (via state aid rules, competition rules and the European Semester) is undesirable, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the Commission only checks compliance with EU rules, that the Dutch housing law already uses the discretion granted under Protocol 26, and that the government will raise housing and poverty themes during the Dutch EU presidency without a specific intervention.

The European Commission checks whether member states comply with the rules and, when this leads to outcomes undesirable for the member state, enters into discussion to reach agreements that minimise market distortion.

De Europese Commissie toetst of lidstaten aan de regels voldoen en gaat, wanneer dit leidt tot voor de lidstaat ongewenste uitkomsten, in gesprek om te komen tot afspraken om zo veel mogelijk marktverstoring te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over enorme verwarring bij automobilisten over de maximumsnelheid op de A2

MP Bashir asked about widespread driver confusion over the speed limit on the A2 and the large number of speeding fines from the average-speed check there. The minister replies that about 98% of drivers keep to the limit, the A2 share of fines is well under a third, signage follows guidelines with extra measures taken, and the limit will be raised on parts of the A2 subject to a pending court decision.
I will inform the House about this within this year.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hier dit jaar nog over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt, Bashir, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de afschaffing van de oldtimervrijstelling

MPs from CDA, SP, PVV and Van Vliet asked the Finance State Secretary about the revenue estimates for abolishing the classic-car tax exemption, the number of diesel and LPG cars affected, and the cost of extending transitional rules to them. The State Secretary defended revised revenue estimates of roughly 60 to 70 million euros, gave a table of affected vehicles, and rejected extending transitional rules to diesel and LPG cars because of budget and air-quality concerns.

In my letter on the classic car measure I only intended to indicate that, to reach the estimated revenue of 137 million euros, the second part of the revenue, the replacement cars, would need to yield 82 million euros in motor vehicle tax.

Ik heb in mijn brief over de oldtimermaatregel slechts willen aangegeven dat, om de geraamde opbrengst van € 137 miljoen te halen, het tweede deel van de opbrengst, de vervangende auto's, € 82 miljoen aan MRB zou moeten opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over de slechte bereikbaarheid en gebrekkige kennis van de politie te water

MPs Kooiman and Bashir asked why water-police calls are poorly handled, why police officers without shipping expertise are deployed on water, and whether the abolished Deelorgaan Binnenvaart should be reinstated. The minister says the national service line is professional, the Landelijke Eenheid has invited shipping association ASV to discuss its complaints, the integrated Dienst Infrastructuur is designed to add capacity and knowledge, existing consultation forums exist, and no reinstatement is needed because the function is secured in current law.
The National Unit of the police has invited shipping association ASV to a meeting to gain more clarity about the problems it raised
De Landelijke Eenheid van de politie heeft de schippersverenging ASV uitgenodigd voor een gesprek om meer duidelijkheid te krijgen over de door haar genoemde problemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het beleid van Rijkswaterstaat ten aanzien van de loodsplicht havengebied Moerdijk en de Dordtse Kil

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why Rijkswaterstaat imposes pilotage obligations on oversized ships in the Moerdijk harbour area and Dordtse Kil even for pilot-exempt captains, and whether exemptions can be reinstated and VTS coverage introduced. The Minister answered that oversized ships are excluded from exemptions for safety reasons, that the pilotage exemption system is under review in the 'Loodsplicht nieuwe stijl' project with consultation planned for early 2016, and that a decision on VTS or other safety measures will follow.
Currently, within the project 'Loodsplicht nieuwe stijl', it is being examined whether the current pilotage exemptions and the current system still suffice.
Momenteel wordt in het kader van het project «Loodsplicht nieuwe stijl» bezien of de huidige loodsplichtvrijstellingen en de huidige systematiek nog voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het niet uitbetalen van compensatie voor vertraging door prijsvechters in de luchtvaart

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether low-cost airlines such as Ryanair and EasyJet are evading mandatory delay compensation, and why no fines have been imposed. The state secretary replies that the ILT finds airlines pay compensation when a complaint is upheld, that Ryanair and EasyJet have compliant processes, and that the ILT prefers warnings and talks over fines, while promising a new study and better passenger information.
The ILT only has data on its own activities, namely supervision in the form of complaint handling and inspections.
De ILT heeft alleen gegevens over haar eigen activiteiten, te weten het toezicht in de vorm van klachtbehandeling en inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de aanhoudende problemen op het spoor in de Achterhoek

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment why rail disruptions continued on the Winterswijk–Arnhem line in the Achterhoek, whether the signalling systems are outdated, why replacement bus services by Arriva failed, and what measures will make the line more robust. The government attributes the disruptions partly to a possibly premature reopening after works, denies outdated signalling, explains the bus problems by a combination of circumstances while placing supervision of the concession with the province, and points to co-financed double-track works and planned studies on electrification and lightning protection.
Supervision of the implementation of the Arnhem–Winterswijk concession is the responsibility of the province of Gelderland.
Het toezicht op de uitvoering van de concessie voor Arnhem–Winterswijk is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Gelderland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Bashir over de gebrekkige informatie bij het vervoeren van gevaarlijke stoffen over het spoor

MPs Smaling and Bashir asked the state secretary about inadequate information on hazardous-substance rail transport, including the ILT's findings, a GPS track-and-trace proposal, emergency capacity on the Brabant route and the VeZA curve. The state secretary said the IGS information system has improved information, the ILT enforces registration duties, a 2.0 IGS and possibly GPS tracking are under study, no extra emergency capacity is currently needed, and the VeZA curve will not be reconsidered.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het stopzetten van toeslagen voor dak- en thuislozen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority stops allowances for homeless people who share a postal address, and whether it will stop doing so. The State Secretary answered that shared postal addresses are not a criterion for stopping allowances, but acknowledged a handling error for people who changed from a home address to a postal address, and said affected people will receive new decisions.
Merely that several persons use the same postal address is not a criterion for stopping allowances.
Sec het feit dat er door meerdere personen gebruik wordt gemaakt van hetzelfde postadres is geen criterium om toeslagen stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir inzake Ryanair

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether Ryanair's slot request at Schiphol fits the policy of moving leisure traffic to regional airports like Eindhoven and Lelystad, and what the effects are on other carriers and on Dutch workers' rights at Ryanair. The state secretary answered that the independent slot coordinator allocates slots under EU rules, that Lelystad is meant to take leisure traffic from Schiphol, and that labour enforcement for Ryanair lies primarily with the Irish supervisor.
Ryanair is already an important carrier at the regional airport of Eindhoven.
Ryanair is al een belangrijke maatschappij op de regionale luchthaven Eindhoven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bashir over de extra aandeelhoudersvergadering van de NS

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Bashir) asked the Finance Minister about extra shareholder meetings of NS and whether the invitation and minutes would be shared, and whether any settlement agreement with CEO Huges would be made public. The minister confirmed the meetings, declined to share the minutes because of ongoing legal proceedings and possible harm to the state's legal position, and referred the settlement question to a prior answer.
Publication of the minutes could harm the legal position of the state.
Openbaarmaking van het verslag kan de juridische positie van de staat schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over toestemming voor een bonus aan de oud-topman van de NS

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether the former NS chief was authorised to receive a EUR 75,000 bonus, why the minister earlier said the bonus was taken without NS or supervisory board knowledge, whether further surprises can be expected in the dismissal procedure, and asks for all dismissal documents. The minister says a 17.5% variable pay was agreed in principle but only finalised as part of a package on 2 June, admits earlier information was not always correct, declines to release documents because of a pending kort geding, and promises only to inform the Chamber confidentially after the procedure.
To avoid harming NS's legal position, I cannot comply with your request.
Om de juridische positie van NS niet te schaden kan ik niet aan uw verzoek voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de gevaarlijke situatie voor motorrijders op het Kooimeerplein in Alkmaar

An SP MP asked the minister about motorcyclists falling at the Kooimeerplein in Alkmaar, how many falls occurred, their causes, and whether more than signs would be taken. The minister acknowledged the problem, reported about fifty incidents via motorcycle organisations, identified road markings, camber and repair patches as likely causes, and promised monitoring and longer-term measures.
Rijkswaterstaat did not record or register these numbers because most motorcyclists continued on their way independently after the incident.
Bij Rijkswaterstaat zijn deze aantallen niet gemeld of geregistreerd omdat de meeste motorrijders na het incident hun weg zelfstandig vervolgden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over een rapport van PwC over ProRail

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a confidential PwC report, commissioned by ProRail's supervisory board, on possible procurement violations in maintenance contracts, and about whistleblower reports and board meetings. The State Secretary answered that the ministry knew of the commission but not the content until 12 June, sent a summary and a separate letter, and described the whistleblower misconduct and the board's compliance meetings.
The summary of the report dated 12 June was submitted to me on that date. That is why I could not inform your House about it earlier.
De samenvatting van het rapport met datum 12 juni jl. is op die datum mij aangeboden. Daarom kon ik uw Kamer hierover niet eerder informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Merkies over “de megabonus voor de topman van Schiphol”

MPs Bashir and Merkies asked why the Schiphol CEO receives a bonus nearly equal to his base salary, whether this is consistent with the 20% cap, and whether the government has acted to get him to waive it. The minister explains the 2008 contract followed then-applicable policy, states that the new 2014 policy caps variable pay at 20%, says the shareholder sets directors' pay policy, and notes he has told Schiphol the CEO's variable pay should be brought into line with current policy.
In addition, I have informed Schiphol that I am of the view that the variable pay of Schiphol's CEO should be brought into line with the current remuneration policy.
Daarnaast heb ik aan Schiphol laten weten dat ik van mening ben dat de variabele beloning van de CEO van Schiphol in lijn moet worden gebracht met het vigerende beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over vrijwillig vertrek versus gedwongen ontslag

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance whether the Tax Authority tightened the rules on voluntary redundancy schemes since 2013, removing advance certainty and raising the 52% RVU levy, and whether this pushes employers toward forced dismissals. The government denies any tightening, says the 2005 rules are enforced and that a 2013 policy decision allows ex-post testing with a 10% margin, and sees no trend toward forced dismissals.
No, that is not correct. The Tax Authority enforces the legislation as it was established in 2005.
Nee, dat klopt niet. De Belastingdienst handhaaft de wetgeving zoals deze in 2005 tot stand is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir ,Van Gerven en Schouw over een einde aan de kraambox voor zeugen en enige andere samenhangende vragen
