MPs Bashir, Van Gerven and Schouw asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about ending farrowing crates for sows, the Pro Dromi alternative, funding for its research, nesting material and inspections, and the EU welfare guidelines, covering 16 questions. The State Secretary answered that Pro Dromi is promising but needs further optimisation before wider rollout, declined to make it mandatory to preserve innovation, pointed to existing funding routes, and said nesting material is largely exempt due to manure systems.
I will discuss with the Dutch pig producers' organisation (POV) and the entrepreneurs involved which bottlenecks exist in practical implementation.
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met de Producentenorganisatie Varkenshouderij (POV) en de betrokken ondernemers om na te gaan welke knelpunten er zijn bij de praktijkimplementatie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over ontduiken van btw-regels door internetbedrijven die zich op de Nederlandse markt richten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about foreign internet companies serving Dutch consumers via Dutch-language sites and iDEAL payments without paying Dutch VAT, and whether payment providers and Google Adwords should be obliged to check VAT numbers, and whether the FIOD should investigate. The State Secretary answered that the 21% VAT rate applies regardless of payment method, that VAT is owed by all providers equally, that an EU-level framework rather than a national measure is appropriate, that he is unaware of large-scale fraud or Google facilitating it, and that investigations start with the Belastingdienst and the FIOD only if warranted.
I am not aware that there is "massive tax evasion by foreign entrepreneurs" nor that Google Adwords would be cooperating with it.
Het is mij niet bekend dat sprake is van «enorme belastingontduiking door buitenlandse ondernemers» en evenmin dat Google Adwords daaraan zou meewerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over niet functionerende trajectcontroles

An SP MP asked why speed trajectory controls on several motorways were switched off, whether tenders caused delays, what the costs were, and how road safety and enforcement would be maintained. The minister replied that the replacement is on schedule (nine systems by mid-2015, a tenth in early 2016), that police use mobile radar at the affected locations, and that she is not willing to study a narrower targeting of enforcement.
The media suggest that the replacement of the trajectory controls has been delayed. This is incorrect.
In de media wordt de suggestie gewekt dat de vervanging van de trajectcontroles is uitgelopen. Dit is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over “notoire snelheidsovertreders”

An SP MP asked the government why persistent speeding offenders keep receiving fines while ordinary drivers bear most penalties, and how bumper-clinging is being tackled. The Minister replied that since 1 January 2015 repeat traffic offences are handled under criminal law to bring offenders into view of the Public Prosecution Service, and gave figures on bumper-clinging cases showing 4,213 reports over three years with a stated adequate recidivism approach.
Since 1 January 2015 a new approach to repeat traffic offenders has started.
Per 1 januari 2015 is een nieuwe aanpak van de veelplegers in het verkeer gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over uitspraken van de heer Don, bestuurslid van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM), over verdere liberalisering van het spoor

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the ACM board member Don's call for studying the splitting and tendering of the Dutch main rail network was appropriate, given that the ACM is an independent regulator and the matter belongs to ministerial policy. The government answered that Don spoke as chair of IRG-Rail, that the Dutch position remains flexible and against splitting the main network, that the ACM may comment on policy only within agreed limits and did not address rail in its Signaal 2015, and that the ACM is not conducting its own study on splitting, only a required competition assessment.
The ACM is an independent administrative body within the meaning of the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies.
De ACM is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan in de zin van de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over uitspraken van DNB over het lage btw-tarief

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether DNB overstepped its remit by suggesting VAT increases to fund lower labour taxes, and cited a NYFER study on job losses in hospitality. The state secretary answered that DNB gives independent advice and must account for its own statements, and that the cabinet is still consulting on and developing the tax reform, with effects to be assessed before the 2016 budget.
For that reason DNB will account for its own statements.
De DNB zal om die reden haar eigen uitspraken verantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Bashir en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de overheid de bouwsector genadeloos uiteen speelt

MPs of the SP asked the government about reports that it squeezes the construction sector, including cost overruns on A15 and A2 projects, the risks of a Ballast Nedam bankruptcy, and whether lowest-price awarding and design-build-finance-maintain contracts cause sector losses. The minister answered that cost overrun figures are confidential, that Rijkswaterstaat compensates responsibly-caused extra costs, that EMVI (best value) is the main award criterion, and that the Aanbestedingswet evaluation will be sent to parliament by summer.
Financial information from contractors, insofar as I have it, I cannot make public.
Financiële informatie van opdrachtnemers, voor zover ik hierover beschik, kan ik niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bashir over ‘de dubbele petten bij Bijzonder Beheer Rabobank’

An SP MP asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about alleged 'double hats' at Rabobank's Bijzonder Beheer unit, its subsidiary Bodemgoed buying assets of failing clients, the transparency of auctions, and use of the BMKB guarantee scheme. The government defended the practice as in the client's interest, rejected concerns about deliberate harm to clients, and provided purchase and portfolio figures while stating it saw no reason to intervene.
Due to confidentiality of company data, payments to individual banks are not disclosed.
Vanwege vertrouwelijkheid van bedrijfsgegevens worden uitkeringen aan individuele banken niet geopenbaard
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het massaal ontduiken van belastingen door UberPOP-chauffeurs

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance, in twelve questions, about tax evasion by UberPOP drivers, including whether they meet their tax obligations, how many have registered as entrepreneurs, and whether Uber can be compelled to supply data. The State Secretary declined most substance citing the tax secrecy rule (art. 67 AWR), said the tax authority cannot currently verify compliance, and pointed to enforcement strategy, cooperation with the ILT and data-sharing rules.
It is not possible for me to establish this at this moment.
Het is voor mij niet mogelijk om dit op dit moment vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat er drie keer zoveel klachten zijn bij NS over volle treinen

An SP MP asked the state secretary how the government will respond to reports of overcrowded NS trains, including the Uitgeest–Amsterdam Sprinter, and what measures are planned for capacity. The state secretary acknowledged performance fell below agreed targets, pointed to a mandatory NS capacity improvement programme and monitoring under the concession, and promised further measures without firm new commitments.
The current performance level does not match the stated ambition.
Het huidige prestatieniveau past niet bij de gestelde ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het personeelsbestand van de Belastingdienst

MP Bashir asked the State Secretary of Finance about the size and grading of the Tax Authority's management team and workforce over the past ten years. The State Secretary answered in detail with headcount tables, noting that top-management bands agreed with BZK have stayed constant and that management numbers have barely changed while operational staff grew by about 666 FTE.
No separate administration is kept that specifies per tax instrument how many people work on assessment respectively special collection.
Er wordt geen aparte administratie bijgehouden die per belastingmiddel specificeert hoeveel mensen werken voor heffing respectievelijk bijzondere inning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over de ANBI-status van Stichting Rohamaa

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked why the ANBI status of Stichting Rohamaa was granted, whether it complies with transparency rules and international law, and whether it should be revoked and the ANBI list cleaned up. The government answered that the status was granted in 2011 under neutral criteria, declined to discuss the specific case citing legal confidentiality, said status can be revoked if an entity no longer serves the general interest, and stated the Tax Administration conducts risk-based supervision of about 65,000 ANBIs.
I cannot make any statements about the specific aspects of granting the ANBI status to Stichting Rohomaa on the basis of the statutory duty of confidentiality.
Over de specifieke aspecten van het verlenen van de ANBI-status aan Stichting Rohomaa kan ik geen mededelingen doen op grond van de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Bashir over de huisvuilinzameling in de binnenvaart

An SP MP asked the minister about the reduced number of waste containers, the paid household-waste subscription for inland shipping, complaints, and whether bargee households pay twice and can deduct the costs as business expenses. The minister defended the subscription system on cost grounds, referred complaints and the CDNI complaint question to other bodies, and deferred the tax question to the Tax Authority.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over onveilige situaties op de vaarwegen door onderbezetting bij verkeersleiding Rijkswaterstaat

An SP MP asked the minister about unsafe conditions on inland waterways caused by understaffing of Rijkswaterstaat traffic control, citing worries from traffic controllers, fewer patrol vessel hours, unreachable traffic posts and staffing levels. The minister answered that efficiency gains allow the same work with fewer staff, that shortages are managed by reallocating staff and prioritising, that the vessel-hours comparison will follow within five weeks, that the Westerschelde incidents fall under the Flemish centre and are under police investigation, and that safety remains a high priority.
The requested comparison cannot be retrieved directly. Comparing vessel hours across the different years takes more time and I will send it to the House within 5 weeks.
De gevraagde vergelijking is niet direct opvraagbaar. Het vergelijken van het aantal vaaruren over de verschillende jaren kost meer tijd en zal ik binnen 5 weken aan de kamer opsturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat kilometertellerfraude bij geïmporteerde auto’s door RDW wordt gedoogd

MP Bashir asked the minister whether it is acceptable that the RDW registers imported cars with apparently tampered odometers, whether the 50% figure is accurate, and what will stop this before EU rules arrive in 2018. The minister answered that registration cannot be refused under EU law, that the RDW records 'no judgement', that a Belgian-Dutch data exchange pilot and a consumer campaign are planned, and that prosecution of odometer-tampering firms is being prepared.
Even if the RDW suspects a rolled-back odometer, registration of a vehicle from another EU country cannot be refused because of European law.
Ook al heeft de RDW een vermoeden van een teruggedraaide teller kan registratie van het voertuig uit een ander EU-land vanwege Europees recht niet worden geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over rijscholen die sjoemelen met slagingspercentages

An SP MP asked the minister whether multi-company driving schools that split pupils by pass rates, and possible tax evasion by such 'fop' schools, could be curbed and whether CBR data could show pass rates per company. The minister answered that the market is free and such structures are not in themselves fraudulent, that CBR already knows which school books each exam, and that the Tax Authority has monitored schools against exam data, adding about EUR 22 million in revenue, with continued monitoring promised.
The approach to the driving school sector has led to roughly EUR 22 million in additional turnover being established at several hundred driving schools beyond what the original tax returns showed.

De aanpak ten aanzien van de rijschoolbranche heeft er toe geleid dat er bij enkele honderden rijscholen ongeveer € 22 miljoen meer omzet is vastgesteld dan uit de oorspronkelijke aangiftes naar voren kwam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over hulp bij de aangifte inkomstenbelasting

MP Bashir (SP) asked whether abolishing electronic signatures on tax returns harms organisations helping vulnerable people, such as Stichting Door en Voor, that file returns for clients unable to do so themselves, and what solution is envisaged. Staatssecretaris Wiebes refers to earlier answers, says a varied range of signing options exists, and states that no organisation has reported to the Tax Administration that no alternative works for it.
To date, no organisations have made themselves known to the Tax Administration for which no alternative has proved workable.
Er hebben zich tot op heden geen organisaties bekend gemaakt bij de Belastingdienst waarvoor geen enkel alternatief werkbaar is gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de crisis bij zeegaande zeilschepen op de Oostzee

An SP MP asked the minister about safety rules and operating restrictions for Dutch sailing ships in the Baltic after Danish pressure, including the five-mile limit, ship stability, and compensation for operators. The minister answered that the rules are being updated with industry, that Denmark's proposed solution limits sailing areas but avoids stricter certification than needed, and that operators must bear normal business risk without compensation.
I do not have this data available.
Deze gegevens heb ik niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het eigen vermogen van Air France KLM

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the declining equity of Air France-KLM from 2011 to 2014 and a press report that the French wanted to dismantle KLM. The State Secretary gave the equity figures, attributed the decline to losses, pension-rate effects and an accounting change, pointed to improving cash flows, and said he would discuss the matter with the French government and report to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat taxichauffeurs het heft zelf in hand willen nemen tegen Uber

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment how the government will respond to taxi drivers' plans to take matters into their own hands against UberPOP, including enforcement numbers, staffing, and why illegal drivers are not caught. The State Secretary rejects vigilante action, reports ten last-onder-dwangsom fines and fourteen enforcement actions in six months, and says enforcement continues with about 20 FTE capacity, though some answers refer to other responsible bodies or cannot provide data.
I therefore maintain the continuation of the enforcement already underway against UberPOP drivers and other unlicensed drivers.
Ik houd daarom vast aan voortzetting van de reeds ingezette handhaving tegen UberPOP chauffeurs en andere snorders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de nieuwe regels voor btw op elektronische diensten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the new EU VAT rules for electronic services from 2015, including the terminology used, administrative burdens, MOSS registration, VIES reliability, and fraud risks. The State Secretary answered that the rules are EU-mandated with little national policy room, that information was provided via the Belastingdienst website, and that he will explore with business organisations whether the information can be made more accessible.
However, I see the importance for Dutch business in this and therefore I will have examined whether we can make the information provided on this subject more accessible.
Ik zie echter het belang van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven in deze en laat daarom onderzoeken of we de geboden informatie over deze materie nog toegankelijker kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over Uber

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about Uber's UberPOP service continuing despite fines and a court ruling, its Dutch expansion, tax and criminal liability of drivers, and how the government will enforce the rules. The government replies that the ILT will keep enforcing the law and the court-ordered penalty, that the Belastingdienst applies VAT rules case by case, and that information for drivers will be expanded.
This means that Uber forfeits a penalty payment for each new violation the ILT establishes, up to a maximum of €100,000.
Dat betekent dat Uber bij elke nieuwe door de ILT geconstateerde overtreding een dwangsom verbeurt, tot een maximum van € 100.000,-.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de kosten voor een nieuwe OV-Chipkaart

An SP MP asks whether Trans Link Systems secretly raised the price of a personal OV-chipkaart by 3 euros as a processing fee, and why the government approved such an increase. The State Secretary answers that the fee is transparently communicated, that transport operators set the advisory price without government approval, and that online ordering avoids the extra charge.
The pricing of the card is determined by the transport operators; it is an advisory price and operators and governments may deviate from it.
De prijsstelling van de kaart wordt bepaald door de vervoerders, het betreft een adviesprijs en vervoerders en overheden kunnen afwijken van deze prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de voorlopige aanslag 2015

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why provisional tax assessments for 2015 were issued differently from previous years, why taxpayers were surprised, whether they were also facing a 2014 assessment, and whether they would be informed about instalment payments without extra costs. The answer refers to a separate letter sent the same day that answers these questions, with footnotes linking to each question.
I have answered the questions of Member Bashir in my letter of today on the same subject
De vragen van het lid Bashir heb ik beantwoord in mijn brief van vandaag over hetzelfde onderwerp
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over schepenveilingen door de Rabobank aan de Rabobank

An SP MP asked whether Rabobank buys back its own foreclosed inland vessels through a subsidiary and whether state guarantees of up to 1 million euro per vessel create an incentive and harm skippers. The minister confirmed the practice, defended it as protecting against sales below expert floor prices, said the guarantee does not double-compensate the bank and that the skipper remains liable for the residual debt, and denied any subsidy or incentive problem.
There is therefore no double compensation paid to the bank.
Er vindt dus geen dubbele vergoeding aan de bank plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smaling over het instortingsgevaar van balkons en galerijen

MPs Bashir and Smaling asked the minister about collapse risks of balconies and gallery walkways in flats, including the Escamp flat in The Hague, and about owners' payment problems and government guarantees. The minister said building owners and municipalities are responsible, pointed to the 2012 inspection protocol and a new inspection duty instrument, opposed a mandatory APK for buildings, and described loan options for owners' associations.
Responsibility for safety lies with building owners and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de veiligheid ligt bij de gebouweigenaren en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat duizenden vliegpassagiers onterecht geen compensatie kregen bij vertraging

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether thousands of air passengers wrongly lost delay compensation and how the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) informs passengers and enforces their rights. The government denies that thousands were wrongly refused, says the ILT applies European Court rulings immediately, handles complaints and fines airlines that ignore its rulings, and promises an improved ILT passenger-rights website and continued consultation with consumer groups.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het schrappen van de OV-chipkaart op Texel

MP Bashir asks why the OV-chipkaart will no longer be accepted for bus travel on Texel from 14 December 2014, and whether the flat fare, loss of discounts and loss of student and annual-pass benefits are acceptable. The Staatssecretaris calls the situation undesirable, says the card will be valid again as soon as possible after a short gap of about 3-4 months, and says fare-setting is a provincial competence with the provincial authority promising lenient treatment of subscription holders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het pleidooi van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) om het hoofdrailnet op te splitsen

An SP MP asked whether an ACM board member's call at Mobiliteitspoort for a study into splitting the main rail network, and his public comments, were appropriate, and whether ACM can be expected to make more such political statements. Minister Kamp replied that ACM is an independent authority that may speak publicly on its supervisory tasks but is limited on policy matters, that the speech fits its powers, that an independent study found negative effects for passengers from splitting the network, and that political positions belong to the ministers.
The government is currently considering whether the procedure for the Signal document should be included in the working agreements in the 2013 ACM–ministers relationship statute.
Momenteel wordt bezien of de werkwijze rondom het Signaal een plaats zou moeten krijgen in de onderlinge werkafspraken in het Relatiestatuut ACM en ministers 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het voornemen van de gemeente Rotterdam om parkeergeld te heffen op de verschillende Park+Rides

An MP asked the minister whether Rotterdam's plan to charge for parking at Park+Ride sites, partly funded by the national Beter Benutten programme and the regional authority, was appropriate and whether the national government could intervene. The minister replied that Rotterdam is fully competent to set its own parking tariffs, that national intervention is not warranted given the modest fee, and that Beter Benutten conditions aim to balance occupancy and business case.
Rotterdam is therefore fully competent to introduce parking tariffs at its own discretion and approval for parking facilities in its territory.
De gemeente Rotterdam is derhalve volledig bevoegd om naar eigen inzicht en goedkeuring parkeertarieven in te voeren voor het gebruik van parkeervoorzieningen op haar grondgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de bezwaarschriften tegen het fictieve rendement van de vermogensrendementsheffing

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about the thousands of objections against the fictitious return on the wealth yield tax and why no settlement agreement is offered like in the classic-car case. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Administration handles the objections individually where no grievance applies, that the cost savings from collective handling are acknowledged, and that options to tax actual returns, including a capital gains tax, are still under study.
Without further investigation, the budgetary impact of honouring the objections cannot be stated.
Zonder nader onderzoek is het budgettaire beslag bij honorering van de bezwaarschriften niet aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over spaarders die tegenwoordig sparen in een bv

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether savers moving savings into a holding company (spaargeld-bv) to avoid the box 3 wealth tax is fair, and about the tax, benefit and AWBZ consequences. The State Secretary said the cabinet will examine alternatives to the wealth yield tax, that a savings BV only becomes attractive for very large fortunes, and that the government will monitor the situation and act if needed.
In view of that sense of injustice, the cabinet will examine alternatives to the existing wealth yield tax, with the aim of making a further assessment.
Mede met het oog op dat gevoel van onrechtvaardigheid gaat het kabinet alternatieven onderzoeken voor de bestaande vermogensrendementsheffing, met het doel hierover een nadere afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over onvolledige beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de grote stapel aan fiscale voorstellen rond Prinsjesdag

The MP asked the State Secretary to answer earlier questions 5 and 6 on why more tax bills were not spread across the year, and whether part of the fiscal package could be sent to parliament in spring. The State Secretary answered that the government aims for spread but capacity is limited, outlining the spring 2015 Fiscale verzamelwet, a Fiscale vereenvoudigingswet and other bills.
The cabinet aims to spread the submission of fiscal bills over the year.
Het kabinet streeft naar spreiding van de indiening van fiscale wetsvoorstellen over het jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de werkwijze van de Belastingdienst na een WSNP-uitspraak

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority offsets debts incurred before a WSNP debt-rescheduling order against childcare and other allowance advances, and what the legal basis is. The State Secretary replied that Tax Authority policy excludes offsetting during debt rescheduling, that individual errors can occur, and that the legal basis is Article 301(3) of the Bankruptcy Act, which the Tax Authority applies by analogy to offsetting.
The Tax Authority's policy explicitly states that during statutory debt rescheduling no offsetting takes place between the debt claimed for verification and childcare allowance advances to be paid.

Antwoord 1, 3 en 4 In het beleid 2 van de Belastingdienst is expliciet vastgelegd dat er gedurende de wettelijke schuldsanering geen verrekening plaatsvindt van de ter verificatie aangemelde toeslagschuld met uit te betalen toeslagvoorschotten 3 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over open sky tussen Suriname en de voormalige Nederlandse Antillen

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch government had signalled no interest in a full open-sky regime with Suriname and how the current air agreement works for flights between Schiphol and Paramaribo. The Foreign Minister answered that the existing agreement works satisfactorily, that Dutch airlines can still add two carriers per country, that the Antilles and Aruba air relations with Suriname are their own competence, and that Curaçao may conclude its own air deals.
The current air transport regime between the Netherlands and Suriname has so far been satisfactory.
Het huidige luchtvaartregime tussen Nederland en Suriname voldoet tot op heden naar tevredenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat het werk aan de brug bij Ewijk stil ligt door ruzie

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether work on the Ewijk bridge had stalled due to a dispute with contractors, and about consequences, safety and prevention. The minister denied the bridge work was stopped, explained the cable-replacement dispute went to court which ordered work resumed, and described Rijkswaterstaat's safety and prevention measures.
Rijkswaterstaat submitted the stopping of the work to the judge in summary proceedings.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft het stilleggen van de werkzaamheden in een kortgeding voorgelegd aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst cijfers heeft gemanipuleerd over het aantal boekenonderzoeken

MP Bashir asked whether the Tax Authority manipulated figures on book audits, how many promised audits actually took place, and what the whistleblowers' claims mean for the minister's responsibility. The State Secretary replied that an Auditdienst Rijk review found no sign of systematic manipulation of registration, that 18 examined files did not meet the audit definition and were removed, and that individual manipulation cannot be excluded but would be disapproved.
The investigation gives no reason to assume that, as suggested in the broadcast, the registration of the investigations is manipulated.
Het onderzoek geeft geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat er, zoals in de uitzending werd gesuggereerd, gemanipuleerd wordt met de registratie van de onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het behouden van de nachttrein naar Kopenhagen, Praag en Warschau

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the planned cancellation of international night trains to Copenhagen, Prague and Warsaw by Deutsche Bahn and DSB, and whether the government would act to keep them. The government replied that international night trains are liberalised, the Dutch state has no formal relationship with DB or DSB and limited powers, that the Amsterdam-Berlin-Prague/Warsaw service ends in 2015 with a connection alternative, and that it will convey parliamentary concerns to NS and urge it to offer attractive products.
For international night trains, the national government therefore cannot grant concessions or prescribe rules.
Voor internationale nachttreinen kan de nationale overheid dus geen concessies verlenen of voorschriften bepalen.

Vragen van de leden Smaling, Van Nispen, Bashir en Ulenbelt (allen SP) aan de Minister en de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie vanwege berichten «Inspectie kondigt be

SP MPs asked whether the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport announcing inspections in advance, and the resulting internal discontent, is acceptable, and about related questions on inspector status, coordination among inspectorates, budgets and merging supervision. The minister defended announcing routine inspections as efficient under a trust-unless approach, said unannounced inspections happen where warranted, attributed staff tensions to reorganisation, and rejected merging inspectorates for now.
Where there is reason to suspect that rules are repeatedly or deliberately violated, companies can be inspected unannounced.
Waar aanleiding bestaat om te veronderstellen dat regels herhaaldelijk of moedwillig worden overtreden, kunnen bedrijven onaangekondigd geïnspecteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de toepassing van de onderwijsvrijstelling

MP Bashir (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance how the VAT education exemption applies to technology lessons, why it does not fall under the general decree listing exempt education, and why belastingkantoren (tax offices) might apply it differently in the MadScience case, and whether CRKBO certification could serve as a checkable standard. The State Secretary answered that technology lessons are exempt when part of regular curricula or given by listed providers, that tax offices should apply rules uniformly, that individual cases cannot be discussed, and that CRKBO certification covers only vocational education so a wider exemption is not possible within the law.
Regarding individual taxpayers, I do not provide information pursuant to Article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over individuele belastingplichtigen doe ik gelet op art. 67 van de AWR geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de grote stapel aan fiscale voorstellen rond Prinsjesdag

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance whether a heavy batch of tax proposals dropped around Prinsjesdag leaves too little time for implementation by the Tax Administration, and why more bills could not be submitted in spring. The State Secretary declined to comment on the characterisation, pointed to measures already notified to parliament, and said remaining measures would be announced on Prinsjesdag with the Tax Administration's implementation capacity checked.
At this moment I cannot address suggestions that a heavy batch of fiscal policy files would be dropped on parliament's table on Prinsjesdag.
Op dit moment kan ik niet ingaan op suggesties als dat er op Prinsjesdag een zware stapel fiscale beleidsdossiers bij het parlement op tafel zou worden gedropt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de schenkingsregeling bij een koophuis

MP Bashir asked the State Secretary of Finance about the temporarily expanded gift-tax exemption for home purchases, which was used far more than the 20,000 expected, and about its revenue loss, effect on house prices and whether it should be extended. The government answered that exact figures are not yet available, estimated a cumulative revenue loss of about 100 million euros over 30 years, and said the temporary exemption will not be extended.
Exact realisation figures will only become available after the tax return data has been processed in the Tax Administration's automated systems.
Exacte realisatiecijfers zullen pas beschikbaar komen nadat de aangiftegegevens zijn verwerkt in de geautomatiseerde systemen van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smalling over het bericht ’10 euro voor 780 meter trein’

MPs Bashir and Smaling asked whether a Belgian senior train ticket being invalid at the border, while a Dutch ticket was valid up to it, was confusing for passengers, and how many fines were issued on the Essen-border stretch. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the confusing ticket conditions, said the fine figures were requested from NMBS and not yet available, and committed to asking NS to seek a solution with the Belgian operator and to inform the Chamber.
NMBS has been asked whether it has this information.
Aan NMBS is gevraagd of zij beschikt over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over onnodige medische keuringen door CBR bij mensen met stabiele aandoeningen

An MP asked the minister whether unnecessary periodic driving-licence medical checks by the CBR burden people with stable chronic conditions, and what the rules are. The minister agreed that stable conditions should not be re-examined, listed which conditions require periodic checks, and promised to improve information and consult stakeholders and the Health Council on neurological rules.
To this end I will sit down this year with various parties such as healthcare providers, doctors, patient organisations, road safety organisations, municipalities and the CBR.
Ik ga hiervoor dit jaar rond de tafel met verschillende partijen zoals zorgverleners, artsen, patiëntenorganisaties, verkeersveiligheidsorganisaties gemeenten en het CBR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over het stijgend aantal ladingdiefstallen

MPs Kooiman and Bashir asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the 42 percent rise in cargo thefts in 2013, its causes, and the claim that police and prosecutors had reduced attention to transport crime. The minister denied reduced attention, said the cause of the rise is not directly explained, described continuing public-private cooperation and the NPC priority, and promised continued monitoring without committing to a specific new measure.
I do not share the view that there would be reduced attention to transport crime.
Ik deel de opvatting dat sprake zou zijn van verminderde aandacht voor transportcriminaliteit niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de uitvoering van de motie over flitsen op trajecten waar staat aangegeven dat er trajectcontrole is

An MP asked whether police flash-speed checks on the A4 near Hoofddorp on 4 March 2014 breached the earlier motion-Bashir commitment not to conduct spot checks where a trajectory-control sign is displayed. The minister answered that the radar check there was not in line with that commitment, so no fines were issued and police were reminded to follow the instruction.
The radar check at that point was not in line with the commitment made to your House referred to in question 1.
De radarcontrole was op dat punt niet in overeenstemming met de in vraag 1 aangehaalde toezegging aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir over het bericht dat Stichting Dienstverlening Serviceflats (SDS) ouderen uit serviceflats jaagt

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked the government to respond to reports that Stichting Dienstverlening Serviceflats (SDS) pressures elderly residents of service flats, including through alleged financial exploitation, intimidation and forced sales, and asked whether an independent investigation would follow. Minister Blok replied that complaints about a service-flat management organisation are a matter for the courts, that private management contracts fall outside government supervision, and pointed to industry certification initiatives, without committing to an investigation.
Ultimately it is for the judiciary to pass judgment and not for me to go into the substance of this.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechterlijke macht om een oordeel te vellen en niet aan mij om hier inhoudelijk op in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Bashir over de bediening van station Utrecht Lunetten

MPs Jansen and Bashir asked why NS sprinter stops at Utrecht Lunetten are halved from December 2013 and whether alternatives were explored. The Secretary of State answered that ProRail's stricter planning norms, after the Amsterdam Singelgracht collision, force the cut for westbound trains until infrastructure is adapted by end 2015, that alternatives were explored with operators, and that he urged ProRail and NS to reduce the hindrance.
I have urged ProRail and NS to jointly inform travellers as well as possible and in good time about travel options.
Ik heb er bij ProRail en NS op aangedrongen om samen de reizigers zo goed mogelijk en tijdig te informeren over de reismogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Bashir over bijstellingsregeling directe belasting

MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Bashir asked when the Secretary of State learned of the 2014 indexation raising the eigenwoningforfait from 0.6% to 0.7%, why earlier calculations assumed 0.6%, and how the rise affects taxpayers, provisional assessments and cost estimates. The government answered that the indexation follows the statutory mechanism, was signed on 18 December 2013 and published without notifying parliament, and that provisional assessments used 0.65% with later requests recalculated at 0.7%, with a commitment to adjust the trial calculation.
It is not customary to share the outcomes of statutory indexation mechanisms with members of the cabinet.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om de uitkomsten van wettelijke indexeringsmechanismes aan leden van het kabinet mede te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over gevaar door uitschakeling van verlichting op snelwegen

An SP MP asked the minister how the decision to switch off motorway lighting at night relates to traffic volume, accident risk, weather and alternatives such as traffic-responsive lighting. The minister answered that lighting will be switched off only 23:00 to 05:00 with adjustments for rush hours and hazardous sections, that no lasting safety effect is found, and that the regime will be revised in early 2014.
To respond to reactions from society, I have reconsidered the lighting regime, and lighting will be switched off between 23:00 and 05:00 on all roads or parts thereof covered by this measure.
Om tegemoet te komen aan de reacties uit de samenleving heb ik het verlichtingsregime heroverwogen en wordt de verlichting tussen 23:00 uur en 05:00 uur uitgeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat rijinstructeurs onbevoegd les geven

An MP asked the minister about a report that around 1,200 driving instructors teach without valid authorisation, and whether enforcement, recertification costs and market saturation should be addressed. The minister disputed the figure, reported only one concrete notification, pointed to police enforcement and planned ILT oversight in spring 2014, and stated that pricing and market entry are left to the market.
In addition, my Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport is examining how additional enforcement can be effectively provided.
Hiernaast onderzoekt mijn Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport op welke wijze aanvullende handhaving effectief vorm kan worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de voortdurende onduidelijkheid over de snelheidslimieten op de snelwegen

MP Bashir asked the ministers about persistent confusion among motorists over speed limits on Dutch motorways, including unclear signage, varying speeds, and navigation data. Minister Schultz van Haegen-Maas Geesteranus answered that Rijkswaterstaat is pursuing harmonised speeds, reviewing signage, improving navigation data and communication, but gave no firm new commitments beyond ongoing work.
Rijkswaterstaat is currently working on a proposal to adapt roadside signage so that it meets the road user's wish to be informed more frequently about the maximum speed.

Rijkswaterstaat werkt momenteel een voorstel uit om de bebording langs de weg zodanig aan te passen dat deze voldoet aan de wens van de weggebruiker om frequenter geïnformeerd te worden over de maximumsnelheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de medische keuring voor mensen met Aandachtstekort Stoornis met Hyperactiviteit (ADHD) door het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An SP MP asked the minister whether the CBR's handling of medical re-examination for drivers with ADHD is fair, especially for those previously declared unconditionally fit, and whether existing records could avoid unnecessary re-tests. The minister answered that the generic re-examination requirement was abolished, that CBR checks prior reports itself, and that a specialist must still see some people once where the earlier report is unclear.
I am pleased that, on the advice of the Health Council, I was able to abolish the generic re-examination requirement for ADHD.
Ik ben blij dat ik met het advies van de Gezondheidsraad de generieke herkeuringseis ingeval van ADHD heb kunnen afschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over belastingheffing op de Amsterdamse beurs door Frankrijk en Italië

An SP MP asked the Finance Ministry whether French and Italian transaction taxes on shares listed in Amsterdam are legitimate, whether the revenue can flow to the Dutch treasury, and whether the tax can be credited against Dutch box 3 tax. The State Secretary confirmed the taxes apply, said they are legally permissible without a basis for sharing revenue, and said they cannot be credited against box 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het Droge Lading Comité en de crisis in de binnenvaart

An SP MP asked the minister about the Droge Lading Comité, its exclusion of smaller barges, the involvement of a brokerage firm linked to overcapacity, and the failed EU crisis declaration for inland shipping. The minister replied that the committee was an initiative of individual large-vessel operators, that smaller vessels face no overcapacity problem, that no views were expressed on individual firms, and that the government awaits Belgium's EU process before reconsidering.
I have no opinion on the role or position of individual companies or persons in this regard.
Over de rol of positie van individuele ondernemingen of personen in dit verband heb ik geen oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de OV-chipkaart voor blinden en slechtzienden

An SP MP asked the state secretary why the OV-chipkaart problems for blind and partially sighted travellers in regional public transport remain unresolved, whether reservation-based travel was pursued as the Dik-Faber motion requested, whether the cheaper Viziris subscription should be reinstated, and asked for early answers. The state secretary answered that a working group is examining travel on account with check-in/check-out, that the decentralised authorities aim for clarity in early 2014, that the Viziris subscription is not feasible because its costs did not match actual travel, and that answers were provided in time.
A working group is now starting, in which the authorities, carriers and the Oogvereniging are all represented.
Er start nu een werkgroep, waarin zowel de overheden, vervoerders als de Oogvereniging zijn vertegenwoordigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht ‘forse groei rijscholen is ongewenst’

MP Bashir (SP) asked the minister to substantiate claims that new driving schools do not underperform, given pass-rate data, and questioned enforcement of driving-instructor licensing and business skills. The minister answered that the pass-rate site does not show school novelty or quality, that enforcement is adequate with reporting to police and IBKI revocation powers, and that IBKI issues certificates with expiry dates, while several questions were only partly answered and deferred to a committee meeting.
I am not aware that the control and enforcement of competence under the WRM is below standard and leads to problems.
Mij is niet bekend dat de controle en handhaving van de bevoegdheid op basis van de WRM onder de maat is en tot problemen leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt, Jasper van Dijk en Bashir over misbruik van de Wet vermindering afdracht loonbelasting en premie voor de volksverzekeringen (WVA)

SP MPs asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs and the state secretary of Finance about firms and training institutions abusing the wage-tax reduction for education (AV onderwijs), including whether unqualified teachers and sham courses were used and whether the responsible parties would be punished. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found shortcomings at several institutions, that investigations continue at two, that the AV onderwijs is being abolished in favour of a new subsidy scheme, and that the Tax Service and FIOD can act, while declining to name firms or give tax-recovery estimates for confidentiality reasons.
Under the duty of confidentiality, no statements are ever made about individual taxpayers in tax matters.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht worden wat betreft fiscale aangelegenheden nimmer uitspraken gedaan over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de aanpak van scooterhufters in Amsterdam (ingezonden 22 juli 2013).

Rep. Bashir (SP) asked whether enforcement figures on speeding and antisocial riding by moped and scooter riders in Amsterdam exist, how the government cooperates with the city to reduce nuisance, and why fines are hard to issue. The government answered that enforcement figures do exist (a misunderstanding between city and police), that nuisance enforcement is a local matter under a 2011 covenant, and that no administrative processing problem for these fines is known.
Er zijn wel degelijk handhavingscijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het aantal gereden kilometers met een oldtimer

MP Bashir (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about criticism from the FEHAC that the Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving overstated oldtimer mileage, whether the report should be improved, the reasons for abolishing the oldtimer motor vehicle tax exemption, and how revenue and motion implementation were calculated. The government answered that the PBL figures rest on CBS data, that the exemption removal serves environmental and budgetary aims, and that an agreed alternative with the trade sector will be included in the 2014 tax plan.
This alternative will be included in the Tax Plan 2014 and will be covered within the overall package of measures.
Dit alternatief zal worden meegenomen in het Belastingplan 2014 en zal binnen het totaalpakket aan maatregelen worden gedekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over de recordopbrengst aan boetes en onduidelijkheid rond 130 km/u-wegen

Two SP MPs asked why the ministry ran an information campaign after confusion about the 130 km/u limit on the A2, whether speeding fines show confusion, which road sections account for most tickets, and whether matrix signs should show limits. The minister said fines data cannot show the cause of speeding, that road signs are clear and flyers were distributed, that the CJIB has no data by road section, and that a Rijkswaterstaat user survey covering signage is due in September 2013 with fixed signs kept for permanent limits.
The CJIB has informed me that its registration system does not distinguish by road section.
Het CJIB heeft mij meegedeeld dat het in zijn registratiesysteem geen onderscheid maakt naar wegvakken.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Veiligheid en Justitie over files door flitsteams (ingezonden 15 juli 2013).

An MP asks whether police speed checks that cause traffic jams, and why they are not stopped immediately, should be ended. The ministers answer that such jams are undesirable, that controls are also used for investigation, and that checks causing jams are to be suspended immediately.
The speed check is immediately terminated if it turns out to cause a traffic jam.
De snelheidscontrole wordt direct beëindigd als blijkt dat die een file veroorzaakt.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de werkdruk en de wurgcontracten van Ryanair-piloten (ingezonden 22 juli 2013).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about Ryanair's treatment of pilots, including union rights, safety risks from workload, Irish oversight, and social security routes. The government said it lacks full knowledge of Ryanair's conditions, relies on Irish and EASA oversight, sees no need to change the European safety system, and declined to meet the pilots' union.
The current European system of aviation safety oversight functions well.
Het huidige Europese systeem van veiligheidstoezicht in de luchtvaart functioneert goed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) niet over de veiligheid van de Fyra gaat

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether ILT certification of the Fyra V250 means the train is safe, and how ILT can call the Fyra unsafe-verdict premature while stating it does not certify on safety. The state secretary replied that a type approval only confirms basic safety requirements and not per-train production quality, that ILT inspections did not on their own show the Fyra failed safety standards, and that an audit of the licensing process would be completed by 1 November 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht in het Algemeen Dagblad van 15 juli 2013 dat Randstadrail wordt geplaagd door wisselstoringen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about recurring switch failures on Randstadrail and whether the regional operators should use the same switch supplier. The state secretary replied that responsibility lies with the regional authorities and operators, that the switches will be replaced before winter, and that supplier choice is for those parties.
Although responsibility for Randstadrail lies with the regional governments and their operators HTM and RET, I of course take note of the reports on this subject.
Hoewel de verantwoordelijkheid voor Randstadrail bij de regionale overheden en hun vervoerders HTM en RET ligt neem ik uiteraard wel kennis van de berichten over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over een volledige open sky tussen Nederland en Suriname

An MP asked the state secretary about a full open-skies agreement with Suriname, given reported Turkish and US moves and high fares on Amsterdam-Paramaribo. The state secretary replied that the existing open-character agreement already allows three carriers per country, that ACM found no excessive fares, and that no new open-skies treaty is needed now, though he is willing to talk if necessary.
I am always willing to talk about a further liberalisation of the current air transport agreement should the need arise in the future.
Ik ben altijd bereid om te praten over een nog ruimere mate van liberalisatie van het huidige luchtvaartverdrag indien daar in de toekomst noodzaak toe blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over uitspraken van econoom Philippe Boucher over de levensvatbaarheid van regionale luchthavens

MP Bashir asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment how the government views economist Boucher's claim that many regional airports are not viable, whether public investment in them makes sense, and whether provinces should keep supporting loss-making airports and Ryanair receives discounts at regional airports. The State Secretary answered that airport viability is left to market parties under a market-oriented approach, that the central government generally does not finance regional airports except in exceptional, consulted cases, that airports' financial results are not reported to government, that provincial support is a provincial decision, and that airport-airline discount deals are a matter for the airport and, if contested, the competition authority ACM.
Airports report their financial results to their shareholders. There is no obligation to report these to me.
Luchthavens rapporteren hun financiële resultaten aan hun aandeelhouders. Er is geen verplichting om deze aan mij te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het controleren van box 3-aangiften door de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how many box 3 tax returns were thoroughly checked by the Tax Authority, how many FTE are available, and about data sources and foreign property. The State Secretary declined to give totals or selection criteria, stating the Tax Authority does not have a consolidated overview, and described existing data sources and ongoing efforts on automatic information exchange.
Due to the multitude of forms, an overall picture of the number of box 3 checks and the associated capacity deployment is not available.
Door de veelheid aan verschijningsvormen is een totaalbeeld van het aantal box 3-controles en de daarmee gemoeide capaciteitsinzet niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het onterecht krijgen van toeslagen door Oost Europeanen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why the tax authority does not check whether registered persons still live and work in the Netherlands, and how many benefit recipients live abroad and what is paid to them. The State Secretary explains that childcare, health and child benefit allowances are exportable under EU and international rules, reports about 45,000 non-resident recipients and several million euros paid, and describes risk-profile checks, stopping and recovering payments and address-based reviews.
With the help of risk profiles, about 1,200 childcare allowances and about 400 rent allowances have been stopped since 11 March 2013.
Met behulp van de risicoprofielen zijn vanaf 11 maart 2013 ongeveer 1.200 kinderopvangtoeslagen en ongeveer 400 huurtoeslagen gestopt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bashir en Paulus Jansen over het opschorten van toeslagen en hypotheekrenteaftrek

MPs Bashir and Paulus Jansen (SP) asked why childcare and other allowances were withheld without prior notice during an investigation of entitlement, how many people were affected, and how the burden of proof and reimbursement timing were handled. State Secretary Weekers answered that a processing error blocked payments to 1411 allowance recipients and 518 tax refunds, which were then paid late, with about 750 cases paid twice, and described the balie and letter procedure for verifying entitlement.
Immediately after the error was discovered, the allowances and income tax refunds were paid after all (by the first week of July at the latest).
Direct nadat de fout is ontdekt zijn de toeslagen en de terugbetalingen inkomstenbelasting alsnog uitbetaald (uiterlijk in de eerste week van juli).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het niet functioneren van de trajectcontrole op de A2

An SP MP asked why the A2 average-speed (trajectory) control between Utrecht and Amsterdam was split between two suppliers, why it is not yet operational, what it has cost and how speeding is enforced meanwhile. The minister answers that the split was a deliberate choice for competition and risk spreading, that delays stem from a difference of view on test quality which is now resolved, that the system goes live on 15 July 2013, and that mobile checks cover the gap.
The system will be put into operation on 15 July 2013.
Het systeem zal op 15 juli 2013 in werking worden gesteld.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de foutmarge van de trajectcontroles

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the state secretary could know that the error margin of traffic-section speed cameras falls within the 1-in-10,000 norm, and asked how many motorists were wrongly fined, whether they will be refunded, and whether fines will be checked manually. The minister said the margin was agreed with the supplier, about 200 complaints fell within it pending validation, referred to a separate letter for the figures, and judged further measures unnecessary, citing the OM's planned optimisation and manual review by BOA officers.
For the answer to these questions I refer to the letter I sent to your House today about the traffic-section control systems.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik naar de brief die ik uw Kamer heden stuurde over de trajectcontrolesystemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over duidelijkheid omtrent de duur van de hypotheekrenteaftrek bij trouwen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about conflicting interpretations of how long mortgage interest deduction lasts when partners marry, and about the Tax Service's delayed answers and whether homeowners should receive annual overviews. The State Secretary confirmed the Tax Service applies the interpretation that a single loan cannot yield more than 30 years of deduction, admitted earlier 2010 answers differed, kept the old position for the old regime, and declined annual overviews for now, while committing to a policy decision clarifying the issue.
The explanatory memorandum to that bill also gave an example of the consequences of marriage under the owner-occupied home scheme in force until 1 January 2013.
In de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag bij dat wetsvoorstel is ook een voorbeeld gegeven van de gevolgen van een huwelijk onder de tot 1 januari 2013 geldende eigenwoningregeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het vertrek van de president-directeur van de NS

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister why NS chief executive Meerstadt left, whether it relates to the failed Fyra, how his successor Huges was selected, and why the Balkenende norm does not apply to his pay. The minister answered that Meerstadt left voluntarily without severance, the supervisory board ran a standard search with an external firm, and the successor's pay is about 35% lower than his predecessor's under a new pay policy, with the Balkenende norm not applying to such holdings.
As is well known, holdings do not fall under the Public Sector Top Incomes Act because they are not publicly funded and are generally subject to competition.
Zoals bekend vallen deelnemingen niet onder de Wet Normering Topinkomens omdat zij niet publiek bekostigd worden en omdat zij over het algemeen aan concurrentie onderhevig zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bashir en Paulus Jansen over de gevolgen van de auto van de zaak voor het autogebruik

MPs Bashir and Jansen (SP) asked the ministers whether they endorse Van Ommeren's analysis that the company car tax regime causes large economic losses through extra car travel, parking and vehicle choice. State Secretary Weekers rejected the analysis and its conclusions, arguing the evidence for the claimed effects is weak and that existing tax burdens and employer incentives already address these issues.
No, I endorse neither the main lines of the analysis nor all of the conclusions.
Nee, ik onderschrijf noch de hoofdlijnen van de analyse noch alle conclusies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over een mogelijke ‘bevriezing’ van deelcertificaten van het motorexamen

An SP MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a possible freeze of motorcycle licence theory certificates, equal treatment, A2/A-zwaar access, and compensation for candidates who could not sit exams in autumn 2012. The minister answered largely by pointing to EU directive requirements and stated policy choices, offering a EUR 150 goodwill payment and declining to reopen the exam or change the A1 rules.
I will examine in the coming years whether it is desirable to do that for those moving from A1 via A2 to A.
Ik zal de komende jaren bezien of het wenselijk is om dat voor doorstromers van A1 via A2 naar A wel te doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de verkeersveiligheid op de N57

An MP asked the minister whether serious accidents occur on the N57 without a physical median and whether a full median barrier and a concrete safety plan with the provinces would be pursued. The minister acknowledged accidents, said the N57's risk figure is not out of line with comparable roads, and listed completed and planned measures already discussed with the provinces.
The risk figure (number of [serious] casualties per million vehicle kilometres driven) for the N57 is, however, not deviant from similar national roads in other regions.
Het risicocijfer (aantal [ernstige] slachtoffers per miljoen gereden voertuigkilometers) voor de N57 is echter niet afwijkend ten opzichte van soortgelijke rijkswegen in andere regio's.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Bashir over vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about the composition of a hazardous-goods train that derailed at Wetteren in Belgium, whether rules were broken, whether emergency services are informed in advance, and whether tank wagons and safety norms are adequate. The government answered that no rules were broken, emergency services are not notified per train but have category-level data via OVGS, tank wagons met Dutch norms at departure, and it will raise safety improvements internationally only if the Belgian investigation finds grounds.
If not, are you willing to make such advance information provision mandatory?
Zo nee, bent u bereid dergelijke informatievoorziening vooraf te gaan verplichten?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het forfaitair rendement in box 3 van de Wet IB 2001

MP Bashir asked the state secretary of Finance whether the 4% forfaitair return in box 3 is fair given low savings rates, and whether a capital gains tax should replace the wealth yield tax. The state secretary rejected the claim that savings rates only fell since 2008, defended the 4% long-term benchmark as stable revenue, declined to change it for budgetary reasons, and said a capital gains tax would raise administrative costs.
I therefore have no intention of proposing the introduction of a capital gains tax.
Ik heb dan ook geen voornemen om een voorstel te doen voor de invoering van een vermogenswinstbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir over de skydivesport

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked whether air traffic control's limits on skydiving centres' altitude and frequency threaten the sport, and what the government will do. The state secretary replied that a 2010 regulation and the 2012 Luchtruimvisie prioritise Schiphol traffic, that talks are under way with the KNVvL and clubs on relocating springing sites, and that the sport will be facilitated but the choice of location is not the ministry's.

It is now essential to start a process for General Aviation as a whole to accommodate these functions in a future-proof way and, if necessary, relocate them within the framework of the Luchtruimvisie.

Het is nu zaak om voor de General Aviation in den brede een traject te starten om deze functies toekomstvast te accommoderen en indien nodig te verplaatsen binnen de kaders die de Luchtruimvisie biedt.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de crisis in de binnenvaart en nieuwe motorenrichtlijn voor binnenvaartschepen

An SP MP asks the minister about the inland shipping crisis, the government's progress in requesting an EU crisis declaration, and an EU engine directive that could apply to existing vessels. The minister answers that Belgium is preparing the crisis notification, that the Netherlands supports it, that concrete industry proposals are needed, and that the EU engine study is not finished and has no 2020 deadline.
I have already pointed out to the European Commission, and will repeat on occasion, that any proposals must take proper account of their affordability, given the current economic crisis.

Ik heb de Europese Commissie al eerder er op gewezen, en zal dat bij gelegenheid herhalen, dat bij het formuleren van eventuele voorstellen terdege rekening gehouden moet worden met de financierbaarheid daarvan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht “België werkt aan verbod op dumpvrachten”

An MP asked the minister whether the Netherlands should follow Belgium in banning sailing below cost in inland shipping, given Belgium's plan for a royal decree. The minister said the Belgian measure is not yet specified, that such proposals should be considered at EU level, and that he will urge Belgian counterparts to raise them there.
I will therefore urge my Belgian counterparts to raise these proposals in the upcoming consultation at European level on inland shipping
Ik zal derhalve bij mijn Belgische ambtsgenoten erop aandringen deze voorstellen in te brengen in het komende overleg op Europees niveau over de binnenvaart
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de Garantieregeling Scheepsnieuwbouwfinanciering

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs and Infrastructure ministers whether the shipbuilding loan guarantee (GSF) applies to inland vessels, why it is not extended to modernisation, and what the budget and risks are. The minister answered that the guarantee is a level-playing-field measure for shipyards, not a capacity stimulus, that it covers new builds with a ceiling of 1 billion euro per year, and that modernisation is excluded to preserve EU state-aid compliance.
The purpose of the GSF is to enable shipyards to finance the construction of a vessel, not to stimulate an increase in inland shipping capacity.
Doel van de GSF is scheepswerven in staat te stellen de financiering van de bouw van een schip te realiseren en niet om de vergroting van de capaciteit in de binnenvaart te stimuleren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht in de Gelderlander “Forse groei rijscholen is ongewenst”

An SP MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a sharp rise in driving schools, whether UWV-funded retraining had caused it, whether municipalities should stop referring people to driving instructor training, and how pupils could be protected from unqualified or underpriced schools. The minister answered that the driving school market is free, that instructor qualifications are set by law, that UWV-funded training has fallen and no recent figures exist, that municipalities have full discretion, that entrepreneurship training will not be required, and that the CBR and tax authority supervise and publish pass rates.
Recent figures specifically for the driving school sector are not available.
Recente cijfers voor specifiek de rijschoolbranche zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Roemer over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het bericht dat meer treinen door rood rijden

MPs Bashir and Roemer asked the state secretary why he had not yet responded to earlier questions on the rise in trains passing red signals (STS-passages), why 2012 per-operator figures were withheld, and what would be done to get other operators to invest in driver training. The state secretary replied that the annual STS report will be sent to parliament in June 2013, that he sees no reason to anticipate its analysis, and that operators give sufficient attention to the problem under the joint improvement plan.
With this in view, I have answered that I see no reason to anticipate this analysis.
Met het oog daarop heb ik geantwoord dat ik geen aanleiding zie om op deze analyse vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Ulenbelt over gesjoemel met lonen in de bouw

MPs Bashir and Ulenbelt asked the ministers how foreign construction firms use constructions to underpay social premiums, which controls apply, whether the NMa, FIOD and Belastingdienst are involved, and what measures will follow. The minister answered that inspectorates are cooperating and have broad powers, pointed to an action plan on sham constructions with intensified supervision, and withheld Belastingdienst findings citing confidentiality.
As you have seen in the action plan, we will intensify this supervision.
Zoals u heeft gezien in het actieplan zullen we dit toezicht gaan intensiveren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir inzake overlast door dichte spitsstroken en het belang van een vluchtstrook

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the 18 March 2013 failure to open the A12 peak-hour lane, the software update behind it, back-up systems for traffic cameras, and the need for emergency lanes after an accident on the A2. The minister explained the software-update failure, the planned weekend maintenance and existing back-up systems, and said emergency lanes remain part of the basic motorway design while peak-hour lanes are used only after case-by-case safety weighing.
The importance of the emergency lane is certainly recognised by me.
Het belang van de vluchtstrook wordt zeker door mij erkend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de verwerking van teerhoudend asfalt

An SP MP asks whether policy on tar-containing asphalt granulate is working, given continued export of large volumes to Baltic states, what has been done since a motion to prevent export, and why not all road managers require thermal cleaning in their tenders. The state secretary replies that Dutch policy works for Dutch-origin material but about half is still exported legally under EU rules, lists actions such as revising CROW guidance and standard tender clauses, and gives 2012 export figures without naming individual exporters.
Can you indicate how many tonnes of asphalt have been exported since the motion was adopted, where to, and by whom?
Vraag 3 Kunt u aangeven hoeveel ton asfalt sinds het aannemen van de motie is geëxporteerd, waarheen en door wie?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over horizontaal toezicht

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about horizontal supervision of the Tax Administration, including whether budget cuts and rising firm numbers undermine vertical enforcement. The State Secretary answered that the instruments complement each other, cuts do not affect supervision, extra staff and enforcement measures are underway, and that there is no real disagreement with the staff association.
The cuts do not come at the expense of supervision.
De bezuinigingen gaan niet ten koste van het toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat meer treinen door rood rijden

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the rise in trains passing red signals (175 last year), what would reduce this before ERTMS is installed, whether rail operators pay enough attention, the per-operator figures, and whether others should follow NS's driver training. The state secretary pointed to the joint ProRail/industry improvement plan and the ILT's pending analysis, gave only indicative figures, and declined to pre-empt the ILT's annual report on driver training.
The ILT is expected to have final figures at the end of February. As usual, I will send Parliament the annual report with the analysis of the figures in June.
Naar verwachting heeft de ILT eind februari definitieve cijfers beschikbaar. Zoals gebruikelijk zend ik uw Kamer in juni de jaarlijkse rapportage met de analyse van de cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Bashir over “premieshoppen op Cyprus”

MPs Ulenbelt and Bashir asked about Dutch lorry drivers employed through Cypriot agencies to pay social premiums in Cyprus, and about SVB and inspectorate controls. The minister says the SVB applies EU coordination rules, has had slow information exchange with Cyprus, will ask Cyprus to investigate, and promises an integrated approach to sham constructions by 1 May.
By 1 May at the latest I will inform you about an integrated approach to curbing sham constructions.
Uiterlijk 1 mei zal ik u informeren over een integrale aanpak voor het terugdringen van schijnconstructies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Bashir over het bericht dat Nederlandse banken tientallen vennootschappen hebben in belastingparadijzen

SP MPs Merkies and Bashir asked whether Dutch banks, especially state-supported ones, should avoid tax via tax-haven subsidiaries, whether such structures are tax avoidance, and whether banks should disclose and justify foreign subsidiaries, plus the status of a proposed reporting duty for tax advisers. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that he has no reason to doubt banks' stated reasons, that tax avoidance is legal but sometimes undesirable, that foreign subsidiaries are already partly disclosed and tax authorities have sufficient powers, and that a reporting point for tax advisers is unnecessary given existing covenants.
Moreover, Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act does not allow me to go into individual cases.
Overigens staat artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelasting mij niet toe in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat Arriva een gevaar is op het spoor

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a near-collision involving an Arriva train at Herfte, whether it was reported to the ILT, and whether Arriva's safety and driver familiarity were adequate, along with STS-passage statistics, the effects of market liberalisation on rail safety, and progress on a warning system and capacity funding. The state secretary replied that the incident was reported immediately, the ILT found no dangerous situation and opened no further investigation, that no broader safety problems were found, and described the warning-system pilot and capacity projects.
The ILT decided not to launch a follow-up investigation into this incident.
De ILT heeft besloten geen vervolgonderzoek naar dit incident in te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de oplopende wachttijden voor rijexamens bij het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An SP MP asked the minister about rising waiting times for driving tests at the CBR, whether they are reasonable, whether labour negotiations are linked, and whether capacity is sufficient. The minister said waiting times are mostly within the 7-week norm (exceptions for re-tests in two locations), sees no reason to intervene, denies a link with the CAO talks, and states capacity is adequate, with the late-2012 rise attributed to the new EU directive and snow.
Given the development outlined under question 1, I see no reason to intervene.
Gezien de onder vraag 1 geschetste ontwikkeling zie ik geen reden in te grijpen.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over fiscale vluchtroutes door Nederland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about multinationals such as Google, Starbucks and Amazon using Dutch structures for tax avoidance, including whether the Dutch government facilitates this and whether royalty tax rulings give discounts. The State Secretary declined to judge individual companies, rejected the claim that the Netherlands aims to facilitate avoidance, said no rates are reduced via rulings, and promised a technical briefing and further action through EU and OECD initiatives.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not allow me to give a judgment on the tax position of an individual company.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen staat mij niet toe een oordeel geven over de belastingpositie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over ‘de karige informatie op de voorschotbeschikkingen voor de zorg- en huurtoeslag 2013’

An SP MP asked why the 2013 childcare and rent allowance advance decisions omit the assessed income and rent data, and whether this information can be restored given that many people lack internet access. The state secretary defended the compact notice as more efficient, pointed to Mijn toeslagen, BelTel and service points as alternatives, and declined to restore the information on all decisions.
Compared with the decision sent last year, the compact notice saves 17 million A4 sheets.
Ten opzichte van de beschikking zoals die vorig jaar nog werd verzonden levert de compacte mededeling een besparing van 17 miljoen vellen A4 op.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht in het Algemeen Dagblad ‘Een op de vijf rijscholen werkt zwart’

An MP asked the ministers whether driving schools that appear to under-report revenue, and whether cheap lessons and possible examination irregularities, warrant action, and asked about instructor entry requirements and entrepreneurship training. The government said the Tax Administration is targeting about 20% of driving schools with a themed approach, that discrepancies do not automatically imply fraud, and declined to judge the entry requirements while the WRM evaluation is ongoing.
The intention is to take firm action against driving school owners who deliberately commit fraud.
Daarbij is het de bedoeling dat bewust frauderende rijschoolhouders krachtig worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Bashir en Van Tongeren inzake publieke functies voorzitter Raad voor de Leefomgeving

MPs Van Gerven and Bashir asked whether the chair of the Raad voor de Leefomgeving en Infrastructuur, Meijdam, should step down given questions about his integrity and an appearance of conflict of interest, while also chairing the Meijdam committee on the OV-chipkaart. The minister answered that transparency safeguards were agreed (code on conflicts of interest, disclosure of ancillary positions, ending his lobbying activities) and saw no reason for further measures.

Thirdly, I made agreements with the chair of the Rli well before his appointment that he would cease his activities as a lobbyist for building companies and developers regarding plots and positions, after completion of ongoing assignments.

Ten derde heb ik met de voorzitter van de Rli al ruim vóór zijn aantreden afspraken gemaakt dat hij zijn activiteiten als belangenbehartiger voor plots en posities van bouwbedrijven en ontwikkelaars zou staken, na afronding van lopende opdrachten.
