Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over concurrentievervalsing door buitenlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen

An MP asked the state secretary whether Gulf carriers receive subsidies and unfair advantages such as lower airport fees, and what the government would do about job losses and the level playing field. The state secretary replied that no facts of unfair competition or subsidies are known, that bilateral agreements require non-discriminatory access, and that the government supports EU transparency and anti-distortion initiatives, with the air services agreement as a last resort.
I am not aware of any facts showing that there is unfair competition to the detriment of Dutch airlines.
Feiten waaruit zou blijken dat er sprake is van oneerlijke concurrentie ten nadele van Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de overeenstemming tussen de Verenigde Staten (VS) en de vijf grootste economieën van Europa om belastingontduiking tegen te gaan

An SP MP asked whether the US and five major European economies reached agreement against tax evasion and what Netherlands lost to evasion in 2011, and why the Netherlands has not signed. The state secretary explained the model FATCA-based bilateral agreement, said the revenue loss cannot be estimated, and said talks with the US will continue.
It is not possible to estimate the amount the Netherlands lost to tax evasion in 2011.
Het is niet mogelijk om een inschatting te geven van het bedrag dat Nederland in 2011 is misgelopen door belastingontduiking
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de grote zorgen bij de kleine binnenvaart

An SP MP asked the ministers about serious concerns in the small inland shipping sector, including fears for vessels under 1000 tonnes, bottom tariffs, crisis measures and the modal shift target. The minister responded that market parties bear primary responsibility, that regulatory changes depend on the Central Commission for Rhine Navigation, that a Transition Committee is implementing structural recommendations, and that no short-term crisis measures are feasible.
I sent this report to the House on 16 November 2011, together with my response.
Ik heb dit rapport op 16 november 2011 samen met mijn zienswijze naar de Kamer gestuurd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over mogelijke belastingontwijking door NS

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether NS Financial Services Co, NS's financing subsidiary, is based in Dublin to avoid Dutch tax, and what the tax and dividend effects are. The government explains the Dublin location was chosen for lease-company investment conditions, declines to give individual tax figures citing secrecy rules, denies any effect on executive bonuses, and says Dutch tax is not earmarked for public transport.
The confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents disclosing information about individual taxpayers.
De geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat eraan in de weg informatie over individuele belastingplichtigen openbaar te maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de verhoging van de tarieven van het openbaar vervoer in Haaglanden

An SP MP asked the minister about steep fare increases in Haaglanden public transport (about 11.6% for bus and tram, 15.7% for Randstadrail), questioning their link to budget cuts and whether they were introduced covertly. The minister defended the increases as legally permitted tariff freedom of the regional authority, attributed the revenue shortfall to the concession design, and stated that passengers were adequately informed.
The Haaglanden regional authority has tariff freedom under the Passenger Transport Act 2000 and may decide on tariffs, subject to the statutory duty to seek advice from consumer organisations.

Het Stadsgewest Haaglanden heeft tariefvrijheid als opgenomen in de Wet personenvervoer 2000 en het staat haar vrij, met inachtneming van de wettelijke adviesplicht van consumentenorganisaties, om besluiten te nemen over de tarieven.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de RET die gesprekken zou opnemen of afluisteren (ingezonden 11 mei 2012).

MP Bashir asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether RET tram and bus operators record or listen in on passengers' conversations, when recording began, how long recordings are kept, whether the privacy regulator knows, and whether there is a legal basis. The state secretary answered that there is no link between radios and recording equipment, that cameras with audio have been in use since 2008 and in new trams since mid-2011, that the recordings were recently reported to the privacy regulator, and referred to earlier answers for retention and legal basis.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over subsidie op schone motoren voor de binnenvaart

MP Bashir asks why a subsidy for clean engines applies to road freight but not inland shipping, and whether a scheme for engines meeting the highest CCR standards will be developed. The state secretary answers that a subsidy is only effective alongside tighter EU emission norms, which are not expected before 2013, so he invests instead in milieuverbeterplannen and an LNG Green Deal, and sees no need for a new CCR-compliant engine subsidy.
A subsidy scheme is not by definition the most effective way to make a sector more sustainable.
Een subsidieregeling is niet per definitie de meest effectieve manier om een sector te verduurzamen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de onbeveiligde spoorwegovergangen van de Valleilijn (herdruk)

An SP MP asks the minister about unprotected level crossings on the Valleilijn, including a fatal 2010 collision at Doolhoflaan, a near-miss at Wildzoom, and a 2012 collision at Zandkamp in Lunteren near a childcare centre. The minister admits ProRail's timelines were too ambitious, says the Doolhoflaan crossing was actively secured in 2011 and that Zandkamp removal stalled due to non-cooperating rights holders, and gives a general assurance that sufficient attention and urgency exist.

In general terms it can be said that ProRail, when drawing up the schedule for the measures of the Valleilijn level crossing safety project, planned the lead times for consultation, design, tendering and execution too ambitiously.

In algemene zin kan worden gesteld dat ProRail bij het opstellen van de planning voor de maatregelen uit het Project Verbetering Overwegveiligheid Valleilijn de doorlooptijden van bijvoorbeeld overleg, ontwerp, aanbesteding en uitvoering te ambitieus heeft gepland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Bashir over het invoeren van een meldingsplicht voor buitenlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs om de naleving van cabotageregels makkelijker te kunnen controleren

MPs Ulenbelt and Bashir asked the minister whether a registration duty for foreign truck drivers would make cabotage rules easier to enforce, and whether Belgian practice and tax losses justify it. The minister answered that the ILT will first run an inventory study after the WWG amendment takes effect, and only then will consider a registration study, while stating that no evidence yet exists on the scale of violations.
After the ILT study mentioned in the answer to question 1 is completed, I will consider whether a study into the possibilities of a registration duty is desirable.
Na afronding van het onderzoek van de ILT, genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 1, zal ik bezien of een onderzoek naar de mogelijkheden van een registratieplicht wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de potentieel onveilige spoorbrug over de Eefsche Beek

An SP MP asked the minister about a possibly unsafe rail bridge over the Eefsche Beek, after a report that contractor VolkerRail released it for train traffic without proper anchoring, and about maintenance quality, contracting and whistleblowing. The minister said ProRail judged the bridge unsafe after the works and that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport is investigating, with an ongoing inspection into ProRail's maintenance philosophy whose results are awaited, while stating existing channels for anonymous reports suffice and no reason to exist to bring maintenance back in-house.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de gigantische stijging van het aantal klachten in het openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the minister whether the austerity policy contributed to a sharp rise in public transport complaints, whether tariff increases should be restrained, and what will be done about the star-subscription chip card transition and quality. The minister denied that austerity caused the rise, defended regional tariff increases, and promised a winter programme and a request to improve passenger communication.
Relative to the number of passengers, I do not find this to be enormous.
In verhouding met het aantal reizigers vind ik dit niet gigantisch veel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de noodzaak van tunnels bij spoorwegovergangen in Castricum en Heiloo

An SP MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about level crossings in Castricum and Heiloo, where barriers are closed for long periods, and about the funding shares offered to the municipalities for tunnels. The minister disputes the closure figures, says a methodology study on accessibility is underway, offers to fund up to half of cost-effective solutions in Castricum and points to a fixed lump-sum grant in Heiloo, promising to discuss further funding with the province and report in the next PHS progress letter.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over vangrails die niet bestand zijn tegen zware vrachtwagens

An SP MP asked the Infrastructure minister whether older median guardrails can no longer withstand heavy trucks, how many crashes occurred, whether SWOV's call for a review would be followed, and whether guardrails would be made motorcycle-friendly. The minister replied that guardrails meet the EU H2 standard, reported 8 truck crashes in 2011, declined a new study for now while agreeing to discuss with SWOV, and stated that risky locations have been fitted with motorcycle-friendly barriers.
I do not consider the requested study necessary for now, given the current policy on the application and maintenance of guardrails.
Ik acht het gevraagde onderzoek vooralsnog niet nodig gelet op het vigerende beleid ten aanzien van de toepassing en instandhouding van vangrails.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de gevolgen van het fiscaal partnerbegrip voor mantelzorgverleners

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether adult children who take a parent into the home for care are treated as fiscal partners inconsistently, and whether this penalises them. The State Secretary replied that partner criteria are objective, that the penalty framing is wrong since it reflects household capacity, and that reinstating an option for unmarried cohabitants is not planned.
I am not in favour of reintroducing this for a specific category, in which there are moreover no undesirable effects.
Ik voel er niet voor om deze te herintroduceren voor een specifieke categorie, waarin bovendien geen sprake is van ongewenste gevolgen.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de IJsselbrug bij Westervoort

An SP MP asks the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the narrowing of the IJssel bridge at Westervoort, its cost, and lessons learned, including whether the side barriers were justified by a single incident and whether they will be replaced by lower barriers and traffic lights. The minister defends the barriers as necessary to protect the inspection path, gives cost figures of about 145,000 and 50,000 euros, confirms the chosen alternative with traffic lights and a curb, and gives a vague answer on lessons learned.
The precise design of the curb is still being discussed by Rijkswaterstaat with the municipalities, so the costs are not yet clear.
Over de precieze vormgeving van de schamprand is Rijkswaterstaat nog in overleg met de gemeenten en daarom zijn de kosten nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Paulus Jansen over de fiscale behandeling van waterwoningen

MPs Bashir and Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance how the Supreme Court ruling on floating houses (waterwoningen) affects transfer tax, mortgage interest relief, the eigenwoningforfait, municipal property tax and box 3 wealth tax, with worked examples, numbers and a plan to remove the unequal treatment. The State Secretary answered that floating homes classed as movable goods fall outside transfer tax and box 3 while the ruling leaves the owner-occupier rules intact, that the number and revenue effect are highly uncertain (a few hundred homes, a few million euros a year), and that he will examine options to remove the difference, reporting by the Belastingplan 2013.
I am not prepared to accept this difference in advance.
Ik ben niet bereid dit verschil op voorhand te accepteren.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de analyse van ING Economisch Bureau over de binnenvaart

MP Bashir asked the minister whether she shares ING Economic Bureau's view on the inland shipping sector, including the vulnerability of independent skippers, the need for small vessels, and calls for a sector crisis declaration with bottom tariffs. The minister replied that ING does not say the free market fails but confirms the sector's structural weaknesses, that market parties are primarily responsible, that a 2009 request for a crisis declaration was rejected by the Commission and no new grounds exist, and that she will investigate bottom tariffs in other member states.
The ING Economic Bureau report provides no new arguments that could lead the European Commission to a different assessment.
Het rapport van ING Economisch Bureau geeft geen nieuwe argumenten die de Europese Commissie tot een andere afweging zouden kunnen brengen.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over aanlegplaatsen in Capelle aan den IJssel

MP Bashir asks whether binnenvaart vessels can no longer moor anywhere in Capelle aan den IJssel, whether the municipality can be asked to create a berth, how often Rijkswaterstaat bars use of mooring places, and how adequate mooring capacity will be ensured. The minister confirms there are no public moorings in Capelle aan den IJssel under the current policy, offers to have the municipality create two berths that Rijkswaterstaat could exempt, says such bans occur regularly without registration, and points to MIRT studies and local consultation as the way to secure capacity.
There are no public mooring places at Capelle aan den IJssel, and there have not been any in the recent past.
Bij Capelle aan den IJssel zijn geen openbare ligplaatsen en die zijn er in het recente verleden ook niet geweest.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over heling van gestolen koper van ProRail

MP Bashir asked the ministers whether they would act against fencing of stolen copper from ProRail and whether railway scrap dealers could be summoned, and asked about measures against copper theft and alternatives to copper. The ministers said they were alarmed, pointed to a convenant and action group, listed prevention measures and planned steps, but declined to name the scrap dealers, citing journalistic source protection.
PowNews then indicated it did not want to provide that information, invoking the protection of journalistic sources.
PowNews heeft toen aangegeven die gegevens niet te willen verstrekken met een beroep op de bescherming van journalistieke bronnen.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Gesthuizen over sluizen, gemalen en bruggen die slecht beveiligd zijn

Two SP MPs asked whether locks, pumping stations and bridges that can be operated remotely over the internet are insecure, whether other municipalities use the same SCADA systems, why earlier warnings from the NCTb were not acted on, and whether these structures should be manned again. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat-managed structures are largely not internet-connected, that security is continuously monitored, and that she is responsible only for Rijkswaterstaat objects, not for municipalities.

As minister I am responsible for the management of locks, pumping stations and bridges managed by Rijkswaterstaat, and I therefore cannot answer for the municipality of Veere or for other municipalities or authorities.

Als minister ben ik verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van sluizen, gemalen en bruggen die door Rijkswaterstaat beheerd worden en ik kan derhalve niet antwoorden voor de gemeente Veere of voor andere gemeenten of overheden.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over snoepautomaten in Connexxion bussen

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Connexxion's ban on eating self-brought food in snack-machine buses, while snacks are sold, is absurd, amounts to forced retail, and whether Connexxion should be called to order. The minister replied that fruit was tolerated, the change is a pilot, the concession authority is the regional body, and that the ministry cannot instruct Connexxion on its products, with results to be discussed with the Stadsregio.
It is not for me to call Connexxion to account for its products.
Het is niet aan de mij om Connexxion aan te spreken op zijn producten.
Antwoord vragen Bashir, Gesthuizen en Irrgang inzake het toezicht op goede doelen

MPs Bashir, Gesthuizen and Irrgang (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about supervision of charities after a VPRO programme found many ANBI-listed organisations did not meet the listing conditions, including missing policy plans and governance requirements. The State Secretary declined to assess the CIGD study because only an anonymised extract was provided, described the Tax Authority's supervision and revocation powers, and said legislation requiring ANBIs to publish balance sheets is being prepared for submission before summer.
If it turns out that an institution does not meet one or more conditions, the Tax Authority can ask the institution's board to remedy the omissions within a reasonable period.

Indien mocht blijken dat een instelling niet voldoet aan één of meer voorwaarden, dan kan de Belastingdienst het bestuur van een instelling verzoeken om binnen een redelijke termijn de omissies te herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de opvolging van adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid over het spoor

An SP MP asked the minister whether the rail sector and the ministry are failing to follow Safety Board (OvV) recommendations, notably on the Barendrecht collision, on signals passed at danger (STS), ERTMS, and registration of recommendations. The minister rejects the claim that recommendations are generally ignored, gives a timeline of the sector's responses and STS figures, refers to attachments for the full overview, and promises to inform parliament on the ERTMS strategy.
The recommendations of the Dutch Safety Board are generally followed up by the parties concerned.
De adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid worden in het algemeen door partijen opgevolgd.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over malafide praktijken bij parkeerbedrijven rond Schiphol (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

An MP asked the ministers about fraudulent practices by parking companies near Schiphol, including damaged cars and extra mileage, and what the government would do about it, including whether the inspectorate should act. The minister said police registered 11 complaints against these companies in 2011, saw no regulatory role for the inspectorate, and pointed to civil remedies and self-regulatory comparison websites.
I see no role for the Inspectorate for the Environment and Transport (ILT).
Ik zie geen taak voor de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT).
Antwoord vragen Bashir over het voorkomen van kijkfiles

An MP asked the infrastructure minister about 'rubbernecking' traffic jams, including their cost, police waving traffic on, and deploying mobile screens at accidents. The minister reported 267 such jams in 2011 costing an estimated 4 to 8 million euros, said waving traffic on by inspectors is sufficient, and noted screens are used only when deemed effective, with no shortage found so far.
So far, in practice it has not been shown that there is a shortage of screens.
Tot nu toe is in de praktijk niet gebleken dat er een tekort aan schermen is.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Vervoerders woest op beheerder chipkaart» (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister about reports that Trans Link Systems raised OV-chipkaart tariffs by over 6% instead of the usual 2% and changed the base, and about its salaries, poor finances and possible dissolution. The minister replied that TLS is a private company outside ministerial responsibility, that the tariff error was corrected, that finances match forecasts, and that the permanent structure for the chipkaart is still being designed.
TLS is an independent private company, set up by a number of transport companies. The ministry therefore has no role or responsibility regarding the tariffs.
TLS is een zelfstandige, private onderneming, opgericht door een aantal vervoerbedrijven. Het ministerie heeft derhalve geen rol noch verantwoordelijkheid ten aanzien van de tarieven
Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het opeens stopzetten van toeslagen (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary of Finance why the Tax Service sent letters around 20 December 2011 stopping rent and healthcare allowances from 1 January 2012, when many recipients may still be entitled, and asked about reachability and urgent payments. The secretary answered that about 48,000 rent-allowance and 120,000 healthcare-allowance letters were sent, that around 600 people were wrongly stopped due to residence-status data and would be paid from 20 January 2012, and that the Tax Service would proactively contact people facing acute financial problems.
However, something went wrong this year with a group of about 600 allowance recipients.
Evenwel is er dit jaar iets niet goed gegaan met een groep van ongeveer 600 toeslaggerechtigden.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de inval van de NMa bij Veolia in verband met een onderzoek naar verboden prijsafspraken r

An MP asked ministers whether the competition authority NMa's raid on Veolia over suspected illegal price agreements on OV-chipkaart development costs for students implicates other transport firms, what sums were charged and provided, when conclusions are expected, and what sanctions are possible. The government confirmed the raid and the investigation, declined to name other firms or give timing or the investigation's scope, reported the public funds provided to decentralised authorities and NS without isolating development costs, and listed fines, orders under penalty and binding instructions.
To avoid parties being unnecessarily incriminated, and also under case law on this, the NMa does not independently disclose the names of parties under investigation.
Om te voorkomen dat partijen onnodig worden geïncrimineerd en ook op grond van de rechtspraak daarover, brengt de NMa zelfstandig geen namen naar buiten van partijen die onderwerp van onderzoek zijn.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de kerntaken van ProRail (ingezonden 8 september 2010).

MP Bashir (SP) asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about ProRail's core tasks, including its investment in an induction bus trial with the Postcode Loterij, its costs for innovation outside its core task, and whether it should focus on rail innovations such as ERTMS 2. The minister answered all seven questions in a letter of 16 September 2011 (Kamerstuk 31 305, nr. 197), and the text here contains only the cover note referring to that letter, not the substantive answers.
Answers 1 through 7: these questions were answered in the letter of 16 September 2011 (Kamerstuk 31 305, no. 197).
Antwoord 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 16 september 2011 (Kamerstuk 31 305, nr. 197 ).

Vragen van de leden Van Gent (GroenLinks), Haverkamp (CDA), Bashir (SP) en Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de bediening van NS station Hoogeveen door intercitytreinen (ingezonden 22 juli

MPs from GroenLinks, CDA, SP and D66 asked the minister whether NS plans to drop intercity stops at Hoogeveen from 2013, whether Zwolle-Assen would then be the longest stretch without an IC station, whether the concession should require IC stops there, and whether through-running stoptrains from Groningen as intercitys was studied. The minister replied that the timetable is NS's responsibility, the concession sets only minimum service levels (not train type or stops), she will not add IC-stop requirements, and through-running is possible but has disadvantages that NS judged unattractive, while noting ProRail's Zwolle station works.
I will therefore not interfere in NS's choice regarding Hoogeveen station or any other station.
Ik zal mij dus niet mengen in de keuze van NS ten aanzien van station Hoogeveen of welk ander station dan ook.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een back-up systeem voor verkeerscamera’s om spitsstroken open te kunnen houden bij computerstoring (ingezonden 28 juni 2011).

MP Bashir asked why a computer fault at the Verkeerscentrale closed motorway hard-shoulder lanes near Amsterdam, how much extra congestion resulted, and whether a functioning back-up system exists. The minister explained the fault, estimated the extra congestion at roughly 11,300 extra vehicle-hours lost, and said back-ups exist for critical systems and measures were taken after an evaluation, without detailing why the back-up failed.
The back-up system in the control centre also could not make contact with the systems outside.
Ook het back-up systeem in de centrale kreeg geen contact met de systemen buiten.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de energiebelasting op aardgas ten behoeve van gasmotoren in schepen (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

MPs Jansen and Bashir asked why natural gas for CNG engines in vehicles is exempt from energy tax while the same gas for vessels is not, and whether this omission would be corrected. The state secretary replied that CNG filling stations pay a fixed energy tax rate, that vessels fall under the degressive band tariff with no exemption or refund, and that the government will examine adjusting the rules and plans to raise the fixed rate to 0.16 per m3.
This natural gas is therefore not exempt from energy tax.
Dit aardgas is dus niet vrijgesteld van EB.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de bemoeizucht van Barroso met de IJzeren Rijn (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether Commission President Barroso is conducting a study on the IJzeren Rijn rail link and why the Commission would intervene, and whether the government will resist such involvement and consult the Chamber. The minister denies any Commission study beyond TEN-T map updates, says the COD report will be published with the ministers' joint decision, and states the reactivation is a bilateral matter with Belgium under binding treaties, so the government will not oppose it.
The two ministers agreed that the COD advice will be made public at the same time as their decision on the reactivation of the IJzeren Rijn.
Door de beide ministers is afgesproken dat het COD-advies openbaar gemaakt zal worden tegelijk met de beslissing van de beide ministers over de reactivering van de IJzeren Rijn.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het terug moeten betalen van een toeslag na het overlijden van de partner (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance why survivors must repay allowances because the deceased partner's income is annualised to a level never actually earned, and whether this is fair. The state secretary defended the annualisation rule as reflecting the deceased's capacity, but announced that the rule will be scrapped in the Belastingplan 2012 and that Belastingdienst/Toeslagen will be instructed to stop annualising in the meantime.
In anticipation of this, I will instruct the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances to stop annualising the deceased's income in cases where a surviving partner remains.

Vooruitlopend hierop zal ik de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen opdracht geven om het herleiden van het inkomen bij overlijden voortaan achterwege te laten in situaties waarin sprake is van een achterblijvende partner.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over adviesgroep transfer pricing (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the EU Joint Transfer Pricing Forum, questioning the scale of profit shifting via transfer pricing and whether its members, largely from business, form a balanced advisory body. The State Secretary replied that Dutch rules and supervision are adequate, denied evidence of lost revenue, and argued that business experts are appropriate for the Forum's dispute-resolution purpose.
The EU Joint Transfer Pricing Forum consists of experts from both the private sector and from governments.
Het EU Joint Transfer Pricing Forum bestaat zowel uit experts afkomstig van de private sector als experts afkomstig van de overheden.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het ontbreken van een restitutieregeling voor de strippenkaart (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister whether travellers holding partly used strippenkaarten could get a refund when regions invalidate them, and whether a national refund scheme would be introduced. The minister answered that cards carry notices that they lapse with the OV-chipkaart and that no refunds are given, that sales stop about 10 days before invalidation and communication starts 6 to 8 weeks earlier, and that a national refund scheme is not appropriate because revenue was allocated to carriers at purchase.
A national refund scheme does not seem appropriate.
Een landelijke restitutieregeling ligt niet voor de hand.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over wettelijke belemmeringen tussen toezichthouders (ingezonden 27 a

SP MPs asked the ministers whether the competition authority NMa is barred by law from sharing information on tax evasion and fraud with other enforcers, how often this occurs, and whether the Competition Act should be changed. The minister answered that legal options for information exchange with other supervisors and the Public Prosecution Service will be widened, with safeguards, via a forthcoming amendment merging NMa, OPTA and the Consumer Authority.
Yes, together with the NMa I have concluded that the legal possibilities for information exchange with other agencies can be widened.
Ja, samen met de NMa ben ik tot de conclusie gekomen dat de wettelijke mogelijkheden voor informatie-uitwisseling met andere instanties kunnen worden verruimd.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de vrijheid binnen een fiscale eenheid om te kiezen of er vrij van btw opleidingen worden verzorgd (ingezonden 5 april 2011).

MP Bashir asks whether the VAT exemption for vocational training, combined with fiscal unity allowing entities within one group to be exempt or taxed, enables competition through VAT and whether this conflicts with EU Regulation 1777/2005, and why the option was not removed. The state secretary replies that the choice has been abolished in favour of institution-level recognition, that fiscal unity does not create an unlawful option, and that no infringement procedure is expected.
By adopting only the recognition of the educational institution as the basis for the VAT exemption, the option to provide exempt or taxable vocational education has been abolished.

Door uitsluitend de erkenning van de onderwijsinstelling als basis voor de btw-vrijstelling aan te nemen, is de keuzemogelijkheid voor het verstrekken van vrijgesteld of belast beroepsonderwijs afgeschaft.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de ondertunneling van de A9 bij Amstelveen (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the infrastructure minister about Amstelveen's threat to undo the A9 tunnel agreement and its refusal to pay a 100 million euro contribution, and whether the state is responsible for adequate environmental mitigation. The minister replied that Amstelveen cannot unilaterally terminate the 2007 administrative agreement, that the state's duty is to meet legal environmental norms, and that the agreement will not be revised for now.
As the administrative agreement shows, Amstelveen cannot unilaterally terminate the administrative agreement on the Stroomlijnalternatief planstudie SAA of 29 October 2007.
Zoals uit de bestuursovereenkomst blijkt kan Amstelveen niet eenzijdig de bestuursovereenkomst over het Stroomlijnalternatief planstudie SAA van 29 oktober 2007 opzeggen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een levensgevaarlijk mysterieus reclamebord langs de A4 bij Leiderdorp (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether a QR-code billboard along the A4 near Leiderdorp, which drivers would need a smartphone to decode, endangers road safety and should be removed. The minister agreed the billboard does not belong by a motorway, said the municipality is responsible but the owner agreed to remove it, and announced a policy framework on distraction from roadside objects expected around summer 2011.
Since the billboard stands on the territory of the municipality of Leiderdorp, I have no authority to remove this billboard.
Aangezien het bord op het grondgebied van de gemeente Leiderdorp staat heb ik geen bevoegdheid om dit bord te verwijderen.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vergoeding van de leden van de commissie «versobering inpassing aanlegprogramma Hoofdwegennet» (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the fees paid to the chair and two paid members of a commission on scaling back the Hoofdwegennet programme, and whether these exceed the Balkenende norm, their professional backgrounds, hours, and oversight. The minister answered that members have civil-engineering backgrounds, fees follow the maximum external hourly rate (about EUR 225), the chair will withdraw in favour of a lower-rate member, and other commissions will be inventoried with a promise to inform the House if deviations are found.
I am carrying out a further inventory to rule out that commissions were established, for example before July 2010, where the fee is not in line with the currently applicable norms.
Ik voer een nadere inventarisatie uit om te kunnen uitsluiten dat er commissies zijn ingesteld, bijvoorbeeld vóór juli 2010, waarbij de vergoeding niet in lijn is met de nu geldende normering.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een herziening van de huur van ligplaatsen van woonboten doo

MPs Jansen and Bashir (SP) asked why RVOB is replacing CPI indexation of houseboat mooring rents with a new tariff structure, whether its basis is justified, why 19% VAT applies, and whether linking a phased rent increase to waiving the tenant's statutory right to a binding rent determination is acceptable. The government answered the questions in a letter of 1 April 2011, referring to the enclosed information.
Do you consider it acceptable that RVOB links an offer to introduce a rent increase in phases to waiving the tenant's statutory right to a binding rent determination by a committee of experts?

Acht u het acceptabel dat het RVOB een aanbod om een huurverhoging gefaseerd in te voeren koppelt aan het afzien van het wettelijk recht van de huurder op bindende vaststelling van de huur door een commissie van deskundigen
Vragen van de lid Tony van Dijck (PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over Marokkaanse banken (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Moroccan banks entering the Dutch market would be fully supervised by DNB, whether they should be excluded from the deposit guarantee scheme, and whether their Islamic banking products hinder integration. The minister replied that EEA branches fall under home-country prudential supervision and are not covered by the Dutch DGS, and referred the integration question to the Interior Minister.
This means that EEA banks can, among other things, open branches in other EEA member states without applying for a new banking licence in the host member state.
Dat betekent dat EER-banken onder andere bijkantoren kunnen openen in andere EER-lidstaten zonder in de «lidstaat van ontvangst» een nieuwe bankvergunning aan te vragen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over het wijzigen van de mogelijkheid om dieetkosten af te trekken in het kader van de B

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked whether dietary-cost deductions under the BU-regeling were changed without informing Parliament or the CG-Raad, and what the reasons, savings, and effects on affected patients and allowances are. The State Secretary answered that a revised dietary cost table from 2010 uses a healthy diet as reference, that budget was not a motive, and that individual effects vary and were not quantified at macro level.
Since there is no insight into which diets are deducted to what extent, the financial consequences cannot be stated at macro level.
Aangezien er geen inzicht bestaat in welke diëten in welke mate in aftrek worden gebracht, is op macro-niveau niet aan te geven wat hiervan de financiële gevolgen zijn.

Vragen van de leden Slob (ChristenUnie), Dijksma (PvdA), Bashir (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Verhoeven (D66) en Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de voortgang van de werkzaamheden Landtu

Six MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the schedule, budget and legal challenges for the A2 Leidsche Rijn tunnel and the temporary bypass. The minister answered that the schedule and budget are unchanged, the court rejected residents' challenge on 11 February 2011, and the bypass will open by 1 April 2011.
On Friday 11 February 2011 the court ruled. The appeal was declared unfounded and the request for an interim injunction was also rejected.
Op vrijdag 11 februari 2011 heeft de Rechtbank uitspraak gedaan. Het beroep is ongegrond verklaard en ook het verzoek voor een voorlopige voorziening is afgewezen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de zoektocht van de fiscus naar zwartspaarders (ingezonden 26 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the tax authority's search for undeclared foreign bank accounts obtained from a French CD-ROM, including how many holders declared their assets, whether voluntary disclosure remains possible, expected revenue, and whether the 2010 SPF rules failed to prevent avoidance. The State Secretary answered that letters will be sent requesting information, the investigation is at an early stage so no conclusions or revenue estimates are possible, penalties apply where declarations were incomplete, and the information was shared free of charge under an EU directive.
The investigation by the Tax Authority is still in its initial phase. Conclusions about the number of taxpayers who did or did not file a correct return cannot therefore be drawn at this time.

Het onderzoek door de Belastingdienst bevindt zich nog in de beginfase. Conclusies over aantallen belastingplichtigen die al dan niet een juiste aangifte hebben gedaan kunnen op dit moment dan ook nog niet worden getrokken.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de fiscale aftrekbaarheid van schikkingen in fraudezaken (ingezonden 13 januari 20

SP MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers why transactions were again concluded in the Klimop real-estate fraud case, on what basis, and whether settlements are tax-deductible so taxpayers effectively subsidise them. The minister defended the transactions as a proportionate disposal of part of the case, explained the withholding of settlement amounts, and referred to earlier answers on tax deductibility.

The press release did not state the amount of the arrangement between the injured parties and the suspects, because the parties also reached agreement on damage claims and real claims and debts from work, beyond agreement on the unlawfully obtained benefit.

In het persbericht is hoogte van de regeling tussen de benadeelde partijen en de verdachten niet weergegeven, omdat de partijen naast overeenstemming over het wederrechtelijk verkregen voordeel ook overeenstemming bereikt over schadeclaims en reële vorderingen en schulden uit werkzaamheden.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het te lang bewaren van persoonsgegevens door vervoersbedrijven en Trans Link Systems (ingezonden 13 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether she would act on the Data Protection Authority's (CBP) findings that several transport companies and TLS keep travel data too long, that NS informs students poorly about check-in obligations, and who bears any sanctions. The minister said an independent enforcement procedure is ongoing, awaited its outcome before taking any step, and noted sanctions fall on the operators while fares are governed by concession terms.
There is an ongoing procedure with an independent supervisor that has found violations of the Wbp.
Antwoord 2 en 3 Er is sprake is van een lopende procedure bij een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die overtredingen van de Wbp heeft geconstateerd.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het naleven van de Europese reizigersrechten in de luchtvaart (ingezonden 9 december 2010).

MP Bashir asks the state secretary why airlines refuse to pay compensation to delayed passengers even after Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat decisions, whether the inspectorate can assess claims, how many passengers are affected, how the Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart functions, and how KLM's misleading passenger information is enforced. The state secretary answers that the inspectorate enforces through warnings and sanctions, has the expertise to assess claims, keeps no data on delayed flights, and has ordered KLM to correct its folder, while pointing to the commission's independence and self-regulation.
The inspectorate does not keep data on delayed and cancelled flights.
De inspectie houdt geen gegevens bij over vertraagde en geannuleerde vluchten.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

MP Bashir asks the state secretary whether ArkeFly's refusal to accept an Aviation Dispute Committee ruling undermines the binding nature of its decisions, what measures will be taken, and whether a statutory binding committee should replace self-regulation. The state secretary answers that the rulings are binding, that a bailiff-based enforcement arrangement via BARIN exists, that no further measures are needed, and that consumers can also go to civil court or the Inspectorate.
A ruling of the dispute committee is binding. Both parties must abide by it.
Een uitspraak van de geschillencommissie is bindend. Beide partijen moeten zich eraan houden.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de aangepaste dienstregeling van de NS in de kerstvakantie (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

MP Bashir (SP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the reduced NS Christmas timetable, with fewer trains, serves travellers, whether it complies with the concession, and whether the minister will stop it and correct the performance incentives. The minister answered that NS decides operational matters itself within the concession, that the reduced timetable reduces delays and unpredictability, still offers 90% of capacity and meets minimum service requirements, and that she will press NS to restore the full timetable after the holidays.
I will urge NS to run the full timetable again after the Christmas holidays.
Ik zal er bij NS op aandringen om na de kerstvakantie weer de volledige dienstregeling te rijden.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het Stichting Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR) (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

An MP asks whether the CBR may impose penalties even when a judge has acquitted the person, whether appeal against CBR decisions is always possible, why the CBR can order additional medical examinations, and how people can independently challenge CBR conduct given that only an internal complaints committee exists. The minister explains that administrative measures are separate from criminal sanctions, that ordinary objection and appeal under the General Administrative Law Act are open, and that an internal complaints procedure is being improved, with a response to the motion on an independent committee deferred.
It is indeed the case that the CBR can impose measures even though the judge has acquitted the person concerned.
Het is inderdaad zo dat het CBR maatregelen kan opleggen, ook al heeft de rechter betrokkene vrijgesproken.
Vragen van de leden Bashir (SP) en Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de overlast van bromfietsen (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

MPs Bashir (SP) and Van Gent (GroenLinks) asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment and of Security and Justice about nuisance from mopeds and snorscooters, including police enforcement, lane use, tampering, rolling-road test tolerances and emissions. The government answered that enforcement is set locally, that studies and talks are under way with results due early 2011, and that it is pursuing stricter EU emission rules.
The outcomes of the study and the promised talks will be reported to the House of Representatives in early 2011.
De uitkomsten van het onderzoek en de toegezegde gesprekken zullen begin 2011 aan de Tweede Kamer worden gemeld.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de minister van Financiën over toezicht van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) op reclame-uitingen (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

MPs Irrgang and Bashir (SP) asked the Finance Minister how the AFM supervises advertisements for investment products that promise high fixed returns below the 50,000 euro threshold, whether the threshold should be raised, and whether the AFM considers tax-benefit claims and undisclosed risks in such ads acceptable. The minister answered that the AFM monitors advertising and acts through informal or formal enforcement, that the threshold is being doubled to 100,000 euro, and that risks should be disclosed, while declining to discuss individual supervisory cases.
Naturally, individual supervisory cases cannot be discussed here.
Uiteraard kan hier niet ingegaan worden op individuele toezichtcasussen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het ontbreken van toiletten in de nieuwe stoptreinen (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the minister why new Sprinter trains lack toilets, affecting passengers and staff, and whether the government will ensure toilets in all trains by 2030 as the Chamber requested. The minister defends NS's purchasing choice, plans toilets at over 100 stations instead, gives cost estimates, and promises an exploration result around the new year.

NS is cautious about giving more specific amounts. Its argument is that it does not want to undermine its competitive position (among others in relation to suppliers) by making detailed information available.

NS is voorzichtig met het geven van meer gespecificeerde bedragen. Haar argumentatie is dat zij haar concurrentiepositie (o.a. in de relatie met leveranciers) niet wil ondermijnen door gedetailleerde informatie beschikbaar te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat, van Justitie en van Financiën over de hoofdelijke aansprakelijkheid bij verkeersongevallen (ingezonden 14 september 2010).

An MP asks ministers whether employees who drive uninsured company cars are jointly liable for accident damage, whether employers should be held responsible instead, and whether the Waarborgfonds Motorverkeer should recover from the employer. The minister confirms that employees are liable under the Civil Code, that the employer normally bears the damage, and that the government will discuss solutions for exceptional cases (e.g. employer bankruptcy) with the Verbond van Verzekeraars and will review the Waarborgfonds role later.
I will discuss the possible solutions for these cases with the Verbond van Verzekeraars.
De mogelijke oplossingen voor deze gevallen zal ik bespreken met het Verbond van Verzekeraars.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over constructies waarbij bedrijven zoals Google via Nederland massaal belasting ontwijken (ingezonden 26 oktober 2010).

The MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about profit-shifting structures (Google via Ireland, the Netherlands and Bermuda) that reportedly lower effective tax to 2.4%, whether a special 0.2% arrangement exists, and whether the US has asked for changes. The minister refuses to discuss individual taxpayers citing confidentiality, defends the Dutch system as a financial hub, denies a fixed 0.2% policy, says the US never asked for changes, and points to treaty anti-abuse clauses and information exchange without committing to new action.
First, I would note that because of the duty of confidentiality it is not possible to go into the tax position of individual taxpayers.
Allereerst wil ik opmerken dat het vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht niet mogelijk is om in te gaan op de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Vragen van de leden Bashir en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Justitie over het schikken van belastingfraude (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

MPs Bashir and Gesthuizen asked the Finance and Justice ministers how tax fraud can be settled through a fiscal transaction instead of prosecution, and whether this is a case of class justice and fuels calculated behaviour. The minister explained the ATV guidelines and procedure, declined to disclose details of the reported case due to tax secrecy, rejected the class-justice and calculation concerns, and stated that no overview of financial-economic transactions is kept.
Because of art. 67 of the AWR, which regulates the fiscal confidentiality duty, it is not permitted to publicly disclose concrete information about this case.
Vanwege art. 67 van de AWR – waarin de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht is geregeld – is het niet toegestaan concrete informatie over deze zaak publiekelijk te verstrekken.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de hoogte van de borg bij het reizen met de OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Transport about the level of the OV-chipkaart deposit (instaptarief of EUR 4) in regional transport, whether incomplete transactions cost travellers much, and whether the deposit should be halved. The minister rejects the criticism, says the deposit is set jointly by regional authorities to prevent unchecked travel, refuses to provide per-month transaction data, and says restitution policy for forgotten check-outs may be tightened later.
The regional authorities and their transport operators have indicated that they are not willing to provide this data.
De decentrale overheden en hun vervoerders hebben aangegeven dat zij niet bereid zijn deze gegevens te verstrekken.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de totstandkoming van grote projecten (ingezonden 9 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked ministers whether knowledge gaps among officials deciding on large infrastructure projects cause cost overruns and whether a national project centre should be created. The minister rejected a causal link, defended the existing Rijksprojectenacademie and inter-agency cooperation, and declined to set up a separate central organisation.
We are still of the opinion that a separate organisation bundling expertise and experience with large projects is not necessary.
We zijn nog steeds van mening dat een aparte organisatie waarin deskundigheid en ervaring met grote projecten wordt gebundeld, niet noodzakelijk is.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over bezuinigingen op de belastingdienst (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about cuts to the Tax Administration, including reasons for letters urging around 6,000 staff to seek other jobs, staffing levels, and whether horizontal supervision reduced supervision capacity. The minister said the cuts follow government savings targets, that the letters aim to avoid forced mobility and were not age-based, and that there are no signs work quality has suffered.
No distinction was made by age.
Er is geen onderscheid gemaakt naar leeftijd.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over buitenlanders die een Nederlands rijbewijs krijgen (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Transport why some foreigners can exchange foreign driving licences for Dutch ones without testing while others from the same countries cannot, and asked about road safety, eligibility criteria and income or education links. The minister explained the 30% ruling scheme for specialist expatriate workers, stated that a declaration of fitness is still required, and denied any link to income or education.
It is expressly not the case that these people can exchange their foreign driving licence for a Dutch one without testing.
Het is uitdrukkelijk niet zo dat deze mensen zonder toetsing het buitenlandse rijbewijs voor een Nederlands kunnen omwisselen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over problemen met huurtoeslag bij straatnaamwijzigingen (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how about twenty Vlaardingen households lost their rent allowance and had to repay 2009 benefits after a street renaming, and how this would be prevented. The minister confirmed the facts, explained that a renaming looks like a move in the GBA-based administrative check, stopped recovery, and promised to alert municipalities and landlords in future.
The Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances will alert municipalities and landlords to this.
De Belastingdienst/Toeslagen zal gemeenten en verhuurders hierop attenderen.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Justitie over het niet voortvarend aanpakken van de bij de Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart bekende zaken (ingezonden 13 augustus 2010).

MP Bashir asks whether the Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart should speed up handling of passenger compensation claims after two court rulings clarified EU Regulation 261/2004, and whether the Inspectie can act against airlines or the commission. Minister Eurlings answers that the Sturgeon ruling applies as binding EU law, that the commission must follow the law and is independent, and that the Inspectie can take enforcement action against airlines but not against the commission.
As previously indicated and discussed with your House, passengers can also bring their individual complaints to the Inspectie.
Zoals eerder aangegeven en met uw Kamer is gewisseld kunnen reizigers met hun individuele klacht ook bij de Inspectie terecht.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de aftrekbaarheid van golfkosten (ingezonden 18 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether golf club membership costs should be tax-deductible, whether a court ruling widened the concept of representation costs, and whether the law should be clarified to prevent precedent for other leisure costs. The minister replied that the court rejected the deduction because the representation-cost rules applied, that existing articles 3.14 and 3.15 give the tax authority sufficient tools, and that no legislative change is planned.
I therefore see no reason for legislative intervention.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding tot wettelijk ingrijpen.
Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Justitie en Verkeer en Waterstaat over gelaatscontrole bij Schiphol (ingezonden 18 augustus 2010).

Two SP MPs asked whether veiled women are sometimes passed through customs at Schiphol without checks, and how checks on face-covering clothing are guaranteed. The government denied this, stating that such women are always checked by the Royal Marechaussee in a separate room by a female officer, with supervision by group commanders.
No, women wearing face-covering clothing are always checked at the border by the Royal Marechaussee (KMar).
Nee, vrouwen met gezichtsbedekkende kleding worden aan de grens altijd door de Koninklijke Marechaussee (KMar) gecontroleerd.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de verkoop van het spoor bij Velsen (ingezonden 4 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Transport whether he had approved ProRail's request to sell and dismantle the Santpoort Noord–IJmuiden railway line to the municipality of Velsen, and asked about its future potential, reactivation costs and whether the sale could still be prevented. The minister confirmed his consent, said the line has no realistic future for freight or passenger service and was not designated as a main railway, and stated that the sale follows from the 2009 designation decision, against which no objection was lodged and under which the owner Rail Infratrust may sell.
Yes. I have agreed to ProRail's request to proceed with dismantling the Santpoort Noord–IJmuiden railway line and selling the land to the municipality of Velsen.
Ja. Ik heb ingestemd met het verzoek van ProRail om over te gaan tot opbreken van de spoorlijn Santpoort Noord – IJmuiden en het verkopen van de grond aan de gemeente Velsen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het artikel «Eurlings houdt EU-brief over aswolk achter» (ingezonden 20 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister whether a June 2010 letter from Commissioner Kallas on full compensation for passengers stranded by the volcanic ash cloud was withheld, and asked for a copy. The minister denied knowing any such letter, said nothing was withheld, and pointed to his August 23, 2010 letter to the Chamber on the European approach.
No, I have not withheld any letter.
Nee, ik heb geen brief achtergehouden.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Financiën over de mogelijke verkoop van Strukton (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

An MP asks the ministers of Transport and Finance about the planned sale of NS subsidiary Strukton to Oranjewoud, its timing, the shareholder's role, governance conditions and union demands. The government answers that NS's board, with supervisory board approval, decided the sale without requiring shareholder approval, that the deal was signed on 23 July 2010 and will close in Q3 or Q4, and that the matters raised are for NS's board and union protocol to settle rather than the shareholder.
The decision on whether to sell Strukton falls within the mandate of NS's board and supervisory board.
Het besluit om al dan niet tot verkoop van Strukton over te gaan valt binnen het mandaat van de directie en de raad van commissarissen van NS.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het artikel «Fiscus geeft overleden man geld terug» (ingezonden 6 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister how a tax assessment for 2009 could be issued to a man who had died 25 years earlier, and what would prevent recurrence. The minister acknowledged a human error caused by a sofi-number mix-up in a paper return, said no special action was planned, and maintained that the control system is sound while noting the paper process is error-prone.
Given the cause of the error and its exceptional nature, I do not intend to take special action.
Gezien de oorzaak van de fout en het uitzonderlijke karakter ervan, heb ik niet het voornemen bijzondere acties te ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de problemen rondom de AIS-transponders (ingezonden 21 juni 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Transport about privacy concerns over AIS transponders on inland vessels, citing a 2006 convenant limiting broadcast data, whether the system will be made mandatory, whether Rijkswaterstaat's dual enforcement role is problematic, and whether a privacy-intrusive tracking website can be acted upon. The Minister confirms the convenant limits AIS data to ship name and position, states no guarantee against future mandatory use (obligation not before 2013 under CCR agreement), refers the tracking website question to the Data Protection College, and says the dual-role criticism is not accepted while digital data use for enforcement is under review.
I have asked the Minister of Justice to request advice from the Data Protection College on this matter and to inform your House of the outcome of that advice.
Ik heb de Minister van Justitie verzocht het College bescherming persoonsgegevens terzake om advies te vragen en uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van het advies te berichten.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de problemen met de OV-Chipkaart en tariefsverhoging door de NS in verband met de invoering van de OV-Chipkaart (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister of Transport about problems with the OV-chipkaart, NS fare changes including the end of the return ticket, and whether the minister would convene consumer groups and reconsider the system. The minister replied that consumer organisations are already involved through formal consultation, defended the fare restructuring as revenue-neutral for the average traveller, and said the card is well received after first use.
However, such a commitment was made for the introduction within regional concessions.
Wel is een dergelijke toezegging gedaan voor de introductie binnen regionale concessies.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over onduidelijkheid rond ontwijking van btw-afdracht door ING en DSB (ingezonden 23 april 2010).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether ING's tax director's statements about a Swiss procurement route avoiding VAT were consistent with the minister's claim of not having known of it, whether a covenant with the tax authority can continue if avoidance is deliberate, and asked for answers withheld pending an investigation. The minister answered that the tax inspector was the competent authority and was informed in 2008, that the minister learned of the case only via press in March 2010, that covenants are not automatically terminated for transparent taxpayers, and that the forthcoming investigation will address the scope of such structures, with some questions deferred until the report is published.

m: Motie van het lid Stultiens c.s. over de budgettaire opgave bij de aanstaande voorjaarsbesluitvorming zo veel mogelijk invullen met alternatieve maatregelen

Asks the government to fill the budget shortfall in the spring decision-making with alternative measures, prioritising levies on fossil and linear consumption, and to give waste incinerators access to investment support.
requests the government to fill the budgetary task at the upcoming spring budget decision as far as possible with alternative measures
verzoekt de regering de budgettaire opgave bij de aanstaande voorjaarsbesluitvorming zo veel mogelijk in te vullen met alternatieve maatregelen
Motie van het lid Middendorp over versterking van de Nederlandse positie in het Gaia-X-project
Asks the government to investigate and report on using existing Defence and CBS cloud and data expertise for government-wide cloud services and to strengthen the Dutch position in Gaia-X.
also requests the government to inform the House on how the Dutch position in the Gaia-X project can be strengthened
verzoekt de regering tevens de Kamer te informeren over hoe de Nederlandse positie in het Gaia-X-project versterkt kan worden
Motie van de leden Middendorp en Kuiken over een voorstel voor een definitie van "online politieke advertenties"
Asks the government to introduce a rule for the coming elections requiring platforms to keep archives of political ads and disclose verification, and to propose a definition of online political ads.
requests the government to introduce a regulation for the coming elections
verzoekt de regering, voor de komende verkiezingen een regeling in te voeren
Motie van de leden Middendorp en Van der Molen over verbeteringen aan het bestaande kader voor onbekende kwetsbaarheden in software
Asks that the evaluation committee on the 2017 Intelligence and Security Services Act also examine improvements to the framework for intelligence and police use of unknown software vulnerabilities.
requests the government to have this committee, within the evaluation, also examine which improvements to the existing framework are possible
verzoekt de regering, deze commissie, in het kader van de evaluatie, tevens te laten onderzoeken welke verbeteringen aan het bestaande kader
Motie van het lid Middendorp c.s. over maandelijks monitoren van de effecten van de CoronaMelder
Asks the government to add criteria to the CoronaMelder evaluation protocol to monitor adverse effects on contact tracing, testing and quarantine willingness monthly.
requests the government to include additional criteria in the evaluation protocol for the announced ongoing evaluation
verzoekt de regering, in het evaluatieprotocol voor de aangekondigde doorlopende evaluatie additionele criteria op te nemen
Amendement van het lid Van den Berg c.s. over interoperabiliteit van door lidstaten gebruikte notificatieapplicaties
Amendment allowing CoronaMelder data to be exchanged with other EU notification apps and requiring that the designating decree be submitted to both Houses at least four weeks before being adopted.
The proposal for this general administrative order will not be made earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both Houses of the States General.
De voordracht voor deze algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers van de Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Motie van de leden Middendorp en Van den Berg over eerst een waarschuwend gesprek tenzij er sprake is van kwade opzet
Asks the government to agree with supervisors that a possible offender of the corona app anti-misuse provision first receives a warning conversation, unless malicious intent is present.
to reach agreements with supervisors on the starting point that a possible offender of the anti-misuse provision first receives a warning conversation
tot afspraken te komen met toezichthouders met als uitgangspunt dat een mogelijke overtreder van de antimisbruikbepaling eerst een waarschuwend gesprek krijgt
Motie van de leden Middendorp en Asscher over het identificeren en voorkomen van digitale inmenging tijdens de verkiezingen
Asks the government to share with the Chamber an operational overview of measures against foreign digital interference in the 2021 elections and information on platforms' political ad archives.
requests the government, before the treatment of the 2021 Budget, to share with the Chamber a concrete operational overview
verzoekt de regering, om voor de behandeling van de Begroting 2021 een concreet operationeel overzicht met de Kamer te delen

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van der Molen en Middendorp ter vervanging van nr. 36 over bij AMvB regels (kunnen) stellen inzake tarieven en een leveringsplicht voor bedrijfs- en organisatiemiddel
Amendment lets general administrative orders set a delivery obligation and tariff rules for business and organisational resources supplied by providers.
The requirements shall in any case include a delivery obligation and may include rules on tariffs to be applied.
De eisen behelzen in ieder geval een leveringsplicht en kunnen regels inzake te hanteren tarieven behelzen.
Motie van de leden Van der Molen en Middendorp over pilots met private identificatiemiddelen
Motion asking the government to quickly start pilots with private identification means to prepare recognition under the digital government act.
requests the government to start relevant pilots as soon as possible for recognising private identification means
verzoekt de regering, zo spoedig mogelijk relevante pilots te starten met het oog op de invoering van erkenning van private identificatiemiddelen
Motie van de leden Middendorp en Van der Molen over monitoren van en ingrijpen in de tarieven van bedrijfsinlogmiddelen
Asks the government to report on eHerkenning costs and tariffs and monitor whether they are market-priced, noting the minister lacks power to intervene.
requests the government to provide insight into the costs and changes in tariffs of business login means
verzoekt de regering, inzicht te geven in de kosten en wijzigingen in de tarieven van bedrijfsinlogmiddelen
Motie van het lid Middendorp c.s. over gratis digitale belastingaangifte voor ondernemers
Asks the government to propose quickly that entrepreneurs can again file tax returns digitally for free, and to inform the House on costs incurred meanwhile.
requests the government to come with a proposal as soon as possible so that entrepreneurs can again file taxes digitally for free
verzoekt de regering, zo snel als mogelijk met een voorstel te komen zodat ondernemers weer gratis digitaal belastingaangifte kunnen doen
Motie van het lid Middendorp over het gebruik van publieke identificatiemiddelen in niet-publieke overige sectoren
Asks government to study whether public identification tools like DigiD could be used in additional private sector situations.
requests the government to examine whether and how public identification means could be used in additional specific situations outside government

verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken of en, zo ja, hoe de publieke identificatiemiddelen in additionele, specifieke situaties buiten de overheid en nu aangewezen sectoren gebruikt zouden kunnen worden

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de uitvoering van de compensatieregeling eHerkenning

VVD MPs asked why businesses that obtained standard eHerkenning before the special Belastingdienst login became available must downgrade it, possibly at cost, to claim compensation, and about the status of the scheme. RVO cannot see, when logging in with the specific eHerkenning Belastingdienst means, whether this was first a generic eH3 login means.
RVO kan bij het inloggen met het specifieke «eHerkenning Belastingdienst» middel niet zien of dit eerst een generiek te gebruiken eH3 inlogmiddel is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent, Middendorp en Van der Molen over het nieuws dat de uitslag van de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen kwetsbaar is voor hackers

MPs Van Gent, Middendorp and Van der Molen asked the Minister of the Interior whether election results are vulnerable to hacking through the counting software, whether manual checks exist, and whether publication of polling station reports is timely. The minister answered only by referring to a separate reaction to a report from the foundation Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen, so none of the seven questions were answered on substance.
For answering these questions I refer to my response to the report of the foundation Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn reactie op het rapport van de stichting Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Middendorp over het bericht 'Nog steeds doodverklaard: verwisselingsfout van drie jaar terug blijft Fred Marree achtervolgen'?

MPs Van der Molen and Middendorp asked about a Rotterdam municipal error that wrongly registered a living man as deceased, with consequences for his insurance, passport, driving licence and pension. The State Secretary confirmed the error, said the municipality contacted agencies to correct it and provided a new travel document, and reported that a central complaints point for basic registries is expected to start in early 2021.
From the municipality I understood that it contacted the agencies directly after the error to correct the mistake and its consequences as quickly as possible.
Van de gemeente begreep ik dat zij de instanties direct na de fout hebben benaderd om de fout en gevolgen zo snel mogelijk recht te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Middendorp 'Zit u op LinkedIn? Dan gooit Lusha uw privénummer mogelijk op straat'

MPs Van Gent and Middendorp asked whether the data-protection regulator had investigated the service Lusha, which may expose private phone numbers scraped from LinkedIn, whether its practices comply with the GDPR and Dutch implementing law, and how the regulator can act against non-EU providers. The minister answered that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is independent and does not comment on possible investigations, explained the legal bases and territorial scope of the GDPR, and said the GDPR's technology-neutral framework will be reviewed, while declining to add this case to the evaluation.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) would be the body that could conduct this investigation.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) zou de instantie zijn, die dit onderzoek zou kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Koopmans en Middendorp over het bericht dat honderden Chinezen hun valse identiteit ‘herstelden’ bij gemeenten

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that hundreds of Chinese nationals 'restored' false identities through municipalities, covering detection, document verification, nationality consequences, limitation periods and sanctions. The State Secretary answered at length, describing existing procedures and safeguards, rejecting several proposed legal changes, and committing only to approach Chinese authorities if useful.
It is not possible to answer this question using data from the BRP.
Het is niet mogelijk om met behulp van gegevens uit de BRP deze vraag te beantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van den Bosch over opstartproblemen bij gemeentes betreffende de ‘Tijdelijke wet digitale beraadslaging en besluitvorming provincies, gemeenten, waterschappen en de openbare

MPs Middendorp and Van den Bosch asked the Minister of the Interior about start-up problems and technical failures in municipalities using the temporary digital deliberation law, and whether this threatens local democracy. The Minister answered that most councils have held digital or physical decision meetings, technical incidents are limited and mostly teething problems, mayors bear democratic responsibility, and an independent evaluation committee will report further.
The number of technical incidents that seriously disrupted digital council meetings is limited.
Het aantal technische incidenten wat zich heeft voorgedaan die de digitaal raadsvergadering ernstig hebben verstoord, is beperkt te noemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Middendorp over het jaarverslag van de Kiesraad over 2019

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about the Electoral Council's 2019 annual report, including budget additions for replacing the election software (OSV), whether that work was completed, and the security findings and next steps for a new digital tool. The minister explained the budget composition, said the 2019 software work was completed, described a new OSV version commissioned for upcoming elections, and promised to inform the House before the summer recess of 2020 on vulnerabilities and tendering.
My planning aims to inform the House further on this before the 2020 summer recess, including on the timing of the tender.
Mijn planning is erop gericht om de Tweede Kamer daar voor het zomerreces van 2020 nader over te informeren, onder meer over het moment van aanbesteding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked about the poor condition of 164 state-owned farmsteads leased to tenant farmers, the timing of repairs, the Grondkamer rent-review process and a recent ruling, and the strategic status of the farms. The ministers answered that repairs will start once funds are freed in the spring budget process (estimated at about 24 million euro), that 153 farms are strategic, and that the rent norms remain adequate, while declining to draw conclusions for other tenants from the ruling.
Once the funds become available, further repair work will be started as quickly as possible.
Na het beschikbaar komen van de middelen wordt zo snel mogelijk gestart met de verdere herstelwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Lodders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de BRP.
