Minister Knops answered that he opposes mandatory prior verification and mandatory consent from existing residents, points to municipal responsibility and ongoing work on a BRP change and complaints point, and promises a progress letter in spring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de eHerkenning en het artikel ‘MKB en VNO-NCW: gedupeerden nieuw aangiftesysteem compenseren’

MPs Lodders, Middendorp and Aartsen (VVD) asked the Finance, Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about internal resistance at the Tax Administration to eHerkenning, its costs, the fate of about 60,000 businesses lacking a suitable login, and whether small firms can keep filing free. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that concerns were addressed, that about 540 organisations cannot obtain eHerkenning, that proactive deadline extensions and an older portal for VAT remain, and that a further letter on support for small firms would follow.
The Tax Administration proactively grants extensions to employer-liable businesses that are legal entities and last filed via the old business portal.

De Belastingdienst verleent proactief uitstel voor ondernemers die aangifteplichtig zijn voor de loonheffingen, rechtspersoon zijn en hun laatst ingediende aangifte hebben gedaan via het oude ondernemersportaal van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Gent over een mogelijk cookiewall-verbod

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a possible ban on cookiewalls, how freely given consent works under the GDPR and Telecommunications Act, the roles of the Dutch data protection authority (AP) and competition authority (ACM), and the state of EU negotiations. The minister answered that consent must be genuinely free, that the Netherlands supports a cookiewall ban in the EU ePrivacy regulation, and that the Council is unlikely to adopt it, while the enforcement and EU details are largely left to the AP and to the negotiations.
It is for the supervisory authority, in this case the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP), and ultimately for the court, to interpret what this means in a specific case.
Het is aan de toezichthouder, in casu de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (hierna: AP), en uiteindelijk aan de rechter, om duiden wat dit in een concreet geval betekent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked about the poor condition of state-owned farmhouses leased by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, complaint channels, rent setting, inspections, repair timelines and the policy against selling these farms. Minister Ollongren answered substantively, reporting complaint figures, inspection status, a budget increase and a plan to start interdepartmental talks, while confirming the ban on selling non-strategic farms to tenants only under conditions.
In the context of the spring memorandum 2020, I will start interdepartmental consultation to free up the funds needed to carry out the maintenance work.
Ik zal in het kader van de voorjaarsnota 2020 een interdepartementaal overleg starten om de middelen vrij te maken, die nodig zijn om de onderhoudswerkzaamheden uit te kunnen voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Middendorp over de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens

MPs Van Gent and Middendorp asked whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) gives unclear guidance, particularly on cookies, and whether an external review should address its advisory role. The minister replied that the AP offers general and specific guidance, that cookiewalls are not permitted under the GDPR consent rules, and that the planned external review focuses mainly on the AP's financing, with guidance being one of its statutory tasks.
That is why it is possible for organisations and their data protection officers to submit specific questions to the AP in addition to general guidance.
Daarom is het voor organisaties en hun functionarissen gegevensbescherming (FG's) mogelijk, om naast algemene voorlichting, ook specifieke vragen aan de AP voor te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Een klik verwijderd van je schuldeisers’

VVD MPs asked the state secretaries about schuldenwijzer.nl, a debt-overview site that currently shows only debts enforced by bailiffs, and why tax authority, municipal and water board debts are not yet included, plus the legal obstacles around citizen service numbers. The government answered that the site helps citizens gain insight, that expansion is in progress led by bailiffs and the Belastingdienst is working on its own portal, and that no concrete legal obstacle has been identified beyond what is still to be signalled by bailiffs.
The Ministry of SZW discusses progress with SNG and KBvG and whether and how government organisations can join.
Het Ministerie van SZW bespreekt met SNG en KBvG de voortgang en ook of en zo ja, hoe overheidsorganisaties kunnen aansluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Ldders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de Basisregistratie Persoon (BRP)

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether residents can register at any address in the BRP without the consent of existing occupants, and about the checks municipalities must perform, in cases where people are registered without the main resident knowing and suffer financial harm. The state secretary answered that registration depends on actual residence rather than consent, that municipalities control registrations under the BRP law and the adres onderzoek circular, that consent-based registration would undermine the BRP, and that the ministry is discussing solutions with municipal and implementing bodies.
Registration in the BRP at an address in the municipality is therefore not dependent on the consent of the resident already registered at that address.
Inschrijving in de BRP op een adres in de gemeente is derhalve niet afhankelijk van de instemming van de reeds op dat adres ingeschreven bewoner.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Middendorp over leeftijdsontslag in het licht van het pensioenakkoord

MPs Van der Linde and Middendorp asked how the slower rise of the AOW age under the pension agreement affects civil servants' forced retirement at the AOW age, pension accrual, ABP communication, and whether discretion or exceptions should apply. The ministers answered that early retirement numbers and pension effects were calculated, that employers and employees decide on working on, and that the government stays politically restrained on collective agreement content.
Whether or not to keep working after the AOW age is a decision for the employer and the employee.
Het wel of niet langer doorwerken na de AOW-leeftijd is een beslissing van werkgever en werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over het bericht 'Overheid lanceert digitaal paspoort op mobiele telefoon'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about government initiatives on digital identity (virtual ID, self-sovereign identity, KTDI), their coordination, and links to pending bills and the regie op gegevens policy. The government answered that these initiatives are in an early experimental phase under binding legal frameworks, coordinated under NL DIGIbeter, and that the regie op gegevens letter has been sent to the Chamber.
Coordination regarding the possible development of a digital identity lies with me.
De coördinatie ten aanzien van de mogelijke ontwikkeling van een digitale identiteit ligt bij mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Sms’jes en WhatsApp berichten op zakelijke én privé telefoons zijn te ‘wobben’’

MPs Middendorp and Van den Bosch asked the Minister of Interior whether work-related WhatsApp and SMS messages on official and private phones fall under the Dutch Freedom of Information Act (Wob) following a Council of State ruling, and what consequences follow. The Minister confirmed such messages can be requested under the Wob, saw no immediate need to amend the Act, and pointed to a government-wide guideline and archiving instruction while stating existing refusal grounds fully apply.
This means that such messages can be requested by invoking the Wob.
Dit betekent dat dergelijke berichten kunnen worden opgevraagd met een beroep op de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Gent over het bericht 'Websites overtreden massaal cookiewallverbod'

VVD MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that websites widely violate the cookiewall ban, the Dutch Data Protection Authority's view that cookiewalls are not allowed, practice in other EU countries, competitive effects on Dutch media, how consent for tracking cookies can be obtained, and how the Telecommunications Act, ePrivacy Directive and GDPR relate. The minister answered that cookiewalls do not give freely given consent under GDPR, that consent cannot be obtained via general terms, that Dutch rules apply to foreign firms targeting Dutch users, and that Dutch government supports an explicit cookiewall ban in the forthcoming ePrivacy Regulation.
That is why the Netherlands, in line with the Verhoeven motion, advocates a ban on these so-called cookiewalls.
Daarom pleit Nederland in lijn met de motie Verhoeven voor een verbod op deze zogenoemde cookiewalls.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Twitter blokkeert Wilders’

MPs Middendorp and Van Gent asked the government about reports that Twitter had blocked MP Wilders' account and whether this affects freedom of expression and the EU disinformation action plan. The Minister replied that Twitter found Wilders violated its hateful conduct policy and asked him to remove a tweet, that Twitter is a private contractual matter outside ministerial control, and that the government will push platforms for more transparency, but could not answer all questions in time.
As Minister, I do not decide on the terms of use of social media platforms such as Twitter.
Als Minister ga ik niet over de gebruiksregels van sociale media als Twitter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Amsterdam wil 'eerlijke' computers in de stad’

MPs Middendorp and Van den Bosch asked the State Secretary whether municipalities such as Amsterdam may audit algorithms of national companies, and about national frameworks for algorithms. The State Secretary answered that municipalities have regulatory and enforcement powers within their territory, that existing legal bases for algorithm checks are limited to specific competition and data protection authorities, and that the national government supports municipalities with frameworks and coordination.
Municipalities have powers for setting frameworks and enforcement, and nationally operating companies will also have to comply with these.
Gemeenten hebben bevoegdheden voor kaderstelling en handhaving en daar zullen ook nationaal opererende bedrijven aan moeten voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Middendorp over de bunker Seyss Inquart

MPs Aartsen and Middendorp asked why the sale and repurposing of the Seyss-Inquart bunker proceeds before the government's promised vision and action plan on WWII heritage, and how this relates to the Beckerman motion. The State Secretary replied that a Nota van Uitgangspunten is not a final sale, that no irreversible steps will be taken before 1 October 2019, and that the sale continues while the motion is implemented in that sense.

No irreversible steps are being taken in the current sale process before the Minister of Education, Culture and Science has presented the promised vision and action plan on Second World War heritage (by 1 October 2019 at the latest).

Er worden geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet in het onderhavige verkoopproces, vóórdat de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW) de toegezegde visie met actieplan voor het erfgoed van de Tweede Wereldoorlog heeft gepresenteerd (uiterlijk 1 oktober 2019).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Middendorp over de artikelen ‘Molly Russell’s father: cutting, biting, burning — my daughter was shown it all on social media’ en ‘You have amazing ability, Damian Hinds tells te

Two MPs asked the government about UK press reports on the death of a teenager linked to social media content, whether similar Dutch cases are known, whether Dutch research on social media and suicide will be undertaken, and what action will be taken. The minister said no Dutch data on causes of suicide are kept, a 113 Suicide Prevention study on 2017 youth suicides is underway with results expected at year end, and pointed to EU audiovisual rules, media literacy in the curriculum and existing support networks.
In the Netherlands no data are kept on the causes of suicide.
In Nederland worden geen gegevens bijgehouden over de oorzaken van zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Eijs over het artikel 'Soap rond architecten verbouwing Binnenhof'

MPs Middendorp and Van Eijs asked the State Secretary about press reports of turmoil among architects for the Binnenhof renovation, including the replacement of the Eerste Kamer architect and the search for new architects. The State Secretary answered that the timeline and budget are unaffected, that architect Pi de Bruijn will be commissioned for building N, and that governance will be reviewed with the House's user groups.
That is why I want to examine with the users of the House of Representatives whether it is possible to make changes to the existing project structure
Vandaar dat ik met de gebruikers van de Tweede Kamer wil bezien of het mogelijk is om wijzigingen in de bestaande projectstructuur aan te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Rechter moet tussenbeide komen bij ICT-ruzie binnen UWV’

MPs Wiersma and Middendorp (VVD) asked about reported internal conflict over UWV's ICT reorganisation, including new IV-director posts, decentralisation of ICT staff, software maintenance costs and coordination with other agencies. Minister Koolmees answered that the transition is UWV's own responsibility as an autonomous body, that the implementation is temporarily suspended for talks with the works council, and that no new management layer is added.
As an autonomous administrative body, however, the Executive Board of UWV is itself responsible for the proper organisation of the agency.
Als zbo is de Raad van Bestuur van UWV echter zelf verantwoordelijk voor een goede inrichting van de organisatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en van Haga over de berichten ‘Limburg genoemd als locatie voor megadistributiecentrum van Chinese webwinkelreus Alibaba’ en 'Rutte wil Alibaba binnenhalen, maar douane is e-com

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the growing role of online retail, the possible Alibaba distribution centre in the Benelux, cross-border goods flows, customs and product-safety gaps for non-EU online sellers. The government answered that data on cross-border flows is largely unavailable, customs and market supervisors already control non-EU imports, and it is pushing in EU negotiations for an EU-based contact point for third-country online sellers.
No figures are known on this, and well-founded estimates cannot be given.
Hierover zijn geen cijfers bekend, en goed onderbouwde schattingen zijn niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over de berichten ‘pilots met Idensys stopt per 31 december 2018’ en ’Einde pilot inloggen met Idensys en iDIN’

An MP asks the State Secretary whether he remembers written questions from 7 December 2018 about reports that the Idensys and iDIN login pilots would end, and whether he will answer them before a committee debate on e-identity and passports. The answer states that the original questions have been answered in the parliamentary appendix and does not address the substance of the reports.
The written questions from MP Middendorp (VVD), question number 2019Z01312, have been answered in the Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1427.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Middendorp (VVD), vraagnummer 2019Z01312 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1427 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over de berichten ‘pilots met Idensys stopt per 31 december 2018’ en ’Einde pilot inloggen met Idensys en iDIN’

The MP asked why pilots with private login means Idensys and iDIN were stopped on 31 December 2018, how many users were involved, and about the evaluation and next steps. The State Secretary answered that the pilots were ended to clear the way for a tender for private login means for (semi)public services, that 39,146 means were issued (6,004 by Idensys, 33,142 iDIN), and that the evaluation by the Kuipers committee was used.
I have no picture of the costs that companies incurred for participating in the pilots.
Ik heb geen beeld van de kosten die bedrijven hebben gemaakt voor de deelname aan de pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Nederlandse vingerafdrukken gedeeld met FBI’

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch fingerprint data shared with the FBI under the PCSC treaty, the alleged 2011 destruction of a national fingerprint database, and the case for a new central database are justified. The government answered that no central fingerprint database was ever created, that passport fingerprints are deleted after issuance and not shared, and that a central database would require amending the Paspoortwet, while not committing to any such change.
The article wrongly claims that a national fingerprint database was destroyed in 2011.
Het artikel stelt ten onrechte dat er in 2011 een landelijke databank met vingerafdrukken is vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Beveiliging data fiscus ondermaats’

MPs Lodders and Middendorp asked about press reports that the tax authority cannot technically secure personal data, and about logging, data location, staff training and AVG compliance. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the limitation concerns only logging of data use once extracted to staff workstations in one department, that measures have been taken, and that an Analytical Data Perimeter will be introduced in 2019.
Actions with data in the central data environment of DF&A are logged and monitored.
Handelingen met gegevens in de centrale dataomgeving van DF&A worden wel gelogd en gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Den Boer over de Verordening mechanisme om juridische en administratieve belemmeringen in een grensoverschrijdende context uit de weg te ruimen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for the status of the EU regulation on a mechanism to remove legal and administrative obstacles in cross-border situations, including negotiation positions and next steps. The State Secretary answered that the Commission proposal is with member states, the Dutch position is set out in a BNC fiche, the Austrian presidency will not put it on the agenda this year, and the Kamer will be informed periodically in quarterly reports.
I will inform the Kamer periodically through the usual information channels about developments regarding this proposal.
Ik zal de Kamer via de gebruikelijke informatievoorziening periodiek informeren over de ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot dit voorstel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over het artikel 'Twitter, Facebook en Google gaan nepnieuws aanpakken'

MP Middendorp asked the Interior Minister about reports that tech companies such as Twitter, Facebook and Google may influence elections and whether Dutch or EU rules govern their role in elections. The minister answered that tech firms can affect elections both positively and negatively, that no Dutch studies exist on their effects, that GDPR and an EU voluntary code of practice on disinformation apply, and that the Staatscommissie Parlementair Stelsel and an evaluation of the Wfpp will address campaign rules.
I do not rule out that personal data could also be misused in the Netherlands to influence elections.
Ik sluit niet uit dat ook in Nederland misbruik gemaakt zou kunnen worden van persoonsgegevens om verkiezingen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over het bericht ’Grote ICT-projecten overheid zeker €1 mrd duurder dan begroot’

An MP (Middendorp, VVD) asked the Interior Minister about a Financieel Dagblad report that large government ICT projects are at least €1 billion over budget, covering cost causes, budgeting, the BIT review body and the Elias commission's estimates. The minister answered that the figure mixes multi-year re-estimates with other costs, promised a letter in autumn on improving cost estimates, and said no overview of projects at risk exists.
I cannot do that without going into the individual case details of each project.
Dat kan ik niet zonder op de individuele casuïstiek van ieder project in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over de uitvoering van de moties ingediend tijdens het VAO WNT

MPs asked the Minister of Interior how she will substantiate the next WNT annual report with figures on labour mobility and public-private pay gaps, as demanded by motions from the VAO WNT debate. The Minister replied that the next report will add information on enforcement, exemption requests and stakeholder experiences, while systematic effect data will come through a sub-study programme feeding the 2020 evaluation, with results sent to Parliament as they become available.

In response to the various motions in the VAO WNT of 17 May 2018, I am meeting you and have repeatedly promised that from the next WNT annual report onward I will enrich it with more information on the effects of the WNT.

Naar aanleiding van de diverse moties in het VAO WNT van 17 mei 2018 kom ik u tegemoet en heb ik bij herhaling toegezegd dat ik vanaf de eerstvolgende WNT-jaarrapportage deze zal verrijken met meer informatie over de effecten WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

Two VVD MPs asked why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (Dutch state property agency) let maintenance of its leased farm buildings lapse, why it does not sell them, and which conditions apply. The State Secretary answered that the agency manages 164 farms, has an inspection and maintenance plan for 2018 after a 2017 letter to tenants, and maintains a policy of not selling farm buildings, while knowing of no operational hindrance from the maintenance backlog.

Because there is a backlog in maintenance of agricultural buildings, the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf notified all tenants of agricultural buildings by letter on 14 September 2017 that they could report faults and problems to a national fault line.

Omdat er een achterstand is in het onderhoud van agrarische gebouwen heeft het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf op 14 september 2017 alle pachters van agrarische gebouwen per brief gemeld dat zij melding kunnen maken van storingen en problemen op een landelijk storingsnummer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Arno Rutte, Middendorp en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Agentschap Telecom slaat alarm over hackbare apparaten’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government shares the Agentschap Telecom's call to hurry a security mark for 'smart' connected devices, how it is progressing, and related questions on consumer visibility, ISP involvement, company-led certification and innovation. The government answers that it supports a European CE-type mark with mandatory minimum digital security requirements under the Radio Equipment Directive, that it has proposed this in Europe, and that it is working with ISPs and on EU cybersecurity certification.

Together with the European Commission, the cabinet is examining how to give effect to the aforementioned possibility of extending the current CE mark of the RED with minimum digital security requirements for wireless devices.

Met de Europese Commissie onderzoekt het kabinet hoe invulling te gegeven aan voornoemde mogelijkheid om het huidige CE-keurmerk van de RED uit te breiden met minimale eisen aan de digitale veiligheid van draadloze apparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over het bericht ‘RVB wil dat onjuiste pachtnota's betaald worden’

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf sent tenants invoices and reminders for April 2018 based on outdated rent percentages, and what would be done about payment pressure and liquidity risk. The Staatssecretaris admitted a process step was wrongly skipped, apologised, committed to no automatic follow-up calls and to stopping collection with interest refunds.

When sending the invoices for rent for the period 1 October 2017 to 30 April 2018, it was not possible to implement in time in the administrative systems the rent price adjustments applying from 1 July 2017.

Bij het verzenden van de facturen voor de pacht over de periode 1 oktober 2017 t/m 30 april 2018 is het niet gelukt om de aanpassingen van de pachtprijzen die gelden vanaf 1 juli 2017 tijdig in de administratieve systemen door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over het bericht 'Nieuwe pachtrekeningen door softwarefout'

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked the State Secretary about reports that Rijksvastgoedbedrijf farm rent invoices failed to apply July 2017 rent adjustments due to a process step being skipped (not a software bug), why this surfaced late, poor reachability and itemised invoicing. The government admitted the error, apologised, promised corrections and contact channels, and said a letter on rent policy would follow.
All tenants have now received a letter about the rent adjustment that was not implemented, apologising for how matters unfolded.
Inmiddels hebben alle pachters een brief ontvangen over de niet doorgevoerde pachtprijsherziening, waarin excuses worden aangeboden over de gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Grenswerkers klem tussen Nederlandse en Duitse belastingdienst’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Interior about reports that cross-border workers are caught between Dutch and German tax authorities, including rising problem cases, information provision, DGA salary double taxation, and capacity. The government denies a clear rise in problems, says information provision is adequate and monitored, sees no need for new Germany-specific agreements or additional measures now, and commits only to continued monitoring.
However, there are no figures available on all cases where problems arise from differing interpretation of those tax rules in relation to Germany.
Er zijn echter geen cijfers beschikbaar van alle gevallen waar zich problemen voordoen door verschillende interpretatie van die (belasting)regels in relatie tot Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Kabinet zet koppositie ICT op het spel, waarschuwt Eelco Blok’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether they agreed with Eelco Blok's claim that the cabinet lacks a long-term ICT vision and risks Dutch digital leadership, and asked about spectrum auction timing and the national digitalisation strategy. The government disputed the claim, pointed to Dutch strengths and the coming Digitaliseringsstrategie, and confirmed that auction dates and the 3.5 GHz options would be sent to parliament before the relevant recesses.
To be able to lead in the coming years, the coalition agreement contains the necessary ambitions and actions regarding digitalisation.
Om de komende jaren voorop te kunnen lopen, bevat het regeerakkoord de nodige ambities en acties bevat als het gaat om digitalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over het artikel 'Het voelt als dat bordspel: De Betoverende Doolhof'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a newspaper article describing how cross-border workers face a maze of fiscal and social rules, and whether bilateral agreements could help without more EU involvement. The State Secretary answered that the government points to grensinfopunten, the Belastingdienst and SVB back offices, existing bilateral tax treaties with compensation schemes, and promised a letter on cross-border policy progress.

A letter on the state of cross-border policy, including progress on all action points on neighbouring-language and culture and accessibility drawn up in January 2017 for the cross-border economy and labour, I will send to your House ahead of the general consultation on cross-border cooperation of 25 April 2018.

Een brief over de stand van zaken van het grensoverschrijdend beleid met daarin de voortgang van alle actiepunten, waaronder buurtaal en -cultuur en bereikbaarheid, die voor de grensoverschrijdende economie en arbeid in januari 2017 zijn opgesteld, stuur ik voor het algemeen overleg over grensoverschrijdende samenwerking van 25 april 2018 naar uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over het bericht 'Problemen met vloeren ministerie BZK: honderden inspecties, tijdelijke ontruiming en aanpassingen vereist'

An MP asked about structural floor problems and mandatory inspections at the Ministry of Interior's Turfmarkt 147 building, including why problems arose and what they will cost. The State Secretary answered that inspections of prefabricated floor slabs are ongoing until end of April, that the floors are safe for current use with load restrictions, and that costs cannot yet be estimated, with the Chamber to be informed after the studies conclude.
I will inform the Chamber as soon as possible after the investigations are concluded.
Ik zal de Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk na afronding van de onderzoeken informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Koopmans over de berichtgeving over het proefschrift van Marlies van Eck van de Tilburg University

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a PhD thesis finding that citizens are insufficiently legally protected against computer-driven financial decisions by government, and whether computer instructions should be open to third parties or reviewed by an independent body. The State Secretary answered that existing law already requires correctable, well-reasoned decisions, that the Wet Openbaarheid van Bestuur allows third parties to request source code, that an algorithms study is under way, and that no independent review body is planned.
In line with this practice, I see no reason for now to establish an independent body to assess source codes.
In lijn met deze praktijk zie ik vooralsnog geen reden om een onafhankelijke instelling in het leven te roepen voor de beoordeling van broncodes.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van den Bosch over het bericht "Dit gaan ze niet leuk vinden, Rik’’

VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a newspaper report on a website built from open government pesticide data, and whether it is the ministry's role to prevent or resolve such conflicts over open-data reuse in the digitalisation strategy. The minister answered that open data should be freely reusable by anyone, with or without profit, that the state remains responsible for its own use of data, and that the policy will not be changed.
Open data are made available without imposing requirements on their use by third parties.
Open data worden beschikbaar gesteld zonder eisen te stellen aan de toepassing door derden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Middendorp en Özütok over het bericht 'Je uitvaart kan een stuk duurzamer maar het mag nog niet'

Three MPs (Den Boer, Middendorp, Özütok) asked the Minister of Interior whether citizens should have more freedom in funeral methods, such as resomation, given environmental benefits and public support, and whether an impact assessment would be conducted. The Minister answered that careful study of ethics, environment and worker safety is needed first, referred to a completed TU Delft report, and promised to inform parliament in the second half of 2018 on policy proposals.
I expect to be able to inform your House further in the second half of 2018 about policy proposals regarding funeral practices in the Netherlands.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in de tweede helft van 2018 nader te kunnen informeren over beleidsvoorstellen met betrekking tot de lijkbezorging in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Koopmans over het bericht 'Online burgerinspraak kan leiden tot teleurstelling in politici' en het rapport van het Rathenau instituut 'Online meebeslissen'

MPs Middendorp and Koopmans asked the government about reports on the limited impact and unrepresentative participation of online citizen consultation, and about how digital participation is shaped and improved. The minister answered that internetconsultatie.nl is the main national tool, that low awareness of the site is acknowledged and being addressed, and that a digital democracy pilot with municipalities starts in April, while broader national measures await the Staatscommissie Parlementair Stelsel report.
For national-level digital participation, additional measures are being considered mainly in conjunction with the publication of the report of the State Committee on the Parliamentary System.

Voor wat betreft digitale participatie op het landelijke niveau worden aanvullende maatregelen m.n. bezien in samenhang met het verschijnen van het rapport van de Staatscommissie Parlementair Stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Middendorp over het bericht ‘grenswerker schiet weinig op met Europese eenheid’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about barriers to cross-border labour in border regions, the growth potential, the EU's role and bilateral arrangements. The State Secretary pointed to a CPB study and an action agenda with partners, said the EU's role is mainly funding and support, and promised a progress report to the Tweede Kamer in spring 2018.
I will, in my previously announced progress report to the House of Representatives in spring 2018, go into greater detail on the progress of that.
Ik zal in mijn eerder aangekondigde voortgangsbericht aan de Tweede Kamer in het voorjaar van 2018 uitvoeriger stilstaan bij de voortgang daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Middendorp over het bericht “NS ziet af van verkoop AH to go en Julia’s op stations”

MPs Aukje de Vries and Middendorp asked why NS (Dutch Railways) decided to keep AH to go and Julia's shops in stations under its own management, despite its 2016 strategy to divest retail, and whether the shareholder was consulted. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that NS's 2016 strategy remains in force, that retail formulas are being put out to concession gradually, that the shareholder was consulted as required, and that the government reviews the strategy with NS on a regular basis.
In accordance with statutory provisions, NS consulted the State as shareholder before the strategy was adopted by NS.
Conform statutaire bepalingen heeft NS de Staat als aandeelhouder geraadpleegd voordat de strategie door NS is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over de berichtgeving omtrent het alarm slaan van de Nederlandse spoorsector over de Duitse stremming bij Rastatt

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the reported alarm in the Dutch rail sector over the closure of the Rastatt rail line in Germany, including damage to Dutch freight operators and ports and calls for EU-level action. The State Secretary answered that the ministry has been in regular contact with German authorities and infrastructure managers, that the closure causes substantial economic damage, and that a joint evaluation and an EU-level meeting are planned, but she gave no detailed damage figures.
I do not have an exact picture of the damage.
Mij is geen exact beeld van de schade bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Remco Dijkstra over de aanpassing van de dienstregeling van het treinverkeer in het Rivierengebied

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about the 2018 timetable changes for rail in the Rivierengebied, including longer transfer times at Tiel and Geldermalsen, and how affected residents were weighed and consulted. The State Secretary confirmed the impacts, explained that the frequency upgrade on the Amsterdam–Eindhoven corridor required them, reported consultations via ROCOV, and said NS had only made a small improvement at Geldermalsen while finding no better option for Tiel.
NS is responsible for the timetable and regularly informs me as concession grantor about developments in the timetable.
NS is verantwoordelijk voor de dienstregeling en informeert mij als concessieverlener regelmatig over de ontwikkelingen in de dienstregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Von Martels, Nijkerken-de Haan en Middendorp over het behoud van het station Valkenburg door de Zuid-Limburgse Stoomtrein Maatschappij

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the State Secretary about the ILT's refusal to let the Zuid-Limburgse Stoomtrein Maatschappij run over the main line to Valkenburg station without machinist licences, and whether the rules are stricter than EU requirements. The State Secretary answered that no regulatory change occurred, the ILT had no legal basis for an exemption, and ZLSM is expected to obtain a new safety certificate by early 2018 with a study into training for its machinists.
The ILT's decision arose from a request by the ZLSM.
Het besluit van de ILT komt voort uit een verzoek van de ZLSM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Hermans over de controle van topinkomens in zorginstellingen

MPs Middendorp and Hermans asked whether the detailed WNT rules on top-income control in healthcare institutions cause high compliance costs and asked for a quick remedy. The minister acknowledges complexity and admin burden, agrees to consult the NBA on reducing the audit protocol burden, and will review controls in the WNT evaluation.

I am happy to consider, together with the parties involved, whether there are possibilities within the aim and framework of the WNT to reduce the audit burden on accountants and thereby the costs for all WNT institutions.

Ik ben graag bereid om samen met betrokken partijen te bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om binnen het doel en de kaders van de WNT de controlelast voor accountants en daarmee de kosten voor alle WNT-instellingen te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over de internationale cyberaanval en de ICT van de Overheid

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether government ICT systems were infected by the Wannacry ransomware attack, whether they are sufficiently secure, what lessons are drawn, and for an overview of systems under the ministry. The minister reported no known infections, described existing patching and NCSC support, noted Court of Audit findings on information security shortcomings, and promised to inform parliament on progress.
The House will also be informed about the progress.
De Kamer zal eveneens over de voortgang worden geïnformeerd.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Boucke c.s. ter vervanging van. nr. 13 over dekking voor middelen voor zonnepanelen op scholen
Shifts 40 million euro within the energy budget to subsidise solar panels on schools via a DUMAVA scheme, a budget reallocation without clear checks on the executive.
The funds will be used for the DUMAVA subsidy scheme
De middelen worden ingezet ten behoeve van de subsidieregeling DUMAVA
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Kröger en Boucke ter vervanging van nr. 21 over middelen voor een kwaliteitsbudget
Reallocates within the energy budget to create a 25 million euro quality budget for ecology and landscape around renewable energy projects.
This amendment therefore arranges that 25 million euros is freed up for a quality budget
Dit amendement regelt daarom dat € 25 miljoen wordt vrijgemaakt voor een kwaliteitsbudget
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Kröger en Boucke ter vervanging van nr. 10 over middelen voor een kwaliteitsbudget
Reserves 25 million euros in the energy budget for a quality budget to restore ecology and landscape around renewable energy projects on land.
With this amendment 25,000,000 euros is reserved for a quality budget
Met dit amendement wordt € 25.000.000 gereserveerd voor een kwaliteitsbudget
Amendement van het lid Boucke over dekking voor middelen voor zonnepanelen op scholen
Amendment moves 100 million euro from the energy budget reserve to the DUMAVA subsidy scheme so schools can fund solar panels.
Therefore this amendment reduces article 4 by 100 million euro
Daarom wordt met dit amendement 100 miljoen euro in mindering gebracht op artikel 4
Amendement van de leden Kröger en Boucke over middelen voor een kwaliteitsbudget
Amendment reserves 50 million euro in the energy budget for a quality budget to restore ecology and landscape around renewable energy projects.
This amendment therefore arranges that 50 million euro is set aside for a quality budget.
Dit amendement regelt daarom dat € 50 miljoen wordt vrijgemaakt voor een kwaliteitsbudget.
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. over toevoeging van de doelen circulaire technieken en koolstofvastlegging in de gebouwde omgeving
Adds circular techniques and carbon storage in the built environment as goals of the Climate Fund.
In part b, after 'greenhouse-gas-reducing', 'and circular' is inserted
In onderdeel b wordt na «broeikasgas-reducerende» ingevoegd «en circulaire»
Motie van de leden Erkens en Boucke over monitoren waar burgers en bedrijven tegen aanlopen bij het indienen van een subsidieaanvraag
Motion asks the government to monitor where citizens and businesses encounter problems when applying for subsidies and use the results when designing new schemes.
requests the government to monitor where citizens and businesses run into problems when submitting a subsidy application
verzoekt de regering te monitoren waar burgers en bedrijven tegen aanlopen bij het indienen van een subsidieaanvraag
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Stoffer en Boucke ter vervanging van nr. 33 over rekening houden met de gevolgen van het klimaatbeleid
Requires that, when assessing the effectiveness and efficiency of climate spending, the consequences of climate policy for household and business capacity be taken into account.
When applying the third paragraph, opening words and part b, account is taken of the consequences of climate policy
Bij de toepassing van het derde lid, aanhef en onderdeel b, wordt rekening gehouden met de gevolgen van het klimaatbeleid
Amendement van de leden Boucke en Kröger ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het verplicht inwinnen van onafhankelijk advies
Changes the Climate Fund bill so the fund manager must always obtain independent advice on the multi-year programme and on spending from the fund, instead of optionally.
In article 7, 'may obtain independent advice' is replaced by 'obtains independent advice'.
In artikel 7 wordt «kan onafhankelijk advies inwinnen» vervangen door «wint onafhankelijk advies in».
Motie van het lid Boucke over de beheerder van het Klimaatfonds blijven betrekken bij de uitwerking van toegekende maatregelen
Asks the government to ensure the Climate Fund manager stays involved in implementing granted measures and checks that assessment criteria continue to be met.
requests the government to ensure that the fund manager remains involved in the implementation of granted measures
verzoekt de regering om te regelen dat de fondsbeheerder betrokken blijft bij de uitwerking van toegekende maatregelen
Amendement van het lid Boucke over het verplicht inwinnen van onafhankelijk advies

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over het bericht 'Provincie stond jarenlang toe dat Tata-fabriek kankerverwekkende stoffen lekte'

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary whether the province knowingly allowed Tata Steel to emit carcinogenic PAHs for decades, including a 1988 agreement that required no action on leaking coke-oven doors, and asked for archival reconstruction, the documents and a full overview of agreements. The state secretary declined archival research, said the 1988 document has not yet been found and will be sent when located, gave no overview of historical agreements, and said licence revocation is for the competent authority, with an OD NZKG investigation expected in Q1 2024.
As soon as these documents have been found, I will still send them to your House.
Zodra deze documenten zijn aangetroffen, zal ik deze alsnog aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over het bericht dat hoge concentraties kankerverwekkende stoffen bij Tata Steel als sinds jaren 70 bekend zijn

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that carcinogenic PAH concentrations near Tata Steel were known since the 1970s, asking whether government acted negligently, about enforcement, emissions, and the Tata India plans. The State Secretary answered that a 1977 provincial report existed and was shared with provincial states, that BaP levels fell 99% since 1975, that the state cannot fully reconstruct past decisions, and that enforcement against Tata is handled by the provincial authority and the Omgevingsdienst NZKG with ongoing penalty orders.
Without archival research it is difficult to say what the government specifically did in response to this report at the time.
Het is zonder archiefonderzoek moeilijk om te zeggen wat de overheid toentertijd precies heeft ondernomen in reactie op dit rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over het bericht 'Tata hakt knoop door en gaat tóch staal maken met waterstof'

The minister answered that the revised plans cannot yet be assessed, that the April 2022 expression of principles remains in place, and that the government will test the plans once the company provides details after the summer.
I cannot yet assess the plans at this moment.
Ik kan de plannen op dit moment nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Boucke over de ingroei van elektrische auto’s

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about the uptake of electric cars under the planned post-2025 stimulus package, covering sales forecasts, total cost of ownership, the SEPP subsidy slowdown, the used-EV market, and international comparisons. The state secretary reaffirmed the 2030 zero-emission goal, forecast about 60% EV share of new sales in 2030 under the package, admitted falling subsidy applications and promised further research, and answered most questions substantively while committing to studies and a letter in 2024.
I expect to be able to inform the House by the first quarter of 2024 at the latest about the outcome of the study.
Ik verwacht de Kamer uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal van 2024 te kunnen informeren over de uitkomst van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over de vertraging om de groenstaalplannen van Tata Steel

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked about delays in Tata Steel's green steel plans, the regional environmental service's enforcement against unclean cokes-oven gas and its capacity, and the government's follow-up on related motions. The State Secretary answered that delays are undesirable, that the government is in talks with the company and the regional service, that enforcement is independent and risk-based, and that a verbal commitment to further steps and extra capacity funding has been made.
I agree with the OD NZKG that a worked-out and reliable planning is necessary for the success of the project.
Ik ben het eens met de OD NZKG dat een uitgewerkte en betrouwbare planning nodig is voor het slagen van het project.
Antwoord op van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'Miljoenen nodig voor sloop kerncentrale Dodewaard bij aandeelhouders beland'

MPs Boucke and Hagen asked how the state came to bear decommissioning costs for the Dodewaard nuclear plant while shareholders received payouts, and about financing rules for decommissioning other energy infrastructure. The minister explains that GKN could not secure approved financial guarantees, that a term sheet transfers NEA's assets to the state, and that a broader reform of mining decommissioning rules is planned for after summer.
The downside is that the state thereby becomes (indirectly) responsible for dismantling GKN.
Keerzijde is dat de Staat hiermee (indirect) verantwoordelijk wordt GKN te ontmantelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Boucke over het artikel 'Lenen voor zonnepanelen levert vaak gratis geld op: 'Jammer dat mensen dit niet weten''

MPs Boulakjar and Boucke asked the Minister for Housing about homeowners' limited awareness of subsidies and green loans for home insulation and solar panels, following a news report. The minister replied that the government is improving information via Verbeterjehuis.nl, mortgage advice rules and municipal programmes, without a detailed timeline for every measure.
The intention is to take the energy label of the home into account in mortgage lending norms from 1 January 2024.
Het voornemen is om bij de leennormen voor de hypotheek vanaf 1 januari 2024 rekening te houden met het energielabel van de woning
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht ‘Belangrijkste maatregel om luchtvaart te verduurzamen sneuvelt: kabinet schrapt 14 procent bijmengverplichting’

MP Boucke (D66) asked the minister whether the government still supports the Akkoord Duurzame Luchtvaart after reports that the national 14% sustainable aviation fuel blending target was dropped in favour of an EU 6% obligation. The minister says the 14% national target remains government policy, that the EU rule does not affect the CO2 goals, and that the ministry is studying additional incentives and talking with fuel producers and airlines.
That target remains in place and is cabinet policy.
Die doelstelling staat overeind en is kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het rapport 'Het energiesysteem van de toekomst: de II3050-scenario’s' van Netbeheer Nederland en Gasunie

An MP asked the minister about the netbeheerders' II3050 report on industrial decarbonisation, including which sectors are strategic, whether space exists for new industry, and whether norms and support would be provided. The minister answered that the NPVI and a forthcoming Routekaart will set framework conditions, that companies decide their own strategies, and that no sectors are being written off.
Before the summer I will present the Routekaart Verduurzaming Industrie to your House.
Voor de zomer zal ik de Routekaart Verduurzaming Industrie aan uw Kamer aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de rechterlijke uitspraak betreffende het kort geding over de experimenteerregeling Schiphol

An MP asked the minister about the court ruling on the Schiphol experiment and the reduction to 460,000 flights, including whether the state would appeal and why outdated data was used. The minister answered that the state is appealing, declined to go into substance given the pending appeal, and said a night curfew option is being studied with results expected after summer 2023.
Given the appeal, it is not possible to go into the substance of this further.
Gelet op het hoger beroep kan hier niet nader inhoudelijk op worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Boucke over de Voorkeursbeslissing voor de herziening van het luchtruim

MPs Van der Graaf and Boucke asked the minister about the air-space redesign decision, including a fourth approach route, its effect on noise, climate, nitrogen and capacity, and how objections were handled. The minister answered at length that the fourth approach point mainly reduces noise and CO2 and does not aim to grow flight numbers, that capacity gains serve sustainable traffic handling, and that the decision is directional with detailed participation to follow.
The preferred decision is a directional decision in broad outline and thereby marks the start of the next phase of the programme.
De Voorkeursbeslissing is een richtinggevend besluit op hoofdlijnen en markeert daarmee de start van de volgende fase van het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Boucke over het initiatief voor energiebesparing op De Zuidas en het voorzien van alle straatverlichting van een led-lichtbron

Two MPs asked the ministers about a campaign to switch off night-time office lighting on the Zuidas and about fully converting street lighting to LED, including whether the government would support the initiative and how energy savings could be mandated. The ministers confirmed support for the campaign, pointed to the energy-saving obligation and the updated measures list, and said about 32% of motorway lighting is LED with the rest to be replaced at natural replacement moments, rather than accelerating full conversion.
Almost all provinces will fit the remaining street lighting with LED lamps in the coming years.
Vrijwel alle provincies gaan de komende jaren de resterende straatverlichting van ledlampen voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht ‘Provincie Utrecht gebruikt als eerste overheid in Nederland een eerlijke CO2-prijs’

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers how the national government factors the costs of climate change into policy, whether a national CO2 price should be used, and whether ministers should report climate costs. The minister answered that the IAK and MKBA guidance already include CO2 prices, that the planning bureaus' efficient CO2 prices differ from Utrecht's social-cost approach, that he is willing to work toward a national CO2 price, and that reporting and decision-note requirements are left to individual ministers.
I would prefer to leave this to the ministers themselves.
Dit laat ik graag aan de Ministers zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht “Schiphol Group heeft boeren uitgekocht voor extra stikstofruimte Schiphol en Lelystad Airport

D66 MPs asked whether Schiphol's buyout of farms for nitrogen space is known, how much space is freed, the status of Schiphol's nature permit, and how Lelystad Airport's nitrogen offsetting and a planned pre-emption right fit together. The government answered that nine farms were bought for Schiphol and three for Lelystad Airport, that the appropriate assessment is still being supplemented, and that a pre-emption right bill is targeted for entry into force on 1 January 2024.
It is important that Schiphol obtains the required nature permit as soon as possible.
Het is van belang dat Schiphol zo spoedig mogelijk over de vereiste natuurvergunning beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht ‘Nieuwkoop roept bewoners op bezwaar te maken tegen extra nachtvluchten Schiphol’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Nieuwkoop's call for residents to object to extra night flights at Schiphol due to temporary use of the Aalsmeer runway during Zwanenburg runway maintenance. The minister confirmed the nighttime use is limited to roughly 5 to 10 nights, that no talks with Nieuwkoop are planned, and that the consultation results will inform the final regulation and a review of runway maintenance rules, though the temporary regulation is maintained.
In light of the internet consultation, the approach to runway maintenance will be examined.
Mede naar aanleiding van de internetconsultatie zal naar de systematiek rond baanonderhoud worden gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het bericht ‘Nederland doet te weinig om Bonaire te beschermen tegen bedreiging klimaatverandering’

MPs Wuite and Boucke (D66) asked the State Secretary and ministers about a report warning that Bonaire risks flooding from climate change, and whether Dutch climate law, international agreements and coordination should extend to the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for adaptation, that further studies and a climate table on Bonaire are planned, and that the Dutch Climate Act and Paris Agreement cannot simply extend to these islands.
The local government has the means to steer spatial planning so as to prevent as much damage and nuisance from extreme weather as possible.
Het lokale bestuur heeft de mogelijkheden om te sturen op een ruimtelijke ordening en inrichting waarmee schade en overlast door weersextremen zo veel mogelijk wordt voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht ‘Krimp Schiphol niet haalbaar, voorlopig meer vluchten dan gepland’

An MP asks why the government's target of reducing Schiphol to 440,000 flights for winter 2023/24 is not achieved and why residents learned this from news reports, and asks about delays in the balanced approach procedure, the nature-permit process and the CO2 cap. The minister answers that the information was already shared earlier, that anticipatory enforcement ends in November 2023, that the 440,000 cap is to be legally anchored by winter 2024/25 and that the timetable and a further update will follow in a separate progress letter.

For a full overview you are referred to the answers to the written consultation on the Schiphol main-lines letter of 29 September and the third progress letter on the Schiphol Airport Environment Programme of 16 December 2022.

Voor een volledig overzicht wordt u verwezen naar de beantwoording van het Schriftelijk Overleg Hoofdlijnenbrief Schiphol van 29 september jl. en de derde voortgangsbrief Programma Omgeving Luchthaven Schiphol van 16 december 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Hong Kong’s Cathay Pacific to restart polar route flight path over Russia after it was axed in March because of invasion of Ukraine'.

An MP asked whether the Russian-airspace polar route used by non-sanctioning airlines creates unfair competition and safety risks, and whether the minister would ban its use and strengthen airspace risk management. The minister replied that Russia itself restricted access for airlines from listed sanctioning countries, that the EU ban covers only EU airspace, and that the government will not seek a ban or wider sanctions, while noting ICAO work on conflict-zone risks.
I cannot prohibit commercial airlines from countries that may still operate through Russian airspace from using the so-called polar route, because I have no legal powers to do so.

Ik kan commerciële luchtvaartmaatschappijen afkomstig uit landen die nog wel via het Russisch luchtruim mogen opereren niet verbieden om gebruik te maken van de zogenaamde «polar route», omdat ik daar geen juridische bevoegdheden toe heb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Boucke over stijgende energieprijzen zorginstellingen

MPs Paulusma and Boucke asked about rising energy costs for hospitals and residential care facilities, including reports of diesel emergency generators being used because they are cheaper than gas, and whether mitigating measures such as the energy price cap and WHOA restructuring apply. The minister acknowledges sector-wide financial pressure, says he is unaware of diesel signals, points to existing energy-cap and TEK compensation conditions, declines to provide an overview of at-risk institutions, and refers to earlier letters and sustainability support programmes.
I do not have such an overview.
Ik beschik niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'Nieuwe productiemethode maakt rotorbladen van windmolens goed recyclebaar'

Two MPs (Boucke and Hagen, D66) asked the government about recycling of wind turbine blades, the fate of decommissioned turbines, circularity in the energy transition, and related regulation and tenders. The minister answered at length, describing current recycling options, the TNO innovation, producer responsibility rules, and planned measures such as a national circular economy programme and circularity criteria in offshore wind tenders, but gave no firm numeric targets.
For stimulating R&D&I aimed at transitions, mission-driven innovation policy makes an important contribution.
Voor het stimuleren van R&D&I gericht op transities levert het missiegedreven innovatiebeleid een belangrijke bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Boucke en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Den Haag vindt na Gazprom geen gasleverancier, gemeente wil ontheffing'

MPs Boucke and Bloulakjar asked the energy minister about reports that municipalities must sign costly new gas contracts after Gazprom's Dutch-German arm was sanctioned, and whether exemptions and cost burdens are justified. The minister explains that the SEFE contracts fell under sanctions until Germany nationalised SEFE GmbH on 11 November 2022, that exemptions have been granted, that municipalities face extra costs of a few tons to a few million euros, and that the government will compensate those costs.
The cabinet cannot go into the details of the tender conducted by the municipality of The Hague. That is for the municipality of The Hague itself.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op de details van de gedane aanbesteding van de gemeente Den Haag. Dat is aan de gemeente Den Haag zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Boucke over het artikel 'Energieleveranciers laten bewoners met betaalproblemen massaal stikken: Schuldhulpverleners luiden noodklok'

MPs Kat and Boucke asked whether energy suppliers refuse payment arrangements for customers with payment problems, risking disconnection and derailing debt relief, and what the government will do. Minister Schouten answered that suppliers sometimes refuse arrangements, that amended disconnection rules from 26 October 2022 require suppliers to make extra efforts to reach customers and offer reasonable arrangements, and that a temporary emergency fund and a planned court-imposed payment arrangement bill are in preparation.

If a debt counsellor's proposal receives no response, the debt counsellor can point to the energy supplier's obligation to make extra efforts to reach customers and offer a reasonable and appropriate payment arrangement.

Indien er niet wordt gereageerd op een voorstel van een schuldhulpverlener, kan de schuldhulpverlener wijzen op de verplichting die de energieleverancier heeft om een extra inspanning te leveren om contact te krijgen met de klanten en om een redelijke en passende betalingsregeling aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Boucke over de voorbereidingen op de boycot op Russische olie

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about preparations for an EU boycott of Russian oil, covering supply shortages, strategic reserves, import and sector use, and crisis instruments. The minister mostly referred to a separate letter on Dutch preparations and gave statistics and a general description of the Landelijk Crisisplan Olie.
For the answer to this question I refer you to the parliamentary letter on the Dutch preparation for oil sanctions against Russia, pages 5 to 9.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief Nederlandse voorbereiding op oliesancties tegen Rusland, pagina 5 t/m 9.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de berichten 'Hoe de industrie steeds onder energiebesparing uit wist te komen' en 'Aanpak energiebesparing bij bedrijven faalt'

An MP from D66 asked the ministers about press reports that industry escaped energy-saving obligations, including why the Netherlands exempted ETS firms, whether lobbying occurred, and how enforcement and monitoring work. Minister Jetten answered most questions substantively, admitted weak enforcement and some gaps, and committed to tightening the obligation from 2023 and reporting further by year end, while declining to create a separate monitor or to state some figures.
With the tightening of the energy saving obligation, supervision of the energy saving obligation will be assigned to a single regional body.
Met de aanscherping van de energiebesparingsplicht wordt het toezicht op de energiebesparingsplicht belegd bij één regionale instantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Agnes Mulder, Dassen en Boucke over het bericht “COP27: Egypt pressed to make human rights move before climate summit”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, CDA, Volt and D66 asked the government about reports that Egyptian authorities restrict civil society and that many Egyptian organisations could not register for COP27, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about shrinking civic space, has raised accreditation inclusiveness and human rights with Egypt bilaterally and at EU level, but stressed that UNFCCC and Egypt as host carry the responsibility for participation.
The Netherlands, like other European countries, urges both bilaterally and multilaterally for an inclusive COP27 without participating organisations having to fear oppression or repercussions.

Nederland dringt, net als andere Europese landen, zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband, aan op een inclusieve COP27 zonder dat deelnemende organisaties hoeven te vrezen voor onderdrukking of repercussies.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Sjoerdsma, Boulakjar en Boucke over het bericht dat beide Nord Stream pijpleidingen vlak na elkaar zijn stuk gegaan en dat seismologische bureaus van Denemarken en Zweden hevig

MPs from D66 asked whether the Nord Stream pipeline explosions were sabotage, whether Russia could invoke force majeure, whether the Netherlands would push the EU to phase out Russian gas, and how Dutch offshore pipelines and infrastructure would be protected. The government answered that sabotage is almost certain but attribution is not yet possible, outlined EU gas-reduction measures and infrastructure protection plans, and promised a separate letter on North Sea protection.
It is almost certain that this was a sabotage action.
Het staat vrijwel zeker vast dat het hier een sabotageactie betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de terugleververgoeding van zonnestroom

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about Eneco cutting the feed-in compensation for solar power, whether a minimum compensation should be set, and how batteries, sharing and dynamic tariffs could be encouraged. The minister said he has no insight into Eneco's pricing, plans to set a legal minimum of 80 percent of the bare supply tariff and an absolute maximum, and promised a battery policy roadmap in Q1 2023.
I have no insight into how Eneco arrived at this feed-in compensation. That concerns commercially sensitive information.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoe Eneco tot deze terugleververgoeding is gekomen. Dat betreft bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Verduurzaming van Europese luchtvaart bedreigd, blijkt uit nieuwe studie'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a study warning that scarce European feedstocks could limit sustainable aviation fuel and cut aviation emissions by only 40%, and about the implications for Dutch blending obligations, hydrogen aircraft certification and non-CO2 climate effects. The minister answered that feedstock availability is considered sufficient in principle, that the national 14% 2030 target stays, that a CO2 cap is being pursued, and that monitoring, a National Energy System Plan and further studies are planned.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management is currently commissioning research to map the specific hydrogen demand for aviation for 2030–2050.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat laat op dit moment een onderzoek uitvoeren om de specifieke waterstofbehoefte voor luchtvaart 2030–2050 in kaart te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over de berichten 'Inspectie controleerde twaalf jaar niet op Schiphol' en 'Schiphol geeft toe: we hadden te weinig oog voor arbeidsomstandigheden'

D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Infrastructure about press reports that the labour inspectorate did not inspect physical workload at Schiphol baggage handling for twelve years and that many workers became incapacitated. The government answered that employers bear primary responsibility, the Inspectorate has started an investigation and will report on its past inspections at Schiphol, and it committed to talks with Schiphol and KLM and to a site visit in November.
Following the press reports, the Labour Inspectorate has meanwhile started an investigation into the situation of baggage staff at Schiphol.
De Arbeidsinspectie is, naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving, inmiddels een onderzoek gestart naar de situatie bij het bagagepersoneel op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de dreigende overschrijding van handhavingspunten op Rotterdam The Hague Airport

MP Boucke (D66) asked how a possible exceedance of noise enforcement points at Rotterdam The Hague Airport would affect commercial, police and trauma helicopter flights, and whether emergency services should get a separate noise allowance. Minister Harbers answered that the airport and its users must keep flights within limits, that a separate allowance for emergency and police flights is not yet legally possible but is planned in the Luchthavenbesluit, and that the effects of restrictions on trauma and police helicopters cannot yet be stated.
There is no decision: as indicated in the letter of 12 September, creating a separate noise allowance for emergency medical services and police tasks is currently not legally possible.

Er is geen sprake van een besluit: zoals in de brief van 12 september jl. aangegeven, is het creëren van een aparte gebruiksruimte voor geluid voor spoedeisende hulpverlening en politietaken op dit moment juridisch niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht ’Minder vluchten en toch nieuwbouw’

An MP asked the minister whether Schiphol's plans for a new Terminal Zuid, a tender consultation, signal growth despite the 440,000 flight movement cap, and questioned the scrapping of staff summer bonuses, stikstof permits and any growth ambitions. The minister answered that no investment decision has been taken, that the tender was a market consultation, that the need for the terminal will be reassessed after the cap, and that the cap will be anchored through further steps.
Should Schiphol want to invest in a new terminal, the planned investment decision will have to be approved by Schiphol's shareholders, because it is a large investment.

Mocht Schiphol willen investeren in een nieuwe terminal dan zal het voorgenomen investeringsbesluit moeten worden goedgekeurd door de aandeelhouders van Schiphol, omdat het om een grote investering gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de 'Hoofdlijnenbrief Schiphol' van 24 juni 2022

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the 24 June 2022 Schiphol main-lines letter, questioning the abandonment of a legally fixed maximum of flight movements, the number of night flights, the legal basis for the new capacity regime, and individual legal protection of residents. The minister answered that a 440,000 movement cap will be fixed in an amended Luchthavenverkeerbesluit, anticipatory enforcement will end, night flights will fall to 29,000, and that a study of residents' legal protection and a proposal to bring LVB appeals before the administrative court are planned.
The new maximum of 440,000 aircraft movements will be laid down in an amendment to the Schiphol Airport Traffic Decree (LVB).
Het nieuwe maximum van 440.000 vliegtuigbewegingen wordt vastgelegd in een wijziging van het Luchthavenverkeerbesluit (LVB) Schiphol.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over de aangenomen motie-Hagen c.s., het artikel ‘Kankerverwekkende stof chroom-6 aangetroffen in grond Tata Steel’ en de intentieverklaring ‘Afspraken met Tata Steel Neder

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked the government about the timeline, binding nature, monitoring, financing and emissions targets of the Expression of Principles with Tata Steel Nederland, and about carcinogenic chromium-6 found in soil at the site. The minister answered that the EoP is non-binding but guides negotiations toward a binding agreement, that no public funds are yet attached, that further investigation into chromium-6 has been commissioned by the regional environmental service, and that some answers depend on ongoing procedures or are the responsibility of other bodies.
First an attempt will be made to reach more concrete and binding agreements between the parties.
Eerst zal geprobeerd worden om te komen tot concretere en bindende afspraken tussen partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Rusland knijpt ook gaskraan naar Duitsland af, olieprijs naar 125 dollar per vat'

MPs Boucke and Boulakjar asked whether Gazprom's reduced gas deliveries to Germany via Nord Stream 1 were political, how long the reduction would last, and what it meant for Dutch gas storage and LNG supply after the Freeport explosion. The minister confirmed the reduction, said the July maintenance was planned, noted that Germany's supply security was not yet affected and that Dutch storage filling was proceeding, and declined to disclose confidential commercial contracts while pointing to the fully contracted Eemshaven LNG terminal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over het artikel 'Op de banenmarkt van Schiphol voelen werkzoekenden zich ‘heel speciaal’ – mits ze uit Nederland komen'

MPs from D66 asked the ministers whether the government shares a newspaper's claim that only people resident in the Netherlands for eight years can obtain a security clearance (VGB) for Schiphol jobs, and how employers' misconceptions could be addressed. The minister denies any legal eight-year rule, explains that the Wvo has no nationality or residence requirement but foreign stays can lengthen screening, and promises to raise the issue with Schiphol and employers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Boulakjar en Podt over het bericht ‘Vluchteling mag wel in herrie’

MPs Boucke, Boulakjar and Podt asked why student housing is blocked near Schiphol under the LIB noise rules while refugee housing at Kronenburg is allowed, and about the duration, permit (vvgb) and planned LIB revisions. The minister replied that temporary stays up to six months are exempt from LIB rules, longer stays need a vvgb which the ILT is assessing, and a LIB revision decision is targeted for year-end.
The ILT will assess whether a vvgb can be issued.
De ILT zal beoordelen of een vvgb kan worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over de veiligheid van maritieme en energie gerelateerde activiteiten op de Noordzee

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about safety measures around offshore wind farms for shipping and energy supply, including ship collisions, risks to energy supply, and innovative solutions. The minister outlined existing and planned measures (ERTVs, Kustwacht oversight, MOSWOZ research, Programma Noordzee 2022-2027), said a full wind-farm outage is unlikely and that no specific scenarios or new integral study are planned, while committing to further collision-consequence research with results expected in 2023.
A follow-up study is underway. The next interim results are expected in the first half of 2023.
Een vervolgonderzoek loopt. De eerstvolgende tussenresultaten worden in de eerste helft van 2023 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Consument krijgt te weinig voor teruggeleverde stroom'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether energy suppliers pay too little for electricity fed back by households with solar panels, and whether a minimum compensation should be set. The minister answered that the ACM is responsible for judging reasonableness, but announced a legal basis to set a minimum compensation at 80% of the supply tariff via general administrative order, included in the Energy Act proposal.
See the answer to question 6 for this.
Zie hiervoor het antwoord op vraag 6.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden  Boucke en Wuite over het bericht 'Bedrijven en instellingen werken samen om in 2030 elektrisch vliegen mogelijk te maken'

MPs Boucke and Wuite asked the minister about government support for the Electric Flying Collective, funding and instruments for electric aviation, the Clean Aviation programme, the Caribbean roadmaps, and sustainability of Winair. The minister answered that the ministry supports the collective only through dialogue and existing schemes, and gave substantive but largely policy-restating replies with several commitments to further talks and exploration.
At present the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management provides no direct financial support to this initiative and there is no request for it.
Op dit moment verleent het Ministerie van IenW geen rechtstreekse financiële ondersteuning aan dit initiatief en er ligt hier ook geen verzoek voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de situatie op Schiphol

An MP asked the minister about staffing shortages at Schiphol, reported requests to airlines to limit departing passengers, cancelled flights, passenger rights, and security staff conditions. The minister answered that Schiphol asked airlines to reduce passenger numbers rather than cancel flights, that cancellation data is not yet available, and described recruitment efforts and security contractors' wages.
Schiphol cannot yet answer that question because it has no visibility into how many flights airlines themselves cancelled.
Schiphol kan die vraag nu nog niet beantwoorden omdat ze geen zicht heeft op hoeveel vluchten door luchtvaartmaatschappijen zelf zijn geannuleerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Boucke over maatwerkafspraken voor woningbouw

MPs Boulakjar and Boucke asked about maintenance-style exceptions (maatwerk) allowing housing near Schiphol under the airport zoning decree (LIB), the student housing at Kronenburg, and whether a revised LIB should follow the new noise and enforcement rules. The minister answered that only a limited number of exemptions have been granted, that a revised LIB will follow the pending LVB change and could free some land for housing, and that talks with the regional authority are ongoing.
In the LIB 4 area the noise exposure is such that caution must be exercised when adding housing.
In het LIB 4 gebied is de geluidbelasting dusdanig dat er terughoudend moet worden omgegaan met het toevoegen van woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Wuite, Van Raan en Wassenberg over de uitzending van Zembla 'Bedreigd Nederlands Koraal' van 17 februari 222

MPs Boucke, Wuite, Van Raan and Wassenberg asked about a Zembla broadcast on threats to Bonaire's coral reef, including a planned oil pier, BBT's sustainability mandate and the 40 million euro WEB green-energy request. The minister answers that no new pier is currently planned, that 10 million euro was invested in BBT for the energy transition, and that a transition roadmap for the Caribbean Netherlands will follow before summer.
To avoid influencing the tender for the construction, some data remain confidential.
Om de aanbesteding van de bouw niet te beïnvloeden, blijven sommige gegevens vertrouwelijk.
