Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Boucke over het bericht dat de roestende olietanker FSO Safer voor de kust van Jemen kan leiden tot één van de grootste olierampen in de geschiedenis

MPs Hammelburg and Boucke asked about the deteriorating FSO Safer oil tanker off Yemen, including the Dutch funding for an inspection mission, UN negotiations with the Houthis, available Dutch expertise, liability, and further contributions. The minister answered that the Netherlands is working with the UN and partners, that the earlier USD 1.686 million project was halted due to lack of Houthi cooperation with only 161,000 USD spent, and that further support depends on a new UN project plan.
At the end of 2020 the Netherlands made USD 1.686 million available for an earlier UN-led project aimed at an inspection and light maintenance mission.
Nederland heeft eind 2020 een bedrag van USD 1,686 miljoen beschikbaar gesteld ten behoeve van een eerder door de VN geleid project met als doel een inspectie- en lichte onderhoudsmissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Boucke over het bericht ‘Groot-Brittannië doet Aeroflot in de ban als gevolg van Russische agressie’

MPs Boucke and Sjoerdsma asked whether Britain closed its airspace to Aeroflot, how many Russian airlines fly from Dutch airports, whether the Netherlands will investigate an EU-level ban, and whether Dutch airlines still fly over Russia. The minister confirmed the UK closure, said no Russian airlines currently fly from Dutch airports due to the EU airspace closure, and said Dutch airlines no longer fly over Russia because Russia banned them.
Due to the current closure of European airspace to Russian airlines, no Russian airlines fly from Dutch airports.
Door de huidige sluiting van het Europese luchtruim voor Russische luchtvaartmaatschappijen vliegen er geen Russische luchtvaartmaatschappijen op Nederlandse luchthavens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Boucke over het bericht dat Rusland BUK-afweersystemen bij de grens met Oekraïne plaatst

Two D66 MPs asked the government about reports that Russia placed BUK and S-300/S-400 air defence systems near the Ukrainian border and what this means for civil aviation safety, including IFALPA and ECA warnings and recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board on airspace closure criteria. The ministers answered that monitoring continues, that KLM and other airlines suspended Ukraine flights, that Dutch airspace-closure powers for airlines face legal and practical objections, and that the government is working on international criteria.
Dutch airlines did not fly there.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over de verdere stappen in het project over de aanlanding van de Kabel Ten noorden van de Waddeneilanden (TNW)

Two D66 MPs asked the minister about the next steps for the cable landing of Net op Zee Ten noorden van de Waddeneilanden, including routes through the Ems and the Westerschelde precedent for stability and maintenance. The minister answered that a stable route is preferred, that an eastern Ems route will be examined in the new programme, and that the route under the shipping channel will be included in the study, pending contact with German authorities.
I intend to include the route variant under the shipping channel in the study.
Ik ben voornemens de routevariant onder de vaargeul op te nemen in het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Boucke over het artikel 'Bonaire krijgt een E-Flight Academy voor elektrisch vliegen'

MPs Wuite and Boucke (D66) asked about a plan for an electric flight academy on Bonaire, the outcomes of a student challenge, the masterplan for electric aviation in the Caribbean, public service obligations on inter-island routes, and exclusion of Caribbean Netherlands from electric vehicle and energy subsidies. The minister answered most questions substantively, noting the masterplan, the challenge winners, a forthcoming exploration of public service obligations in the autumn, and that subsidy questions fall under the climate and energy minister.
Following this evaluation, the possibility is being explored of using the public service obligation instrument to better safeguard accessibility of this part of the Netherlands.

Naar aanleiding van deze evaluatie wordt de mogelijkheid verkend om het instrument van de openbaredienstverplichting in te zetten teneinde de bereikbaarheid van dit deel van Nederland beter te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Luchtvaartonderzoek houdt vliegherrie buiten beeld, waarschuwt GGD'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the aviation cost-benefit guidance should adopt the WHO noise thresholds and monetise noise as the UK does, after GGD criticism. The minister defended the guidance as an independently prepared first version, promised further research and a second opinion for state-involved analyses, and committed to updating the guidance later.

Yes, as the guidance states, when an MKBA is drawn up for an airport (traffic) decision for Schiphol and airports of national significance, for which central government is the competent authority, the ministry should commission a second opinion.

Ja, zoals ook in de werkwijzer staat aangegeven is het gewenst dat indien een MKBA wordt opgesteld ten behoeve van een luchthaven(verkeer)besluit voor Schiphol en de luchthavens van nationale betekenis (waarvoor het Rijk het bevoegd gezag is) het ministerie een second opinion laat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Boucke over het artikel 'Anode Energie vraagt faillissement aan vanwege energieprijzen'

MPs Erkens and Boucke asked about the bankruptcy of Anode Energie and other energy suppliers, consumer losses, supplier protection, licensing by the ACM, and possible stress tests. The minister said about 160,000 customers were affected, outlined a study into stricter financial requirements and consumer protection, and announced Energiewet changes such as VOG screening and Bibob checks.

At this moment I am conducting a study into whether it is desirable and possible to set further requirements for the legal framework and, if so, which requirements best achieve the aim and are workable for both energy suppliers and the ACM.

Op dit moment doe ik een onderzoek naar de vraag of het wenselijk en mogelijk is om nadere eisen te stellen aan het wettelijke kader en zo ja, welke eisen het doel het beste bereiken en goed uitvoerbaar zijn voor zowel energieleveranciers als de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Opnieuw stormloop op SNN-subsidie, wachttijd loopt op tot enkele uren'

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about reports of a rush for the SNN housing improvement subsidy in Groningen, with waiting times of several hours, and whether this could create inequality or arbitrariness. The state secretary said extra budget will be made available so all eligible Groningers can apply, and that applications are processed in order of arrival.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Boucke over het artikel 'Warmtewet laat nog minstens een jaar op zich wachten’

Two MPs asked the minister for Climate and Energy about press reports that the heat law delay means heat tariffs, tied to gas prices, are rising sharply, and what the government will do about consumer protection and market power. The minister acknowledges that the gas-linked maximum tariff has risen, says a new law moving to cost-based tariffs is being prepared for submission by end 2022, and points to new ACM powers to examine individual suppliers' returns.
To offset the effects of the rise in energy bills, measures were taken at the end of last year that also apply to heat customers.
Om de effecten van de stijging van de energierekening te compenseren zijn eind vorig jaar maatregelen getroffen die ook voor warmte-afnemers gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Mogelijk grote rol voor zonne-energie op de Noordzee'

An MP asked the government about TNO research and pilots for solar energy on the North Sea, its alignment with the Routekaart Zon op water, ecological effects and possible tenders combining wind and solar. The government answered that ecological effects are not yet known, that only small pilots exist, that NWO research and monitoring are planned, and that it will discuss the matter in the Noordzeeoverleg.
There is still much unknown about the ecological effects of solar energy on water.
Er is nog veel onbekend over de ecologische effecten van zon op water.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over het bericht 'Risico’s gaswinning onder Waddenzee vanuit Ternaard onvoldoende onderzocht'

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Boucke (D66) asked the minister about reports that the environmental impact assessment for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea from Ternaard was incomplete, and whether a permit could lawfully be granted, including compensation and UNESCO/IUCN issues. The minister answered that the NAM was asked to supplement the MER, that the advice and objections will be weighed before a decision expected in March 2022, and that no new IUCN advice is needed, but she declined to pre-judge the permit decision or any compensation liability.
Following the advice of the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment (m.e.r.), the previous Minister of EZK and my predecessor asked the NAM to supplement the Environmental Impact Report (MER)

Naar aanleiding van het advies van de Commissie voor de milieueffectrapportage (m.e.r.) hebben de vorige Minister van EZK en mijn voorganger de NAM verzocht om de Milieueffectrapportage (MER) aan te vullen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Bontenbal, Erkens en Grinwis over de stijgende gasprijzen

MPs from D66, CDA, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about rising gas and energy prices, including household exposure, the causes, the Hermans motion funds, and whether France-style price freezes or targeted support should be used. The government answered that most households face higher bills, outlined temporary energy tax reductions for 2022 and a 150 million euro scheme for vulnerable households via municipalities, and rejected price regulation as market-distorting.
This therefore requires an individual assessment of the situation of all households. That information is not available.
Dit vergt dus een individuele beoordeling van de situatie van alle huishoudens. Die informatie is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Tjeerd de Groot over de campagne “Iedereen doet Wat”

MPs Boucke and De Groot ask why reducing meat consumption was dropped from the 'Iedereen doet wat' climate campaign despite internal documents treating it as low-threshold, and why flying less is omitted, and who is responsible among ministries. The state secretary answers by pointing to the campaign's positive-behaviour-change approach and the ministries' shared responsibility, without fully explaining the March 2019 decision or the ministry's arguments for dropping the measure.
Can you answer these questions separately?
Vraag 13 Kunt u deze vragen los beantwoorden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over het bericht 'Milieuorganisaties vrezen dat nieuwe gasboringen oesterbank bij ‘Schier’ vernielen'

MPs De Groot and Boucke asked whether planned gas drilling north of Schier could damage an oyster restoration project and how this fits the North Sea Agreement and Natura 2000 rules. The minister answers that extensive assessments found no significant harm, that permits contain safeguards, and that definitive decision-making follows after objections are processed.
The concerns of the environmental organisations were raised in consultation responses. The consultation responses and advice will be taken into account in the definitive decision-making.
De zorgen van de milieuorganisaties zijn naar voren gebracht in inspraakreacties. De inspraakreacties en adviezen worden meegenomen bij de definitieve besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Boucke over het bericht dat greenwashing bedrijven dreigt door de lage prijs voor CO2-compensatie

Two MPs from D66 asked the government about reports that cheap old carbon offset credits make greenwashing likely, and whether the voluntary offset market needs independent oversight. The State Secretary acknowledged surplus old credits and average prices below real abatement costs, but said the government does not regulate the voluntary market, referring consumer misleading-claims issues to the ACM and committing only to a letter to the European Commission.
Current average prices are not made public.
De actuele gemiddelde prijzen worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'De wereld heeft veel meer grondstoffen nodig om de klimaatdoelen te halen'

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers how the Netherlands is raising raw material supply for the energy transition in a clean, recycling-focused way, and how it responds to an IEA report on critical minerals. The government answered that it works through EU critical materials and circular economy plans, a circular manufacturing transition agenda, and innovation programmes, without committing to new concrete measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over de oproep uit Suriname om hulp te bieden met vaccineren

MPs from D66 and the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about Suriname's request for vaccination help amid a COVID-19 surge and the Indian export ban. The minister answered that Nederland has responded with oxygen containers, medical supplies, 90,000 AstraZeneca doses and a planned 500,000 to 750,000 doses, sent a special envoy, and donated EUR 70 million to COVAX.
The Netherlands has also committed that from week 25, provided supplies allow, vaccines will be delivered to Suriname.
Nederland heeft tevens toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over het aanbod van het Diaspora Medisch Team Nederland om steun aan het vaccinatieprogramma in Suriname te faciliteren

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about the Diaspora Medical Team's offer to support Suriname's vaccination programme, whether the minister had contacted Suriname's health minister, and whether vaccines would be supplied. The minister replied that talks with Suriname's health minister had taken place, that 90,000 AstraZeneca doses were sent with further deliveries promised from week 25, and that a coordinator was deployed to match Surinamese needs with Dutch medical staff offers.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has committed that from week 25, provided deliveries allow it, vaccines will be supplied to Suriname.
Verder heeft Nederland toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Paternotte, Hagen, Boucke, Grinwis en Ceder over niet-EU-familieleden van expats, die geen toegang hebben tot Nederland

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked whether non-EU family members of expats and residents are barred from entering the Netherlands under the EU entry ban and Dutch flight bans, whether this breaches Article 8 ECHR, and whether exceptions can be made for Suriname and other regions. The government answered that family of Dutch residents with residence permits are exempt, that individual exceptions exist for urgent family reasons, that the flight bans were lifted on 1 June 2021, and that generic exceptions for first- and second-degree relatives were not desirable.
The cabinet notes that the right to private and family life in Article 8 ECHR does not constitute an absolute right of access to the Netherlands.
Daarbij merkt het kabinet op dat het in artikel 8 EVRM opgenomen recht op privé en familieleven geen absoluut recht tot toegang tot Nederland behelst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Diederik Samsom: Nederland laat miljarden aan subsidies liggen voor energietransitie'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the Netherlands is leaving billions in EU recovery subsidies unclaimed, the delayed Recovery and Resilience Plan, and the government's position on hydrogen in mobility and home heating. The Minister replied that the plan is deliberately left for the next cabinet to decide, that about 6 billion euro is expected to be claimed without loss if submitted by summer 2022, and that hydrogen's role is still being explored through pilots.
As communicated in the same letter, the caretaker cabinet has commissioned an official exploration of the possible content of a Dutch recovery plan.
Zoals gecommuniceerd in dezelfde brief, heeft het demissionaire kabinet opdracht gegeven tot een ambtelijke verkenning naar de mogelijke inhoud van een Nederlands herstelplan.

m: Amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 36 over middelen voor renovaties en extra plaatsen in het gevangeniswezen
Amendment adds 25 million euro in 2025 to the prison system budget, funded by shifting money reserved for a constitutional court, with the reserved funds partly kept for the Council of State.
The funding for this amendment is found in the funds reserved for a constitutional court
De dekking voor dit amendement wordt gevonden in de middelen gereserveerd voor een constitutioneel hof
Amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 37 over middelen voor renovaties en extra plaatsen in het gevangeniswezen

Adds 25 million euro in 2025 to 2027 (rising to 75 million) for prisons by shifting funds reserved for a constitutional court and the Administrative Jurisdiction Division's independence, to prevent early release.
In article 34 Punishment and protection of the departmental budget, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 25,000 (x 1,000 euro).
In artikel 34 Straffen en beschermen van de departementale begrotingsstaat worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 25.000 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 38 over middelen voor renovaties en extra plaatsen in het gevangeniswezen

Moves 25 to 75 million euro from a reserved fund for a constitutional court and the independence of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State into the justice budget for prisons.
Part of the reserved funds will therefore be brought forward via a cash shift and transferred to the Justice and Security budget
Een deel van de gereserveerde middelen worden daarom middels een kasschuif naar voren gehaald en overgeheveld naar de begroting Justitie en Veiligheid
Motie van het lid Mutluer c.s. over uitspreken dat de Kamer onder bepaalde voorwaarden instemt met decharge voor de jaarverantwoording 2024 van JenV

Conditionally agrees to discharge (decharge) of the Ministry of Justice and Security's 2024 accountability report, conditional on concrete plans in the 2026 budget on case throughput information, implementation tests, victims' information, and correcting errors.
declares that the House agrees to discharge the 2024 accountability report of the Ministry of Justice and Security, on condition that
spreekt uit dat de Kamer instemt met decharge voor de jaarverantwoording 2024 van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, onder de voorwaarde
Motie van het lid Koops over verbetermogelijkheden bij de aanbesteding van tolkendiensten
Motion asking the government to investigate improvements to the tendering of interpreter services in legal proceedings, given signs of conflicts of interest, and report to the House by 1 October.
requests the government to conduct research into improvement options in the tendering of interpreter services
verzoekt de regering om onderzoek te doen naar verbetermogelijkheden bij de aanbesteding van tolkendiensten
Motie van de leden Van Nispen en Koops over een proef met een sociaal notariaat
Asks the government to consult the Royal Dutch Notarial Professional Organisation about piloting a social notary service in one or a few places, such as a Huis van het Recht.
requests the government to consult the Royal Dutch Notarial Professional Organisation to see whether it can pilot a social notary service in one or a few places in the country

verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met de Koninklijke Notariële Beroepsorganisatie om te bezien of de beroepsorganisatie op een of enkele plaatsen in het land een proef kan uitvoeren met een sociaal notariaat
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Koops ter vervanging van nr. 49 over het meteen motiveren in het eindvonnis als is afgeweken van een uitdrukkelijk voorgedragen standpunt
Requires the criminal judge to give reasons in the original judgment when departing from an expressly argued position, rather than later in a supplementary judgment, for all cases.
the judge must give reasons in the original judgment and not in the supplement to the judgment
dit moet motiveren in het oorspronkelijke vonnis en niet in de aanvulling op het vonnis
Motie van het lid Koops over lessen trekken uit het experiment met de zaaksgebonden strafrechter en gerechtsjurist
Asks the government to consult the judiciary council on lessons from the Rotterdam experiment with case-bound judges and clerks and to adopt it nationally if the results are positive.
requests the government to consult the Judiciary Council to see which lessons can be drawn from this experiment
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met de Raad voor de rechtspraak om te kijken welke lessen uit dit experiment kunnen worden getrokken
Motie van het lid Koops over betere informatieverstrekking door het OM aan ontvangers van een strafbeschikking

Asks the government to work with the Public Prosecution Service so that written information sent with a penal order states clearly, prominently and understandably the recipient's rights and the consequences of accepting it.
explicitly and in the most understandable way contains what the rights and position of the person concerned are and what the consequences are if the person accepts the penal order
expliciet en op de meest begrijpelijke wijze gaat bevatten wat de rechten en positie van de betrokkene zijn en wat de gevolgen zijn als de betrokkene de strafbeschikking aanvaardt
Motie van het lid Koops over geen strafbeschikking uitvaardigen in gevallen waarin een taakstrafverbod geldt
Asks the government to legislate that no criminal penalty order may be issued where a community-service prohibition applies, so prosecutors cannot avoid the prison-sentence rule.
requests the government to legally anchor through the second supplementary act that no penalty order may be issued in cases where a community-service prohibition applies
verzoekt de regering via de tweede aanvullingswet wettelijk te verankeren dat er geen strafbeschikking mag worden uitgevaardigd in gevallen waarin een taakstrafverbod geldt
Amendement van het lid Koops over Het verlengen van de termijn voor het instellen van hoger beroep naar drie maanden
Extends the deadline for lodging an appeal (hoger beroep) from two weeks to three months.
In article 5.4.2, 'two weeks' is replaced each time by 'three months'.
In artikel 5.4.2 wordt «twee weken» telkens vervangen door «drie maanden».
Amendement van het lid Koops over het verlengen van de termijn voor het instellen van verzet tegen een strafbeschikking naar zes weken
Extends the period to object to a penal order (strafbeschikking) from two weeks to six weeks.
the words 'two weeks' are replaced by 'six weeks'
Amendement van het lid Koops over het meteen motiveren in het eindvonnis als is afgeweken van een uitdrukkelijk voorgedragen standpunt
Requires criminal courts to give reasons in the original judgment when departing from an expressly argued defence position, instead of in a later supplement.
The final judgment also states the reasoning facts or circumstances from the evidence, or the evidence, that led to departing from expressly argued positions.

Het eindvonnis vermeldt tevens een weergave van de uit de bewijsmiddelen blijkende redengevende feiten of omstandigheden dan wel een opgave van de bewijsmiddelen die tot afwijken van uitdrukkelijk voorgedragen standpunten hebben geleid.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Koops ter vervanging van nr. 22 over het introduceren van de bevoegdheid een bestuurlijke boete op te leggen
Gives the minister power to impose administrative fines on government bodies violating the Archives Act, and extends enforcement tools of the supervisor.
Our Minister may impose an administrative fine on a responsible government body that does not comply with this Act.
Onze Minister kan een verantwoordelijk overheidsorgaan als bedoeld in het eerste lid, dat niet voldoet aan het bepaalde bij of krachtens deze wet, een bestuurlijke boete opleggen.
Amendement van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over het schrappen van de beperkingsgrond bescherming van het milieu
Deletes the environmental ground for restricting public access to government documents, widening access to information about the executive.
In Article 7.2, second paragraph, subsection g is deleted.
In artikel 7.2, tweede lid, vervalt onderdeel g.
Amendement van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Koops ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het introduceren van de bevoegdheid een bestuurlijke boete op te leggen
Gives the minister power to impose administrative fines up to the fifth category on responsible government bodies for Archives Act violations, excluding the listed decentralised bodies.
Our Minister may impose an administrative fine of at most the fifth category on a responsible government body
Onze Minister kan een verantwoordelijk overheidsorgaan een bestuurlijke boete opleggen van ten hoogste de vijfde categorie
Amendement van het lid Koops over het verduidelijken van de aanduiding voorzitter
Clarifies in the Code of Criminal Procedure that the 'voorzitter' with case-management powers is the chair of the chamber that will hear the case on its merits.
Where powers related to directing the investigation are granted to the chair, 'voorzitter' means the chair of the chamber that will substantively hear the case.

Onder voorzitter wordt daar waar aan hem bevoegdheden worden toegekend die verbandhouden met de regievoering over het onderzoek verstaan de voorzitter van de kamer die de zaak inhoudelijk zal behandelen.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koops over het krantenartikel 'Hoe minister Yeşilgöz in 2022 KPMG inschakelde en interne juristen omzeild werden in de crisis rond Ter Apel'

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a newspaper report that KPMG was hired in 2022 and that the legal directorate DWJZ was bypassed in the Ter Apel asylum crisis, questioning whether the letter of 26 August 2022 and proposed measures were properly prepared and legally sound. The government answers that DWJZ was not involved in drafting the letter due to the speed of the process but had regular contact, denies that Parliament was misinformed, explains KPMG's role was limited to process support on a measures list, and provides the requested documents.
Due to the speed of the process, DWJZ was not involved in drafting the letter of 26 August 2022.
In de snelheid van het proces is DWJZ niet betrokken geweest bij het opstellen van de brief van 26 augustus 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Lahlah, Sneller en Koops over het bericht dat justitiepersoneel bekneld raakt door de doorgeslagen verzuimaanpak van Detentiecentrum Rotterdam

MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that a harsh sick-leave policy at Detentiecentrum Rotterdam pressures staff, blocks access to occupational doctors and may breach good employer rules. The State Secretary denied the policy is structural or that absenteeism there is significantly above the DJI average, acknowledged an incidental misapplication, and declined a separate investigation while noting ongoing verzuim monitoring.
However, this does not concern a structural practice or standing policy.
Het gaat hier echter niet om een structurele werkwijze of staand beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over het RSJ-advies over het stemrecht van gedetineerden

MPs Van Nispen and Koops asked about the RSJ advice on voting rights for detained persons, noting that practical obstacles cause many votes to be lost and asking what can be improved before the next election. Staatssecretaris Rutte answered that voting by proxy is the statutory route, that DJI will implement several measures including clearer information, proxy forms, a pilot mobile polling station and access to voting aids, and that the RSJ recommendations are adopted where feasible and legally possible.
Where feasible and legally possible, the RSJ recommendations are therefore adopted.
Waar uitvoerbaar en juridisch mogelijk, worden de aanbevelingen van de RSJ daarom overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah, van Nispen, Boswijk, Koops en Bruyning over het uitblijven van investeringen voor het gevangeniswezen

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the 2025 spring budget omitted funds for prisons, whether the 23 million euro withdrawal from DJI's equity amounts to a cut, and what the consequences are for staff, early release, unexecuted sentences and pardon requests. The State Secretary confirmed no extra funds were allocated, explained the withdrawal as a legal requirement used to cover other justice costs, and warned of a growing capacity shortfall of around 800 places by 2030, while answering the timing question late.
Without additional investments I cannot realise structural capacity expansions and many necessary renovations cannot be carried out.
Zonder aanvullende investeringen kan ik geen structurele capaciteitsuitbreidingen realiseren en kunnen veel van de noodzakelijke renovaties niet uitgevoerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koops over het bericht ‘Pijnlijke balans na een jaar vol rapporten: toeslagenouders krijgen hun kinderen er niet mee terug’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the 'Regie bij de ouders' pilot, a contra-expertise initiative for affected parents, its funding, delayed evaluation, a court ruling on a commissioned report, and the stalled half-year reassessment of out-of-home placements. The State Secretary confirms the pilot's structure and up to two million euro budget, says no update was given because of delays, declines to disclose the cost of a specific study for privacy reasons, and points to a forthcoming policy response and an evaluation to be sent to parliament.
I therefore cannot provide you with this information.
Ik kan u deze gegevens daarom niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koops over het bericht ‘Daders lopen mogelijk vrij rond door fout met naam in 867 zaken’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that 867 criminal cases may contain wrong identity records, including 141 serious cases, and whether convicted persons were wrongly punished. The state secretary answered that an analysis is ongoing, one innocent person was wrongly flagged, and an action plan and evaluation will follow.
This is being investigated. The first analysis of the 141 more serious cases showed that 1 innocent citizen was wrongly flagged due to identity mix-up.
Dit wordt onderzocht. Uit de eerste analyse van de 141 zwaardere zaken is gebleken dat er 1 onschuldige burger gesignaleerd stond door persoonsverwisseling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Michon-Derkzen en Koops over de omgang met een informant van de politie

MPs asked the Justice Minister about a police informant who was detained and could not defend himself after being prosecuted, and whether compensation or legal gaps should be addressed. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, citing the need to protect informant identities, and said existing rules adequately cover informants, so no legal gap is seen.
As Minister, I do not comment on individual cases or on matters concerning whether persons work or have worked as informants for the police and judicial authorities.
Als Minister ga ik niet in op individuele zaken en op zaken die zien op de vraag of personen als informant voor politie en justitie werken of in het verleden hebben gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Korte en Koops over bijdrage aan Anti Corruptie Rechtbank Oekraïne

Two MPs asked whether the Dutch government's refusal to fund the selection committee for Ukraine's High Anti-Corruption Court, after US funding was withdrawn, conflicts with its constitutional and treaty duties to support the international legal order and anti-corruption. The minister answered that the committee was never Dutch-funded, that other donors covered the gap, that Nederland supports anti-corruption in Ukraine, and that it is assessing the impact of the US funding freeze.
Nederland is currently assessing, together with other countries, the exact consequences of the freeze or termination of American aid, in the short and longer term.
Momenteel inventariseert Nederland in samenwerking met andere landen welke gevolgen de bevriezing dan wel stopzetting van Amerikaans hulp precies heeft, op de korte en langere termijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koops, Omtzigt en Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Gewijzigd beleid van het Openbaar Ministerie rondom strafbeschikkingen, waardoor bijvoorbeeld veelplegers en asielzoekers standaard een str

Three MPs asked the Justice and Asylum ministers about the Public Prosecution Service's expanded use of penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen), which could mean repeat offenders and asylum seekers receive fines or community service instead of prison and no longer go before a judge. The minister answers that the OM acts independently, that the expansion aims to shorten case times and cover offences up to six years, that cases can still be referred to court, and that the data requested is not registered or is forthcoming later.
The OM will clarify the passage in the instruction at the next amendment or following instruction on this point.
Het OM zal de passage in de instructie bij een eerstvolgende wijziging of volgende instructie op dit punt verhelderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koops en Bruyning over de rijdende rechter

MPs Koops and Bruyning asked the State Secretary of Justice whether ending funding for the Zeeland 'rijdende rechter' pilot by Samen Recht Vinden would undermine access to justice and court workload goals. The State Secretary replied that the organisation only received temporary project subsidies under the legal aid renewal programme, never structural funding, but that he would favourably consider a one-time bridging contribution for 2025 and that a regional legal aid network coordinator would be appointed by summer 2025.
At present I am awaiting a subsidy application from Samen Recht Vinden, on the basis of which I will kindly consider whether to grant a one-time bridging contribution in 2025.
Momenteel ben ik in afwachting van een subsidieaanvraag van Samen Recht Vinden naar aanleiding waarvan ik welwillend zal bezien of ik in 2025 nog éénmaal een overbruggingsbijdrage toe zal kennen.

m: Motie van het lid Van Meetelen over de wijzigingen in de Internationale Gezondheidsregeling verwerpen
Asks the government to reject the 2022 amendments to the International Health Regulations, citing shortened national parliamentary review and rejection periods and risks to democratic control.
requests the government to reject the amendments to the International Health Regulations (2005) adopted in Geneva on 28 May 2022
verzoekt de regering de op 28 mei 2022 te Genève aangenomen wijzigingen van de Internationale Gezondheidsregeling (2005) te verwerpen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schilder en Van Meetelen over het bericht 'Uit huis geplaatste kinderen uit Noord-Nederland jarenlang ernstig mishandeld'

MPs Schilder and Van Meetelen asked the government about abuse of children placed in a Northern Netherlands foster home, possible supervisory failures, the William Schrikker Stichting's repeated involvement in serious incidents, and whether dismissal, prosecution and tougher sanctions would be introduced. The State Secretary answered that inspectorates are investigating and that enforcement and sanctions are for inspectorates, employers, the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declining to pre-empt the outcome and refusing new legislation on dismissal or prosecution.
We will inform your House about the outcomes of the investigation.
Wij zullen uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Van Meetelen over de rellen en racistische leuzen gericht naar kermisexploitanten in Emmeloord

MPs Van Meetelen and Faber-van de Klashorst asked about riots, vandalism and racist chants aimed at fairground operators in Emmeloord, including whether closing hours and costs should fall on the operators, and what prosecution follows. The Minister says municipalities are equipped to handle such disorder, leaves the local measures and prosecution to the mayor and Openbaar Ministerie, and notes that victims can pursue civil claims or request partial restitution of the pitch fee.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide how it follows up on this.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen hoe zij hier opvolging aan geven.

m: Motie-Driessen c.s. over de vertrekpremie van de directeur
Asks the government to deduct the €134,600 severance paid by SNV to its former director from SNV's subsidy.
requests the government to deduct the said amount from the subsidy for SNV
verzoekt de regering voornoemd bedrag op de subsidie voor SNV in mindering te brengen
Motie-Irrgang/Driessen over de raad van toezicht
Asks the government to press the NGO SNV to strengthen its supervisory board's controlling role and replace the board entirely.
to strengthen the controlling role of the supervisory board and replace the current supervisory board entirely
de controlerende rol van de raad van toezicht te versterken en de huidige raad van toezicht in zijn geheel te vervangen
Motion asking the government not to grant SNV non-generic subsidies in future.
Requests the government not to make SNV eligible for non-generic subsidies in future.
verzoekt de regering SNV in de toekomst ook niet meer in aanmerking te laten komen voor niet-generieke subsidies
Motie Driessen over geen cent aan het Global Fund
Asks the government to give no money to the Global Fund.
requests the government to give not a cent to the Global Fund
verzoekt de regering geen cent aan het Global Fund te geven
Motie-Driessen over stoppen subsidie aan ICCO
Asks the government to stop all subsidies to ICCO if it brings in more asylum seekers to the Netherlands.
requests the government to stop all subsidies to ICCO if ICCO brings more asylum seekers to the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering alle subsidies aan ICCO te stoppen indien ICCO nog meer asielzoekers naar Nederland haalt
Motie-Driessen over stoppen subsidie voor EU-ontwikkelingshulp
Asks the government to lobby within the EU for stopping all EU development aid.
requests the government to push hard within the European context for stopping all EU development aid
verzoekt de regering zich in Europees verband hard te maken voor het stoppen van alle EU-ontwikkelingshulp
Motie-Driessen over subsidie en antisemitische organisaties
Asks the government to require development organisations not to pass subsidy funds to antisemitic organisations, under penalty of subsidy suspension.
requests the government to prohibit development organisations from channelling subsidy funds to antisemitic organisations, on pain of a subsidy suspension
verzoekt de regering ontwikkelingsorganisaties te verbieden subsidiegelden door te sluizen naar antisemitische organisaties op straffe van een subsidiestop
Motie-Driessen over stoppen ontwikkelingshulp aan Suriname
Asks the government to stop all development aid to Suriname except emergency aid.
requests the government, except for any emergency aid, to stop all development aid to Suriname
verzoekt de regering behoudens eventuele noodhulp, alle ontwikkelingshulp aan Suriname te stoppen
Asks the government to remove all OIC member states from the list of partner countries for development cooperation.
requests the government to remove all partner countries that are members of the OIC as partner countries
verzoekt de regering alle partnerlanden die lid zijn van de Organisatie van de Islamitische Conferentie (OIC) als partnerland te schrappen
Motie Driessen over geen nieuwe subsidies verstrekken aan ontwikkelingsorganisaties met meer dan drie directieleden
Asks the government not to grant new subsidies to development organisations with more than three directors.
requests the government not to grant new subsidies to development organisations with more than three directors
verzoekt de regering geen nieuwe subsidies te verstrekken aan ontwikkelingsorganisaties met meer dan drie directieleden
qa: Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen over kenniscentrum E-Quality en de afscheidsreceptie van zijn directeur

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about subsidies to knowledge centre E-Quality, the costs of a farewell reception for its director, and whether future subsidies should be stopped. The minister listed the subsidy amounts from 2007 to 2012 and said the reception costs were not yet known, and declined to end subsidies, citing the emancipation subsidy scheme.
The costs of the event are not known at this moment; what costs were involved will become clear in the accountability report.
De kosten van de bijeenkomst zijn op dit moment niet bekend; welke kosten hiermee gemoeid waren zal blijken bij de verantwoording.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Driessen over mogelijke verduistering van Nederlands ontwikkelingsgeld in Oeganda

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs whether Dutch development aid to Makerere University in Uganda was embezzled, whether an investigation would be launched, whether Nuffic gave money to a university official under police investigation, and whether all aid would stop if embezzlement were confirmed. The State Secretary answered that a Ugandan Auditor General investigation and a Nuffic investigation are underway, that Nuffic funds are not paid to individuals, and that if misuse is found legal steps and recovery of funds would follow.
I will inform the House as soon as possible about the outcomes of these investigations.
Ik zal de Kamer zo snel mogelijk informeren over de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Driessen en Van Vliet over bezoldiging van FMO’s bestuurders

MPs Driessen and Van Vliet asked about state ownership of development bank FMO, its capital base, and whether its executives' pay (directors earning up to 429,000 euro including pensions) fits a development organisation and should be subject to the Balkenende norm. The minister confirmed the state holds 51% and over 90% of equity is state-funded, explained that pay figures include pensions and that the CEO's fixed pay is now capped at 270,000 euro, and argued FMO operates as a market-facing bank so the public/market pay category applies, declining to apply the Balkenende norm or sell the shares.
The public interest is reflected in the way the state, as shareholder, acts on the remuneration policy, which must be sufficiently moderate.
Het publiek belang vindt zijn weerslag in de wijze waarop de staat als aandeelhouder acteert ten aanzien van het beloningsbeleid, dat voldoende gematigd moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Driessen over de '0,7-procentsnorm'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs whether the 0.7% development aid norm would be dropped, whether the cost of the #jekrijgtwatjegeeft campaign could be stated, and whether all development aid except emergency aid would be abolished. The government replied that the 0.7% norm is part of the coalition agreement, that no ministry funds went to the campaign run by Partos, and that it remains committed to development aid.
The 0.7 percent norm is the starting point of the coalition agreement.
De «0,7 procentnorm» is uitgangspunt van het regeerakkoord.
Antwoord vragen Driessen over de invoering van de sharia in Timboektoe

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he deplores the imposition of sharia on Timbuktu by Tuareg groups, whether sharia applies elsewhere in Mali, whether Ansar Dine has links to AQIM, and whether the government will explicitly condemn sharia in Mali internationally. The minister answered that the situation is unstable and worrying, that independent confirmation of sharia elsewhere in Mali cannot be given, that contacts between Ansar Dine and AQIM exist, and that developments are followed with concern internationally without an explicit condemnation.
Independent confirmation of the introduction of sharia in parts of Mali cannot be given.
Onafhankelijke bevestiging van invoering van de sharia in delen van Mali kan niet worden gegeven.
Antwoord vragen Driessen over het bericht dat de Sudanese president Bashir zegt dat in Sudan de geest van de jihad is opgeleefd

MP Driessen (PVV) asked the foreign minister whether she shares concern over Sudanese president Bashir's claim that the spirit of jihad has revived in Sudan and his talk of 'liberating' South Sudan, and whether Sudan's attacks on the South are part of jihad. Minister Rosenthal answered that the statement is an example of escalatory language and that the recent violence stems from unresolved issues of the Comprehensive Peace Agreement, without addressing the jihad framing directly.
The statement in question is an example of escalatory language.
De desbetreffende uitspraak is een voorbeeld van escalerend taalgebruik.
Antwoord vragen Driessen over radiospotjes van Oxfam Novib

An MP asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about recent Oxfam Novib radio spots, how often they aired this year and their total cost. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the spots, said he lacks the frequency and cost data because Oxfam Novib is an independent organisation accountable through its own annual report, and rejected the 'propaganda' characterisation.
I do not have this specific information. Oxfam Novib is an independent organisation that determines its own media and communications policy.
Over deze specifieke informatie beschik ik niet. Oxfam Novib is een eigenstandige organisatie die zelf haar media- en voorlichtingsbeleid bepaalt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Driessen over gesubsidieerde spookcursussen in de gemeente Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Amsterdam's subsidised courses, allegedly sometimes never held, and a related national subsidy to a board member's foundation were acceptable, and what measures would be taken. The minister replied that municipal subsidy decisions fall under local autonomy, that the municipal council handles accountability, and that the national government will not intervene.
It is not the task of the national government to interfere in this.
Het is niet de taak van het Rijk zich hierin te mengen
Antwoord vragen Driessen over het per direct stoppen van alle ontwikkelingshulp voor Suriname

An MP asked whether the government will immediately halt all development aid to Suriname after parliament passed an amnesty law, and asked for a reply before a set deadline. The state secretary said bilateral aid is being phased out and remaining treaty funds of about 20 million euros cannot simply be stopped, but suspension is under consideration and other programmes are being reviewed; he agreed to answer by the deadline.
Suspension is an option, which I am currently considering.
Opschorten is wel een optie, die ik momenteel in beraad heb.
Antwoord vragen Driessen over de besteding van provinciale subsidiegelden

Deputy Driessen (PVV) asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that four provinces spend about half their budgets on subsidies, that many subsidies are not evaluated or evaluated poorly, and whether the government will talk to the provinces about this. Minister Spies answered that provinces are autonomous and responsible for their own subsidies, that the provincial councils and local audit offices should hold the executive to account, and that the provinces will adopt the audit office's recommendations.
The provinces, as autonomous tiers of government, are themselves responsible for granting subsidies, and it is up to the local elected council to form a judgement on this.
De provincies zijn als autonome bestuurslaag zélf verantwoordelijk voor de verstrekking van subsidies en het is aan de lokale volksvertegenwoordiging om hier een oordeel over te vormen
Antwoord vragen Driessen en Tony van Dijck over de integriteit van Lodewijk de Waal

PVV MPs Driessen and Tony van Dijck asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs and the finance minister about the integrity of Lodewijk de Waal, a supervisory board member of SNV, over a 2010 Tanzania trip paid for by SNV. The government answered that the trip was SNV's own responsibility, that the costs (about 2,375 euro) were borne by SNV under normal practice, that it sees no reason to doubt the trip's legitimacy, and that it does not consider De Waal's integrity in question nor that he should step down from ING's supervisory board.
Decisions on working visits by members of its Supervisory Board are the responsibility of SNV itself.
Besluitvorming over werkbezoeken van leden van haar Raad van Toezicht is de verantwoordelijkheid van de SNV zelf.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over Julius Malema (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister and state secretary why Julius Malema, suspended from the ANC, was elected to the Limpopo provincial committee, and whether development aid to South Africa should end. The government answered that Malema's suspension is under appeal, the embassy will monitor it, aid will not be ended because Nederland works with the government rather than individual politicians, and the development relationship will be phased out as already announced.
The handling of the appeal against Malema's suspension will be closely monitored by the Dutch embassy.
De behandeling van het beroep tegen de schorsing van Malema zal door de Nederlandse ambassade nauwlettend worden gevolgd.
Vragen van de leden Bontes, Driessen en Van Klaveren (allen PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over een nieuwe Nigeriaanse anti-homowet (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a Nigerian Senate-passed anti-homosexuality law, a senator's call to kill homosexuals, the death penalty under sharia, and whether aid should be halted. The minister confirmed awareness, condemned the call to violence, explained that Nigeria receives no direct development relationship but Dutch and EU human-rights programmes continue, and argued that cutting aid would not help LGBT people.
The Netherlands does not maintain a development relationship with the Nigerian government.
Nederland onderhoudt geen ontwikkelingsrelatie met de Nigeriaanse overheid.
Vragen van de leden Driessen en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over ontwikkelingshulp aan de Islamitische Republiek Afghanistan (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about EU and Dutch aid to Afghanistan given corruption reports, and whether all aid should be ended. The government acknowledged corruption as a serious problem, said it would keep anti-corruption on the agenda, and refused to end aid, pointing to conditional post-2014 engagement and rule-of-law programmes.
Dutch support is however not unconditional.
Nederlandse steun is echter niet onvoorwaardelijk.

Vragen van de leden Driessen, Van Klaveren en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Zimbabwaanse dictator Mugabe die homo's erger dan varkens en honden noemt (ingezonden 29

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about Mugabe's remark that gay people are worse than pigs and dogs, about Dutch aid to Zimbabwe, and why the Netherlands sends funds there. The minister confirmed the remark, declined to qualify predecessors' statements, and said aid goes via civil society and NGOs to democratisation, LHBT rights and the poorest, with no direct funding to the government.
The Dutch government provides no direct financial support to the Zimbabwean government.
De Nederlandse regering geeft geen rechtstreekse financiële steun aan de Zimbabwaanse regering.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse voordracht van Ad Melkert bij de Internationale Arbeidsorganisatie ILO (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked whether the government would withdraw the candidacy of Ad Melkert for ILO Director-General, citing his past political remarks about Fortuyn and concerns about former Labour politicians receiving lucrative posts. The minister answered that Melkert is a good candidate, that social partners were closely involved and support the nomination, and that the ILO is important for the Netherlands.
Mr Melkert is a good candidate for the position of Director-General of the ILO.
De heer Melkert is een goede kandidaat voor de positie van Directeur-Generaal van de ILO.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de televisiereclames van subsidieclub Oxfam Novib (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about a television advertisement by the subsidised organisation Oxfam Novib, including how often such ads aired, their cost, and whether the money would be better spent on poverty reduction. The state secretary said the organisation sets its own media policy, the ads are paid from its own funds, and he sees no reason to meet the MP.
I do not have this information because it falls outside my mandate.
Over deze informatie beschik ik niet want dit valt buiten mijn mandaat.

Vragen van de leden Driessen en De Roon (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat UNESCO het zogenaamde «Palestina» heeft geaccepteerd als volw

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would cut or reduce its UNESCO funding after UNESCO admitted Palestine as a full member, following the US decision to stop its UNESCO funding. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, gave Dutch contribution figures (about 4.6 million euro mandatory in 2011, around 20 million total per year), and rejected any financial sanction as the Palestinian request is no reason to punish UNESCO.
No, the Palestinian application for full membership of UNESCO is no reason to punish UNESCO as an organisation.
Nee, de Palestijnse aanvraag voor volledig lidmaatschap van de UNESCO is geen reden om de UNESCO als organisatie te straffen.

Vragen van de leden Driessen en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het door ontwikkelingsorganisatie Cordaid ondersteunen van illegale vreemde

PVV MPs asked whether Cordaid's support for a protest by illegal migrants is misleading and whether its state subsidy should be withdrawn because it undermines government policy. The government answered that the protest claims are inaccurate, that Cordaid's advocacy is legitimate civil-society dialogue separate from its subsidised programmes, and that it sees no reason to revise the partnership.
The cabinet sees no reason to revise cooperation with CORDAID.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden de samenwerking met CORDAID te herzien.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de honderdduizenden euro's belastinggeld voor een opvoedingsproject voor Marokkanen (ingezonden

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about EUR 300,000 of public money for a parenting project for Moroccan families, arguing it conflicts with the coalition agreement's end of target-group policy and suggesting denaturalisation and deportation instead. The minister replied that parenting support is a municipal responsibility under decentralised youth policy, so no cut to the municipal fund is warranted, and that the government will pursue reforms to nationality revocation for serious offences.
Youth policy falls under decentralised policy. The municipality acts within the policy space it has.
Jeugdbeleid valt onder het gedecentraliseerde beleid. De gemeente handelt binnen de beleidsruimte die de gemeente heeft.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de Nexus-directeur de PVV fascistisch noemt. (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Nexus Institute director's remarks calling the PVV fascist should lead to a subsidy stop by the province of Noord-Brabant and whether the SER chair should sit on the Nexus supervisory board. The minister declined to judge the director's opinions, said subsidy decisions are for the province, and said the director's personal views are separate from the institute's subsidy and the SER chair's membership.
It is for the Noord-Brabant provincial executive to weigh the subsidisation of the Nexus Institute and other subsidy-receiving institutions.
Het is aan het bestuur van de provincie Noord-Brabant een afweging te maken betreffende de subsidiëring van het Nexus Instituut en andere subsidieontvangende instellingen.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de kosten van het SNV lobbykantoor in Washington DC (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about the SNV Washington office's cost overrun of 611,655 euro in 2010 against a 450,000 euro budget, and whether the annual report explanation was adequate. The state secretary said SNV's office is not a lobby office but focuses on fundraising and donor relations, and that SNV's supplementary explanation attributed the overrun to faster-than-expected growth of partnerships and higher recruitment and temporary staffing costs.
I share your view because this concerns a substantial cost overrun, and I have asked SNV for a more extensive explanation.
Ik deel uw mening omdat het hier om een forse kostenoverschrijding gaat en heb SNV om een uitgebreidere toelichting gevraagd.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de besteding van Europese hulpgelden via de VN (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about the European Court of Auditors' report on EU funds channelled through UN agencies in conflict countries, including whether he shares its negative verdict on effectiveness and oversight, the use of the term 'Palestine', and whether the EU should be involved in development aid at all. The state secretary shares the audit's analysis and recommendations on project timing and monitoring, rejects the characterisation of the verdict as negative, notes the Commission has already tightened reporting guidelines, and defends the EU's role in development cooperation.
I share the analysis of the European Court of Auditors and endorse the recommendations made.
Ik deel de analyse van de Europese Rekenkamer en onderschrijf de aanbevelingen die worden gedaan.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de graai- en bonuscultuur binnen subsidie-instituut Forum (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about alleged bonus and perk culture at subsidised institute FORUM, including luxury hotel stays and a director's salary, and whether the supervisory board can be trusted. The minister replied that subsidised bodies set their own secondary conditions, that the supervisory board is responsible, that no bonus scheme is known, and that a factual report has been requested for the parliamentary committee.

In response to the request from the parliamentary committee for a factual investigation into events at FORUM, I have asked the FORUM Supervisory Board to send me a factual account as soon as possible.

Mede naar aanleiding van het verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties van de Tweede Kamer voor een feitenonderzoek naar de gang van zaken binnen FORUM heb ik de Raad van Toezicht van FORUM verzocht om mij ten spoedigste een feitenrelaas te doen toekomen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de paranoïde uitspraken van vrijheidshater en voo

PVV MPs asked the government whether it shares the view that statements by Rabbae (LBM, Stop de Bezetting) about an alleged Israeli strategy are paranoid, how the LBM is funded, and whether Stop de Bezetting should ever receive subsidy, plus a question on the 1967 war. The government answered that it does not share Rabbae's views, that the LBM receives no direct or indirect state subsidy for its statutory activities, that subsidy is not an option given Stop de Bezetting's current positions, and restated its two-state position on the 1967 borders.
The Landelijk Beraad Marokkanen foundation receives neither direct nor indirect subsidy from the Dutch government for its statutory activities.
De stichting Landelijk Beraad Marokkanen ontvangt noch direct, noch indirect subsidiegelden van de Nederlandse overheid voor haar statutaire activiteiten.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de praktijken binnen de zwaar gesubsidieerde hulpclub SNV (ingezonden 1 juni 2011).

An MP asks whether SNV director Robert de Jongh remains in post in Latin America despite a negative internal audit, whether a senior ministry official with an SNV past is involved, and whether SNV hired a PR firm at taxpayer expense. The state secretary confirms de Jongh will leave SNV soon, declines to answer on the reported promotion talks, states the official's SNV background is managed under existing conflict-of-interest rules, and confirms a capped contract of 75,000 euro with a communications firm.
Ik kan op deze vraag geen antwoord geven.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verwevenheid van hulpclubs en het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (ingezonden 25 mei 2011).

An MP asks whether the DG International Cooperation, Joke Brandt, should step down from or be kept out of matters concerning the NGO SNV and the network Worldconnectors, given her past at SNV and her membership of a left-leaning network, and asks for an overview of ministry officials with NGO backgrounds. The state secretary rejects the premises, says her past does not hinder her duties and that conflicts of interest are prevented under existing rules, and says no structural overview exists.
No. No structural overview of that is available.
Nee. Daar is geen structureel overzicht van beschikbaar.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bizarre subsidiebeleid van het stadsdeel Amsterdam-Oost (ingezonden 18 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about subsidies granted by the Amsterdam-Oost district to organisations offering headscarf-folding lessons, funerals in Egypt and Turkish or Moroccan language classes, questioning how this fits the coalition agreement. The minister replied that municipalities set their own subsidy policy within legal limits, declined to judge Amsterdam's policy or accept the insulting characterisations, and planned no measures.
Decentralised governments are free, within the limits of the law, to determine their own subsidy policy.
Decentrale overheden zijn vrij om – binnen de grenzen van de wet – zelf hun subsidiebeleid te bepalen.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken over twee ton subsidie voor een handenweigeraar (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether Utrecht should reclaim a 200,000 euro subsidy to an organisation led by a man who refuses to shake women's hands, and whether that undermines its credibility on integration, and asked for research into the effect of the hajj on integration. The minister replied that the central government will not intervene in municipal subsidy clawbacks, that religious conviction does not by definition prevent promoting integration, and that such research is not meaningful because freedom of religion is compatible with the duty to integrate.
The cabinet assumes that Utrecht and other municipalities will settle accounts with subsidy recipients on the basis of the agreements made when the subsidy was granted.
Het kabinet gaat er vanuit dat Utrecht en andere gemeenten subsidieontvangers afrekenen op basis van de afspraken die gemaakt zijn bij de toekenning van de subsidie.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het salaris van ICCO-voorzitter Marinus Verweij (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about a salary increase for the ICCO chair Marinus Verweij and whether the supervisory board chair should have objected, given cuts to ICCO's subsidy. The state secretary confirmed the salary is within the DG-norm, said the salary is set by the subsidy recipient within that norm, and called the timing a separate question without committing to action.
Responsibility for setting the salary lies with the subsidy recipient, provided it does not exceed the DG-norm.
Verantwoordelijkheid voor de vaststelling van het salaris ligt, mits deze de DG-norm niet overschrijdt, bij de subsidieontvanger.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Driessen en Helder (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over straatcoaches (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether reported lying by street coaches (straatcoaches) to obtain subsidies was known, whether such subsidised projects should be stopped, and how lying coaches help keep neighbourhoods together. The minister answered that effectiveness and deployment are local matters, that coaches must behave properly with the responsibility of their employer and municipality, and that stopping subsidies is for the municipality to decide.
The decision to deploy street coaches, the way they are supervised and the assessment of their effectiveness is not for me but takes place at local level.
De keuze om straatcoaches in te zetten, de wijze waarop ze begeleid worden en de beoordeling van de effectiviteit is niet aan mij, maar vindt plaats op lokaal niveau.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat hulpclubs Hivos en SNV ervan worden beschuldigd intellectueel eigendom te hebben gestolen (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs whether development organisations Hivos and SNV had taken intellectual property from a biogas project in Africa and been funded for it with 30 million euros, and whether the subsidy would be reclaimed. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the report, said the ministry had financed the preparatory phase of an Africa biogas programme in 2007-2008 and that the intellectual property rests with the ministry, stated that Hivos received the 30 million euro subsidy while SNV contributed its own funds, and rejected the report as untrue.
No, Hivos received a subsidy of 30 million euros. SNV contributes from its own funds to the project.
Nee, Hivos kreeg een subsidie van 30 miljoen euro. SNV draagt uit zijn eigen middelen aan het project bij.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de door een linkse subsidieslurper gevoerde haatcampagne tegen het kabinet (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Interior Minister about a publicly funded campaign by the foundation Asri against the cabinet, including calls for repayment of a city-district subsidy and an end to future subsidies. The minister answers that the subsidy decisions and any recovery belong to the municipality and city district, and declines to act.
Whether or not to grant a subsidy falls within the municipality's policy discretion.
Het al dan niet verstrekken van subsidie behoort tot de beleidsvrijheid van de gemeente.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de moord op de Ugandese homo-activist David Kato (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

PVV MPs Bontes and Driessen asked the foreign minister whether the government shares outrage at the murder of Ugandan gay rights activist David Kato, whether it will put political pressure on Uganda to improve the position of homosexuals, and whether it will halt all development aid except emergency aid. The minister answered that the government is shocked, that the issue is raised in bilateral and EU dialogue and that donors pressed for protection of activists, but that stopping aid would not help the position of homosexuals.

The Netherlands will continue to hold the Ugandan authorities accountable for their responsibility to protect the rights of sexual minorities and press for a vigorous criminal investigation into the murder of David Kato.

Nederland zal de Ugandese autoriteiten blijven aanspreken op hun verantwoordelijkheid bij het beschermen van de rechten van seksuele minderheden en aandringen op voortvarend strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de moord op David Kato.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over ICCO en Electronic Intifada (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the foreign minister whether ICCO, a subsidised NGO, will stop its policy supporting boycotts and sanctions against Israel and whether it should be cut off from state funding. The minister replies that ICCO was told such activities do not fit government policy, that the ministry will monitor and may issue further instructions under the subsidy decision, and that ICCO's stance will be weighed in future funding applications, but that there is currently no reason to end its subsidy.
The ministry will keep a close eye on the situation in the coming period and, if necessary, issue further instructions within the framework of the applicable subsidy decision.
Het ministerie zal de komende tijd de vinger aan de pols houden en zo nodig overgaan tot het geven van nadere aanwijzingen binnen het kader van de geldende subsidiebeschikking.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de financiering van de haat-club «Electronic Intifada» (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether government and lottery funding to ICCO should be withheld because ICCO sponsors the website Electronic Intifada, and whether a motion excluding such organisations from subsidies should be implemented. The minister says state funding to the website conflicts with Dutch foreign policy, that ICCO has been informed and subsidy conditions allow redress up to reduction and appeal, that the lottery decides its own grants, and that subsidy consequences will be assessed if organisations break the law.
I am of the view that financial support from public funds, direct or indirect, to the website Electronic Intifada is contrary to the principles of Dutch foreign policy.

Ik ben van mening dat financiële ondersteuning uit overheidsmiddelen, rechtstreeks of indirect, aan de website Electronic Intifada in strijd is met de uitgangspunten van het Nederlands buitenlands beleid.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het enorme corruptieschandaal bij het Global Health Fund (ingezonden 27 januari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about large-scale fraud and corruption at the Global Fund, including fraud rates in Mauritania, Mali and Djibouti, and whether the Netherlands should stop funding it. The State Secretary confirmed the fraud findings, described the Inspector General's investigations and sanctions, and rejected halting Dutch contributions, while promising continued close monitoring.
Naturally we will keep following all developments closely and keep pressing for strict control mechanisms.
Vanzelfsprekend zullen we alle ontwikkelingen scherp blijven volgen en blijven aandringen op strikte controle mechanismen.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de stelling dat ontwikkelingshulp radicalisering tegen kan gaan (ingezonden 24 november 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs whether there is evidence that development aid can help address root causes of radicalisation, and posed two sarcastic questions about whether Bin Laden and Atta were hungry and whether the minister believes in fairy tales. The state secretary answered that radicalisation has many causes, that development activities are hard to apply to ideologically driven radicals but may help with socioeconomic marginalisation and political exclusion citing international studies, and answered the two rhetorical questions briefly.
Numerous international studies show that other groups and individuals radicalise because, for example, they are socioeconomically marginalised and/or politically excluded.
Uit tal van internationale studies 2 blijkt dat andere groepen en individuen radicaliseren, omdat ze, bijvoorbeeld, sociaaleconomisch worden gemarginaliseerd en/of politiek worden uitgesloten.

Vragen van de leden Bontes en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uithaal van de premier van Kenia naar homomannen (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

PVV MPs asked whether the minister is aware of reports that Kenya's prime minister called for arrest of gay men, whether they share outrage, and whether all development aid except emergency aid should be halted. The government answers that the prime minister has clarified his remarks, that it sees no reason for bilateral steps, and that bilateral aid flows through civil society rather than the Kenyan government.
We are of the view that the Kenyan government has already convincingly corrected the picture painted in the media and see no reason for bilateral steps.
Wij zijn van mening dat de Keniaanse regering het in de media geschetste beeld al overtuigend heeft rechtgezet en zien geen reden voor bilaterale stappen.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de financiële steun van het dictatoriale islamitische regime van Iran aan de Afghaanse president Hamid Karzai (ingezond

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Iran gives cash to President Karzai's office and whether this destabilises the region, and about Dutch funding and involvement in an Afghan reintegration trust fund. The minister said the government does not see Iran as a stabilising factor, that Dutch money mostly goes through international funds and partner organisations rather than directly to the Afghan government, and that the Netherlands has not committed to the reintegration fund pending its design.
The largest part of Dutch money flows through funds managed by international institutions such as the World Bank.
Het grootste deel van het Nederlandse geld loopt via fondsen die beheerd worden door internationale instellingen als de Wereldbank.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aan Oxfam Novib toegezegde honderden miljoenen euros belastinggeld (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about Oxfam Novib's government-funded grants, alleging links to anti-Israel activism, a donation to a group linked to a political case, funding of projects in large economies, and the conduct of its director Farah Karimi, and asked whether the funding should be withdrawn. The State Secretary answered that Oxfam Novib funds such activities from its own means, that Brazil and China qualify for aid under OECD criteria, that the director's residence history does not relate to costs to taxpayers, and that there is no reason to withdraw the subsidy.
I see no reason to cancel the subsidy granted to Oxfam Novib after all.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de aan Oxfam Novib toegekende subsidie alsnog te schrappen.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het onmiddelijk stoppen van ontwikkelingshulp aan Jemen (ingezonden 5 november 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs whether, after explosives were found in air cargo bound for the US, Yemen should be labelled a jihad breeding ground and development aid suspended immediately. The State Secretary rejected both the characterisation and an immediate aid stop, noting Dutch cargo restrictions on Yemen and a development programme being reviewed.
No. Development cooperation can make an important contribution to addressing the underlying causes of radicalisation.
Nee. Ontwikkelingssamenwerking kan een belangrijke bijdrage leveren aan het wegnemen van onderliggende oorzaken van radicalisering.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat ontwikkelingshulporganisatie SNV weigert de salarissen van haar directieleden te verlagen (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he knew that aid organisation SNV refused to cut its directors' salaries, whether he would publish salary overviews for all subsidised aid organisations, and whether the measures against SNV would apply to all aid organisations paying excessive director salaries. The government answered yes, with a salary overview of 106 organisations sent in a separate letter, and stated that from 1 January 2011 the DG-norm applies to MFS organisations, with agreements to be made with other organisations.
An annex to a separate letter to the Chamber of 27 October 2010 (ref. DSO/MO-480/10) provides an overview of director salaries of a total of 106 development organisations.
In de bijlage bij een separate Kamerbrief van 27 oktober 2010 (ref. DSO/MO-480/10) wordt een overzicht van directiesalarissen verstrekt van in totaal 106 ontwikkelingsorganisaties.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de onderdrukking van homo's in Oeganda (ingezonden 12 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about a Ugandan weekly calling for hanging of gay people and whether the president actively fosters repression of homosexuals, and whether all development aid to Uganda except emergency aid should stop. The minister shared the outrage and refused to halt aid, noting the article is press content rather than government policy and that the Media Council has suspended the paper on registration grounds.
This concerns an article in the Ugandan press and not government policy of Uganda.
