Het betreft hier een artikel in de Ugandese pers en geen regeringsbeleid van Uganda.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «EU grants Egypt 609 million euros for development» (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about the EU granting Egypt 609 million euros for development, questioning whether the EU should give aid, how much the Dutch taxpayer contributes, and whether the aid and bilateral aid should be stopped given rights abuses and military spending. The state secretary defended EU development cooperation as serving shared interests, estimated the Dutch share at about 30.45 million euros (5%), and refused to reverse the grant, citing its legal basis.
No. Support to Egypt from the EU budget has a legal basis, namely Regulation (EC) No 1638/2006.
Neen. De steun aan Egypte uit de EU-begroting heeft een wettelijke basis, te weten de Verordening (EG) nr. 1638/2006

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Driessen en Van Vliet (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over het bericht dat Duitsland de Inter

PVV MPs asked ministers whether the Dutch branch of the IHH aid organisation, banned in Germany over alleged Hamas funding, should be scrutinised, de-listed as an ANBI charity, or designated as terrorist. The government said it has no indications of IHH Netherlands financing Hamas, that AIVD assesses risks, that the ANBI integrity test is limited to criminal convictions, and that further study of Union of Good is promised.
The AIVD assesses and interprets any indications of risks from the perspective of national security.
De AIVD beoordeelt en duidt eventuele aanwijzingen voor risico's vanuit het belang van de nationale veiligheid.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over problemen met Nederlandse ontwikkelingshulp in Afghanistan (ingezonden 7 september 2010).

An MP from the PVV asks the foreign minister about a Dutch aid official's interview alleging that Afghans tell the Taliban that Dutch-funded projects are paid by Islamic donors, and whether aid money disappears through corruption, and asks for an immediate halt to aid except emergency relief. The minister replies that Dutch funds mostly flow through international institutions under strict controls and monitoring, that the population knows the projects are Dutch-funded, and that he sees no reason to stop aid.
The largest part of Dutch money flows through funds managed by international institutions such as the World Bank.
Het grootste deel van het Nederlandse geld loopt via fondsen die beheerd worden door internationale instellingen als de Wereldbank.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over ontwikkelingshulp door decentrale overheden (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

An MP asked whether Dutch municipalities, provinces and water boards spend money on development aid and whether central government will hold them to account for it. The government answered that no systematic data on local development aid spending is kept, pointed to a 2009 VNG survey, and stated that local authorities are autonomous and accountable to their councils, with no plan to intervene.
Neither central government nor national or umbrella organisations systematically keep information on spending on development cooperation by municipalities, provinces and water boards.

Door de rijksoverheid noch door landelijke- of koepelorganisaties wordt op systematische wijze informatie bijgehouden over uitgaven voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking door gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over noodhulp aan Pakistan (ingezonden 17 augustus 2010).

MP Driessen (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether 367 million euro of 2005 earthquake aid to Pakistan reached victims, whether every cent of current flood aid will reach victims, and whether aid controls will be tightened. The minister said the cited funds went to government reconstruction projects that cannot be verified, that flood aid goes via UN, Red Cross and NGOs reporting to the ministry, and that existing controls are sufficient.
The Netherlands cannot verify what happened to donations from other donors and aid organisations.
Nederland kan niet verifiëren wat er met donaties van andere donoren en hulporganisaties gebeurd is.

Vragen van de leden Driessen, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat christelijke slachtoffers van de overstromingen in Pakistan met betrekking tot de hulpverlening

Three PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Christian flood victims in Pakistan are denied water, food and aid in favour of Muslims. The minister answered that no signals of partiality had been received, that humanitarian principles require aid regardless of religion, and that he trusts these principles are applied in practice.
No signals have been received from humanitarian aid organisations, the Dutch embassy or other parties indicating partiality in humanitarian aid.
Er zijn geen signalen ontvangen van humanitaire hulporganisaties, van de Nederlandse ambassade of andere betrokkenen die duiden op partijdigheid bij de humanitaire hulpverlening.
Vragen van de leden Driessen en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over noodhulpverlening door een terroristische organisatie in Pakistan (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

PVV MPs Driessen and Wilders asked whether the government knew of emergency aid in Pakistan channelled through the militant group Jamaat e Dawa, condemned a hateful remark by one of its aid workers, and asked for a guarantee that no Dutch relief reaches such groups. Minister Verhagen confirmed awareness, condemned the remark as contrary to humanitarian principles, and said Dutch aid flows only via established humanitarian organisations (Red Cross, WFP, UNICEF, SHO) that uphold neutrality.
The Dutch government supports the flood victims through the International Red Cross, the World Food Programme, UNICEF and the Cooperating Relief Organisations (SHO).
De Nederlandse regering geeft steun aan de overstromingsslachtoffers via het Internationale Rode Kruis, het Wereldvoedselprogramma, UNICEF en de Samenwerkende Hulporganisaties (SHO).

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over subsidieverstrekking aan e

PVV MPs asked ministers about a municipal subsidy to Stichting Ar Rayaan, an organisation they called ultra-Islamic and anti-Western, including its views on polygamy, lessons in schools, and whether Nijmegen should reclaim the subsidy. The government answered that schools must respect legal limits but may introduce diverse worldviews, that municipalities are free to set subsidy policy within the law, and that the subsidy has since been stopped.
Decentralised governments are free, within the limits of the law, to determine their own subsidy policy.
Decentrale overheden zijn vrij om – binnen de grenzen van de wet – zelf hun subsidiebeleid te bepalen.

Vragen van de leden Driessen en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat slechts 2 procent van de toegezegde hulp Haïti heeft bereikt (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

PVV MPs Driessen and Wilders asked whether only 2 percent of pledged aid to Haiti had reached the country and where Dutch aid funds were, and whether they would be spent properly or returned. Minister Verhagen answered that the 2 percent figure referred to donor disbursements to the World Bank reconstruction fund, that Dutch emergency aid had been transferred to aid organisations which are funding projects, and that reconstruction funds will be disbursed from 2011 under agreed arrangements monitored by the government.
Agreements have been made with the aforementioned aid organisations on the proper use of the pledged aid.
Over de juiste besteding van de toegezegde hulp zijn afspraken gemaakt met de voornoemde hulporganisaties.
Vragen van de leden Driessen en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de EU haar hulp aan Afghanistan bevriest (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

PVV MPs Driessen and Bontes asked the foreign minister whether he agreed that corruption in Afghanistan is rampant and whether he would suspend aid as the EU reportedly did. The minister acknowledged corruption as a serious problem, cited Karzai's announced anti-corruption measures, and said the EU is not suspending aid but has postponed adopting its 2011-2013 programme until after the Kabul conference.
The European Union is not suspending development aid to Afghanistan.
De Europese Unie schort de ontwikkelingshulp aan Afghanistan niet op.
Vragen van de leden Driessen en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het intrekken van alle ontwikkelingshulp aan Suriname (ingezonden 21 juli 2010).

PVV MPs Driessen and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of Bouterse's election as Surinamese president and whether all development aid to Suriname will be halted immediately. The minister confirms he is aware and declines to stop aid, saying the new government will be judged on its actions and existing commitments will be honoured unless circumstances make this impossible.
The Netherlands will continue to pursue a businesslike and engaged relationship with Suriname.
Nederland blijft een zakelijke en betrokken relatie met Suriname nastreven.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders en Driessen (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de islamitische jihad tegen christenen in de Islamitische Republiek Pakistan (ingezonden 22 juli 2010).

MPs Kortenoeven, Wilders and Driessen asked the foreign minister about killings of Christians in Pakistan, whether the violence is systematic, Pakistan's blasphemy laws, whether Pakistan should sit on the UN Human Rights Council, and whether aid should be halted. The minister denied systematic persecution, described the government's diplomatic efforts and the blasphemy laws, and refused to end development aid.

The Netherlands, in consultation with other EU countries, expressed its concern to the Pakistani government about violence against Christians and other religious minorities after previous incidents and called for the perpetrators to be prosecuted.

Nederland heeft, in samenspraak met andere landen van de EU, na voorgaande incidenten de Pakistaanse overheid zijn zorgen over het geweld tegen christenen en andere religieuze minderheden kenbaar gemaakt en opgeroepen de daders te vervolgen.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat jaarlijks een derde van al het ontwikkelingsgeld weglekt (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether a third of global development aid leaks away through inefficiency, how much Dutch aid leaks, whether an investigation will be launched, and whether aid should be stopped except for emergency relief. The minister answers that the figure is not hard, that no investigation is warranted, that the Netherlands will not stop development cooperation, and points to aid results and international efficiency agreements.
Question 3: How much Dutch development money leaks away each year? Are you willing to launch an investigation?
Vraag 3 Hoeveel Nederlands ontwikkelingsgeld lekt jaarlijks weg? Bent u bereid een onderzoek in te stellen?

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over zijn verschillende antwoorden op de vraag of hij kan aangeven of door corrupte Afghanen ook Nederlandse hulpgelden Afghanistan zijn uitgesmokk

MP Driessen asked Foreign Minister Verhagen why his answers to a question on whether corrupt Afghans smuggled Dutch aid money out of the country differed between two versions. The minister said the first was a mistakenly sent draft, and that there is no evidence Dutch aid was smuggled, citing risk analysis and monitoring of funds managed by international bodies.
A draft version had mistakenly already been sent electronically to the Chamber.
Een conceptversie was abusievelijk reeds elektronisch naar de Kamer verzonden.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Keniaanse parlementariërs hun eigen salaris met 25 procent verhoogden en nu 11.000 euro per maand verdienen (ingezonden 5 juli

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch aid to Kenya should be stopped after Kenyan MPs raised their own salaries by 25 percent, and whether the minister agreed the rise was outrageous. The minister called the proposed rise exorbitant, but declined to halt aid for now, citing support for the Kenyan power-sharing accords and noting a planned independent salary commission in the new constitution.
For now I am not willing to halt aid to Kenya.
Ik ben vooralsnog niet bereid de hulp aan Kenia te staken.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat ontwikkelingsorganisatie SNV weigert het salaris van haar directeur te verlagen (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he would stop SNV's subsidy entirely because its director keeps a 160,000 euro salary, and whether the director and supervisory board chair are motivated by self-enrichment. The minister refused a full stop, opting instead for a subsidy reduction equal to the excess over the DG-norm, and said he has no reason to doubt the director's motives.
As I have previously informed the House, in this case I choose as a measure a reduction in the subsidy to SNV equal to the difference between the director's salary and the DG-norm
Zoals ik de Kamer eerder heb meegedeeld kies ik als maatregel in dit geval voor een korting op de subsidie aan SNV die gelijk is aan het verschil tussen het salaris van de directeur en de DG-norm

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat een Zuid-Afrikaanse hulporganisatie mogelijk enkele tonnen Nederlands belastinggeld heeft verduisterd (ingezonden 8 juli 2010)

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that a South African aid organisation may have embezzled several million euros of Dutch aid funds, and why intervention came so late. The minister confirmed irregularities up to about 700,000 euros, said recovery is being pursued through South African courts, and declined to tighten controls, citing existing risk analysis and monitoring.
In case of proven fraud, the funds will be recovered.
Bij bewezen fraude zullen de fondsen worden teruggevorderd.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Nederland miljoenen extra aan de Palestijnen geeft (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

MP Driessen (PVV) asked why the Netherlands gives extra funds to Palestinians in a Hamas-controlled region, whether the money could be used for jihad or incitement, and whether Dutch donations to UNRWA should be withdrawn. Minister Verhagen replied that the funds go to UNRWA as humanitarian aid, that UNRWA controls misuse of funds, and that Dutch support will continue because the aid is still needed before a peace agreement.
UNRWA is a reliable and neutral organisation that carefully checks whether the funds provided are not misused.
UNRWA is een betrouwbare en neutrale organisatie die nauwgezet controleert of verstrekte middelen niet worden misbruikt.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat gevreesd wordt dat ongeveer 2,5 miljard euro aan hulpgelden voor Afghanistan het land is uitgesmokkeld (ingezonden 30 juni 201

An MP asked the foreign minister whether around 2.5 billion euro of aid for Afghanistan, largely development funds, had been smuggled out via Kabul airport since 2007, whether Dutch aid was among it, and whether he would investigate and stop aid. The minister could not confirm the figure, said no evidence shows Dutch aid was smuggled, noted that most Dutch funds flow through World Bank and UNDP trust funds with audits, and declined to stop aid while pointing to Afghan anti-corruption investigations.
The Netherlands will welcome initiatives in this direction.
Nederland zal initiatieven in deze richting verwelkomen.
